Ŋ-la nɛ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa a pɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la faagaa lɛ lɩɩŋ sɩɩ lɩɩ disiniŋ ta.
16Dɩ baal nɛ fɩɩ bafɩɩrɩŋ, ʋ maga ʋ chaasa fo lɩɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ. 17Dɩ bafɩɩrɩ-la nɛ digi gɛrɩŋ koo teniŋ, ʋ maga ba joŋo chɛsɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ. 18Dɩ baal arɩ haal nɛ pɛ bɔsɔ aŋ sii, ʋ maga dɩ ba fo lɩɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ba ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.
19Dɩ haala nɛ hɛ tɩŋa, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ digu, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.
20Haal-la sɩ hɛ tɩŋa nɛ pɩŋ kʋŋ nyuŋ koo dɩ ʋ hɔnɔ nɛ, kʋ-la jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ. 21Dɩ nʋʋ na-kala nɛ digi ʋ kʋpɩnɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ nɛ a fo lɩɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ. 22-23Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ digi kʋŋ na-kala nyuŋ ʋ sɩ hɔnɔ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ nɛ a fo lɩɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.
24Dɩ baal nɛ kɛŋ haal-la sɩ hɛ tɩŋa pɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Bɔsɔ na-kala lɛ baal-la sɩ pɩna jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.
25Dɩ haal nɛ hɛ tɩŋa dɩ ʋ kieli bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ dɛrɛ, koo dɩ ʋ hɛ tɩŋa bʋa-la lɛ sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ hɛ, ʋ ha kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. 26Dɩ ʋ nɛ pɩŋ bɔsɔ kala lɛ, bɔsɔ-la kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ hɔŋ kʋŋ ma kala lɛ, kʋ-la ma jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ. 27Nʋʋ na-kala saa sɩ digi kɩaa deemba, ʋ tɩɩna ma kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ nɛ a fo lɩɩŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ.
28Dɩ ʋ tɩŋa-la nɛ dɛrɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ dɩɩsɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ nɛ, ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. 29Tapʋl-chori chɛɛŋ haal-la maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ kokosuŋ balɩa kaa mʋ pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ. 30Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ dɔŋɔ a sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a joŋ dɔŋɔ ma sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ŋ-la nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a pɩɩsɛ haal-la disiniŋ ta.
31Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ chagɩlɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa kɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ disiniŋ lɛ, dɩ ba sɩ́ disiniŋ ŋaa hɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ ma teeŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ba sɩ́ sʋʋ.’ ”
32Wombie-la sɩ maga baala faagaa lɛ lɩɩŋ sɩɩ lɩɩ koo baala sɩ fɩɩ bafɩɩrɩŋ chei ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋɩɩ, 33arɩ haala sɩ hɛ tɩŋa koo haala sɩ hɛ tɩŋa bʋa-la lɛ sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ hɛ koo baala sɩ kɛŋ haala sɩ hɛ tɩŋa pɩŋ a kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.

Title: LEVI DOHO NƖAA 16
Content:
Disiniŋ pɩɩsɩŋ tapʋlʋŋ
1Arɔŋ hambolibiisi-la balɩa sɩ mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a nyɩgɛ nyiŋ-la ʋ sɩ bɩ ba daga a sʋʋ, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 2“Bʋla pɩ ŋ naambie Arɔŋ, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ jʋʋ, lee-la Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la sɩ chɩna, bʋa na-kala lɛ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ vɩa aŋ jʋʋ, ʋ jaŋ sʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩmɛ nɛ mɩ yie to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ lɛ a kʋ tuu daga-la nii-tɔlɔ nyuŋ.
3Dɩ Arɔŋ nɩɩ chɛ ʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ, bʋa-la sɩ maga, see dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ arɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pie-bele a kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. 4Ʋ jaŋ joŋ ʋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ gɛrɩ-duduoŋ-la a laalɛ, a joŋ ʋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ kpʋŋ-kpeli kuuŋ a vɔɔ, a joŋ gɛrɩ-la gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie a vɔɔ, a joŋ nyu-bɛlɛ bɛ. Gɛnnɩŋ deemba ŋaa Wɩa kɩaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ maga dɩ ʋ fo lɩɩŋ aŋ-na laalɛba. 5Ʋ jaŋ laa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ gbuŋgbogusuŋ balɩa arɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pie-bele Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ.
6Arɔŋ jaŋ kɛŋ nɛ-bele a sʋl ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. 7Ʋ jaŋ kɛsɛ gbuŋgbogusu-la balɩa a kaa kɔ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ. 8Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tɔnsɔ lɩɩsɛ gbuŋgbogusu-la tʋɔŋ kʋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA arɩ kʋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo ta. 9Dɩ Arɔŋ nɛ kʋ jɩŋ gbuŋgbogo-la sɩ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋa, ʋ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. 10Bʋʋŋ-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ joŋo ta, ʋ jaŋ kɛnʋ mʋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ aŋ joŋo ta dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ mʋ.
11Arɔŋ jaŋ kɛŋ nɛ-bele a sʋl ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, aŋ kpʋ. 12Ʋ jaŋ mʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a joŋ kʋ-la lɛ ba sɩɩ hɛ nyiniŋ a chaanɛ nyiŋ-halaa su a ŋaa kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma ba sɩ nɔmɔ ba bii, nɩsɩŋ sɩɩŋ bʋlɩa, a kaa jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ. 13Nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ joŋ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋ-la sʋɔra sɩ sɩma hɛ nyiŋ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba nyʋɔsʋŋ sii tɔ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la arɩ ʋ nii-tɔlɔ, dɩ ʋ sɩ́ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la nii-tɔlɔ na a sʋʋ. 14Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ-bele-la chalɩŋ a kɛŋ ʋ neniiŋ tagɛ a mɩsɛ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la nii-tɔlɔ aŋ bɩra tagɛ a mɩsɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ.
15Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ʋ jaŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ bʋʋna a ŋaa ʋ chalɩŋ kaa jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ a ŋaa mɩsɛ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la nii-tɔlɔ nyuŋ aŋ ŋaa mɩsɛ daga-la sɩpaaŋ ma arɩ ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kɛŋ nɛ-bele-la chalɩŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. 16Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ pɩɩsɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ disiniŋ ta nɛ, disiŋ-la arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa hɛ lee-la. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ ma lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ma kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. 17Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ hɛ lɛbɩ-la mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ tʋɔŋ bʋa-la lɛ Arɔŋ sɩ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta, see dɩ ʋ pɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala disiniŋ ta a dɛrɛ.
18Ʋ jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la teeŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a pɩɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la ma disiniŋ ta. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ-bele-la arɩ bʋʋŋ-la chalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ a taa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyilliŋ. 19Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ neniiŋ a tagɛ chal-la a mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la lɛ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ a pɩɩsɛ disiŋ-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa hɛ ʋ lɛ ta, aŋ joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ bɩra ŋaa Wɩa kʋzɔŋ.
Bʋʋŋ-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ bʋl ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ aŋ joŋo ta dɩ ʋ mʋ
20Dɩ Arɔŋ nɛ pɩɩsɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ disiniŋ ta dɛrɛ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ arɩ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ arɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ bʋ-wei-la kaa kɔ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ, 21a joŋ ʋ nɩsaa daŋ bʋ-wei-la nyuŋ lɛ, aŋ bʋl wʋbɔmɔ-la, arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ vɩa Wɩa niiŋ aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la kala a hɛ bʋʋŋ-la lɛ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ kiri bʋʋŋ-la kaa mʋ ta tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. 22Nɩalɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala jaŋ hɛ bʋʋŋ-la lɛ dɩ nɩɩ-la kire mʋ ta lee nʋʋkala sɩ tuo.
23Arɔŋ jaŋ bɩra jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ tʋɔŋ a wuri gɛnnɩ-la ʋ sɩ laala jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a bil. 24Ʋ jaŋ fo lɩɩŋ lee sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, aŋ paa ʋ gɛnnɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ laalɛ, aŋ kʋ lɩɩ a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ nɩalɩŋ disiniŋ ta. 25Ʋ jaŋ joŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna-la nʋʋŋ a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ.
26Nɩɩ-la sɩ kiri bʋʋŋ-la kaa lɩɩ ta maga ʋ ma fo lɩɩŋ nɛ a chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ aŋ-na kʋ jʋʋ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ. 27Nɛ-bele-la arɩ bʋʋŋ-la ba sɩ kaa sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a kɛŋ chalɩŋ kaa jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta, maga dɩ ba kaa lɩɩ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ a nyɩgɛ ba tenniŋ, ba nammɩa arɩ ba tʋɔŋ kɩaa kala. 28Nɩɩ-la sɩ nyɩgɛ kɩaa deemba maga dɩ ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ a fo lɩɩŋ aŋ-na mɩɩra jʋʋ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ.
29Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ ma sɩ jaŋ tuto a kaa mʋ wuu: Jɩna na-kala chɛŋ pɛɩ lɛ tapʋlaa fii chɛɛŋ, Iziral tɩɩna koo nʋhʋɔrʋ kala sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ maga dɩ ʋ vɔɔ niiŋ a sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ, 30bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlʋŋ deeŋ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta dɩ ma sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. 31Tapʋlɩɩ-la maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa chɛ-wiesii nɛ dɩ ma vɔɔ niiŋ a sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ ma sɩ jaŋ tuto a kaa mʋ wuu. 32Bʋa na-kala lɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ nɛ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ laalɛ gɛnnɩ-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩɩ laalʋ nɛ, 33a ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala a pɩɩsɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ disiniŋ ta, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a hɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la harɩŋ arɩ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ.
34Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ ma sɩ jaŋ tuto a kaa mʋ wuu: Jɩna tʋɔŋ ʋ maga dɩ ba pɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta bala.”
Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis.

Title: LEVI DOHO NƖAA 17
Content:
Wɩa sɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ́ chalɩŋ dii
1La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 2“Bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala: ‘Wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dagɛ: 3Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna kala nɛ kɛŋ nɛ-bele koo pie-pɔrʋŋ koo bʋʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ koo dɩ ʋ kaa lɩɩ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ nɛ, 4aŋ bɩ kaa mʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, má joŋ tɩɩna arɩ ʋ jaasɛ chalɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ jaasɛ chal-la ŋɩɩ, má keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ. 5Ŋ-la daga arɩ Iziral tɩɩna kala sɩ́ ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna kpʋ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ. Ba maga dɩ ba kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kaa mʋ pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ dɩ ʋ joŋo sʋl nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 6Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ pʋna-la chalɩŋ a mɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la sɩ chɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ aŋ joŋ pʋna-la nʋʋŋ nyɩgɛ, ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 7Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba bɩra kpaarɛ vʋɩ kala, kɩalɩŋ lɛ ba fa sɩ to a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ a pɩ ma dɩ ma doho kala dɩ ma tuto.’ 8Bʋla pɩba, ‘Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna koo dɩ nʋhʋɔrʋ nɛ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koo Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ dɔŋ, 9aŋ bɩ kaa mʋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ maga dɩ ba keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.
10Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna koo nʋhʋɔrʋ sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ dii chalɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ vɩa nɩɩ-la a keru ta mɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ. 11Kʋŋ na-kala sɩ weye mɩɩsɩŋ hɛ ʋ chalɩŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ nɛ mɩ joŋo pɩma dɩ ma kaa pɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tɩta Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ, chalɩŋ nɛ yie pɩɩsɛ nʋʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta ka ʋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. 12Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ bʋlaa pɩ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ nʋhʋɔra-la kala sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, má sɩ́ chalɩŋ dii.
13Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna koo nʋhʋɔrʋ kala sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ mʋ nambagɩlɩŋ a kpʋ bagɩl koo diibie kala ma sɩɩ chaŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma keri ʋ chalɩŋ hugi, 14bɛɛ wɩaa kʋŋkala sɩ weye mɩɩsɩŋ hɛ ʋ chalɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ sɩ má sɩ́ kʋŋkala chalɩŋ dii ŋɩɩ. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ die, ʋ maga ma keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.
15Dɩ ma kʋŋkala koo nʋhʋɔrʋ nɛ dii kʋŋ sɩ sʋʋ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ koo dɩ baga kʋŋ nɛ kpʋa, tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ chɛsɛ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ a fo lɩɩŋ. Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, ʋ ha jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ. Dɩ wɩa nɛ jʋa, ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. 16Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ chɛsɛ a fo lɩɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.’ ”

Title: LEVI DOHO NƖAA 18
Content:
Haalaa arɩ baalaa dɔŋɔba pɩnɩŋ wɩaa
1La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 2“Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala: ‘Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. 3Má pɔ má sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ ŋaa to, lee-la ma fa sɩ hɛ, arɩ wɩalɩŋ Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ ŋaa lee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɛmma mʋ. 4Má to mɩ wombiee a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma, mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. 5Má to mɩ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma, nɩɩ-la kala sɩ toba, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.
6Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ naambie pɩŋ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.
7Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ nyɩmma hɩɩsʋ a kɛŋ ŋ naaŋ pɩŋ. Ŋ naaŋ nɛ, sɩ́ ʋ kaa pɩŋ.
8Sɩ́ ŋ nyɩmma hɩɩsʋ a kɛŋ ŋ naaŋ hadɔŋɔ pɩŋ.
9Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ dɩhaala kaa pɩŋ, ŋ nyɩmma tolo koo ŋ naaŋ tolo, dɩ ba lʋl ma kala dɩ-bala nɛ koo dɩ ba lʋlʋ lee dɔŋ nɛ.
10Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ nihiŋ kaa pɩŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ.
11Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ naaŋ hadɔŋɔ tolo ŋ nyɩmma sɩ lʋla kaa pɩŋ, ʋ ŋaa ŋ dɩhaala nɛ.
12Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ ŋ nyɩmma dɩhaala kaa pɩŋ, ʋ ŋaa ŋ nyɩlɩma nɛ.
13Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ naaŋ ŋaana kaa pɩŋ, ŋ naaŋ kʋbie nɛ.
14Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ nyɩmma kʋbie hɩɩsɩŋ hɛ a kɛŋ ʋ haala pɩŋ, ŋ naaŋ nɛ.
15Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ nanʋala haala kaa pɩŋ, ŋ bii-haala nɛ.
16Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ naambie haala kaa pɩŋ a hɛ ŋ naambie hɩɩsɩŋ.
17Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ haala arɩ ʋ tolo kala kaa pɩŋ koo haal-la nihee. Ma pɛ chalɩŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ.
18Dɩ ŋ haala nɛ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ jaa ʋ ŋaana dɩ ba ŋaa hadɔsɛ.
19Dɩ haala nɛ hɛ tɩŋa, pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ʋ kaa pɩŋ, ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.
20Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ nʋʋ haal kaa pɩŋ a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ŋ tɩtɩa lɛ.
21Má pʋpɔ ma sɩ́ ma bii kaa pa dɩ ba kaa kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk, a hɛ ma Wɩa hɩɩsɩŋ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA.
22Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ ŋ ba-dɔŋɔ kaa pɩŋ, arɩ nɩa sɩ yie kɛŋ haala pɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋʋ kɩsɛ nɛ.
23Baal kala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ pʋna pɩŋ. Haal ma bɩ maga dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ pʋna kɛnʋ pɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋberige nɛ.
24Má pʋpɔ ma sɩ́ wɩaa deemba kʋŋ ŋaa a kɛŋ disiniŋ. Lee-la ma sɩɩ mʋ wɩaa deemba nɛ baa ŋaa, mɩɩ chɛ mɩ kiriba ta tintee-la lɛ. 25Wɩalɩŋ nɛ ba ŋaa tintee-la kala kɛŋ disiniŋ, mɩ dɔgɩsɛba a kiriba ta tintee-la lɛ. 26Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ maga dɩ má to mɩ wombie-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛ nɛ. Má sɩ́ disiŋ wɩaa deemba kʋŋkala ŋaa. 27Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ ŋaa disiŋ wɩaa deemba nɛ a chei tintee-la kala. 28Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa disiŋ wɩaa deemba tintee-la lɛ, mɩ jaŋ kirima ta arɩ mɩ sɩ kiri nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ ta ŋɩɩ.
29Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ ŋaa wʋkɩsaa deemba, ʋ maga dɩ má keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ. 30Má ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma, aŋ sɩ́ disiŋ wɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ a ŋɩŋaa to a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ma tɩtɩa lɛ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.’ ”

Title: LEVI DOHO NƖAA 19
Content:
Tʋɔpʋla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ Wombiee
1La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 2“Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala: ‘Má sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna Wɩa bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.
3Má zizil ma nyɩmmaba arɩ ma naamba, a tuto mɩ chɛ-wiesii-la woruŋ, mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.
4Má sɩ́ mɩ vɩa aŋ kpʋkpaarɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ koo a kɛŋ hɔɔŋ libi vesiŋ a pɩ ma tɩtɩa. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.
5Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma ŋaa nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, má to wombie-la mɩ sɩ daga dɩ mɩ laa ma sʋla. 6Má chaŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nammɩa-la tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa ma sɩ ŋaa koo chɛ-lɩa chɛɛŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ka tapʋl-tori chɛɛŋ, má joŋo nyɩga ta. 7Dɩ ma nɛ chaŋ nammɩa-la tapʋl-tori chɛɛŋ, ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA bɩ sɛɩ. 8Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ chaŋa, ʋ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ kʋ-la sɩ zɔmɔ Wɩa teeŋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ maga ma keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ.
9Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ma bagɩsɩŋ kɩaa, má sɩ́ sɛŋ-keree kɩaa ŋaa, ma bɩra sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ a kuuni ma. 10Má bɩra sɩ́ ma girep nɛnɛɛ mɩɩra mʋ tɔrɛ a sɩ́ nɛnɛ-la ma sɩ tele paa, má lemba pɩ summo arɩ nʋhʋɔraa dɩ ba mʋ kuuni. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.
11Má sɩ́ gaa.
Má sɩ́ wɩaa nyɩa.
Má sɩ́ dɔŋɔba ma nyɩsʋ.
12Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ wɩaa nyɩa aŋ ŋmɩɛsɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ a chei mɩ yɩrɩŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.
13Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ dɔŋɔba gɩrɩmʋ koo a kɛŋ dɔŋɔba kɩaa lɩlaa. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ tɩma pɩŋ ka ŋ timu, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ moribiiŋ chʋa ŋ teeŋ.
14Má fá mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a sɩ́ taŋɩŋ tʋʋsʋ koo a joŋ kʋa bil nyʋlɩma sɩpaaŋ dɩ ʋ gɛrɛ tel.
15Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ wʋtɩtɩɩ joŋo faa. Má sɩ́ summo gʋrʋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ bɩ kʋŋ kɛnɛ wɩaa, a sɩ́ kɩaa tɩɩna ma lɛ pɛ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa. Má dii nʋʋkala sarɩya arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. 16Má sɩ́ gɔllɔ chichei ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa yɩrɩŋ.
Má sɩ́ ma naambiiriŋ joŋo hɛ wɩaa lɛ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.
17Sɩ́ ŋ naambie bɛrʋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ pʋ, dɩ ŋ sɩ́ pɛ laa cheeriŋ.
18Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ tʋɔŋ kɛŋ arɩ ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna aa chɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wɩaa tiŋ chɩŋŋaa, ama cho ŋ dɔŋɔ arɩ ŋ sɩ cho ŋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.
19Má kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga tɩtɩŋ.
Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ pʋŋ-wogusuŋ jɩjɩl dɔŋɔ. Má sɩ́ kʋdo wogusuŋ balɩa joŋo duu bagɩ-bala lɛ.
Má sɩ́ gɛrɩpɛ wogusuŋ balɩa ba sɩ kaa yɛrɛ gɛrɩŋ laalʋ.
20Dɩ yoŋ-haal nɛ ha bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa time laa koo nɩɩ-la sɩ yɔbʋʋ ha bɩ ʋ joŋo ta, ka dɩ baal bilu a bɩ ʋ naasɩŋ to ka dɩ ba-wogo kɛŋ haal-la pɩŋ, ba maga dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛ haal-la arɩ baal-la sɩ kɛnʋ pɩŋ nɛ. Ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋba. 21Baal-la maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ pie-bele nɛ kɔ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ a sʋl cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 22Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pie-bele-la a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ nɩɩ-la wʋbɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa ta mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛʋ.
23Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ Kɛnaŋ tintee-la a chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩ-la nɛnɛɛ ma sɩɩ dii, dɩ ba nɛ kʋ nɛŋ, má kɩkɩsɛba jɩsɩŋ batori. 24Jɩ-nɛsɛ lɛ, má joŋ tɩɩnɛnɛ-la kala hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ a zilmi. 25Ama jɩ-nɔŋ lɛ, ma jaŋ wuo didii tɩɩnɛnɛ-la. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ jaŋ wasɛ woruŋ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.
26Má sɩ́ nammɩa ha sɩ kɛŋ chalɩŋ chaŋ. Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ vʋgʋ, a sɩ́ chichiribi wɩaa ma ŋaa. 27Má pʋpɔ má sɩ́ ma nyusuŋ sɛsɩŋ kɛ, a sɩ́ ma tɔŋŋɔɔ ma kɛ. 28Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sʋba, ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ ŋɩɩ wɩaa tɩŋ a kpɛrɛ ma tɩtɩa. Má sɩ́ kɩaa tuuro hɛ ma yaraa lɛ. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA.
29Má pʋpɔ ma toloo sɩ́ berimu a ŋɩŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, tintee-la kala jaŋ su arɩ hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.
30Má to mɩ chɛ-wiesii-la woruŋ aŋ zizil lee-la ma sɩ kʋʋ zilmi. Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma TƖƖNA.
31Má sɩ́ vʋgʋ, a sɩ́ kantɔŋ dɩɩsɩŋ ma jʋʋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ disiniŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.
32Má fá ma Wɩa a leŋ dɩ ma sɩɩŋ susu nɩhɩasɩŋ a zizilba. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.
33Dɩ nʋhʋɔrʋ nɛ hɔŋ ma tinteeŋ lɛ, má pʋpɔ má sɩ́ ʋ walɩmʋ. 34Nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɛ ma tinteeŋ lɛ, má kɛmba woruŋ arɩ ma naambiiriŋ. Má choba arɩ ma sɩ cho ma tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ. Ma ma fa ŋaa nʋhʋɔra nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.
35Má pʋpɔ má sɩ́ nʋʋ gʋrʋ, a mʋʋ tɩgɛ kɩaa magɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba yuŋuŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ yʋga magɛ lɛ. 36Má kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kaa magɩsɛ kɩaa a magɩsɛ kɩaa woruŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ ma lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.
37Má to mɩ niiŋ arɩ wombie-la kala mɩ sɩ daga. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.’ ”

Title: LEVI DOHO NƖAA 20
Content:
Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩ chei, ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaaʋ
1La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 2“Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, dɩ ba kʋŋ koo nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ kʋŋ nɛ joŋ ʋ bie pa dɩ ba kaa kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala maga dɩ ba yagɛ tɩɩna kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa. 3‘Mɩ jaŋ vɩa tɩɩna a keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ joŋ ʋ bie pa ba kaa kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk wɩaa. Ʋ ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ mɩ-na Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ nɛ a chei mɩ yɩrɩ-zɔŋ-la. 4Dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ na nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ ʋ bie pa ba kaa kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk aŋ vɩa dɩ ba kpʋʋ, 5mɩ-na tɩtɩa jaŋ joŋ mɩ sɩaa a chaasɛ nɩɩ-la arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa, a keriba ta ba nɩaa tʋɔŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ vɩa mɩ niiŋ aŋ to ba harɩŋ kpʋkpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk.
6Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ sɩaa chaasɛ nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ jʋʋ vʋgʋrʋ-dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ kantɔŋ-dɩɩsɩŋ a keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ. 7Má joŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. 8Má to mɩ niiŋ arɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ dagɛma. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ leŋe ma ŋaa nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.
9Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bʋl wʋbɔŋ hɛ ʋ nyɩmma koo ʋ naaŋ lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ʋ sʋʋŋ.
10Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kɛŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ haala pɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋ baal-la arɩ haal-la kala nɛ.
11Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma haala pɩŋ, ʋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ nyɩmma nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋ baal-la arɩ haal-la kala. Ba tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ba sʋʋŋ.
12Dɩ baal nɛ kɛŋ ʋ bii-haala pɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋ baal-la arɩ haal-la kala, wʋberige nɛ ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ba sʋʋŋ.
13Dɩ baal nɛ kɛŋ ʋ ba-dɔŋɔ pɩŋ arɩ ba sɩɩ pɩŋ haala ŋɩɩ, ba ŋaa wɩɩ sɩɩ kɩsʋ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ma kpʋba nɛ. Ba tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ba sʋʋŋ.
14Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ jaa haal arɩ ʋ tolo kala, ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ maga má nyɩgɛ ba kala batori a giri wʋbɔŋ-la ta ba tʋɔŋ.
15Dɩ baal nɛ kɛŋ pʋna pɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋ baal-la arɩ pʋna-la kala.
16Dɩ haal ma nɛ leŋe dɩ pʋna kɛnʋ pɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋ haal-la arɩ pʋna-la kala, ba tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ba sʋʋŋ.
17Dɩ baal nɛ jaa ʋ dɩhaala, ʋ nyɩmma tolo koo ʋ naaŋ tolo a kɛnʋ pɩŋ, ʋ ŋaa hɩɩsɛ wɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ má keriba ta ba nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ʋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ dɩhaala nɛ, ʋ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.
18Dɩ baal nɛ kɛŋ haala sɩ hɛ tɩŋa pɩŋ, ba ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ma keriba ta ba nɩaa tʋɔŋ.
19Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma dɩhaala koo ʋ naaŋ naambii pɩŋ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa hɩɩsɛ nɛ. Ba jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.
20Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma kʋbie haala pɩŋ, ʋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ nyɩm-bie nɛ. Ba jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ sʋʋ dɩ ba bɩ bii lʋla. 21Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ laa ʋ naambie haala jaa, ʋ ŋaa disiŋ nɛ. Ʋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ naaŋ-bile nɛ, ba jaŋ sʋʋ dɩ ba bɩ bii lʋla.
22Má to mɩ niiŋ arɩ wombie-la kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma wuo hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛŋ maa mʋ. Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, tintee-la bɩ jaŋ laama. 23Má sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kiri tintee-la lɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ to. Wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma, ba kala nɛ ba ŋaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɛrɛba. 24Ama mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, mɩ jaŋ joŋ ba tintee-la sɩ sɩma a kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ a pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ nɛ lɩɩsɛma tinteyee kala tʋɔŋ. 25Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ pʋsʋŋ arɩ bagɩla-la sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ bʋa, a bɩra jɩŋ fille-la sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ fille-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ma bʋa. Má pɔ ma sɩ́ pʋna koo bagɩl koo zaarʋ koo kʋŋ na-kala sɩɩ tuuri tinteeŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa arɩ ba kɛŋ disiniŋ chaŋ. 26Má joŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, mɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Mɩ nɛ lɩɩsɛma tinteyee kala tʋɔŋ dɩ ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.
27Dɩ baal koo haal nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a ŋaa vʋgʋrʋ koo kantɔŋ yɩrɩrʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma yagɛba kpʋ, arɩ tabɩaa, ba tɩtɩa nɛ chɛ ba sʋʋŋ.’ ”

Title: LEVI DOHO NƖAA 21
Content:
Wɩalɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ maga dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa
1La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, dɩ ba kʋŋ naambii nɛ sʋba, ʋ sɩ́ ʋ digu a kɛŋ disiniŋ. 2Ama ʋ naaŋ koo ʋ nyɩmma, ʋ nanʋala koo ʋ tolo, ʋ ŋaana koo ʋ malɩma, kʋŋ nɛ sʋba, ʋ jaŋ wuo digi. 3Dɩ ʋ dɩhaal ma nɛ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ a bɩ bala jaa aŋ sʋʋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo digi. 4Dɩ ʋ haala naambii nɛ sʋba, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ digi ʋ kʋsʋʋŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ.
5Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩ maga dɩ ba fʋŋ ba nyusuŋ koo a kɛ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ koo a kpɛrɛ ba yaraa dɩ ba nɩɩ yel yoho. 6Ba bɩ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ disiniŋ a chei mɩ-na ba Wɩa yɩrɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ lɩɩsɛba nɛ dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa a nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa pɩpɩmɛ a ŋaa kʋ diilee Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩmɛ. Ba bɩ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ disiniŋ.
7Ba bɩ maga dɩ ba jaa haala-la sɩ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa aa hɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa, koo haala-la sɩ vɩa ba balaba, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩ maga ba kɛŋ disiniŋ mɩ-na ba Wɩa teeŋ. 8Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa maga dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɛ joŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋdiilee a pɩpɩ mɩ-na ma Wɩa. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, a leŋ ma ma bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.
9Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara tolo nɛ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ, ʋ hɛ ʋ nyɩmma hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ tolo-la a nyɩgɛ.
10Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tʋɔŋ kʋhɩaŋ, nɩɩ-la ba sɩ chaasa lɩɩsɛ a wansɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nʋʋŋ hɛ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ, dɩ́ ʋ nɛ laalɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ gɛnnɩŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ vɩa ʋ nyuŋ ta koo a kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aa dagɛ arɩ ʋʋ yel yoho nɛ. 11Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ mʋ kpagɛ sʋʋŋ, dɩ ʋ naaŋ koo ʋ nyɩmma nɛ sʋba ma, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ. 12Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tʋɔŋ a yel yoho a ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ ʋ tɩtɩa arɩ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba lɩɩsʋ nɛ a joŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nʋʋ-la tɩsʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.
13Haal-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ jaa maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa hapuŋ nɛ. 14Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ jaa yo-haal koo haal arɩ ʋ bala sɩ vɩa dɔŋɔ koo haal-la sɩ ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa a hɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ jaa hapuŋ nɛ ʋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, 15dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ ʋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarɩ-hɩaŋ.”
16La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis, 17“Bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ, ʋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋmʋ, dɩ nʋʋ yaraa nɛ kɛŋ nyɔɔ, ʋ bɩ maga ʋ kʋ joŋ kʋdiilee Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ ʋ Wɩa. 18Dɩ nʋʋ yaraa nɛ kɛŋ nyɔɔ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kʋ kpagɛmɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ nyʋlɩma, koo dɩ ʋ nɛ gbɛrɩgɛ koo dɩ ʋ yaraa nɛ bɩ chese koo a ŋaa jɩgɩla jɩgɩla. 19Dɩ nʋʋ naaŋ koo ʋ nɩsɩŋ nɛ sʋba, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋdiilee kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ. 20Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ gʋma koo a faasa kui, koo dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ sɩɩ-togo, koo dɩ ʋ lee nɛ ŋmɛrɛ a lɩlɩɩ nʋɔlʋŋ, koo dɩ ʋ luribiee nɛ yɛrɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋdiilee kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ. 21Dɩ Arɔŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara doho nʋʋ yaraa nɛ kɛŋ nyɔɔ, nɩɩ-la bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kʋ nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kʋ joŋ kʋdiilee Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ma pɩ mɩ-na ʋ Wɩa. 22Ʋ jaŋ wuo dii kʋdiile-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ba sɩ yie joŋo pɩ mɩ-na ma Wɩa, kɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ. 23Ama a tɩŋ ʋ yaraa sɩ kɛŋ nyɔɔ ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kʋ kpagɛ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ, koo patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔmʋŋ arɩ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ kaa kpaa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ lee-la. Mɩ-na nɛ ma TƖƖNA a leŋ lere-la bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ.”
24Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bʋl wɩaa deemba kala pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala.

Title: LEVI DOHO NƖAA 22
Content:
Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa bɩ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ disiniŋ
1La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 2“Bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɩ ba sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a chei Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ yie kaa kʋ pɩmɛ ŋaa. Ba sɩ́ wɩalɩŋ ŋaa a chei mɩ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.
3Bʋla pɩba, ba doho kala tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ disiniŋ, ʋ pʋpɔ ʋ sɩ́ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ yie kaa kʋ pɩ mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA kʋ kpagɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ vɩa aŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ kiri tɩɩna ta mɩ sɩpaaŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.
4Dɩ Arɔŋ doho nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ nyanyal cholii koo lɩɩŋ lɩlɩɩ ʋ faagaa lɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ dii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo pɩ Wɩa, see ba pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta. Dɩ Arɔŋ doho Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋŋ nɛ digi sʋʋŋ koo dɩ bafɩɩrɩŋ nɛ lɩɩ ʋ lɛ, 5koo dɩ ʋ nɛ digi kɩalɩŋ sɩɩ vaamɛ tinteeŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ koo dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa disiŋ-la hɛ ʋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ. 6Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ digi kʋdosunuŋ deemba, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ dii kʋzɔmɔ-la ba sɩ joŋo pɩ Wɩa, see dɩ ʋ fo lɩɩŋ. 7Dɩ wɩa nɛ jʋa ʋ bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ ʋ jaŋ wuo dii Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo pɩ Wɩa, ba ŋaa ʋ kʋdiilee nɛ. 8Ʋ bɩ maga ʋ chaŋ kʋŋ sɩ sʋʋ pimee koo kʋŋ baga kʋa sɩ kpʋa, dɩ ʋ nɛ chaŋa, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.
9Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa maga dɩ ba tuto wombie-la mɩ sɩ dagɛba nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ba jaŋ laa cheeriŋ a to ŋɩɩ lɛ sʋʋ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA a leŋ ma bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.
10Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɩa nɩaa dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ wuo dii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ. Nʋhʋɔrʋ sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ koo pachɩŋ-diiru sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ bɩ jaŋ wuo dii. 11Ama dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ yɔɔ yomo koo dɩ ba lʋl yomo-la ʋ dɩa lɛ nɛ, ʋ-na jaŋ wuo dii. 12Dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara tolo nɛ jaa nʋʋ sɩ tuo Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ, tolo-la ma bɩ jaŋ wuo dii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ. 13Ama dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara tolo nɛ ŋaa yo-haal koo ʋ dɩ ʋ bala nɛ vɩa dɔŋɔ, dɩ ʋ bɩ bii kɛnɛ, aŋ kʋ hɔŋ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa lɛ a ŋaa dɩɩ-tolo, ʋ jaŋ wuo dii ʋ nyɩmma kʋdiilee, ama nʋhʋɔrʋ na-kala bɩ jaŋ wuo dii.
14Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ jɩŋ aŋ dii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ, ʋ jaŋ tiŋ kɩalɩŋ aŋ ha tiŋ tʋŋ bʋnɔŋ a daŋ. 15Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaa disiniŋ hɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ yie kaa kʋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 16Dɩ ba nɛ leŋe dɩ nɩwogusuŋ pɛ didii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛ dii laa cheeriŋ, a tiŋ chɩmɩŋ. Mɩ-na nɛ ma TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.”
Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la doho La TƖƖNA sɩ bɩ chɛ
17La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 18“Bʋla pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna koo nʋhʋɔrʋ nɛ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋkɔ dɩ ʋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, dɩ niiŋ nɛ ʋʋ chɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ koo dɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ, 19ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ pie-bele koo nɛ-bele koo gbuŋgbogo sɩ bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ, dɩ mɩ wuo laa ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. 20Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ pʋna sɩ kɛŋ nyɔɔ kaa sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa ŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. 21Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kɛŋ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ-bele koo piese kɔ dɩ ʋ sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, dɩ niiŋ nɛ ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ koo dɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ, pʋna-la bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nyɔɔ kala. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. 22Sɩ́ pʋna sɩ nyʋlɩma koo a gbɛrɩgɛ koo a bolimi koo a kɛŋ naakuuŋ koo a kɛŋ naawɩɩlɩŋ sɩɩ lɩɩ nʋɔlʋŋ kaa sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ pʋna sɩ kɛŋ nyɔɔnʋŋ deemba kʋŋkala nyɩgʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la nyuŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 23Ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ pʋna sɩ pugumo koo pʋna sɩ kɛŋ nyɔɔ, nɛ-bele koo piese a sʋl tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ama ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa lɩɩsɛ niiŋ-na. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa ŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. 24Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ kɛŋ pʋna luribiee sɩ yɛrɛ koo ba sɩ fere kaa sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ ma TƖƖNA. Ma bɩ maga dɩ ma ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ ma tinteeŋ lɛ. 25Dɩ pʋna nɛ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ laa nʋhʋɔrʋ ma teeŋ a kaa sʋl kʋdiilee Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma Wɩa. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ laa ma sʋla, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ kɛŋ nyɔɔŋ nɛ.”
26La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis, 27“Dɩ nɛŋ koo piese koo bʋʋŋ nɛ lʋl bie, bile maga dɩ ʋ hɛ ʋ naaŋ teeŋ nɛ a wasɛ yɩlɩŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. A chɩŋ tapʋl chori a kaa mʋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo kaa sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 28Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ nɛŋ koo piese arɩ ʋ bie kala kpʋ chɛ-bala.
29Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ ŋ kpʋ pʋna a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a lɔllɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, to wombie-la mɩ sɩ daga dɩ mɩ laa ŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. 30Ʋ maga ŋ chaŋ ʋ nammɩa tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ chɩna chʋa, mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.
31Má to mɩ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA. 32Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ mɩ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ chei. Ʋ maga dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala jɩŋ arɩ mɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe ma bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. 33Mɩ nɛ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa ma Wɩa. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.”

Title: LEVI DOHO NƖAA 23
Content:
Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ gbielee
1La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 2“Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: ‘Gbielee deemba nɛ maga dɩ ma kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ aa gbieli mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ. 3Tapʋlaa balɩdʋ nɛ ma jaŋ tɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa, ama chɛ-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ nɛ ŋaa chɛ-wiesii-la. Ʋ maga má kʋ hilimi mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ. Lee na-kala ma sɩ hɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la ŋaa chɛ-wiesii nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.
Dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele arɩ boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ
4Gbielee deemba nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dagɛ dɩ ma hilimee gbieli, dɩ bʋa-la nɛ kʋ yi na-kala. 5Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele jaŋ suomi jɩna tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ dɩdaanɩŋ. 6Chɛnɛ-la tɩtɩa tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɔŋ chɛɛŋ nɛ ba sɩ yie dii boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ gbiele ma jaŋ suomi. Ma jaŋ dii boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. 7Tapʋlaa balɩpɛ-la tʋɔŋ tapʋl bumbuŋ nɛ maga dɩ má hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ aŋ sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ. 8Tapʋlɩa-la tʋɔŋ nɛ maga dɩ má joŋ kʋdiilee ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Tapʋl-pɛɩ má hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ aŋ sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ.’ ”
Kʋdii-falaa
9La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis, 10“Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: ‘Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ Kɛnaŋ tintee-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ joŋo pɩma, jɩna na-kala dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ma kʋdii falaa, má sʋa mɩɩ-jagɩsɩŋ a kaa mʋ pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara. 11Chɛ-wiesii-la taŋ sɩ pʋla nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ mɩɩ-jagɩsɩ-la ba sɩ kaa kʋ pʋ je, a zaara ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ dɩ mɩ laa ma sʋla. 12Tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩ-jagɩsɩ-la je a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ tɩtɩa nɛ maga dɩ má kpʋ pie-bie sɩ yi jɩna a bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, 13a pɛ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ gbaŋa lɛ a kɛŋ nʋʋŋ buu a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩmɛ, a pɛ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ loŋ arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ. 14Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ŋaa, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma dii ma kʋdii falɩɩ kala, dɩ ba kaa wasɛ boroboro nɛ koo dɩ ba joŋo wasɛ nɛ koo dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋhuoŋ nɛ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ a magɛ dɩ ma doho kala tuto, lee na-kala ma sɩ hɛ.
Baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ gbiele
15Má chɩŋ chɛ-wiesii-la taŋ sɩ pʋla lɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ kɛŋ mɩɩ-jagɩsɩŋ je, a zaara ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a dɩɩsɛ yɔɔsʋŋ balɩpɛ. 16Yɔɔ-pɛɩ-la taŋ sɩ pʋla, má ŋaa kʋdii falaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 17Kaala kala nɩaa maga dɩ má kɛŋ munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ gbaŋa a hɛ sɩbʋrʋŋ a wasɛ boroboro balɩa a kaa kʋ je a zaara sʋl kʋdii falaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 18Má pɛ kɛŋ pie-pɔrɔɔ balɩpɛ sɩ yi jɩna a bɩ nyɔɔ kala kɛnɛ a pɛ boroboroba-la lɛ, arɩ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ a pɛ pie-belliŋ balɩa lɛ. Kɩaa deemba nɛ ma jaŋ joŋo sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA a pɛ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ. Ba ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa wɩɩ-sʋlʋŋ nɛ. Ba sʋɔra sɩma nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 19Má kpʋ gbuŋgbogo ma sʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, aŋ kpʋ pie-bel-pɔrɔɔ balɩa sɩ yi jɩna a sʋl nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. 20Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ pie-belli-la balɩa arɩ ba sɩ kɛŋ kʋdii falaa wasɛ boroboroba-la a je aa zaarɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Ŋɩɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ nɛ. Ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ mɩ teeŋ, a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋdiilee. 21Tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa ʋ maga dɩ má hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ aŋ sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ a magɛ dɩ ma doho kala tuto lee na-kala ma sɩ hɛ.
22Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa Kɛnaŋ tintee-la lɛ, má sɩ́ sɛŋ-keree kɩaa ŋaa, má bɩra sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ kuuni ma. Má lemba pɩ summoo arɩ nʋhʋɔraa. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.’ ”
23La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 24“Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: ‘Chɛŋ-pɛɩ tʋɔŋ tapʋl bumbuŋ, ʋ maga dɩ má wiesi aŋ hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ a ŋmʋʋ banyile a gbieli. 25Má sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ, má joŋ kɩaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.’ ”
Disiniŋ pɩɩsɩŋ tapʋlʋŋ
26La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis, 27“Chɛŋ-pɛɩ-la tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa fii chɛɛŋ nɛ ma jaŋ pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta. Má hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ a vɔɔ niiŋ a joŋ kɩaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 28Má sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tiŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la, bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ maga ma pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. 29Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ vɩa dɩ ʋ vɔɔ niiŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la, ʋ maga dɩ ma keru ta ʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ. 30Mɩ jaŋ kpʋ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ jaŋ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa tapʋlɩɩ-la. 31Má paala sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ a magɛ dɩ ma doho kala tuto lee na-kala ma sɩ hɛ. 32Má vɔɔ niiŋ chɛnɛ-la tʋɔŋ tapʋl-nibi dɩdaanɩŋ a kaa mʋ ʋ chɛ-lɩa dɩdaanɩŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ ma to chɛ wiesii-la woruŋ.”
Lɛŋŋɛɛ gbielee
33La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 34“Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: ‘Chɛŋ-pɛɩ tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɔŋ chɛɛŋ nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele jaŋ suomi. Ʋ jaŋ dieni a magɛ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. 35Tapʋl-bumbuŋ ma jaŋ hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ aŋ sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ. 36Tapʋlɩa-la balɩpɛ, má joŋ kɩaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩgaa pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Tapʋl-chori chɛɛŋ má hilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ a joŋ kɩaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Gbiele-la dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Má sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ.
37Gbielee deemba nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dagɛ dɩ ma hihilimi mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a nyɩga pɩpɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ maga dɩ ma kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a pɛ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ. 38Wɩɩsʋllʋŋ deemba kala pɛ chɛ-wiesii-la Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ nɛ, arɩ zile kɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ yie joŋo pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA arɩ ma tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ yie kaa lɩɩsɛ niiri-la ma sɩ hɛ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA.
39Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa, má gbieli gbiele deeŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Má suomi chɛŋ-pɛɩ-la tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɔŋ chɛɛŋ. Tapʋl-bumbuŋ ŋaa chɛ-wiesii nɛ, tapʋl chori ma ŋaa chɛ-wiesii. 40Tapʋl-bumbuŋ-la má tɔrɛ ma tɩɩ-nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ, a chɔl abɛ pɩpaarɩŋ, a chɔl tɩɩ-naakelee sɩ kɛŋ pɩpaarɩŋ a jʋɔsɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. 41Jɩna na-kala chɛŋ pɛɩ lɛ, má gbieli gbiele deeŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Gbiele deeŋ maga dɩ ma doho nɩaa kala gbigbielu nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. 42Tapʋlɩa-la balɩpɛ kala lɛ ma sɩɩ gbieli gbiele-la, nʋʋ na-kala sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ jʋjʋʋ lɛbɩŋ nɛ. 43Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma doho nɩaa kala jaŋ liliisi arɩ mɩ leŋe Iziral tɩŋŋaa jʋʋ lɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛmba lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.’ ”
44Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala jɩŋ tapʋlɩa-la sɩ maga dɩ baa gbieli gbielee deemba, a zizil La TƖƖNA.

Title: LEVI DOHO NƖAA 24
Content:
Ba bil nʋʋŋ arɩ boroboro La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ
1La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 2“Leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ olif nʋʋŋ sɩ faasa zɔŋ kɔ dɩ ba joŋo hɩhɛ chaanaa lɛ dɩ ba didii a sɩ́ dɩsʋ. 3Arɔŋ maga dɩ ʋ nyɩgɛ chaanaa dɩdaanɩŋ a bil mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ nɛ, lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ. Chaana-la jaŋ chɩŋ patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔmʋŋ arɩ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ kaa kpaa sɩpaaŋ, dɩ ba didii ŋɩɩ a kaa mʋ chʋchʋɔŋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa nii nɛ a magɛ dɩ ma doho kala tuto a kaa mʋ wuu. 4Ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ ŋaa chaaŋ-daaŋ ʋ chɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, chaana-la sɩ sagɛ ʋ nyuŋ maga dɩ ba didii nɛ bʋa na-kala.
5Ŋaa munuŋ sɩ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ a wasɛ boroboroba fii arɩ balɩa, dɩ ba kʋŋkala yuŋuŋ ŋaa kilo balɩa, 6a joŋo daŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ naaderee balɩa teebʋl-la ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ ŋaa nyuŋ, dɩ ʋ chɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. 7Naadere-la kʋŋkala lɛ, hɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sɩ faasa zɔŋ sɩ jaŋ laa boroboroba-la nyuŋ a ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA toruŋ dɩ ba joŋo ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 8Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ na-kala Iziral tɩŋŋaa maga ba kɛŋ boroboroba-la kɔ, dɩ Arɔŋ joŋo bil mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ ŋaa nii nɛ pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala dɩ ba tuto wuu. 9Boroboroba-la ŋaa Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kɩaa nɛ. Ba jaŋ diiba Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa kʋdiilee zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo nyɩga pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ.”
Ba yagɛ nʋʋ sɩ chei Wɩa yɩrɩŋ kpʋ
10Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ naaŋ ŋaa Iziral tɩɩna, ka ʋ nyɩmma ma ŋaa Ijipiti tɩɩna. Ŋɩɩ nɛ yuosuŋ sii baal-la arɩ Iziral tɩɩna pɛgɛ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ. 11Baal-la naaŋ sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩɩna bʋl wɩaa chei La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛnʋ mʋ Mosis teeŋ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Sɛlɔmɩf, Dibiri sɩ ŋaa Daŋ doho nʋʋ tolo. 12Ba kɛnʋ tɔ dɩa aŋ gbɩgbɛrɛ dɩ La TƖƖNA dagɛ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba ŋaa ʋ lɛ. 13Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 14“Kɛŋ mɩ yɩrɩ-cheeru-la sʋʋsa lɩɩ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla joŋ nɩsaa daŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ, ka dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala paa tabɩaa a yagʋ kpʋ. 15Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ chei mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ, 16dɩ ʋ ŋaa nʋhʋɔrʋ koo dɩ ʋ ŋaa Iziral tɩɩna, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala maga dɩ ba paa tabɩaa yagʋ kpʋ nɛ.
17Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kpʋ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ. 18Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kpʋ ʋ dɔŋɔ pʋna, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ pʋna nɛ tiŋ ʋ chɩmɩŋ. 19Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bolimi ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa nɩɩ-la lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba joŋ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa ʋ ma lɛ. 20Dɩ ŋ nɛ bori nʋʋ naaŋ, ba jaŋ bori ŋ ma naaŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ togi nʋʋ sɩɩŋ, ba jaŋ togi ŋ ma sɩɩŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋmoo nʋʋ nyɩlɩŋ churi, ba jaŋ ŋmoo ŋ ma nyɩlɩŋ churi. Wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ joŋo ŋaa ŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ, ba jaŋ joŋ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa ŋ ma lɛ. 21Dɩ ŋ nɛ kpʋ nʋʋ pʋna, ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ pʋna tiŋ ʋ chɩmɩŋ, ama dɩ nuhuobiiŋ nɛ ŋ kpʋ, ba jaŋ kpʋ ŋ ma. 22Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ nʋhʋɔraa kala nɛ maga dɩ ba tuto wombiee deemba. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.”
23Mosis sɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba kala pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɛrɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ baal-la fa sɩ bʋl wɩaa chei La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ, a sʋʋsa lɩɩ ba dɩhɔnʋŋ a paa tabɩaa yagʋ kpʋ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis.

Title: LEVI DOHO NƖAA 25
Content:
Jɩna-la lɛ tinteeŋ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ pɩna wiesi
1La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ nyuŋ, 2“Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, dɩ ma nɛ kʋ jʋʋ Kɛnaŋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, tintee-la jaŋ kɛŋ jɩna ʋ sɩ jaŋ pɩna wiesi a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 3Jɩsɩŋ balɩdʋ tʋɔŋ ma jaŋ duduu kɩaa ma bagɩsɩŋ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa, a beŋ ma girep tɩɩsɩŋ nyuŋ woruŋ a tʋtɔrɛ ba nɛnɛɛ. 4Ama jɩ-pɛɩ lɛ ma bɩ maga dɩ ma pɛrɛ tintee-la koo a buori ma girep tɩɩsɩŋ ta. Ʋ maga dɩ tintee-la pɩna wiesi nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 5Kʋtɩarɩ-la ma sɩ waa ba tɩtɩa lɛ, má sɩ́ ba kala ŋaa a sɩ́ girep tɩɩsɩ-la sɩ nɛnɛ ma kala tɔrʋ. Tintee-la maga dɩ ʋ pɩna wiesi nɛ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. 6Jɩna-la tʋɔŋ tintee-la sɩ jaŋ pɩna wiesi, kʋtɩarɩ-la sɩ jaŋ bii tintee-la lɛ jaŋ ŋaa ma dɩ ma tɩntɩnnaa baalaa arɩ haalaa arɩ ma nʋhʋɔraa kala kʋdiilee. 7Ma pʋsʋŋ arɩ gɩrɩŋ kɩaa kala nɛ jaŋ didiiba. Kʋtɩarɩ-la kala sɩ jaŋ bii tintee-la lɛ ma jaŋ wuo diiba.
Jɩ-mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii
8Má chɩŋ jɩna-la lɛ tintee-la sɩ jaŋ pɩna wiesi a dɩɩsɛ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ nibi. 9Jɩna-la chɛŋ-pɛɩ tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa fii chɛɛŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ jaŋ pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta, ʋ maga dɩ ma ŋmʋʋ banyile tintee-la kala lɛ. 10Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, má lɩɩsɛ jɩ-mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, dɩ ʋ ŋaa jɩna-la nʋʋkala sɩ maga dɩ ʋ tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa. Jɩna deeŋ tʋɔŋ, dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ tinteye-la kala nɩaa sɩ yɔbɔ maga dɩ ba joŋo pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ, ka dɩ yosuŋ ma mɩɩra mʋ ba dɩa nɩaa teeŋ. 11Jɩ-mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii-la lɛ, má sɩ́ pɛrʋ koo a ŋaa kʋtɩarɩ-la sɩ bɩa koo a tɔrɛ ma girep nɛnɛɛ. 12Ʋ ŋaa jɩ-zɔŋ nɛ a pɩma. Ma jaŋ dii kʋtɩarɩ-la sɩ bɩɩ ma bagɩsɩŋ lɛ, ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa a kaa kɔ dɩa a tʋɔlɛ.
13Jɩna deeŋ tʋɔŋ maga dɩ ma joŋ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa tinteye-la ma sɩ yɔbɔ pɩba nɛ.
14Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna nɛ yallɛ tinteeŋ pɩpɩ ʋ naambii koo dɩ ʋ yɔɔ tinteeŋ ʋ naambii teeŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ to ŋɩɩ lɛ a gʋrʋ. 15Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ hɛ yalɩŋ a magɛ jɩsɩ-la ŋ naambile sɩ jaŋ wuo pɛrɛ tintee-la lɛ, ka dɩ jɩna-la ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tinteye-la ba sɩ yɔbɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa-na yi. 16Dɩ jɩsɩ-la nɛ yʋga, ʋ maga dɩ yalɩŋ ma yʋgɛ nɛ, ka dɩ ba nɛ bɩ yʋgɛ, yalɩŋ ma bɩ maga dɩ ʋ yʋgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa kʋdiilee magɛ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo na tintee-la lɛ nɩɩ dagɛ ʋ yalɩŋ. 17Iziral tɩɩna kala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ gʋrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ama má to mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ.
18Má to mɩ niiŋ arɩ wombie-la kala mɩ sɩ daga. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. 19Ma jaŋ na kʋdiilee woruŋ tintee-la lɛ a didii aŋ hɔŋ sɔm. 20Ma jaŋ wuo pɩɛsɛ arɩ ma sɩ bɩ kɩaa duo a bɩ kɩaa ŋaa, bɛɛ kɩaa nɛ ma jaŋ dii jɩ-pɛɩ-la tʋɔŋ? 21Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kʋdiilee chaasa wasɛ jɩ-dʋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ma wuo dii yi jɩsɩŋ batori. 22Ma jaŋ duu kɩaa jɩ-chori tʋɔŋ aŋ ha didii jɩ-dʋ-la kʋbɩnaa a mʋ jʋʋ jɩ-nibi tʋɔŋ bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa.
23Ma bɩ maga ma joŋ tintee-la yalla pɩ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ʋ kʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ tɩɩ tintee-la, ka ma ŋaa nʋhʋɔra a hɔŋ ʋ lɛ. 24Dɩ nʋʋkala nɩɩ yallɛ tinteeŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma bʋla bil arɩ tɩɩna jaŋ wuo bɩra tiŋ a laa ʋ kʋa.
25Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna kala nɛ summo a keri ʋ tinteeŋ yallɛ, ʋ naambile sɩɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ maga dɩ ʋ time laa tintee-la. 26Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ naambii kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ time laa, ka dɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dʋa, a jaŋ wuo time laa, 27ʋ jaŋ dɩɩsɛ jɩsɩ-la tɩɩna sɩ yɔɔ tintee-la a kʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ time laa, a tiŋ jɩ-kaana-la sɩ ka, ka dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa-na yi. 28Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ time laa, nɩɩ-la sɩ yɔbɔ jaŋ tɩɩ tintee-la a mʋ yi jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa dɩ ʋ saa-na laa ʋ kʋa.
29Dɩ taŋ nɛ ba saa kɛrɛ golli, ka dɩ nʋʋ joŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ dɩa yalla pɩ nʋʋ, jɩna-la lɛ ʋ sɩ yalla dʋndʋŋa tʋɔŋ nɛ ʋ jaŋ wuo time laa ʋ kʋa. 30Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ time laa ka dɩ jɩna-la bal, dɩa-la jaŋ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ yɔbɔ arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa kʋŋ a kaa mʋ. Dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ yie, dɩa-la-na bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ yalla kʋŋ. 31Ama tasɩ-la na-kala ba sɩ bɩ kɛrɛ saa golli ka dɩ nʋʋ joŋ dɩa a yalla lee-la, nɩɩ-la sɩ yalla jaŋ wuo time laa ʋ kʋa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ time laa, jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩpɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ yie, nɩɩ-la sɩ yalla jaŋ laa ʋ kʋa.
32Levi doho nɩaa-na ŋaa dabaŋ nɛ. Ba-na jaŋ wuo time laa ba dɩɩsɩŋ ba tasɩ-la ba sɩ joŋo pɩba bʋa na-kala lɛ. 33Dɩ Levi doho nʋʋ nɛ yallɛ ʋ dɩa, dɩ ba saa kɛrɛ golli taŋ-la koo ba bɩ saa golli, aŋ bɩ wuo time laa, dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩpɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ yie, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ laa ʋ kʋa nɛ. Levi doho nɩaa dʋndʋŋa nɛ tɩɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala tʋɔŋ. 34Ama pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diile-la kala sɩ golli Levi doho nɩaa tasɩŋ-na bɩ maga dɩ ba joŋo yallɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa ba kɩaa nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.
35Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna kala nɛ kʋ summi a bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa wuo bibeŋ, má kɛnʋ mɛrɛ ma tɩtɩa lɛ a bibenu, arɩ ma sɩɩ beŋ nʋhʋɔraa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ wuo hɛ ma tʋɔŋ. 36Má fá mɩ-na ma Wɩa a leŋ dɩ ma naambie guoli ma tʋɔŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ joŋ kʋŋ chɩmʋ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ tiŋ kʋŋ daŋ. 37Má sɩ́ moribiee koo kʋdiilee joŋ chɩmʋ aŋ chɩchɛ nyʋʋrʋŋ. 38Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩ nɛ kɛŋ ma kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ joŋ Kɛnaŋ tinteeŋ pɩma aŋ ŋaa ma Wɩa.
39Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna kala nɛ kʋ summi a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa yalla pɩ ʋ naambii, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ʋ tɩma pʋpʋ a nagɛ yoŋ. 40Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ joŋu dɩ ʋ nagɛ pachɩŋ diire koo nʋhʋɔra sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩa lɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tɩma pʋ a mʋ yi jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa. 41Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ biiriŋ, tɩɩna maga dɩ ʋ leŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ kala mɩɩra mʋ ʋ doho nɩaa teeŋ ba tinteeŋ, 42bɛɛ wɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ mɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba joŋ ba kʋŋ yallɛ a nagɛ yomo. 43Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma kɛŋ tʋɔhɛɛŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Má fɩfá mɩ-na ma Wɩa.
44Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ yosuŋ, ma jaŋ wuo yɔɔba tinteye-la sɩ kpagɛ ma lɛ. 45Ma jaŋ wuo yɔɔ nʋhʋɔra-la ma sɩ hɔŋ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ba doho nʋʋkala ba sɩ lʋla ma tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa ma kɩaa. 46Ma biiriŋ ma jaŋ wuo sii tɩɩba, dɩ ba ŋaa ba yosi a kaa mʋ wuu. Ama ma pɔ má sɩ́ ma Iziral tɩɩna dɔŋɔ dɔgɩsʋ. 47Dɩ nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɔŋ ma tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ ŋaa kɩaa tɩɩna dɩ ma dɔŋɔ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa yalla pʋ koo nʋhʋɔrʋ-la doho nʋʋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ summo wɩaa, 48wombiiŋ hɛ nɩmɛ ba sɩ jaŋ wuo time laaʋ. Ʋ naambiiriŋ dɔŋɔ jaŋ wuo time laaʋ. 49Ʋ nyɩmma kʋbie koo ʋ nyɩmma kʋbie ma bie koo ʋ naambii na-kala jaŋ wuo time laaʋ, koo dɩ ʋ ma tɩtɩa nɩsɩŋ nɛ kʋ kɛŋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo time laa ʋ tɩtɩa. 50Ʋ dɩ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa yalla pa jaŋ chɩŋ jɩna-la lɛ ʋ sɩ yɔbʋ a dɩɩsɛ jɩsɩ-la ʋ sɩ yɔbʋ a kʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ time laa ʋ tɩtɩa, a saa na jɩ-kaana-la sɩ ka, ka dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa-na yi. Ʋ jaŋ tiŋ a maga ŋɩɩ nɩa sɩ jaŋ tɩŋ jɩsɩ-la, ka ba timu a pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ yɔbʋ. 51Dɩ jɩsɩ-la sɩ ka nɛ yʋga, ʋ jaŋ time yʋgɛ aŋ-na laa ʋ tɩtɩa. 52Ama dɩ jɩsɩ-la sɩ ka, ka dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa-na yi nɛ bɩ yʋgɛ, ʋ jaŋ time magɛ ŋɩɩ jɩsɩ-la sɩ maga. 53Nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ yallɛ ʋ tɩtɩa pa maga dɩ ʋ joŋu arɩ pachɩŋ diiru nɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ dʋdɔgɩsʋ.
54Dɩ ʋ nɛ paala bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa wuo time laa ma, jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ tintee yɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ yie, nɩɩ-la sɩ yɔbʋ maga dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ ta nɛ, 55bɛɛ wɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ mɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kɔ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.”

Title: LEVI DOHO NƖAA 26
Content:
Woruŋ-la ma sɩ jaŋ na dɩ ma nɛ to Wɩa niiŋ
1La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Má sɩ́ kʋŋkala ŋaa a pɩ ma tɩtɩa aa kpaarɛ: tɔŋŋɔɔ, vesiŋ, koo a saa tabɩaa aa kpaarɛ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.
2Má to mɩ chɛ-wiesii-la woruŋ, a zizil lee-la ma sɩ kʋʋ chʋɔlɛmɛ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.
3Dɩ ma nɛ fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa aa to mɩ niiŋ arɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ dagɛma, 4mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ ʋ bʋa lɛ a pɩma dɩ ma kʋdiilee arɩ ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ wasɛ. 5Ma jaŋ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi girep nɛnɛɛ tɔrʋŋ, a bɩra tɔrɛ ma girep nɛnɛɛ ma ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi kɩaa duunuŋ. Kʋdiilee jaŋ pʋrɩgɛ ma tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ ma hɔŋ wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ walɩmɛma.
6Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ Kɛnaŋ tintee-la lɛ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ dɩ wɩɩkala sɩ leŋe dɩ ma bɔyɛ joŋ. Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ gɩrɩŋ kʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ laalɩŋ ma tinteeŋ lɛ. 7Ma jaŋ kire to ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ a kpʋba. 8Ma nɩaa banɔŋ jaŋ yuo dii nɩaa zɔlɔ, dɩ nɩaa zɔlɔ ma yuo dii nɩaa bʋɩ fii.
9Mɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma pʋŋ, aŋ leŋ dɩ nii-la ma mɩ sɩ bile mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ chɩŋ. 10Ma pire jaŋ chol dɩ ma chaarɛ kʋbɩnaa aŋ hɛ kʋfalaa. 11Mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ lemma ta. 12Mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a ŋaa ma Wɩa dɩ ma ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa. 13Mɩ nɛ ma Wɩa, mɩ nɛ kɛmma kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ ma sɩ́ ba yosi ŋaa. Mɩ nɛ laama ta dɩ ma tɩɩ ma tɩtɩa a sɩ́ wɩɩkala fá.”
Dɔgɩsɩna-la ma sɩ jaŋ na dɩ ma nɛ vɩa Wɩa niiŋ
14La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ, “Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ jaŋ jegile mɩ teeŋ a to wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga, 15aŋ vɩa mɩ niiŋ wɩaa mɩ sɩ daga arɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ma tuto a chei nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ, 16ŋ-la nɛ mɩ jaŋ ŋaama: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ jʋʋma. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyanyalaa sɩ bɩ daalusuŋ kɛnɛ hɛ ma lɛ, arɩ yarɩ-lɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nyʋlɩmɛ dɩ ma yaraa kala yʋɔlɛ ŋɩɩ dɩ ma mʋ sʋʋ. Ma jaŋ duu kɩaa aŋ bɩ jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ jaŋ diiba. 17Mɩ jaŋ vɩama ta a leŋ dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diima. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrɛma nɛ jaŋ bemma. Ma jaŋ fá, ka nʋʋ bɩ maa kiri.
18Dɩ wɩaa deemba kala nɛ ŋaa ma lɛ, ka ma ha bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a magɛ ŋɩɩ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ, a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. 19Mɩ jaŋ giri ma babii-ballɩŋ ta. Duonuŋ bɩ jaŋ nɩɩ pɩma, ma tinteeŋ jaŋ hɩl korikori. 20Ma jaŋ tɩŋ pɛɩ, ma baga kɩaa bɩ jaŋ wasɛ, ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ ma bɩ jaŋ nɛŋ.
21Dɩ ma nɛ ha vɩamɛ a bɩ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la mɩ fa sɩ sɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo hɛ ma lɛ a magɛ ŋɩɩ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ a hɛ ma lɛ, a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. 22Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ baga kɩaa kʋ kpʋ ma biiriŋ arɩ ma pʋsʋŋ, dɩ ma nɩaa faasa muuri, dɩ ma wombiee kala pɩŋ hoi.
23Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaama ŋ-la, ka dɩ ma bɩ mɩ teeŋ jegile nɩɩ, aŋ ha vɩamɛ, 24mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma na hɛɛŋ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa. 25Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ laalɩŋ kʋ gɩrɛma a tɩŋ ma sɩ chei nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ fá jʋʋ ma tabalaa dɩ ma laa ma mɩɩsɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diima. 26Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ kʋdiilee nyaa, dɩ ha-bala joŋ haalaa fii kʋdiilee ŋaa tabʋʋ bala lɛ. Ba jaŋ pɩɛrɛ mʋa mʋa a pɩ nʋʋkala dɩ ma dii aŋ bɩ vɔgɛ.
27Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala ma lɛ, ka ma ha vɩa a bɩ jegilee nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ aŋ ha ŋaa wɩaa chichei mɩ tʋɔŋ, 28mɩ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii ma nyuŋ dɩ mɩ dɔgɩsɛ ma a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩpɛ, a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa. 29Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ losuŋ faasa jʋʋma, dɩ ma gʋra kɛsɛ ma biiriŋ chɩchaŋ. 30Mɩ jaŋ chei ma vʋɩ-kpaarɛ leree arɩ korunu-la nyuŋ ma sɩɩ nyɩgɛ ma kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ, aŋ kpʋma a paa ma kʋsʋʋnʋŋ daŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ ma tɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩ cheye nyuŋ, aŋ vɩama ta. 31Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tasɩŋ pɩŋ jikpeeniŋ aŋ chei ma vʋɩyaa dɩ-kpaaraa, ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ sʋɔra bɩra bɩ jaŋ sɩma pɩmɛ. 32Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tinteeŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere a pɩ ma dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ hɛ lee-la. 33Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ laalɩŋ kirima dɩ ma fá a pɩsa jʋʋ tintee-wogusuŋ, ka ma tinteeŋ arɩ ma tasɩŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ. 34-35Bʋa-la kala lɛ tintee-la sɩ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, ʋ jaŋ wiesi jɩsɩ-la kala ʋ fa sɩ maga dɩ ʋ wiesi, ka ʋ bɩ wiese, ka dɩ ma hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteyee lɛ.
36Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ka a hɛ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteyee lɛ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɛ ma lɛ, dɩ wʋbie kala nɛ ŋaa, dɩ ma bɔɩsɩŋ joŋ. Ma jaŋ fá a foro titel a nagɛ laalɩŋ sɩɩ kiri nɩaa, ka nʋʋkala bɩ maa kiri. 37Ma jaŋ fá a yigi dɔŋɔ lulo arɩ laalɩŋ nɩɩ kirima, ka nʋʋkala bɩ maa kiri. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma sɩ́ wuo yuo ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ. 38Ma jaŋ mʋ sʋʋ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ, ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteeŋ jaŋ diima. 39Ma nɩkaana-la sɩ bɩ sʋba ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteeŋ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɩl ŋɩɩ a mʋ sʋʋ, a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ma nyɩmmaba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.
40Ama ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, dɩ mɩ nɩaa nɛ jaŋ sɛɩ a dagɛ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ba naabalɩmaba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, arɩ baaŋ-siiri wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ, a vɩa mɩ niiŋ, 41ŋɩɩ leŋ mɩ yaraa hosi ba lɛ, mɩ kiriba hɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteyee lɛ, dɩ ba nɛ leŋ ba babii-ballɩŋ aŋ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri a na hɛɛ-la sɩ maga dɩ ba na, a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa, 42mɩ jaŋ liisi nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ Jekɔb arɩ Aɩzɩk arɩ Abɩraham pɛgɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ tintee-la mɩ sɩ sɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩba lɛ. 43Tintee-la jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a wiesi, nʋʋkala jaŋ tuo ʋ lɛ. Ʋ maga ba na hɛɛ-la sɩ maga dɩ ba na nɛ, a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba vɩa mɩ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ daga nɛ. 44Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, dɩ ba nɛ hɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ tinteeŋ lɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ vɩaba ta koo a bɛrɛba a cheiba, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ba pɛgɛ chei. Mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa. 45Mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ ba wɩaa, a liise yi nii-la sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ ba naabalɩmaba pɛgɛ, nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ka tinteyee nɩaa kala bibeŋ. Mɩ nɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa.”
46Wombie-la arɩ niiri-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩ Mosis peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ nyuŋ dɩ ʋ joŋo dagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba tuto nɛ ŋɩɩ.

Title: LEVI DOHO NƖAA 27
Content:
Ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ time laa kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ joŋo pɩ La TƖƖNA
1La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩ Mosis, 2“Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: ‘Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ta niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ nuhuobiiŋ a hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ, aŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ nii-la, 3dɩ nɩɩ-la nɛ ŋaa baal a yi jɩsɩŋ mara a kaa mʋ mahɩŋ batori, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ warɩpʋla mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, a magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ daga Wɩa dɩa lɛ. 4Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa haal, ʋ jaŋ tiŋ warɩpʋla mara arɩ fii. 5Dɩ tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa baal a chɩŋ jɩsɩŋ banɔŋ a kaa mʋ jɩsɩŋ mara, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ warɩpʋla mara nɛ, ka dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa haal, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ warɩpʋla fii. 6Dɩ tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa baal a chɩŋ chɛnɛ a kaa mʋ jɩsɩŋ banɔŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ warɩpʋla banɔŋ nɛ, ka dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa haal, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ warɩpʋla batori. 7A chɩŋ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ batori a kaa mʋ, dɩ tɩɩna nɛ ŋaa baal, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ warɩpʋla fii arɩ banɔŋ, ka dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa haal, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ warɩpʋla fii. 8Dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ ta nii-la nɛ ŋaa summu a bɩ jaŋ wuo na warɩpʋla-la magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa lɩɩsɛ nii-la, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kaa ta nii-la a mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ dɩ ʋ dagɛ maga ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ wuo tiŋ.
9Dɩ pʋna sɩ bɩ kɩsɛ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ kaa ta nii-la, pʋna-la jaŋ ŋaa mɩ-na Wɩa kʋzɔŋ. 10Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ pʋna-la lenni pʋna dɔŋ, kʋzɔŋ koo kʋlɔrʋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba kala balɩa jaŋ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋzɔmɔ. 11Dɩ pʋna-la ʋ sɩ kaa ta niiŋ nɛ kɛŋ disiniŋ ba sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ pʋna-la mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ. 12Ʋ nɛ jaŋ beŋ a na dɩ ʋ zɔmɔ koo ʋ bɩ zɔŋ, aŋ dagɛ ʋ yalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ. 13Dɩ pʋna-la tɩɩna nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ time laa, ʋ jaŋ tiŋ ʋ yalɩŋ, aŋ ha kɛŋ pʋna-la yalɩŋ kpaa leree banɔŋ a joŋ dɔŋɔ pɛ.
14Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ joŋ ʋ dɩa a hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ beŋ dɩa-la a na ʋ zɔmʋŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ aŋ hɛ ʋ yalɩŋ, magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ sɩ daga, ʋ yalɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. 15Nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ dɩa-la hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ time laa, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ dɩa-la yalɩŋ aŋ ha kɛŋ dɩa-la yalɩŋ kpaa leree banɔŋ a joŋ dɔŋɔ time daŋ aŋ-na laa ʋ kʋa.
16Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ chɔgɛ ʋ doho nɩaa tinteeŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ yalɩŋ maga dɩ ʋ magɛ kʋdoho-la ba sɩ jaŋ joŋo duu lee-la yalɩŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Mɩɩ-doho bɔtɔ yalɩŋ ŋaa warɩpʋla mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ. 17Dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ joŋ kʋyɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ dɩ ʋ joŋ tintee-la hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ yalɩŋ ha maga dɩ ʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ. 18Dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ joŋ kʋyɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ bala ka dɩ ʋ joŋ tintee-la hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ jɩsɩ-la sɩ bala ta nɛ aŋ hɛ ʋ yalɩŋ. 19Dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ tintee-la hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ time laa, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ tintee-la yalɩŋ aŋ ha kɛŋ tintee-la yalɩŋ kpaa leree banɔŋ a joŋ dɔŋɔ pɛ aŋ na laa ʋ kʋa. 20Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ tintee-la time laa, aŋ bɩra joŋo yallɛ pɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo time laaʋ maachie kala. 21Dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ joŋ kʋyɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ kʋ yi, tintee-la jaŋ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ jaŋ tɩɩʋ.
22Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ yɔɔ tinteeŋ a ma bɩra joŋo hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ, 23Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ yɔɔ tintee-la aŋ dɩɩsɛ jɩsɩŋ magɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ ka, ka dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ kʋyɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa yi aŋ hɛ ʋ yalɩŋ, dɩ nɩɩ-la timu tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa. Moribiiŋ deeŋ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋzɔŋ nɛ. 24Dɩ jɩna-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ kʋyɔbɔɔ pɩ ba tɩŋŋaa nɛ kʋ yi, nɩɩ-la teeŋ ʋ sɩ yɔɔ tintee-la nɛ jaŋ laa ʋ kʋa. 25Dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma hɛ kʋŋkala yalɩŋ, má hɛ dɩ ʋ magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ daga Wɩa dɩa lɛ.
26Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo joŋ piese koo bʋʋŋ koo nɛŋ sɩ lʋl ʋ bii-bumbuŋ hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma paala jɩŋ arɩ ba-na ŋaa mɩ kɩaa nɛ. 27Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ pʋna sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ bii-bumbuŋ kaa kɔ dɩ ʋ hɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ time laa a magɛ yalɩɩ-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara sɩ hɛ, aŋ ha kɛŋ yalɩɩ-la kpaa leree banɔŋ a joŋ dɔŋɔ pɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ jaŋ time laa, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ joŋ pʋna-la yallɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ yalɩŋ sɩ maga.
28Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ joŋ nuhuobiine koo pʋna koo ʋ doho nɩaa tinteeŋ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo time laa koo a joŋo yallɛ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋzɔŋ. 29Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ mɩ chaasa lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba kpʋ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo time laaʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ.
30Ma kʋpɛrɛɛ, mɩaa arɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ kala, ma jaŋ kaa kpaa leree fii a joŋ dɔŋɔ pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA. Ba ŋaa kʋzɔmɔ nɛ mɩ teeŋ. 31Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ mɩɩra time laa kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ, ʋ jaŋ tiŋ ʋ yalɩŋ aŋ ha kɛŋ ʋ yalɩŋ kpaa leree banɔŋ a joŋ dɔŋɔ time daŋ. 32Ma pʋsʋŋ tʋɔŋ, pʋŋ fii tɩɩna na-kala ŋaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA kʋa nɛ. 33Dɩ pʋŋ fii-la nɛ ŋaa kʋzɔŋ koo kʋlɔrʋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma kaa lenni pʋna dɔŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ kaa lenni pʋna dɔŋ, ba kala balɩa jaŋ ŋaa mɩ kɩaa, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo time laa.’ ”
34Wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Mosis Sɩnaɩ peel-la nyuŋ dɩ ʋ bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

Title: NAMBABA 1
Content:
Ba dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa
1Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ jɩ-lɩamɩŋ tʋɔŋ chɛŋ-lɩamɩŋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ Mosis, lɛbɩ-la lɛ ʋ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ Sɩnaɩ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ. Ʋ sɩ, 2“Dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala, doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa, a ŋmʋnsɛ baal na-kala yɩrɩŋ. 3Ŋ dɩ Arɔŋ maga dɩ ma dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩɩna na-kala sɩ ŋaa baal a yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ. 4Doho na-kala kʋhɩaŋ maga dɩ ʋ pɛ ma lɛ. 5Baala-la sɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la:
Rubiŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Sediu nanʋala Elizu nɛ jaŋ pɛ.
6Simioŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Zurisadai nanʋala Sɛlʋmɩɛl nɛ jaŋ pɛ.
7Juda doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Amɩnadab nanʋala Nasɔŋ nɛ jaŋ pɛ.
8Ɩsaka doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Zʋaa nanʋala Nɛtanɛl nɛ jaŋ pɛ.
9Zebuluŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Heloŋ nanʋala Ɛlɩab nɛ jaŋ pɛ.
10Josɛf nanʋala Efirem doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Amihud nanʋala Ɛlɩsama nɛ jaŋ pɛ. Josɛf nanʋala Manasɛ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Pedazu nanʋala Gamalɩɛl nɛ jaŋ pɛ.
11Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Gidioni nanʋala Abɩdaŋ nɛ jaŋ pɛ.
12Daŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Amɩsadaɩ nanʋala Ahieza nɛ jaŋ pɛ.
13Asa doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Ɔkɩraŋ nanʋala Pagɩɛl nɛ jaŋ pɛ.
14Gad doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Dʋɛl nanʋala Ɛlɩasaf nɛ jaŋ pɛ.
15Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Ɛnaŋ nanʋala Ahɩra nɛ jaŋ pɛ.”
16Baalaa deemba nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ ba ŋaa ba sɩpaalaaraa. Ba nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba doho tʋɔŋ nɩaa kʋhɩasɩŋ.
17Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ, a pɛ baala-la fii arɩ balɩa ba sɩ lɩɩsɛ lɛ 18-19ba yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kʋ hilimi Sɩnaɩ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, chɛŋ-lɩamɩŋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ. Ba dɩɩsɛ baala-la sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ kʋŋ kʋŋ a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa, doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa, arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis. 20Rubiŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Iziral hambolibii bumbuŋ, baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ kʋŋ kʋŋ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa, doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 21Rubiŋ doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ balɩdʋ arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ nɛ.
22Simioŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ, a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ kʋŋ kʋŋ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa, doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 23Simioŋ doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ nibi arɩ zɔɔ-batori nɛ.
24Gad doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 25Gad doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ banɔŋ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ. 26Juda doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 27Juda doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ nɛ. 28Ɩsaka doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ, a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 29Ɩsaka doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ. 30Zebuluŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 31Zebuluŋ doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ. 32Efirem, Josɛf nanʋala doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ, a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 33Efirem doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ nɛ. 34Manasɛ ma sɩ ŋaa Josɛf nanʋala, ʋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 35Manasɛ doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ. 36Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 37Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ. 38Daŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 39Daŋ doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-balɩpɛ nɛ. 40Asa doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 41Asa doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ kʋbala arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ nɛ. 42Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 43Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ. 44Iziral tɩŋŋaa baala-la Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ arɩ sɩpaalaaraa fii arɩ balɩa-la sɩ chɩŋ ba doho nɩaa nyuŋ lɛ, ba dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩmma-la nɛ ŋɩɩ. 45Iziral tɩŋŋaa baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, a jaŋ wuo mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ dɩa dɩa. 46Ba kala fa ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ.
47Ba bɩ Levi doho nɩaa-na dɩɩsa bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. 48La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩ Mosis, 49“Sɩ́ Levi doho nɩaa dɩɩsa pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ. 50Ama joŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tɩntɩŋŋaa hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba nɛ maga dɩ ba chʋchʋŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa kala lee na-kala ma sɩɩ mʋ. Ba nɛ jaŋ hɔnɔ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la a bibeŋ ʋ nyuŋ. 51Bʋa na-kala, dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ ma churi Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la a kaa mʋ lee, Levi doho nɩalɩŋ nɛ maga ba churu a kaa mʋ pɛ dɩ-falɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ mʋ. Dɩ nɩwogo kala nɛ mʋ kpagɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, ʋ maga ma kpʋʋ nɛ. 52Iziral doho doho-la kala maga dɩ ba ŋmoo bugoo a hɔŋ, bugu kala arɩ ba magɩlɩŋ. 53Levi doho nɩaa-na maga dɩ ba hɛ ba lɛŋŋɛɛ a golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nɛ, lee-la Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la sɩ hɛ, a pɔ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la teeŋ kɔ, a ŋaa dɩ mɩ baanɩŋ sii Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ. Levi doho nɩaa nɛ maga ba bibeŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la.”
54Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis.

Title: NAMBABA 2
Content:
Ŋɩɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho doho-la sɩ jaŋ ŋmoo ba bugoo a kɩɛlɛ
1La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ, 2“Iziral doho doho-la kala maga dɩ ba ŋmoo bugoo a hɔnɔ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nɛ, aŋ sɩ́ ʋ kpagʋ, doho kala arɩ ʋ jɔnjɔŋ arɩ ʋ magɩlɩŋ.
3Iziral doho doho-la sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ: Juda doho nɩaa, Ɩsaka doho nɩaa arɩ Zebuluŋ doho nɩaa. Ba jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ ba magɩlɩŋ. Amɩnadab nanʋala Nasɔŋ nɛ ŋaa Juda doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara. 4Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ nɛ.
5Ɩsaka doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ hɔnɔ tɩgɛ Juda doho nɩaa lɛ. Zʋaa nanʋala Nɛtanɛl nɛ ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara. 6Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ.
7Zebuluŋ doho nɩaa ma nɛ jaŋ hɔnɔ tɩgɛ Ɩsaka doho nɩaa lɛ. Heloŋ nanʋala Ɛlɩab nɛ ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara. 8Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ. 9Laalɩyuoro-la kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ zɔlɔ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ balɩdʋ arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ. Juda buguŋ laalɩyuoroo nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba nɛ jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ a lɩɩ.
10Iziral doho doho deemba nɛ jaŋ hɔŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ ba magɩlɩŋ: Rubiŋ doho nɩaa, Simioŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Gad doho nɩaa. Sediu nanʋala Elizu nɛ ŋaa Rubiŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara. 11Ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ balɩdʋ arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ nɛ.
12Simioŋ doho nɩaa ma nɛ jaŋ hɔnɔ tɩgɛ Rubiŋ doho nɩaa lɛ. Zurisadai nanʋala Sɛlʋmɩɛl nɛ ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara. 13Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ nibi arɩ zɔɔ-batori nɛ.
14Gad doho nɩaa ma nɛ jaŋ hɔnɔ tɩgɛ Simioŋ doho nɩaa lɛ. Dʋɛl (ʋ nɛ ha Rɛwɛl) ʋ nanʋala Eliasaf nɛ ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara. 15Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ banɔŋ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ.
16Laalɩyuoro-la kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ kala ŋaa bʋɩ zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ kʋbala arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ. Rubiŋ buguŋ laalɩyuoroo nɛ ŋɩɩ, ba nɛ jaŋ ŋaa lɩa a lɩɩ.
17Dɩ ba nɛ sie ba vɛŋ, lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ arɩ Levi doho nɩaa buguŋ sɩ hɛ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ jaŋ sii. Ba sɩ hɔŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ba nɛ sie dɩ ba vɛŋ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba jaŋ vɩvɛŋ, nʋʋkala arɩ ʋ leriŋ arɩ ʋ magɩlɩŋ.
18Iziral doho doho-la sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ ba magɩlɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Efirem doho nɩaa, Manasɛ doho nɩaa arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa. Efirem doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa Amihud nanʋala Ɛlɩsama. 19Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ nɛ.
20Manasɛ doho nɩaa ma nɛ jaŋ hɔnɔ tɩgɛ Efirem doho nɩaa lɛ. Manasɛ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa Pedazu nanʋala Gamalɩɛl. 21Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ.
22Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa ma nɛ jaŋ hɔnɔ tɩgɛ Manasɛ doho nɩaa lɛ. Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa Gidioni nanʋala Abɩdaŋ. 23Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ.
24Laalɩyuoro-la kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ ŋaa bʋɩ zɔlɔ arɩ chori arɩ zɔlɔ nɛ. Efirem buguŋ laalɩyuoroo nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba nɛ jaŋ lɩɩ tori.
25Iziral doho doho deemba ma nɛ jaŋ hɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ ba magɩlɩŋ: Daŋ doho nɩaa, Asa doho nɩaa arɩ Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa. Daŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Amɩsadaɩ nanʋala Ahieza. 26Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-balɩpɛ nɛ.
27Asa doho nɩaa ma nɛ jaŋ hɔnɔ tɩgɛ Daŋ doho nɩaa lɛ. Asa doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa Ɔkɩraŋ nanʋala Pagɩɛl. 28Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ kʋbala arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ nɛ.
29Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa ma nɛ jaŋ hɔnɔ tɩgɛ Asa doho nɩaa lɛ. Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa Ɛnaŋ nanʋala Ahɩra. 30Ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ.
31Laalɩyuoroo kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ ŋaa bʋɩ zɔlɔ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ nɛ. Daŋ buguŋ laalɩyuoroo nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba nɛ jaŋ to harɩŋ lɩɩ arɩ ba magɩlɩŋ.”
32Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la kala ba sɩ dɩɩsa doho doho nɛ ŋ-la: ba ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ. 33Ba bɩ Levi doho nɩaa-na dɩɩsa pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis.
34Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis, a ŋmoo ba bugoo a hɔŋ arɩ ba magɩlaa. Dɩ ba nɛ sie ba vɛŋ ma, ba yie vɛŋ doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa nɛ.

Title: NAMBABA 3
Content:
Levi doho nɩaa
1Bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩ Mosis Sɩnaɩ peel-la nyuŋ, dɩ Arɔŋ arɩ Mosis dɩa nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: 2Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ yɩraa nɛ fa: Nadab, ʋ bii-hɩaŋ, Abihu, Elieza arɩ Ɩtama. 3Arɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ deemba nɛ ba joŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ tɩsɛ a jomba hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ baa tɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tɩntɩŋŋaa. 4Ama Nadab arɩ Abihu-na tel La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ nɛ a sʋʋ Sɩnaɩ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, bʋa-la ba sɩ nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa pɩ La TƖƖNA, ka ʋ bɩ ba ŋɩɩ daga. Nadab arɩ Abihu fa bɩ biiriŋ lʋla, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba nyɩmma Arɔŋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ Elieza arɩ Ɩtama dʋndʋŋa nɛ faa tɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tɩntɩŋŋaa.
5Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 6“Lɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa dɩ ba pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Arɔŋ lɛ dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ. 7Ba nɛ jaŋ tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ aa pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala. 8Ba nɛ maga dɩ ba bibeŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ kpɩɛraa kala, a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la kala Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ maga dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ. 9Joŋ Levi tɩmma-la a hɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩmma-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ jomba arɩ ba wɩɩkala hɛ Arɔŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. 10Lɩɩsɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɩ ba nɛ tɩtɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tɩntɩŋŋaa. Dɩ nɩwogo nɛ chɛbɛ a chɩchɛ ʋ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la ba sɩɩ tɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma kpʋʋ nɛ.”
11La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis, 12“Mɩ lɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ dɩ ba nɛ chɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa haal na-kala hambolibii bumbuŋ nyuŋ. Mɩ nɛ tɩɩ Levi doho nɩaa, 13bɛɛ wɩaa hambolibii bumbumba kala ŋaa mɩ kɩaa nɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kpʋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba, mɩ lɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba nɛ dɩ ba ŋaa mɩ kɩaa, nuhuobiinee arɩ pʋsʋŋ kala. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.”
14La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis Sɩnaɩ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, 15“Dɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. Dɩɩsɛ baal na-kala sɩ yi chɛnɛ koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ.” 16Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis dɩɩsɛba arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ. 17Levi hambolibiisiŋ yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la: Gɛsɔŋ, Kohaf arɩ Mɛrarɩ. 18Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Libini arɩ Sɩmɛɩ. 19Kohaf doho nɩaa nɛ: Amɩram, Ɩzɩha, Hɛbʋrɔŋ arɩ Ʋzɩɛl. 20Mɛrarɩ tɩŋŋaa doho nɩaa nɛ: Mali arɩ Musi. Levi doho nɩaa dɩa dɩa nɛ ŋɩɩ.
21Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa nɛ ŋaa Libini tɩŋŋaa arɩ Sɩmɛɩ tɩŋŋaa. 22Baala-la kala ba sɩ dɩɩsa sɩ yi chɛnɛ koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ba ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ balɩpɛ arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ nɛ. 23Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa nɛ maga dɩ ba ŋmoo ba buguŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la harɩŋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. 24Gɛsɔŋ tɩŋŋaa doho nɩalɩŋ sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa Laal nanʋala Ɛlɩasaf. 25Lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, Gɛsɔŋ tɩmma-la nɩɩ beŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la arɩ ʋ lɛbɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ tɔ lɛbɩ-la nyuŋ, a pɛ patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛrɛ ʋ boiŋ niiŋ lɛ, 26arɩ lɩga-la sɩ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la patɩɩsamba arɩ patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛrɛ lɩga-la boiŋ niiŋ, arɩ koru-la, ŋmɛsɩŋ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ pɛ kɩaa deemba lɛ ba kaa tɩtɩŋ.
27Kohaf doho nɩaa nɛ ŋaa Amɩram tɩŋŋaa, Iziha tɩŋŋaa, Hɛbʋrɔŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Ʋzɩɛl tɩŋŋaa. 28Ba sɩ dɩɩsɛ ba baala-la kala sɩ yi chɛnɛ koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ba ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ chori arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ nɛ. Kohaf tɩmma-la nɩɩ beŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la dɩ-zɔmʋŋ. 29Kohaf tɩŋŋaa doho nɩalɩŋ nɛ maga dɩ ba ŋmoo ba buguŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. 30Ba sɩpaalaara nɛ ŋaa Ʋzɩɛl nanʋala Elizafaŋ. 31Ba nɩɩ beŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la, teebʋl, chaaŋ daaŋ, korunu-la, Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa, patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛrɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ pɛ kɩaa deemba lɛ ba kaa tɩtɩŋ. 32Levi doho nɩaa sɩpaalaarɩ-hɩaŋ nɛ ŋaa Elieza, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Arɔŋ nanʋala. Ʋ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la dɩ-zɔmʋŋ kʋhɩaŋ.
33Mɛrarɩ doho nɩaa nɛ ŋaa Mali tɩŋŋaa, arɩ Musi tɩŋŋaa. 34Ba sɩ dɩɩsɛ ba baala-la kala sɩ yi chɛnɛ koo a kɩɩ, ba ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ balɩdʋ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ. 35Ba sɩpaalaara nɛ fa ŋaa Abɩhɛɛl nanʋala Zʋrɩɛl. Ba nɛ maga dɩ ba ŋmoo ba buguŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa. 36Mɛrarɩ tɩmma-la nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ ba bibeŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la daapɛsɩŋ, daa-gɛsɛɛ, daaterigeba, hɔ-taalɩŋ arɩ ba tɩntɩnnɩ kʋŋ na-kala, 37a saa pɛ lɩga-la sɩ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la daapɛsɩŋ, hɔ-taalɩŋ, lɛbɩ-la daapɛ-biisiŋ arɩ ŋmɛsɩŋ lɛ.
38Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ jaŋ ŋmoo ba buguŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ sɩpaaŋ. Ba nɛ jaŋ tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la dɩ-zɔmʋŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a pɩpɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Dɩ nɩwogo nɛ mʋ kpagɛ lee-la, ʋ maga dɩ ma kpʋʋ nɛ.
39La TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ dɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa doho doho, baala-la kala sɩ yi chɛnɛ koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ba ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa nɛ.
40Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, “Dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba kala sɩ yi chɛnɛ koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa. 41Joŋ Levi doho nɩaa pɩmɛ dɩ ba nɛ chɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba nyuŋ, aŋ joŋ Levi doho nɩaa pʋsʋŋ ma pɩmɛ dɩ ba ma chɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba nyuŋ. Mɩ-na nɛ ma TƖƖNA.”
42Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba kala arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ. 43Hambolibiisi-la sɩ yi chɛnɛ koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ kala nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa. Ba fa ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii arɩ batori nɛ.
44La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis, 45“Joŋ Levi doho nɩaa hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba nyuŋ, aŋ joŋ ba pʋsʋŋ ma hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba nyuŋ. Levi doho nɩaa maga ba ŋaa mɩ nɩaa nɛ. Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA. 46Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba sɩ kɩɩ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ nɩaa zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii arɩ batori ŋɩɩ, dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ ŋ time laaba, 47ʋ maga dɩ ŋ laa nʋʋkala nyuŋ warɩpʋla banɔŋ nɛ, a magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ laa Wɩa dɩa lɛ. 48Joŋ moribie-la ba sɩ joŋo time laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba-la sɩ daŋa, a pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ.” 49Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis laa moribie-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa hambolibii bumbumba-la sɩ daŋa nyuŋ. 50Moribie-la kala ŋaa warɩpʋla bʋɩ arɩ zɔɔ-batori arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ banɔŋ nɛ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ laa Wɩa dɩa lɛ. 51Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis joŋ moribie-la kala a pɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagʋ ŋɩɩ.

Title: NAMBABA 4
Content:
Kohaf tɩŋŋaa
1La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ, 2“Má dɩɩsɛ Kohaf tɩŋŋaa Levi doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 3Má dɩɩsɛ baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii a kaa mʋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ maga dɩ ba kʋʋ tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ.
4Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ Kohaf tɩŋŋaa tɩtɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ nɛ, dɩ ba bibeŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ kʋzɔmɔ woruŋ. 5Dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩɩ sii ba dɩhɔnʋŋ, Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ jaŋ jʋʋ puri patɩɩsaŋ-la sɩ kɛrɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a kaa tɔ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la. 6Ba jaŋ joŋ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a tɔ, a joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine a tɔ daŋ, a joŋ daaterigeba-la ba sɩ kaa jujoŋ daga-la a tʋʋ ba dɩ-tʋʋlaa.
7Ba jaŋ joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine a tɔ teebʋl-la nyuŋ boroboro sɩ yie daŋ a chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ, a paa pɩrataba, dasɔsʋŋ, gbansɩŋ arɩ tagɩsɩŋ ba sɩ kaa ŋɩŋaa kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a daŋ. Boroboro-la sɩ daŋ teebʋl-la nyuŋ maga dɩ ʋ daŋ nɩmɛ nɛ bʋa na-kala. 8Ba jaŋ joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-fɩaŋ a tɔ kɩalɩŋ, a joŋ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a tɔ daŋ, a joŋ daaterigeba-la ba sɩ kaa jujoŋ teebʋl-la a tʋʋ ba dɩ-tʋʋlaa.
9Ba jaŋ joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine a tɔ chaaŋ daaŋ arɩ ʋ chaanaa, a pɛ kʋ-la ba sɩ kaa mɩlɩmɛ chaana-la ta ba jɩjɩl aŋ tutuu, tʋɔrʋŋ gbaŋa, arɩ chaana-la nʋʋŋ tagɩsɩŋ. 10Ba jaŋ bɩra kɛŋ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a bɛ tɔ chaaŋ daaŋ arɩ ʋ nyuŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa kala, a joŋo daŋ daasɩ-la nyuŋ ba sɩ kaa chʋchʋŋ ba lɛ.
11Ba jaŋ joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine arɩ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a tɔ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la, a joŋ daaterigeba-la ba sɩ kaa jujoŋ koru-la a tʋʋ ba dɩ-tʋʋlaa.
12Ba jaŋ paa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩa lɛ, a joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine a bɛ tɔ, a joŋ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a tɔ daŋ, a joŋo daŋ daasɩ-la ba sɩ kaa chʋchʋmba lɛ.
13Ba jaŋ chaarɛ tʋɔrʋ-la kala sɩ hɛ kɔlɩɩŋ koru-la tʋɔŋ, aŋ joŋ gɛrɩpɛ-vachalɩŋ tɔ. 14Ba jaŋ paa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ koru-la nyuŋ: nʋʋ-hallɩŋ, nammɩa lɛsɩŋ, safʋlba arɩ kʋmɩsɩrɩ gbansɩŋ a daŋ. Ba jaŋ joŋ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenniŋ a tɔ daŋ, aŋ joŋ daaterigeba-la ba sɩ kaa chʋchʋŋ koru-la a tʋʋ ba dɩ-tʋʋlaa.
15Dɩ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ tɔ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la kpɩɛrɩ-zɔmɔ-la arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kala dɛrɛ, dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba vɛŋ, Kohaf doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ kʋ chʋmba. Ama ba bɩ maga dɩ ba digi Wɩa kʋzɔmɔ-la. Dɩ ba nɛ dige, ba jaŋ sʋʋ. Ba nɛ jaŋ chʋŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ tʋɔŋ kɩaa kala. 16Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Arɔŋ nanʋala Elieza nɛ maga dɩ ʋ bibeŋ kɩaa deemba kala nyuŋ: chaana-la nʋʋŋ, kʋsʋɔrɩ-sɩŋŋa-la, tapʋlɩɩ kala mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ nʋʋŋ. Ʋ nɛ maga dɩ ʋ bibeŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa a pɛ ʋ kpɩɛrɩ-zɔmɔ-la kala lɛ.”
17Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ, 18“Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Kohaf tɩŋŋaa sɩ lɩɩ Levi doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ kʋ kpagɛ mɩ kʋzɔmɔ a sʋʋ. 19Ŋaa ŋ-la pɩba: Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩa-la tʋɔŋ a dagɛba tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ba kʋŋkala sɩ maga dɩ ʋ tɩŋ arɩ kʋ-la nʋʋkala sɩ maga dɩ ʋ chʋŋ. 20Ama Kahof tɩmma-la bɩ maga dɩ ba jʋʋ Wɩa dɩa-la a nyilime na mɩ kʋzɔmɔ-la, dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ sʋʋ.”
Gɛsɔŋ tɩŋŋaa
21La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis, 22“Dɩɩsɛ Gɛsɔŋ tɩŋŋaa, doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 23Dɩɩsɛ baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii a kaa mʋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, nɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba kʋʋ tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ. 24Tɩntɩmɩa-la Gɛsɔŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ tɩtɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ chʋchʋŋ nɛ ŋ-la: 25Ba nɛ jaŋ chʋŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la patɩɩsamba, lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, gɛrɩpɛ-la sɩ tɔʋ arɩ lɩɩ-nɛsɩŋ tenni-la sɩ tɔ daŋ, a pɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ boiŋ niiŋ patɩɩsamba lɛ, 26lɩga-la sɩ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la arɩ koru-la patɩɩsamba arɩ ʋ boiŋ niiŋ patɩɩsamba, ŋmɛsɩ-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa. Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ. 27Tɩntɩŋŋaa deemba kala, dɩ kɩaa chʋŋʋŋ nɛ koo dɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ dɔŋ nɛ, Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ jaŋ dagɛba ba tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ba nɛ maga dɩ ba dagɛba kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ jaŋ chʋŋ. 28Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa sɩ maga dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Arɔŋ nanʋala Ɩtama nɛ maga dɩ ʋ bemba dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ.
Mɛrarɩ tɩŋŋaa
29Dɩɩsɛ Mɛrarɩ tɩŋŋaa, doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 30Dɩɩsɛ baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii a kaa mʋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, nɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba kʋʋ tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ. 31Ba tɩntɩŋŋaa ba sɩ jaŋ tɩtɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ba nɛ jaŋ chʋchʋŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la daapɛsɩŋ, daa-gɛsɛɛ, daaterigeba, arɩ hɔ-taalɩsɩŋ, 32Lɩga-la sɩ golli Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la daapɛsɩŋ, hɔ-taalɩŋ, lɛbɩ-la daapɛ-biisiŋ, ŋmɛsɩŋ, arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa. Dagɛ baal na-kala kʋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ chʋŋ. 33Mɛrarɩ tɩŋŋaa sɩ maga dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la lɛbɩ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Arɔŋ nanʋala Ɩtama nɛ maga dɩ ʋ dagɛba tɩntɩmɩa-la.”
Ba dɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa
34Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaara-la dɩɩsɛ Kohaf tɩŋŋaa, doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 35Ba dɩɩsɛ baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii a kaa mʋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, nɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba kʋʋ tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ. 36Nɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ dɩɩsa doho doho, ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-balɩpɛ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ. 37Kohaf tɩŋŋaa doho nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ niiŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ dɩɩsɛ.
38Ba dɩɩsɛ Gɛsɔŋ tɩŋŋaa ma doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa nɛ. 39Ba sɩ dɩɩsɛ baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii a kaa mʋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋʋ tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, 40ba ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ mara arɩ fii nɛ. Ba dɩɩsɛba doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa nɛ. 41Gɛsɔŋ tɩmma-la doho kala sɩɩ tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ niiŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ dɩɩsɛ. 42Ba dɩɩsɛ Mɛrarɩ tɩŋŋaa ma doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa nɛ. 43Ba dɩɩsɛ baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii a kaa mʋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kʋʋ tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, 44ba ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ. Ba dɩɩsɛba doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa nɛ. 45Mɛrarɩ tɩmma-la doho kala niiŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ dɩɩsɛ. 46Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Arɔŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaara-la dɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa doho doho arɩ dɩa dɩa. 47Ba dɩɩsɛ baala-la kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii a kaa mʋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋʋ tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ aŋ pɛ chʋchʋŋ lɛbɩ-la. 48Ba kala fa ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ chori arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ arɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ nɛ. 49La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ, ba dagɛ nʋʋkala ʋ tɩntɩmɩŋ arɩ kʋ-la nʋʋkala sɩ maga dɩ ʋ chʋŋ.
Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba dɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ kala arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis ŋɩɩ.

Title: NAMBABA 5
Content:
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ bɩ maga dɩ ba hɛ lee-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɔnɔ
1La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 2“Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba chaarɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ nyanyal choloo ta ma dɩhɔnʋŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ lɩɩŋ sɩɩ lɩɩ ba faagaa lɛ, koo ba yaraa lee-kala, koo dɩ nʋʋ nɛ digi sʋʋŋ ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ mɩ teeŋ. 3Dɩ nɩalɩŋ ŋaa baalaa nɛ koo haalaa nɛ, ma sɩ leŋe dɩ ba hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ, lee-la mɩ sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ.” 4Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa chaarɛ nɩdosunu-la ta ba dɩhɔnʋŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛ Mosis.
Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ chei ʋ dɔŋɔ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ kʋŋ nɛ
5La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Mosis, 6“Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, dɩ baal koo haal nɛ vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ, aŋ ŋaa wɩɩ a chei ʋ dɔŋɔ, nɩɩ-la laa cheeriŋ nɛ. 7Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ sɛɩ aŋ suri ʋ niiŋ a bʋl arɩ ʋ cheye nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ kʋ-la ʋ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ nɛ a pɩ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la chei, aŋ ha time daŋ a magɛ time-la ba sɩ kpaa leree banɔŋ a joŋ dɔŋɔ daŋ. 8Ama dɩ nɩɩ-la lɛ ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩɩ-la chei nɛ sʋba, aŋ bɩ naambii kɛnɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ tiŋ kɩalɩŋ pa, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ time pɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ. Ba jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara kɩaa. Tɩɩna jaŋ pɛ kɛŋ pie-bele kɔ dɩ ba kaa pɩɩsɛ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta. 9Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋzɔmɔ-la kala Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kaa kʋ pɩmɛ, jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara kɩaa. 10Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tʋɔŋ kʋŋ na-kala nɛ laa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, ba ŋaa ʋ kɩaa nɛ.”
Dɩ baal nɛ bɩɩna arɩ ʋ haala ŋaa hachɔrʋŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa
11Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Mosis, 12“Bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, dɩ ba kʋŋ nɛ bɩɩna arɩ ʋ haala berime nɛ a ŋɩŋaa hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa ʋ harɩŋ, 13a bɩɩnɛ arɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ kɛnʋ pɩŋ nɛ ka ʋ bɩ na, nʋʋ ma bɩ pɛ na wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa, nʋʋ ma bɩ ʋ kɛnɛ, 14dɩ baal-la nɛ bɩɩnɛ ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ yaraa bibieri ʋ haala nyuŋ, ka haal-la bɩ wɩɩ jɩŋ, 15ŋɩɩ-na, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ haal-la kaa mʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara teeŋ. Ʋ jaŋ pɛ kɛŋ munuŋ gbaŋa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a kaa mʋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ haal-la wɩaa. Baal-la bɩ maga dɩ ʋ joŋ nʋʋŋ koo kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a guoli muŋ-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa yarɩ-bieriŋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa a pɩa na wʋtɩtɩɩ. 16Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ kɛŋ haal-la kɔ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. 17Ʋ jaŋ joŋ taka a ŋaa mɩ lɩɩzɔmʋŋ hɛ a ŋaa Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tinteeŋ hagɩla a hɛ lɩɩ-la lɛ. 18Haal-la sɩ chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ nɛ vɔɔ ʋ nyuŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ kaa puri, aŋ joŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ muŋ-la a hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ka dɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kori lɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa kalɩbɛ. 19Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ bʋla pɩ haal-la, ‘La jaŋ kalɩbɛ, dɩ baal dɔŋ nɛ bɩŋ jɩŋ, lɩɩŋ deeŋ bɩ jaŋ ŋaaŋ wʋbɔŋ kala, 20ama dɩ ŋ nɛ lɩɩ ŋ bala harɩŋ a ŋaa disiniŋ, wɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ lɛ.’ 21Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ kalɩbɛ ŋ-la a hɛ haal-la lɛ: ‘La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ kalɩbɩŋ deeŋ diiŋ ŋ nɩaa sɩɩŋ lɛ, ŋ lʋla jaŋ kʋʋrɛ, dɩ ŋ luoruŋ su.’ 22Dɩ lɩɩŋ deeŋ la sɩ kaa kalɩbɛ nɛ tuu ŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ŋ nɛ jɩŋ wɩɩ, wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Dɩ haal-la laa hɛ a bʋl, ‘A leŋ dɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa, a leŋ dɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa.’
23Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kaa kalɩbɛ a hɛ daboro lɛ a chɛsɛ hɛ lɩɩ-la lɛ. 24Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ haal-la joŋ lɩɩ-la a nyʋa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ jɩŋ wɩɩ, kalɩbɩ-na-la jaŋ diiu dɩ ʋ chaasa na hɛɛŋ. 25Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ laa yarɩ-bieriŋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ muŋ-la haal-la teeŋ, a kaa zaarɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, aŋ kaa mʋ koru-la teeŋ. 26Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ muŋ-la nɩsɩŋ sɩɩŋ, mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dɩ-diiliŋ a nyɩgɛ koru-la nyuŋ.
