13Má zizil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a chʋchʋɔlɛ ʋ dʋndʋŋa a tutou, a ŋɩŋaa wɩɩkala ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. 14Má sɩ́ vene kala to, nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔ kpagɛma vesiŋ. 15Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa bɩ hadɔrʋŋ ka chɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ to vene dɔŋ, ʋ baanɩŋ jaŋ faasa sii ma nyuŋ dɩ ʋ cheima ta tintee-la lɛ. 16Má sɩ́ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa magɩsʋ arɩ ma fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Masa lɛ. 17Má hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wombie-la, niiri-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛma. 18Má ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, dɩ wɩɩkala vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩma dɩ ma wuo jʋʋ tintee-zɔŋ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, 19dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma wuo yuo kiri ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala tintee-la lɛ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.
20Maachie dɩ ma biiriŋ nɛ pɩɛsɛma, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa bʋl dɩ la to wombiee deemba arɩ niiriŋ deemba arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ dagɛla?” 21Má bʋla pɩba, “La fa ŋaa yosi nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA joŋ doluŋ a yuo laala. 22La sɩɩŋ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ, wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋduoruŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala lɛ. 23Ʋ laala ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a kɛnla kaa kɔ tinteeŋ deeŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩ la naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla. 24Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa bʋla pɩla arɩ la to wɩaa deemba kala aa zilu. Dɩ la nɩɩ toba bʋa na-kala, ʋ jaŋ beŋ la nyuŋ woruŋ a leŋ dɩ la wɩaa kala vɩvɛŋ ba bʋa lɛ. 25Dɩ la nɛ chaasa to wombie-la kala, arɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ daga, ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ la nyuŋ.”

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 7
Content:
Má kiri tintee-wogusu-la nɩaa sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ
1Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ kɛmma jʋʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ, a kiri tintee-wogusuŋ deemba balɩpɛ nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩma a yʋgɛ kɩɩma ma sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ: Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Gɩgasɩ tɩŋŋaa, Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa, Hivi tɩŋŋaa arɩ Jebus tɩŋŋaa. 2Dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ jomba hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ma yuo dii, má sɩ́ ba nenige fá, má chei ba kala. Má sɩ́ leŋe ma dɩ ba pɛ nii. 3Má sɩ́ ba toloo jaa, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba ma jaa ma toloo. 4Dɩ ma nɛ leŋe ma biiriŋ jaa ba toloo, tolie-la jaŋ lɛrɛba mʋ dɩ ba ma tuto ba vesiŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ saa ŋaa ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ chaasa na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ a guu cheima. 5Wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa nɩalɩŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Má giri ba vʋɩyaa korunuŋ, a ŋmoo ba vesiŋ tabɩaa yɛrɛ, a keri ba vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ lo aŋ nyɩgɛ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ kala. 6Ma chaasa ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɩaa nɛ. Ʋ lɩɩsɛma nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ dɩ ma nɛ chaasa ŋaa ʋ nɩchooloo.
7Ʋ bɩ naga ma sɩ yʋga nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA choma a lɩɩsɛma dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ʋ nɩaa, ma nɛ paala ŋaa doho-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ yʋgɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ. 8Ama La TƖƖNA paala choma nɛ a bɩ chɛ dɩ nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba kʋ ŋaa pɛɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ yuo laama arɩ ʋ doluŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, lee-la ma fa sɩ hɛ a ŋaa yosi. 9Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nii-la sɩ hɛ ma dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ chɩŋ. Ʋ jaŋ dagɛ ʋ chonuŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ chou a tuto wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga doho doho bʋɩba. 10Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrʋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ lemba, ʋ jaŋ cheiba. 11Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wombie-la arɩ niiri-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ.
12Dɩ ma nɛ to wombie-la woruŋ a kɛmba tɩtɩŋ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ choma a leŋ dɩ nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩ ma pɛgɛ chɩŋ, arɩ ʋ sɩ ŋmɩɛsɛ ŋɩɩ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba. 13Ʋ jaŋ choma a pɛ ma lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ma pʋŋ. Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma lʋl biiriŋ yʋgɛ, a leŋ ma mɩaa, girep arɩ olif tɩɩsɩŋ wasɛ, a leŋ dɩ ma pʋsʋŋ ma pʋŋ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala a pɩma tintee-la lɛ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma. 14Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a kɩɩ tintee dɔŋ kala. Ma tʋɔŋ, bapɩrɩ koo hapɩrɩ bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Ma pʋsʋŋ ma kala jaŋ lʋlʋl. 15La TƖƖNA bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nyanyalɩɩ kala jʋʋma. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔmɔ-la ma sɩ na Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ kʋŋkala hɛ ma lɛ. Ama La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. 16Tintee kala ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ, má cheiba, má sɩ́ ba nenige fá. Má sɩ́ ba vesiŋ kpaarʋ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ to ŋɩɩ lɛ a nyɩsa kɛmma.
17Ŋ bɩ pɔ ma jaŋ bʋl arɩ tinteyee deemba nɩaa dolie kɩɩma nɛ, ɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ ŋaa a kiriba dɩ ba lɩɩ tintee-la lɛ? 18Ama má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a tɩŋ ba wɩaa. Má liisi wɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa kala lɛ. 19Ma na wʋkpuŋkperisi-la arɩ wʋmagɩla-la arɩ wʋduoru-la La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ ʋ doluŋ ŋaa nɛ, aŋ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ joŋo ŋaa nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ fá lɛ. 20Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ faasa jʋʋba. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ foro ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ a faa, ʋ jaŋ kpʋba. 21Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ wɩaa, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ, ʋ ŋaa Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ a magɛ dɩ nʋʋkala fɩfáʋ. 22Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ kiri tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ dɩ ba lɩɩ kʋŋ kʋŋ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma guu kiri ba kala bala. Dɩ ʋ nɛ leŋe ma guu kiri ba kala bala, baga kɩaa jaŋ pʋrɩgɛ tintee-la lɛ a wʋwalɩmɛma. 23Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ joŋ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ a hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ba wɩaa kala vʋgʋmɛ dɩ ba to ŋɩɩ lɛ a kala sʋʋ. 24Ʋ jaŋ joŋ ba kuoroo ma a hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ma leŋ dɩ ba yɩraa lɛl dʋnɩa kala lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo diima. Ma nɛ jaŋ yuo diiba a cheiba. 25Má nyɩgɛ ba vesi-la kala. Má sɩ́ vesi-la sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla paa a kɛŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ lɔrɛ a pɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa ka kɩsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. 26Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ vesiŋ deemba kʋŋkala kaa kʋ jʋʋ ma dɩa. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋmɩaŋ-la sɩɩ to vesi-la jaŋ mɩɩra toma. Má kɩkɩsɛ kɩaa deemba a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ba kpagɛma, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA ŋmɩɛsa hɛ vesi-la lɛ nɛ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 8
Content:
Má sɩ́ La TƖƖNA Wɩaa yʋ
1Má hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, dɩ La TƖƖNA leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a pʋŋ, a jʋʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba. 2Má liisi jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa-la kala ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ kɛmma kaa vɩvɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ. Ʋ ŋaa wɩaa ma lɛ dɩ ma sɩaa tuu tinteeŋ nɛ, aŋ magɩsɛma dɩ ʋ na ma jaŋ to wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga koo ma bɩ to. 3Ʋ ŋaa ma sɩaa tuu tinteeŋ nɛ, ʋ joŋ losuŋ kpʋma, aŋ bɩra leŋ ma dii kʋdiile-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ “Mana.” Ma dɩ ma nyɩmmaba kʋŋkala bɩ kʋdiile-la jɩŋ. Ʋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ a chɩchɛ ma jɩŋ arɩ kʋdiilee dʋndʋŋa dee bɩ nuhuobiine mɩɩsɩŋ ka pa, ama Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl nɩɩ pɩ mɩɩsɩŋ. 4Jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa deeŋ kala ma sɩɩ vɛŋ, ma gɛnnɩŋ bɩ kɩɛsa, ma naasɩŋ ma bɩ ŋmɛrɛ. 5Má saa maga dɩ ma jɩŋ nɛ, a nagɛ nuhuobiine sɩ yie kɛŋ ʋ bie a dagʋ wɩaa a kɛnʋ tʋra kɩkɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa ma kɛmma tʋra kɩkɩɩ.
6Wombie-la kala ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛma, má tutoba a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga a zizilu. 7Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa kɛmma kaa mʋmʋ tintee-sɩŋ nɛ. Tintee-la kɛŋ fuonuŋ arɩ lɩɩ-bul-sɩaa sɩ bulo lɩɩ a pɩpɛllɛ fuonaasɩŋ arɩ dundolluŋ kala lɛ nɛ. 8Tintee-la kɛŋ kʋdiilee, mɛmpɛ, mɩaa, girep, tutogusuŋ, tɩɩnɛnɛ-la sɩ nagɛ kampoi nɛnɛɛ, olif tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ tʋʋŋ. 9Kʋdiilee bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba nyaa tintee-la lɛ. Ma bɩ jaŋ chɛ kʋŋkala ka nɩmɛ. Tintee-la bʋsʋŋ kɛŋ hɛgɛŋŋɛɛ, ʋ dundolluŋ ma kɛŋ hɔɔ-fɩaŋ, ma sɩ jaŋ wuo huri. 10Dɩ ma nɛ dii kɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩɩ chɛ tintee-la lɛ a vɔgɛ, má zil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa arɩ ʋ sɩ joŋ tintee-zɔŋ-la pɩma. 11Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a sɩ́ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩaa yʋ. Má to ʋ niiŋ, ʋ wombiee arɩ ʋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ. 12Dɩ ma nɛ na kɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩɩ chɛ a dii vɔgɛ, a saa dɩɩ zɔŋŋɔɔ a jʋjʋʋ, 13dɩ ma pʋsʋŋ ma pʋŋ, dɩ ma sɛlɩmɛ arɩ ma hɔpʋla ma pʋŋa pɛ arɩ kʋŋ na-kala ma sɩ kɛnɛ, 14ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa dagʋ a yʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩaa. Ʋ nɛ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, lee-la ma fa sɩ hɛ, a ŋaa yosi. 15Ʋ nɛ kɛmma vɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la sɩ jalɩa a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ lɛ, lee-la dɩ-bɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nʋɔmaa sɩ hɛ. Tintee-la fa bɩ lɩɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ leŋ lɩɩŋ lɩɩ bʋŋ lɛ a pɩma. 16Ʋ pɩma kʋdiile-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ‘Mana’ nɛ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, kɩalɩŋ ma dɩ ma nyɩmmaba kʋŋkala ha sɩ bɩ die aŋ ka. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a magɩsɛma nɛ dɩ ma sɩaa tʋʋ tinteeŋ, dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩma. 17Ʋ maga dɩ má jɩŋ nɛ arɩ dʋa-la kala ma sɩ na, ma tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ dee ma naba. 18Má jɩŋ arɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ pɩma doluŋ ma dʋa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ daga arɩ nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba chɩna nɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ chɩŋ ŋɩɩ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.
19Dɩ ma nɛ yʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩaa, aŋ mɩɩra tuto vesiŋ harɩŋ, mɩ jaŋ chaasa bʋla pɩma jɩnɩŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ cheima. 20Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ to, ʋ jaŋ cheima arɩ ʋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ chei tinteye-la dɔnsʋŋ ŋɩɩ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 9
Content:
Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla dee bɩ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA joŋ tintee-la pɩba
1Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ, jɩnɩŋ ma jaŋ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a mʋ yuo laa tinteyee nɩaa sɩ yʋga kɩɩma aŋ dolie kɩɩma ma tinteeŋ. Nɩalɩŋ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ sɩ jɩla tɩgɛ wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ a golli ba tasɩŋ. 2Nɩalɩŋ waayi nɛ woruŋ aŋ dol ma, ba nɛ baa yɩrɛ Anakɩ tɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ma nɩɩ ba wɩaa nɛ arɩ nʋʋ tuo a jaŋ wuo yuo diiba. 3Jɩnɩŋ, má jɩŋ arɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ laa ma sɩpaaŋ dɩ ʋ yuo dii nɩalɩŋ a nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩɩ dii kɩaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ma kiri ba kala ta dɩ ba lɩɩ tintee-la lɛ arɩ ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.
4Dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ yuo kiri nɩalɩŋ, má sɩ́ bɩɩna arɩ ma sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma nɛ tɩɩ ʋ joŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ pɩma. Ama nɩalɩŋ tʋɔbɔmʋŋ nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ kiriba ta tintee-la lɛ. 5Ma tʋɔpʋla arɩ ma wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩaa dee bɩ tɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa kiri nɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ. Ba paala ŋaa tinteye nɩaa sɩ ŋaa nɩbɔmɔ nɛ. Aŋ ka ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb dɩ ʋ chɩŋ. 6Má jɩŋ arɩ ma tʋɔpʋla wɩaa dee bɩ tɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa joŋ tintee-zɔmʋŋ deeŋ a pɩma. Ma paala ŋaa nyu-duo tɩmma nɛ.
Sɛlɩmɛ nɛ-bie-la ba sɩ libe
7Má sɩ́ yʋ, ŋɩɩ ma sɩ leŋe ma TƖƖNA Wɩa baanɩŋ faasa sii ma nyuŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ, a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a kʋ yi daha, ma vɩa ma TƖƖNA niiŋ nɛ. 8Peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ leriŋ, ma leŋe La TƖƖNA chaasa na baanɩŋ nɛ ma nyuŋ a magɛ dɩ ʋ cheima. 9Mɩ sɩ jɩl peel-la nyuŋ dɩ mɩ laa tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la balɩa, La TƖƖNA sɩ tuuri ʋ niiri-la ʋ sɩ hɛ ma dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ wɩaa hɛ, mɩ hɛ nɩmɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ tapʋlaa mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ. Mɩ bɩ kʋŋkala die, mɩ bɩ lɩɩ ma nyʋa. 10Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA joŋ tabɩɩ-taalɩ-la balɩa lɛ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa neniiŋ tuuri ʋ niiŋ wɩaa hɛ a pɩmɛ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ kʋ hilimi peel-la bʋbʋɔŋ, wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa La TƖƖNA fa sɩ hɛ nyiniŋ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ aŋ bʋla pɩma nɛ ŋɩɩ. 11Tapʋlɩa-la mahɩŋ balɩa chɛ-dɛrɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA joŋ tabɩɩ-taalɩ-la balɩa lɛ ʋ sɩ tuuri ʋ niiri-la sɩ hɛ ma dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ a pɩmɛ. 12Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Lɩɩ peel-la nyuŋ a tuu lɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ yeŋŋe nɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋ. Ba vɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛba nɛ, aŋ libi vene a pɩ ba tɩtɩa.” 13Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mɩ jɩŋ nɩaa deemba nɛ, ba ŋaa nyu-duo tɩmma nɛ woruŋ. 14Mʋ́ aŋ lemmi, mɩ na baanɩŋ nɛ woruŋ ba nyuŋ. Mɩ jaŋ cheiba, dɩ ba yɩrɩŋ lɛl dʋnɩa lɛ aŋ to ŋ lɛ a leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa tinteeŋ sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ a yʋga kɩɩba a dolie kɩɩba ma.”
15Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ lɩɩ peel-la nyuŋ a kʋʋ tuu a kori tabɩɩ-taalɩ-la balɩa lɛ Wɩa niiri-la sɩ hɛ, niiri-la sɩ hɛ ma dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ, ka peel-la kala tɔ arɩ nyiŋgeliŋ. 16Mɩ sɩ kʋ tuu, mɩ na dɩ ma vɩa wɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛma nɛ, aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ a libi nɛ-bie. Ma guu vɩa wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛma nɛ. 17Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la balɩa mɩ sɩ koro a yaga yɛrɛ ma sɩpaaŋ. 18Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra gbieni La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala tapʋlaa mahɩŋ balɩa, mɩ bɩ kʋŋkala die mɩ bɩ lɩɩ ma nyʋa. Mɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala a tɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa nɛ, a leŋ La TƖƖNA chaasa na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ. 19Fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛmmɛ nɛ a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ faasa na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ a magɛ dɩ ʋ cheima. Ama La TƖƖNA bɩra jegile nɩɩ mɩ sʋla nɛ. 20La TƖƖNA fa na baanɩŋ nɛ woruŋ Arɔŋ ma nyuŋ bʋa-la lɛ, a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sʋla laa ʋ ma. 21Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ joŋ ma wʋbɔŋ kʋ-la ma sɩ libe ʋ nagɛ nɛ-bie a hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ ʋ dii. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ a ŋmoo yɛrɛ a nɔŋ ʋ bɩɩ nʋgʋgʋ, mɩ paa hɛ lɩɩ-la sɩ pɛllɛ lɩɩ peeliŋ nyuŋ a tutuu lɛ.
22Ma bɩra leŋe La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ nɛ ma nyuŋ leree deemba lɛ: Tabɩra, Masa arɩ Kɩbʋrɔf Hataava lɛ. 23La TƖƖNA sɩ sɩ ma lɩɩ Kadɛs Banɩa lɛ a mʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ, ma vɩa nɛ. Ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ daga to, ma bɩ ʋ laa dii. 24Mɩ sɩ jɩmma faafaa kala, ma paala bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa ka nɩɩ.
25Mɩ gbieni La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala tapʋlaa mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA fa sɩ ʋʋ chɛ dɩ ʋ cheima nɛ. 26Mɩ sʋllʋ a bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ, sɩ́ ŋ nɩaa ŋ tɩtɩa sɩ lɩɩsa chei. Ŋ nɛ laaba arɩ ŋ doluŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ a kɛmba kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. 27Liisi ŋ tɩntɩnnaa Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk arɩ Jekɔb wɩaa, aŋ sɩ́ nɩaa deemba nyuduoŋ, ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ba wʋcheelee wɩaa beŋ. 28Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa jaŋ bʋl arɩ ŋ bɩ wuo kɛŋ ŋ nɩaa kaa yi tintee-la ŋ sɩ sɩ ŋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ bɛrɛba wɩaa. Ba jaŋ bʋl ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɛmba kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ŋ kpʋba ta tintee-hɩlɩŋ deeŋ lɛ. 29Ba ŋaa ŋ nɩaa nɛ, ŋ nɛ tɩɩba, ŋ nɛ kɛmba arɩ ŋ dol-balɩŋ a kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.”

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 10
Content:
Mosis yɛrɛ lɩɩsɛ tabɩɩ-taalaa balɩa ba nagɛ bumbuŋ kɩalɩŋ
1Bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Yɛrɛ a lɩɩsɛ tabɩɩ-taalaa balɩa dɩ ba nagɛ bumbuŋ kɩalɩŋ a kaa kʋ jɩl mɩ teeŋ peel-la nyuŋ. Kɛŋ daaŋ ŋaa daga ma, ʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ jaŋ joŋ tabɩa-la hɛ. 2Mɩ jaŋ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa fa sɩ hɛ bumbuŋ kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ joŋo yaga yɛrɛ lɛ, a hɛ ba lɛ, dɩ ŋ joŋo hɛ daga-la tʋɔŋ.”
3Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kɛŋ sɔjaamɩŋ daaŋ a ŋaa daga-la, aŋ yɛrɛ lɩɩsɛ tabɩɩ-taalaa balɩa ba nagɛ bumbuŋ kɩalɩŋ, mɩ kaa jɩl peel-la nyuŋ. 4Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa ʋ fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ bumbuŋ kɩalɩŋ lɛ a hɛ ba ma lɛ, ʋ niiriŋ fii-la ʋ fa sɩ hɛ nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ peel-la nyuŋ aŋ dagɛma, bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ hilimi peel-la bʋbʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA joŋ tabɩa-la a pɩmɛ. 5Mɩ kɛŋ tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la a lɩɩ peel-la nyuŋ kʋ tuu a joŋo hɛ daga-la tʋɔŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ dagɛmɛ ŋɩɩ. Tabɩa-la ha hɛ daga-la tʋɔŋ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. 6(Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɩɩ Jakaŋ tɩŋŋaa vile-la leriŋ a mʋ lee kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔsɛra. Nɩmɛ nɛ Arɔŋ sʋʋ ba hugu, ka ʋ nanʋala Elieza laa ʋ nyuŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara. 7Ba lɩɩ Mɔsɛra lɛ a mʋ Gugoda a kiele mʋ Jobata, lee-la fuo-biisiŋ sɩ hɛ. 8Peel-la nyuŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa baalaa, dɩ ba nɛ chʋchʋŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la aŋ tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa a sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Ba tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ ha ŋɩɩ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Levi doho nɩaa bɩ tinteeŋ kpaalɩŋ kɛnɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa ba kpaalɩŋ, arɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ a pɩba.)
10Mɩ bɩra sagɛ peel-la nyuŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ tapʋlaa mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ, a sʋl La Tɩɩna, arɩ mɩ fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. La TƖƖNA bɩra laa mɩ sʋla. Ʋ chonuŋ dee dɩ ʋ fa paala cheima. 11Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mʋ a laa nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba mʋ tintee-la mɩ sɩ hɛ niiŋ a pɩ ba naabalɩmaba arɩ mɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩba dɩ ba tɩɩʋ.”
Má zizil ma TƖƖNA
12Lɛɛlɛ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa, má jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma ŋaa. Má zizil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ. Má cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a tɩma pʋpʋ arɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩ-wɩɩkala. 13Má to ma TƖƖNA niiŋ arɩ ʋ wombie-la mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, ŋɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ a pɩma. 14Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ tɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ, Wɩa-jaŋ arɩ tinteeŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ. 15Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, La TƖƖNA chaasa cho ma naabalɩmaba nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bɩ tintee dɔŋ-kala lɩɩsa, aŋ lɩɩsɛma dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ʋ nɩaa. Ma nɛ ha ŋaa ʋ nɩaa arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. 16Ŋɩɩ wɩaa a chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma pʋllɛ ma tʋɔŋ, aŋ bɩra sɩ́ nyuduoŋ kɛŋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. 17Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ kɩɩ vene kala. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ kʋŋkala lɛ a magɛ dɩ ma zizilu. Ʋ bɩ nɩaa kaa pʋpɔrɛ, nʋʋkala ma bɩ ʋ wuo kpal dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ. 18Ʋ bɩ biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haala wɩaa ka sɛɩ. Ʋ cho nɩwogusuŋ a pɩpɩba kʋdiilee arɩ gɛnnɩŋ. 19Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má cho nʋhʋɔraa, bɛɛ wɩaa ma ma fa ŋaa nʋhʋɔra nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. 20Má zizil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a tɩma pʋpʋ. Má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ a kɛŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ a tɩtɩŋ. 21Ʋ nɛ ŋaa ma Wɩa, má zilu. Ma tɩtɩa na wʋduoru-la arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa pɩma nɛ. 22Ma naabalɩmaba fa sɩɩ mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, ba ŋaa nɩaa mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii dʋndʋŋ nɛ. Ama lɛɛlɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa leŋe ma pʋŋ nɛ a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 11
Content:
Má cho La TƖƖNA a tuto ʋ niiŋ
1Má cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a tuto ʋ niiŋ arɩ ʋ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga bʋa na-kala. 2Jɩnɩŋ ma jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ na, ma biiriŋ dee bɩ ba na. Ma nɛ na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ a kɛmma tʋraa kɩɩ, ma na ʋ ballɩŋ arɩ ʋ doluŋ sɩ yʋga nɛ. 3Ma na wʋmagɩla-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ nɩaa kala lɛ nɛ. 4Ma na ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ yuo dii Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo arɩ ba janɩŋ arɩ ba janɩŋ torukoba kala nɛ, a jomba yuo hɛ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ lɛ ba kala sʋʋ, bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kire to ma harɩŋ. 5Ma biiriŋ dee bɩ wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa pɩma tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ na, aŋ ka ma-na kɔ daha. 6Bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe tinteeŋ suri Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩɩŋ lɛ a paa Ɛlɩab sɩ ŋaa Rubiŋ doho nʋʋ biiriŋ liŋ, Dataŋ arɩ Abɩram arɩ ba dɩa nɩaa, ba lɛŋŋɛɛ, tɩntɩnnaa arɩ ba pʋsʋŋ kala. 7Ama ma tɩtɩa nɛ na wʋduoru-la kala La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa.
8Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ toba, ma jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a wuo chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a jʋʋ tintee-la a laaʋ tɩɩ. 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma wuo dieni tintee-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩ ba dɩ ba doho nɩaa. Tintee-la zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ a kɛŋ kɩaa. 10Tintee-la ma sɩɩ mʋ, dɩ ma laaʋ a tɩɩ, ʋ bɩ Ijipiti tintee-la lɛ ma sɩ lɩa naga. Ijipiti lɛ ma yie duu kɩaa nɛ a ŋaa lɩɩŋ mɩmɩsɛ. 11Ama tintee-la ma sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma jʋʋ, ʋ kɛŋ peelee arɩ fuonaasɩŋ nɛ, duonuŋ nɩnɩɩ woruŋ nɩmɛ. 12Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩɩŋ fɩɛsɛ tintee-la lɛ nɛ woruŋ, ʋ yie beŋ ʋ nyuŋ a lɩɩ jɩna dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ.
13Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dɩ ma nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a to wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ a cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a tɩmaa pʋ arɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩ-wɩɩkala, 14ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ ʋ bʋa lɛ a pɩma, tafaaŋ arɩ yibiiniŋ, dɩ ma wuo pɛrɛ a na mɩaa, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ arɩ olif nʋʋŋ. 15Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma pʋsʋŋ ma na yaŋ a didii, dɩ ma tɩtɩa na kʋdiilee a dii vʋvɔgɛ. 16Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa, dɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa sɩ́ bɩrɩmʋ dɩ ma to vesiŋ harɩŋ a kpʋkpaarɛba. 17Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ. Ʋ jaŋ pɔ dɩ duonuŋ sɩ́ nɩɩ pɩma dɩ ma wuo pɛrɛ a na kɩaa. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma sʋʋ lɩma tintee-zɔŋ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩpɩma. 18Má joŋ wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma a hɛ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma nyuŋ lɛ, a ŋmʋnsɛba a vɔɔ mɛrɛ ma nɩsaa arɩ ma tilliŋ lɛ. 19Má joŋ wɩalɩŋ a dɩdagɛ ma biiriŋ bʋa na-kala, ma dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ koo dɩ ma nɩɩ vɛŋ wombiiŋ, dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma pɩŋ koo dɩ ma nɛ pɩna aŋ sii. 20Má ŋmʋnsɛba a hɛ ma borusuŋ arɩ ma boi-baalaa lɛ, 21dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma dɩ ma biiriŋ kala mɩɩsɩŋ duomi tintee-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ma naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba, dɩ ma hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.
22Dɩ ma nɛ fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a tuto wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma, a cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, a tuto ʋ wombiee a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ, 23ʋ jaŋ yuo a kiri tinteye-la kala nɩaa sɩ hɛ ma sɩpaaŋ a yʋga kɩɩma a kɛŋ doluŋ ma kɩɩma. Ka dɩ ma laa ba dɩhɔnʋŋ a hɔŋ. 24Lee na-kala ma sɩ joŋ naaŋ nʋɔsɛ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ. Ma tinteeŋ bʋa jaŋ chɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la lɛ a mʋ yi Lɛbanɔŋ tinteeŋ, a bɩra chɩŋ Yufireti fuo-la lɛ a kaa mʋ mʋgʋ-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediterenia sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. 25Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ ma sɩpaaŋ. Lee na-kala ma sɩ jaŋ mʋ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ hɛ nɩalɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba fɩfáma arɩ ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.
26Jɩnɩŋ wɩaa balɩa nɛ mɩ joŋo bil ma sɩpaaŋ: Wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa pɛ ma lɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa cheima. 27Wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa pɛ ma lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ ma nɛ to ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ. 28Wɩalɩŋ ma, ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa cheima nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ ma nɛ vɩa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ aŋ tuto vesiŋ ma sɩ bɩ jɩŋ. 29Dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ kɛmma mʋ tintee-la ma sɩɩ mʋ dɩ ma tɩɩʋ, ʋ maga dɩ má jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɛrɩzɩm nɛ a dagɛ wɩalɩŋ nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa pɛ ʋ lɛ, aŋ bɩra jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛbal ma a dagɛ wɩalɩŋ nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa cheyu. 30Peelee deemba balɩa hɛ Kɛnaŋ tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la cholo tinteeŋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ, ba dɩ More tɩɩ-bala-la bɩ bol aŋ kpagɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɩlɩgal. 31Ma ka mʋa nɛ, ka dɩ ma chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a jʋʋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩpɩma dɩ ma tɩɩ. Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ tintee-la a hɔŋ nɩmɛ, 32má hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wombie-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ joŋo bil ma sɩpaaŋ jɩnɩŋ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 12
Content:
Dɩ-bala nɛ maga dɩ ma chʋɔlɛ Wɩa
1Wombiee deemba arɩ niiriŋ deemba nɛ maga dɩ ma fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a tuto, bʋa-la kala lɛ ma sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa ma naabalɩmaba Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma. 2Tinteye-la kala ma sɩ yuo dii, má chei ba vʋɩyaa dɩ-kpaaraa kala, kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ peelee nyuŋ arɩ dundolluŋ arɩ tɩɩsɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ. 3Má yɛrɛ ba vʋɩyaa korunuŋ arɩ ba vesiŋ tabɩaa, aŋ nyɩgɛ ba vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ. Má chei ba tɔŋŋɔɔ kala, dɩ ba yɩraa lɛl lere-la.
4Ma pɔ má sɩ́ ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ to aa kpaarɛ ba vesiŋ to a zil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. 5Ama ʋ maga dɩ ma-na mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ ma doho doho kala tʋɔŋ, dɩ ma zizilu nɩmɛ. 6Nɩmɛ nɛ ma jaŋ kɛŋ ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kaa mʋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ, kpaalɩŋ fii-la sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA kʋa arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ-la ma sɩ yie kaa je a zaarɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ yie hɛ niiŋ dɩ ma joŋo pɩ La TƖƖNA, arɩ ma tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa a pɛ ma pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba lɛ. 7Nɩmɛ nɛ ma dɩ ma dɩa nɩaa jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, aŋ jʋɔsɛ kɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ kɛnɛ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ pɛ ma lɛ ma naba.
8Ma bɩ maga dɩ ma ŋɩŋaa wɩaa arɩ la sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ jɩnɩŋ. Nʋʋkala ka ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bene dɩ ʋ zɔmɔ nɛ, 9a tɩŋ ma ha sɩ bɩ tintee-la yie, lee-la ma sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ a na wiese aŋ laa dʋa-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma. 10Dɩ ma nɛ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma jʋʋ tintee-la a hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsɛma ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ma hɔŋ nɩmɛ sɔm. 11Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ tintee-la dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa lɩɩsɛ lee-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma zizilu, nɩmɛ nɛ ma jaŋ kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma kaa mʋ. Ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ arɩ ma kpaalɩŋ fii-la sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA kʋa arɩ Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ yie kaa je a zaarɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ arɩ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ yie hɛ niiŋ dɩ ma joŋo pɩ La TƖƖNA. 12Nɩmɛ nɛ ma jaŋ gbieli ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Ma dɩ ma biiriŋ arɩ ma dɩa tɩntɩnnaa arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ma tasɩŋ lɛ. Ma jɩma, ba bɩ tinteeŋ kpaalɩŋ kɛnɛ ma tʋɔŋ. 13Ma pɔ má sɩ́ ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ŋaa lee na-kala ma sɩ cho. 14Má ŋaa ma Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ kala dɩ-bala, lee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ ma doho kala tʋɔŋ. Nɩmɛ nɛ maga ma ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma.
15Ama lee na-kala ma sɩ hɛ, ma jaŋ wuo kpʋ pʋsʋ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ pɛ ma lɛ ma na a chaŋ nammɩa magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ma sɩɩ chɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ Wɩa teeŋ kala jaŋ wuo chaŋ, a nagɛ ma sɩ yie chaŋ tɛhɩɩ arɩ aamaa ŋɩɩ. 16Ama má sɩ́ pʋsʋ-la chalɩŋ dii, ma chagɛ ʋ kala ta tinteeŋ. 17Ma sɩ yie kɛŋ ma kɩaa kpaa leree fii a joŋ kʋbala-la a pɩ La TƖƖNA, a lɩɩ ma mɩaa lɛ koo ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ lɛ, koo ma nʋʋŋ lɛ koo ma pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba lɛ, koo ma tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ koo kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kaa lɩɩsɛ niiri-la ma sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ koo Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ yie kaa je a zaarɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, ma bɩ maga dɩ ma diiba ma tasɩŋ lɛ. 18Ʋ maga dɩ má kɛmba mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ma mʋ a zizilu nɛ, a diiba ʋ sɩpaaŋ, ma dɩ ma biiriŋ ma tɩntɩnnaa arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ma tasɩŋ lɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ má gbieli ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ pɛ ma lɛ ma tɩntɩmɩɩ-kala lɛ. 19Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa, a sɩ́ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ma tasɩŋ lɛ vɩa ta bʋa-la kala lɛ ma sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ.
20Dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ ma tinteeŋ jallɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ pɩma, dɩ nammɩa hɩɛnɩŋ kɛmma, ma jaŋ wuo chaŋ a magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ma sɩɩ chɛ. 21Dɩ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ma zizilu nɛ faasa bol arɩ ma dɩɩsɩŋ, ma jaŋ wuo kpʋ pʋsʋ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩma ma tasɩŋ lɛ a chaŋ a magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ma sɩɩ chɛ arɩ mɩ sɩ dagɛma ŋɩɩ. 22Ma jaŋ wuo chamba arɩ ma sɩɩ chaŋ tɛhɩɩ koo aamɩŋ ŋɩɩ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ Wɩa teeŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ Wɩa teeŋ kala jaŋ wuo chaŋ. 23Ama ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ pʋsʋ-la chalɩŋ dii, bɛɛ wɩaa chalɩŋ nɛ ŋaa pʋsʋ-la mɩɩsɩŋ. Ma saa bɩ maga dɩ ma chaŋ ba nammɩa arɩ ba mɩɩsɩŋ kala. 24Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma dii chal-la. Má joŋo bɩsa ta. 25Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ chalɩŋ ka dii, La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ, dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩ ma dɩ ma doho nɩaa kala.
26Ama ʋ maga dɩ má kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA kɩaa, arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ hɛ niiŋ dɩ ma joŋo pʋ a mʋ lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ma zizilu nɛ. 27Má kɛŋ ma kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋna nammɩa arɩ ʋ chalɩŋ kaa mʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa koru-la teeŋ. Ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋŋ kala chalɩŋ maga dɩ má joŋo bɩsa wurisi La TƖƖNA koru-la nɛ. Ama, ma jaŋ wuo chaŋ ba nammɩa-na. 28Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a tuto wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma, dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩ ma dɩ ma doho bʋa na-kala lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa maa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ a tʋtɔrɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa tʋɔŋ nɛ.
29Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ chei tinteye-la kala nɩaa sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ ma sɩɩ mʋ dɩ ma tɩɩ. Ama dɩ ma nɛ kiriba ta ba tintee-la lɛ aŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ, 30ma pʋpɔ dɩ má sɩ́ chɩchɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ to a kpʋkpaarɛ ba vesiŋ, a bʋl ma ma jaŋ to ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa a zil ma Wɩa. 31Má bɩ maga dɩ má zil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ zil ba vesiŋ. Dɩ ba nɩɩ kpaarɛ ba vesiŋ, ba yie ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ bana kɛnɛ a kɩkɩsɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Ba yie wuo joŋ ba biiriŋ a nyɩga pɩ ba vesiŋ.
32Má hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma, ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ wɩɩ lɩɩsa ta a sɩ́ wɩɩ ma kaa pɛ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 13
Content:
Má sɩ́ vene kala to
1Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ koo a wuo dɩdagɛ duosoo bʋbʋɔŋ, a bʋl arɩ wʋkpuŋkpere koo wʋmagɩl jaŋ ŋaa, 2dɩ wʋkpuŋkpere-la koo wʋmagɩl-la wɩaa ʋ sɩ bʋla nɛ sɛnɛ ŋaa, ka dɩ ʋ bʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ la to vesiŋ a pɛ La Tɩɩna lɛ a kpʋkpaarɛba (vesiŋ ma ha sɩ bɩ to aŋ ka),” 3má sɩ́ jegile nɩɩ ʋ teeŋ. Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa to ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ dɩ ʋ magɩsɛma a na arɩ ma chou arɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩ-wɩɩkala nɛ. 4La TƖƖNA Wɩa dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga dɩ ma tuto a zizilu. Má tuto ʋ niiŋ a tɩma pʋpʋ a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ woruŋ. 5Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la koo nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagɛ duosoo bʋbʋɔŋ maga dɩ ma kpʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla lɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ daga harɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ kɛmma kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, a laama ta lee-la ma fa sɩ hɛ a ŋaa yosi. Nɩdoho deeŋ ka walɩmɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛma wombii-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛma lɛ nɛ. Má kpʋ nɩɩ-la a giri wʋbɔŋ-la ta ma tʋɔŋ.
6Dɩ ŋ naambie tɩtɩa koo ŋ bie koo ŋ tolo koo ŋ hachooluŋ koo ŋ nandɔŋ-fɩɛmɩŋ nɛ lʋara nyɩsɩŋ a bʋl, “Leŋ dɩ la mʋ a to vesiŋ a pɛ La Tɩɩna lɛ,” vesi-la ma dɩ ma nyɩmmaba kʋŋkala ha sɩ bɩ to aŋ ka, 7nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔnɔ gollima vesiŋ, dɩ ba kpagɛma koo dɩ ba hɛ dɩ-bolii nɛ, 8sɩ́ jegile nɩɩ ʋ teeŋ, sɩ́ sɛɩ a pʋ, a sɩ́ ʋ nisusuŋ fá a gbaa tɔ wɩɩ-la. 9Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ kpʋʋ nɛ. Ŋ nɛ maga dɩ ŋ laa sɩpaaŋ yagʋ arɩ tabɩɩŋ ka dɩ nɩaa na kʋʋ pɛ. 10Má yagʋ kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋʋ walɩmɛ dɩ ma vɩa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ nɛ, ʋ nɛ kɛmma lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, lee-la ma fa sɩ hɛ a ŋaa yosi. 11Dɩ ma nɛ kpʋ nɩɩ-la dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala nɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba. Ba kʋŋkala maachie bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la doho.
12Dɩ ma nɛ hɔŋ tasɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩma, a nɩɩ 13dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɩɩ ma tʋɔŋ a nyɩsɛ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ to vesiŋ, vesi-la ma ha sɩ bɩ to aŋ ka, 14má hɛ doluŋ aŋ beŋ wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ woruŋ a na, dɩ ma nɛ kʋ na dɩ wʋlɔrʋ-la sɛnɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ, 15má chei taŋ-la kala, a kpʋ ʋ nɩaa arɩ ba pʋsʋŋ kala. 16Má paa taŋ-la tɩŋŋaa dʋa kala a kaa mʋ bil taŋ-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, a nyɩgɛ ba kala dɩ ba ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. Taŋ-la maga dɩ ʋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, ma bɩra sɩ́ ʋ paa saa. 17Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ taŋ-la kɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala La TƖƖNA sɩ sɩ ma nyɩgɛ joŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA baaŋ-la ʋ sɩ faasa na ma nyuŋ jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ ka dɩ ʋ fá ma nenige. Ʋ jaŋ fá ma nenige a leŋ dɩ ma pʋŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ a pɩ ma naabalɩmaba ŋɩɩ, 18dɩ ma nɛ to ʋ niiŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 14
Content:
Kʋdiile-la sɩɩ kɩsʋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ kɩsɛ
1Ma ŋaa La TƖƖNA Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sʋba dɩ ma yiyel ʋ yoho, má sɩ́ ma yaraa kpɛrʋ, a sɩ́ ma tilliŋ ma fʋŋ arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, 2bɛɛ wɩaa ma ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ. Dʋnɩa kala tʋɔŋ, ma TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛma nɛ dɩ ma ŋaa nɩa ʋ sɩ chaasa cho.
3Má sɩ́ kɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ sɩ baa kɩsʋ kʋŋkala dii. 4Pʋsʋ-la arɩ bagɩla-la ma sɩ jaŋ wuo chaŋ nɛ ŋ-la: nɛsɩŋ, piesee, bʋʋnaa, 5aamaa, bʋrʋŋ, tɛhɩɩ, tabʋmbʋŋ koo komo. 6Ma jaŋ wuo chaŋ pʋna koo bagɩl na-kala sɩ kɛŋ naachɛŋŋɛɛ aŋ gbu kɩaa chɩchaŋ. 7Ama pʋsʋ-la arɩ bagɩla-la sɩ bɩ naachɛŋŋɛɛ kɛnɛ aŋ gbu kɩaa chɩchaŋ tʋɔŋ, má sɩ́ bʋntaŋŋa, chuomo arɩ bʋŋ-nyuŋ gbuŋgbogo chaŋ, ba kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ ma teeŋ. 8Tooŋ ma kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ ma teeŋ, ʋ ma kɛŋ naachɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ aŋ bɩ kɩaa gbu chɩchaŋ, má sɩ́ ʋ nammɩa chaŋ a sɩ́ ʋ kʋsʋʋŋ ma digu.
9Kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ kerikee arɩ horuŋ ma jaŋ wuo chamba. 10Ama kɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ horuŋ arɩ kerikee kɛnɛ, ba kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ ma teeŋ má sɩ́ ba chaŋ.
11Ma jaŋ wuo chaŋ diibiisi-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. 12Má sɩ́ diibiisiŋ deemba chaŋ: kachuuŋ, duuŋ arɩ duuŋ-bine, 13habal-joŋ doho na-kala, 14gɩlɩŋgaaŋ doho na-kala, 15hajaaŋkuŋkuŋ-la sɩ kɛŋ dɩgɩlaa, gʋra nyilimi arɩ kɩl doho na-kala, 16hajaaŋkuŋkuŋ-pʋla, hajaaŋkuŋkuŋ-bine arɩ hajaaŋkuŋkuŋ-bie, 17hajaaŋkuŋkuŋ-la sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, kachuunaa-fɩaŋ arɩ kamege, 18naliiribommie, kʋlʋŋkʋɔl doho na-kala, diibii-kantɔmʋŋ arɩ jɩŋ.
19Filli-biisi-la kala sɩ yie hɛ dɔŋɔ a fifil, ba kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ ma teeŋ, má sɩ́ ba chaŋ. 20Ma jaŋ wuo chaŋ filli na-kala sɩ kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ aŋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.
21Má sɩ́ kʋŋ na-kala sɩ sʋʋ pimee dii. Ma jaŋ wuo joŋo pɩ nɩwogusu-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ dɩ ba dii koo ma yalla pɩ nɩwogusu-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ hɔnɔ kpagɛma. Ma ŋaa ma TƖƖNA nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ. Má sɩ́ bʋʋ-bie koo pie-bie chɔ ʋ naaŋ yɩlɩŋ lɛ.
Kpaalɩŋ fii-la sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA kʋa
22Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa jɩna na-kala, ma kaa kpaa leree fii a joŋ dɔŋɔ bil. 23Ma sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ma mɩaa, ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ a kpaa leree fii-la a joŋ kɩalɩŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA, a pɛ ma pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba lɛ, má kaa mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dagɛma dɩ ma mʋ a zizilu nɩmɛ a dii kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ. Má ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ a zizil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa bʋa na-kala lɛ. 24Dɩ lee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ daga nɛ bolie arɩ ma dɩɩsɩŋ, ma sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo chʋŋ kpaalɩŋ fii time-la kaa mʋ, kɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA sɩ pɛ ma lɛ ma na, 25má joŋo yallɛ a kɛŋ moribie-la mʋ lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ dɩ ma zizilu nɩmɛ. 26Ma joŋ moribie-la a yɔɔ kʋŋ na-kala ma sɩɩ chɛ: Nɛsɩŋ, piesee, tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ koo sɩ-yele. Ma dɩ ma dɩa nɩaa jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ aŋ gbieli. 27Ma pɔ má sɩ́ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ wɩaa yʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba-na bɩ tinteeŋ kpaalɩŋ kɛnɛ ma tʋɔŋ.
28Jɩ-tori na-kala dɩdɛrɩŋ, ma sɩ yie kɛŋ ma baga kɩaa kpaa lere fii a joŋ kʋbala-la a pɩ La TƖƖNA, má joŋ ba kala bil ma tasɩŋ lɛ. 29Kʋdiile-la nɛ jaŋ ŋaa Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ kpaal kɛnɛ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ kʋdiilee, ba dɩ nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haala-la sɩ hɛ ma tasɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba dii a vɔgɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ wɩɩkala ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 15
Content:
Jɩna-la ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ chɩŋ diiree chɩŋŋaa chɛba
1Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ joŋ kɩaa chɩŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ, dɩ jɩ-pɛɩ nɛ kʋ dɛrɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ giri chɩŋ-la ta. 2Ŋ-la nɛ maga ma ŋɩŋaa: Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna nɛ joŋ kɩaa a chɩŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ, ʋ bɩra sɩ́ pɩɛsa laa, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ sɩ ba giri chɩŋŋaa ta yie nɛ. 3Ma jaŋ wuo pɩɛsa laa ma chɩŋŋaa nɩwogusuŋ teeŋ, ama ma naambiiriŋ-na teeŋ, má gire ta. 4Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa summu ma tʋɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ, ʋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ woruŋ, 5dɩ ma nɛ sɛɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ, a to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ. 6Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ chaasa pɛ ma lɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩma ŋɩɩ. Tinteyee jaŋ yʋgɛ a chɩŋ kɩaa ma teeŋ, ama ma-na bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ kʋŋ nʋʋkala teeŋ. Tintee kala nɩaa bɩ jaŋ bibemma, ama ma-na jaŋ bibeŋ tintee daŋ.
7Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, dɩ summoo hɛ ma naambiiri-la tʋɔŋ tasɩ-la kʋŋkala lɛ, má sɩ́ tʋɔhɛɛŋ kɛŋ a vɩaba ta. 8Má kɛŋ zile a joŋ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ chɛ a chɩmba. 9Dɩ jɩ-pɛɩ-la lɛ ma sɩ jaŋ giri chɩŋŋaa ta nɛ kpaga ma, ka dɩ ma naambiiri-la kʋŋ nɩsɩŋ buo, dɩ ʋ chɩchɛ ʋ chɩŋ kʋŋ ma teeŋ, má sɩ́ tʋɔhɛɛŋ kɛŋ a vɔmʋ. Dɩ ma nɛ vɔmʋ dɩ ʋ yele pɩ La TƖƖNA, ma jaŋ laa cheeriŋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. 10Má sɩ́ wɩaa gʋrʋmʋ aŋ-na pɛ ʋ lɛ, má pɛ ʋ lɛ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala ma sɩɩ tɩŋ lɛ, ma nɩsɩŋ jaŋ su. 11Bʋa na-kala lɛ nyaabaa jaŋ hɛ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, má kɛŋ zile ma naambiiriŋ arɩ nyaaba-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ teeŋ.
Yosuŋ joŋo tanɩŋ wɩaa
12Dɩ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa baal koo haal nɛ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a yalla pɩ ma dɔŋɔ a ŋaa yoŋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa pɩŋ jɩsɩŋ balɩdʋ, jɩ-pɛɩ lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ŋ joŋu ta nɛ. 13Dɩ ŋ nɛ taʋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ mʋ arɩ na-hɩllɩŋ. 14Lɩɩsɛ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ pɛ ŋ lɛ ŋ dʋa a pʋ, piesee, mɩaa arɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ. 15Ma jɩŋ arɩ ma ma fa ŋaa yosi nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa laama ta, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ joŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ aa dagɛma jɩnɩŋ. 16Dɩ ŋ yomo-la nɛ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ viiri, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ cho ŋ dɩ ŋ dɩa nɩaa wɩaa, ka ʋ nɩsɩŋ ma jʋjʋʋ, 17ŋɩɩ-na kɛŋ ʋ dɩgɩlɩŋ mʋ mɛrɛ boro lɛ a tɔɔ luri arɩ luro. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ yoŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Dɩ yomo-la nɛ ŋaa haal, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ.
18Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ wɩɩ dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ ŋ joŋ ŋ yomo ta, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ tɩŋ jɩsɩŋ deemba balɩdʋ a pɩŋ, ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa sɩ yʋga kɩɩ nʋʋ ŋ fa sɩ jaŋ joŋ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ, ka dɩ ŋ timu naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa wɩaa. Dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ leŋe ŋ tʋɔŋ wɩɩ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ wɩɩ na-kala ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.
Pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba
19Má joŋ ma pʋsʋŋ bii-bumbumba sɩ ŋaa belliŋ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. Ma pɔ má sɩ́ ma nɛsɩŋ bii-bumbumba-la kaa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, a pʋpɔ má sɩ́ ma piesee ma bii-bumbumba pʋnaa kɛ. 20Jɩna na-kala ma dɩ ma dɩa nɩaa jaŋ kɛŋ pʋsʋ-la mʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛ, a kpʋ chaŋ. 21Ama dɩ pʋsʋ-la kʋŋ nɛ kɛŋ nyɔɔ, dɩ ʋ nyʋlɩma nɛ koo dɩ ʋ gbɛrɩgɛ nɛ koo dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nyanyal-bɔŋ dɔŋ nɛ, ma bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛnʋ kʋ kpʋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. 22Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ La TƖƖNA teeŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ ʋ teeŋ, ma kala jaŋ wuo chamba ma tasɩŋ lɛ a nagɛ ma sɩ yie chaŋ tɛhɩɩ koo aamɩŋ ŋɩɩ. 23Má sɩ́ ba chalɩŋ dii, má joŋo bɩsa ta.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 16
Content:
La TƖƖNA dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele
1Chɛnɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Abib tʋɔŋ, má gbieli ma TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele, bɛɛ wɩaa chɛnɛ-la tʋɔŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ nɛ ʋ kɛmma kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. 2Má lɩɩsɛ piese koo nɛŋ a kaa mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ma zizilu a kpʋ a ŋaa ma TƖƖNA dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la kʋdiilee. 3Dɩ ma nɩɩ dii gbiele-la kʋdiilee, má sɩ́ boroboro-la sɩ kɛŋ sɩbʋrʋŋ dii. Má dii boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ ŋɩɩ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ, dɩ ʋ liliisima hɛɛ-la ma sɩ na bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩɩ chɛ lɩma lɩma dɩ ma lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. 4Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ hɛ ma teeŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Má pʋpɔ dɩ pʋsʋ-la ma sɩ kpʋa chɛ-bumbuŋ-la dɩdaanɩŋ nammɩa sɩ chɩna chʋa.
5Má sɩ́ La TƖƖNA dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la pʋna kpʋ taŋ kala ma sɩ cho lɛ, tasɩ-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma lɛ, 6see lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛma dɩ ma mʋ a zizilu. Nɩmɛ nɛ ma jaŋ kpʋ pʋsʋ-la wɩɩ-mul-jʋʋlʋŋ, bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ ma sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. 7Má wasɛ nammɩa-la a chaŋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dagɛma. Dɩ taŋ nɛ pʋla chʋchʋɔŋ, má mɩɩra mʋ ma dɩɩsɩŋ. 8Má dii boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ tapʋlaa balɩdʋ, ama tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ má sɩ́ tɩntɩmɩɩ kala tɩŋ, má hilimi a zil ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.
Baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ gbiele
9Má chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ suomo a kʋkʋŋ ma mɩaa a dɩɩsɛ yɔɔsʋŋ balɩpɛ, 10aŋ gbieli ma baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ gbiele a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. Nʋʋkala jaŋ kɛŋ Wɩa sɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ magɛ ŋɩɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa a kaa kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. 11Ma dɩ ma biiriŋ, ma tɩntɩnnaa, baalaa arɩ haalaa, Levi doho nɩalɩŋ arɩ nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haala-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, ma kala maga dɩ má mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ma zilu nɩmɛ a gbieli ʋ sɩpaaŋ. 12Má jɩŋ arɩ ma fa ŋaa yosi nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩɩ dagɛma.
Lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele
13Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa dɛrɛ, a tɔrɛ ma tɩɩnɛnɛɛ, má gbieli lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. 14Ma dɩ ma biiriŋ, ma tɩntɩnnaa, baalaa arɩ haalaa, Levi doho nɩalɩŋ arɩ nɩwogusu-la, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haala-la kala sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, ma kala maga dɩ má gbieli gbiele-la arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. 15Má mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dagɛma dɩ ma zizilu a gbieli gbiele-la tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Má leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma TƖƖNA pɛ ma lɛ nɛ ma baga kɩaa wasɛ, a pɛ ma lɛ ma nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa ma kala lɛ.
16Jɩna na-kala tʋɔŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa baalaa kala maga má mʋ ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ naansɩɩŋ butori nɛ, lee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dagɛma dɩ ma zizilu, a gbieli gbielee deemba: La TƖƖNA dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele, baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ gbiele arɩ lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele. Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ arɩ na-hɩllɩŋ. 17Nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ kʋŋ nɛ a mʋ dii zile pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ.
Sarɩya diiree
18Tasɩ-la kala ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma lɛ, doho kala maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛ sarɩya diiree arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ. Ba maga ba kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a laa nɩalɩŋ wɩaa jɩjɩŋ. 19Nɩaa deemba bɩ maga dɩ ba joŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ faa, a sɩ laa pɛ nʋʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kɩaa nɛ bɩ sɩŋ, a sɩ́ kpalaa laa. Kpalaa nɛ yie leŋ nɩaa joŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ faa aŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ bɩrɩmɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ. 20Má leŋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ laa ma wɩɩkala sɩpaaŋ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma a tɩɩʋ.
Má sɩ́ vesiŋ to
21Dɩ ma nɛ saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ dɩ ma pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, má pɔ dɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daa kala sɩ́ nɩmɛ pɛ. 22Má sɩ́ tabɩɩ kala joŋo bil aa kpaarɛ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa bɛrɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 17
Content:
1Ma pɔ má sɩ́ nɛŋ koo piese sɩ kɛŋ nyɔɔ kpʋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, ʋʋ kɩsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ.
2Tasɩ-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ma hɔŋ ba lɛ, dɩ baal koo haal nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ, a ŋaa wʋbɔŋ a chei nii-la sɩ hɛ ma dɩ ma TƖƖNA pɛgɛ, 3a zizil wɩa-nyuŋ kʋŋ, wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, chɛnɛ, koo chɛnwʋlaa, arɩ vesiŋ dɔnsʋŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ bɩ ŋɩɩ daga, 4dɩ ma nɛ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, má nyilimi wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ woruŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ na dɩ wɩɩ-la ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ, arɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ nɛ ba sɛnɛ ŋaa Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, 5má kɛŋ baal-la koo haal-la sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la a lɩɩ taŋ-la lɛ, a yagʋ kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa. 6Dɩ nɩaa balɩa koo batori nɛ pɛ na wɩɩ arɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ma jaŋ wuo kpʋ nɩa. Ama ma bɩ jaŋ wuo kpʋ nʋʋ dɩ nɩbala dʋndʋŋ nɛ pɛ na. 7Nɩalɩŋ sɩ dii pɛ na nɛ maga dɩ ba laa sɩpaaŋ paa tabɩaa a yagɛ nɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋ, ka dɩ nɩkaanaa na pɛ. Ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a giri wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba doho ta Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.
Sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ
8Dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ wɩaa kaa kɔ ma sarɩya dɩ-diilee, dɩ wɩalɩŋ dolie kɩɩ ma jɩmɩŋ, má kaa mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ. Wɩalɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ba kpʋ koo dɩ nʋʋ nɛ pɩrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ, koo dɩ nɩaa nɛ kɛŋ dʋa wɩaa yuyuo dɔŋɔ. 9Má kɛŋ wɩɩ-la mʋ Levi doho Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ sarɩya diiri-la sɩ hɔŋ kpasa nyuŋ bʋa-la lɛ teeŋ, a bʋla pɩba. Ba jaŋ laa wɩɩ-la jɩma pɩma. 10Lee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ lɛ, wɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ bʋla pɩma, ʋ maga dɩ ma fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to ba kala. 11Ʋ maga dɩ má to wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ beŋ wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ a bʋla pɩma, má sɩ́ begilu wɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala lɛ. 12Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩa wɩalɩŋ sarɩya diire sɩ dagɩŋ koo wɩalɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara sɩ hɛ lee-la a tɩma pɩpɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɩŋ, ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋʋ nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ a giri wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. 13Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba, dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ wʋdosunu-la ŋaa.
Ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ to a lɩɩsɛ kuoro
14Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ yi tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ma hɔŋ ʋ lɛ a tɩɩʋ, ma jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ kuoro, arɩ tinteye-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ golli ma sɩ kɛŋ kuoroo ŋɩɩ. 15Má beŋ woruŋ arɩ nɩɩ-la ma sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kuoro, ŋaa nʋʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa. Ʋ maga ʋ ŋaa ma naambii nɛ, nɩwogo bɩ maga ʋ ŋaa ma kuoro. 16Kuoru-la bɩ maga ʋ kɛŋ janɩŋ yʋgɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ nɩaa mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a yɔɔ janɩŋ kaa kʋ pʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ, ʋ bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ nɩaa bɩra joŋ ba sɩaa chaasɛ lee-la. 17Kuoru-la bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ haalaa yʋgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa La TƖƖNA. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ chɩchɛ ʋ kɛŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ yʋgɛ. 18Dɩ ʋ nɛ dii kuoruŋ, ʋ maga ʋ laa ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa hɛ teŋ-la lɛ Levi doho nɩaa sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa teeŋ, a leŋ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ teniŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ pʋ dɩ ʋ bil, a kɩkarɩmɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ. 19Teŋ-la maga ʋ hɛ ʋ teeŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ kɩkarɩmɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ zizil ʋ Tɩɩna Wɩa a tuto ʋ wombiiŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga. 20Ŋɩɩ nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ Wɩa wombiiŋ lɛ bibegili, a bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ nɛ kpɩa ʋ naambiiriŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala. Dɩ ʋ nɛ to woruŋ, ʋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa jaŋ dii kuoruŋ a dieni Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 18
Content:
Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Levi doho nɩaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kɩaa
1Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa kala bɩ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ tinteeŋ kpaal Iziral tinteeŋ kala lɛ. Ba kpaalɩŋ nɛ kɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kaa kɔ dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA. 2A tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ tinteeŋ kpaal kala kɛnɛ ba naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ, La TƖƖNA nɛ jaŋ pɩba kʋŋkala ba sɩɩ chɛ, arɩ ʋ fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩba.
3Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kpʋ nɛ-bele koo piesu dɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ vaaŋ, talaŋa arɩ tʋɔŋ kɩaa. 4Má joŋ ma baga kʋdii falaa ma a pɩba: Mɩaa, tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ, nʋʋŋ arɩ ma pie-pʋŋ-bumbumba-la ma sɩ kɛ. 5Ma doho doho kala tʋɔŋ, Levi doho nɩaa arɩ ba doho nɩaa kala nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa a kaa mʋ wuu. 6Dɩ Levi tɩɩna nɛ lɩɩ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa tasɩ-la kʋŋ ʋ sɩ hɛ lɛ, a mʋ lee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ma zizilu, 7ʋ jaŋ wuo tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa ʋ Tɩɩna Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɩmɛ arɩ ʋ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ ŋɩɩ lee-la. 8Ʋ dɩ ʋ dɔnsʋ-la kala kpaalɩŋ jaŋ magɛ dɔŋɔ. Kpaalɩŋ deeŋ-na bɩ ʋ nyɩmma dʋa kpaalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa lɛ pɛ.
Wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kɩsʋ
9Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ jʋʋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, má sɩ́ tinteye-la sɩ hɛ lee-la nɩaa lɛ to a ŋaa wɩaa deemba sɩɩ kɩsʋ. 10Ma pɔ má sɩ́ ma bii-kala, baal koo haal kaa kpʋ a nyɩgɛ koruŋ nyuŋ a pɩ vene kala. Má sɩ́ vʋgʋ, a sɩ́ chichiribi wɩaa ŋaa, hɩllɩŋ, 11koo a didii koruŋ-barɩŋ, aa yɩrɛ lɛlɛɛ koo kantɔŋŋɔɔ. 12La TƖƖNA bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋkɩsaa deemba nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa kikiri tinteye-la nɩaa sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ ŋɩɩ. 13Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma kɛŋ wʋcheeli kala ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ.
Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla
14Tinteye-la ma sɩɩ mʋ dɩ ma yuo kiri aŋ laa ba tinteeŋ, ba nɩaa ka to vʋgʋraa arɩ chichiribee niiŋ nɛ. Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa bɩ chɛ dɩ ma-na tuto wɩalɩŋ. 15Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ ma naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ a pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ʋ wʋlaabʋlla a nagɛ mɩ-na Mosis. Ʋ maga dɩ má jegile nɩnɩɩ ʋ teeŋ. 16Tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ hilimi peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ bʋbʋɔŋ, ma sɩ, “La bɩra bɩ chɛ dɩ la nɩɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa yikoro, koo dɩ la na ʋ nyiŋ-bal-la, dɩ la nɛ na ŋɩɩ la jaŋ sʋʋ.”
17Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ. 18Mɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ ba naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ dɩ ʋ nagɛ ŋ-na Mosis, a joŋ mɩ wɩaa hɛ ʋ niiŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagʋ a pɩba. 19Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ vɩa dɩ ʋ jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ-la sɩ jaŋ bʋl mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, mɩ-na tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ tɩɩna. 20Ama dɩ mɩ wʋlaabʋllʋ kala nɛ bʋl wɩɩ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ka mɩ dee bɩ ʋ hɛ, koo dɩ vene dɔŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ ma kpʋʋ nɛ.” 21Ma jaŋ wuo pɩɛsɛ dɔŋɔ a bʋl, “Ɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa dee bɩ ʋ hɛ ʋ bʋbʋl wɩɩ-la?” 22Dɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ nɛ bʋl wɩɩ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ka wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla bɩ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋɩɩ-na La TƖƖNA dee bɩ ʋ hɛ, ʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la ʋ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ, má sɩ́ ʋ fa.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 19
Content:
Tasɩ-la ma sɩ jaŋ fá mʋ yuyuori
1Dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ chei tinteye-la nɩaa tinteeŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, dɩ ma kiriba ta aŋ laa ba tasɩŋ arɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ a hɔŋ, 2má lɩɩsɛ tabalaa batori a pɩ ma tɩtɩa, dɩ ba hɛ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ. 3Má kɛŋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ kaa kpaa leree batori, dɩ lere-la kʋŋkala kɛŋ taŋ ba sɩ jaŋ fá mʋ yuyuori. Má bil wombiee a mʋmʋ tasɩ-la, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kpʋ nʋʋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo fá mʋ tasɩ-la dɔŋɔ.
4Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ sɛnɛ aŋ kpʋ nʋʋ sɩ tuo ʋ dʋndɔŋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo fá mʋ tasɩ-la a laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ. 5La joŋ arɩ nʋʋ arɩ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna nɛ sii mʋ gɩrɩŋ dɩ ba keri daasɩŋ. Ʋ sɩɩ keri ŋɩɩ, dɩ saaŋ fogi a yagɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna-la kpʋ. Baal-la jaŋ wuo fá mʋ tasɩ-la dɔŋɔ a laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ. 6Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kpʋa naambile sɩ jaŋ dii ʋ dʋa nɛ na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa, ʋ jaŋ na baanɩŋ a kire to nɩɩ-la sɩ kpʋ ʋ naambie harɩŋ. Dɩ taŋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ mʋ yuori nɛ bolie, ʋ jaŋ kire kɛnʋ a kpʋʋ, ka ʋ fa bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kpʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ sɛnɛ. 7Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ mɩ bʋl ma lɩɩsɛ tabalaa batori a pɩ ma tɩtɩa a fá mʋ yuyuori nɛ ŋɩɩ.
8Dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ leŋe dɩ ma tinteeŋ jallɛ, arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ a pɩ ma naabalɩmaba ŋɩɩ, a joŋ tintee-la kala pɩma arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ, 9a tɩŋ ma sɩ fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to wombie-la kala mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, a cho ma TƖƖNA Wɩa a tuto ʋ wombiee bʋa na-kala, ʋ maga dɩ má bɩra lɩɩsɛ tasɩŋ batori nɛ a pɛ. 10Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ, dɩ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye chalɩŋ sɩ́ tintee-la lɛ jaasʋ, dɩ ma laa cheeriŋ.
11Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɛrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, a maachie sii lʋara ŋmobu kpʋ, aŋ fá mʋ tasɩŋ deemba dɔŋɔ, 12ʋ taŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ maga dɩ ba leŋ dɩ ba mʋ kɛnʋ mɩɩra kɔ ba jaŋ nɛ, dɩ ba joŋu hɛ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kpʋa naambile sɩ jaŋ dii ʋ dʋa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋʋ. 13Má sɩ́ nɩɩ-la nenige fá. Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ a leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye chalɩŋ sɩ́ jaasʋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, ka dɩ wɩaa wuo vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩma. 14Tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma lɛ, má sɩ́ tinteeŋ bʋɔsʋ-la ma naabalɩmaba sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bil kaa vʋgʋmɛ a gʋrɛ dɔŋɔ.
Pɛ-naaraa wɩaa
15Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ba bʋl arɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ nɛ a chei, nɩbala dʋndʋŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ na arɩ wɩɩ-la ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Nɩaa balɩa koo nɩaa batori nɛ jaŋ wuo pɛ na ka dɩ wɩɩ-la na chɩŋ.
16Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sɩ ʋ pɛ na wɩɩ a nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩ nʋʋ arɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ nɛ a chei, 17ʋ dɩ nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa pa maga dɩ ba mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ nɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ sarɩya diire-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ bʋa-la lɛ teeŋ. 18Sarɩya diire-la maga dɩ ba beŋ wɩɩ-la tʋɔŋ nɛ woruŋ. Dɩ ba nɛ kʋ na arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ sɩ ʋ pɛ na wɩɩ-la nɛ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ, a nyɩɛ wɩaa pɩpɩ ʋ naambile, 19ʋ maga dɩ ba joŋ wɩɩ-la ba fa sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa ʋ naambile lɛ, a ŋaa ʋ lɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ má giri wʋbɔŋ-la ta nɛ ma tʋɔŋ. 20Dɩ nɩkaana-la nɛ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la ma sɩ ŋaa, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋba, ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ doho ma tʋɔŋ. 21Má sɩ́ nʋʋkala nenige fá. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kpʋ ʋ dɔŋɔ, má kpʋʋ ma, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ pʋrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ sɩɩŋ, má pʋrɛ ʋ ma sɩɩŋ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋmoo ʋ dɔŋɔ nyɩlɩŋ churi, má ŋmoo ʋ ma nyɩlɩŋ churi, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bori ʋ dɔŋɔ nɩsɩŋ, má bori ʋ ma nɩsɩŋ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bori ʋ dɔŋɔ naaŋ, má bori ʋ ma naaŋ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 20
Content:
Laalɩŋ Wɩaa
1Dɩ laalɩŋ nɛ sii ma dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ pɛgɛ, dɩ ma nɛ na ba janɩŋ arɩ ba janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ba laalɩyuoroo dɩ ba yʋga kɩɩma, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma, bɛɛ wɩaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ kɛmma kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ nɛ. 2Dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ma mʋ laalɩŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara maga dɩ ʋ kʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ ma laalɩyuoroo sɩpaaŋ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩba. 3Ʋ jaŋ bʋl, “Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ, jɩnɩŋ maa mʋ laalɩŋ nɛ dɩ ma yuo ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ. Má sɩ́ ba fá, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma bɔyɛ joŋ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ, má sɩ́ chel ba sɩpaaŋ. 4Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ kɛmma vɩvɛŋ, ʋ jaŋ yuo dii ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩma.”
5Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ ma jaŋ pɩɛsɛ laalɩyuoro-la, “Ma kʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a saa dɩɩ-falɩɩ aŋ ha bɩ suroo? Ʋ tɩɩna mɩɩra mʋ dɩa, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ wuo sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ ka dɩ nɩwogo mɩɩra mʋ suri dɩa-la. 6Ma kʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩŋ baga, aŋ ha bɩ ba nɛnɛɛ die? Ʋ tɩɩna mɩɩra mʋ dɩa, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ wuo sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, ka dɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ mɩɩra dii tɩɩnɛnɛ-la. 7Ma kʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a sʋgɛ haala aŋ ha bɩ jaa? Ʋ tɩɩna mɩɩra mʋ dɩa, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ wuo sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ, ka dɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ jaa haal-la.” 8Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la jaŋ bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Ma kʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ ʋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ koo fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ? Ʋ tɩɩna mɩɩra mʋ dɩa, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ naambiiri-la ma nandaasɩŋ jaŋ yʋɔrɛ.” 9Dɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la nɛ bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩ laalɩyuoro-la a dɛrɛ, ba jaŋ lɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaaraa dɩ ba bibeŋ laalɩyuoro-la.
10Dɩ ma nɩɩ mʋ dɩ ma yuo taŋ na-kala, má laa sɩpaaŋ leŋ dɩ ba jɩŋ arɩ maa kɔ dɩ ma yuoba nɛ. 11Dɩ ba nɛ sɛyɛ arɩ ma wuoba nɛ, má bɩra sɩ́ ba yuo. Má kɛsɛ ba kala dɩ ba ŋaa ma yosi a tɩŋ yoŋ-tɩntɩŋŋaa a pɩpɩma. 12Dɩ taŋ-la nɩaa nɛ bɩ sɛyɛ arɩ ma wuoba nɛ, a chɩchɛ dɩ ma yuo laal-la, má leŋ dɩ ma laalɩyuoroo golli taŋ-la chu a yuoba. 13Dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma yuo diiba, má kpʋ baala-la kala sɩ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ. 14Ama, má kɛsɛ ba haalaa, ba biiriŋ arɩ ba pʋsʋŋ, a paa kʋŋ na-kala sɩ hɛ taŋ-la lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa ma kɩaa. Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ joŋ ma dʋndɔmɔ-la kɩaa pɩma. Ma jaŋ wuo kaa ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ma sɩɩ chɛ. 15Wɩɩ-la ma sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa tasɩ-la sɩ bɩ ma kpaga lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Tasɩ-la sɩ kpagɛma lɛ dee.
16Ama tabala-la sɩ hɛ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ, má kpʋ kʋŋ na-kala sɩɩ wiesu a hɛ nɩmɛ. 17Ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋ tinteyee deemba nɩaa kala: Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa, Hivi tɩŋŋaa arɩ Jebus tɩŋŋaa arɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛma ŋɩɩ. 18Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ba kpʋa, ba jaŋ dagɛma dɩ ma to ba lɛ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kɩsʋ aa kpaarɛ ba vesiŋ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa lɛ. 19Dɩ ma nɛ mʋ yuo taŋ kala, dɩ yuosu-la nɛ diene magɛ ɛɛ ma, má sɩ́ tɩɩsɩ-la sɩɩ nɛŋ taŋ-la lɛ keru, bɛɛ wɩaa ma jaŋ wuo dii ba nɛnɛɛ. Tɩɩsɩ-la-na bɩ nuhuobiine ŋaa dɩ ma yuyuoba. 20Ma jaŋ wuo keri tɩɩsɩ-la nɛnɛɛ ma sɩ bɩ dii, a kaa ŋaa lusuŋ-cholluŋ a jʋʋ taŋ-la a yuo diiba.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 21
Content:
Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ba kpʋ, ka ba bɩ jɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ kpʋa, ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ ba to
1Tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ, dɩ ma nɛ na nʋʋ dɩ ʋ sʋʋ pɩŋ pɔkɔŋ nyuŋ, ka ma bɩ jɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ kpʋʋ, 2ma nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ sarɩya diiree maga dɩ ba mʋ lee-la sʋʋ-la sɩ pɩna, a magɩsɛ a na tasɩ-la sɩ golli lee-la, kʋ-la ʋ sɩ kpaga. 3Taŋ-la sɩ kpagɛ sʋʋ-la, ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ jaŋ kɛŋ napaha ba ha sɩ bɩ kaa tɩŋ aŋ ka, 4a kaa tuu fuonaaŋ sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ ba ha sɩ bɩ lee-la pɛrɛ aŋ ka, a mɩlɩmɛ ʋ baŋŋaa bori. 5Levi doho sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa maga dɩ ba hɛ nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, aŋ sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩma, a laa ma wɩaa jɩma pɩpɩma dɩ nɩaa nɛ kɛŋ kaalɛrɛ koo dɩ ba yuo dɔŋɔ. 6Sʋʋ-la sɩ pɩna a kpagɛ taŋ-la, ʋ nɩhɩasɩ-la jaŋ sɔŋ ba nɩsaa a hɛ napaha-la ba sɩ kaa mʋ fuonaaŋ a mɩlɩmɛ ʋ baŋŋaa bori lɛ, 7aŋ chaasa bʋl, “La dee bɩ baala deeŋ kpʋa, la bɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kpʋʋ ma jɩŋ. 8La TƖƖNA, joŋ wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ a chɛ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa, nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, aŋ sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la laa cheeriŋ a tɩŋ baala deeŋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩŋ cheye sʋʋŋ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.” Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ joŋo chɛma. 9Má sɩ folo ŋaa ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩɩ chɛ, ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ laa cheeriŋ baal-la ba sɩ kpʋa bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ.
Haalaa ba sɩ yuo laalɩŋ kɛsɛ jaanɩŋ wɩaa
10Dɩ laalɩŋ nɛ sii ma dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ pɛgɛ, dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma yuo diiba aŋ kɛsɛ ba haalaa, 11dɩ hazɔŋ nɛ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ, dɩ ŋ na a cho dɩ ŋ jaa, 12ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ haal-la mʋ ŋ dɩa dɩ ʋ fʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ a kɩɛrɛ ʋ naanii-fʋlaa, 13aŋ wuri gɛnnɩ-la ʋ fa sɩ laala, ka ma yuo kɛnʋ aŋ laalɛ gɛrɩ-wogusuŋ. Leŋ dɩ ʋ hɛ ŋ dɩa lɛ a yel ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ yoho chɛŋ-piliŋ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, ma jaŋ wuo jaa dɔŋɔ. 14Dɩ ʋ nɛ kʋ magɛ bʋa dɔŋ dɩ ŋ bɩra bɩ ʋ cho, ŋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ʋ mʋ lee-kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ. Ŋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ joŋu yallɛ arɩ yomo, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ kɛnʋ ŋaa haal nɛ aŋ ka.
Kpaal-la sɩ maga dɩ hambolibii-hɩaŋ laa
15Dɩ baal nɛ kɛŋ haalaa balɩa, a cho dɔŋɔ a kɩɩ dɔŋɔ, dɩ haala-la balɩa kala lʋl hambolibiisiŋ, dɩ haal-la ʋ sɩ bɩ faasa cho hambolibie nɛ ŋaa ʋ bii-hɩaŋ, 16dɩ ʋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ dʋa kpaa ʋ biiri-la, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ bii-hɩaŋ-la kpaalɩŋ pɩ ʋ hachooluŋ bie, aŋ vɔŋ haal-la ʋ sɩ bɩ faasa cho bie. 17Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ dʋa-la kpaa dɩ kʋhɩaŋ kɩaa kɩɩ kʋbie kɩaa naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa. Bile nɛ ŋaa ʋ nyɩmma doluŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ laa bii-hɩaŋ kpaalɩŋ.
Ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaa hambolibii-nyu-duo tɩɩna lɛ
18Dɩ baal arɩ ʋ haala nɛ kɛŋ ba bii, dɩ bile kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a bɩ ba niiŋ ka nɩɩ, dɩ ba dagʋ a lɔl, 19ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ bile mʋ ba jaŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ lee-la ba sɩɩ hilimu. 20Ba jaŋ bʋla pɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la, “La bie deeŋ ŋaa nyu-duo tɩɩna nɛ, ʋ bɩ la niiŋ wɩaa ka nɩɩ, a chichei moribiee aŋ pɛ ŋaa sɩ-nyʋarʋ ma.” 21Baala-la kala sɩ hɛ ʋ taŋ-la lɛ maga dɩ ba yagʋ kpʋ nɛ arɩ tabɩaa, a lɩɩsɛ wʋbɔŋ-la ta ma tʋɔŋ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala jaŋ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba.
Wombie-la ba sɩ bile dɔnsʋŋ
22Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ chaasa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ dɩ ma kpʋʋ a joŋo sagɛ tɩa nyuŋ, 23ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma leŋ dɩ ʋ sagɛ nɩmɛ dɩ taŋ pʋl. Ʋ maga dɩ ma hugu tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ nɩɩ-la kala kʋsʋʋŋ sɩ sagɛ tɩa nyuŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa disiniŋ a hɛ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩpɩ ma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 22
Content:
1Dɩ ŋ nɛ na ŋ naambie nɛŋ koo ʋ piese dɩ ʋ lɛlɛ, sɩ́ beŋ a nagɛ ŋ bɩ ʋ na, kɛŋ a kaa mʋ pʋ. 2Dɩ ŋ naambile nɛ bɩŋ kpaga, koo ŋ bɩ pʋna-la tɩɩna jɩŋ, kɛŋ pʋna-la kaa mʋ ŋ dɩa. Dɩ ŋ naambile nɛ chɛ pʋna-la kɔ, dɩ ŋ kaa pʋ. 3Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa, dɩ ŋ naambie kakumo koo ʋ gɛrɩŋ koo ʋ kʋŋkala nɛ lɛlɛ. Sɩ́ vɩa ta.
4Dɩ ŋ nɛ na ŋ naambie kakumo koo nɛŋ dɩ ʋ tel wombiiŋ lɛ, sɩ́ kiele bal. Pɛ ʋ lɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ pʋna-la chʋʋlɛ.
5Haala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ laalɛ baalaa gɛnnɩŋ koo baala laalɛ haalaa gɛnnɩŋ. Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ.
6Dɩ ŋ nɛ na diibii-dɛlɛ tɩa nyuŋ wombiiŋ niiŋ koo tinteeŋ, dɩ ʋ pɛŋ halaa nyuŋ nɛ koo dɩ ʋ tiese nɛ, sɩ́ naaŋ-la arɩ ʋ biiriŋ kala paa. 7Ŋ jaŋ wuo paa biiri-la aŋ leŋ ba naaŋ. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ.
8Dɩ ŋ nɛ saa dɩɩ-falɩŋ a yuo, saa kɛrɛ golli lusu-la chu, dɩ nʋʋ sɩ́ lusu-la nyuŋ lɩɩ tel a sʋʋ dɩ ba joŋ cheeriŋ pɩŋ.
9Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga, sɩ́ kʋŋ dɔŋ joŋo duu hɛ tɩɩsɩ-la pɛgɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ jaŋ kɩkɩsɛ baga-la kɩalɩŋ kala.
10Má sɩ́ kakumo arɩ nɛŋ kaa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba pɛrɛ.
11Má sɩ́ gɛrɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ arɩ pʋnaa yuo laalʋ.
12Má yɛrɛ jʋɔsaa hɛ ma gɛnnɩ-la ma sɩɩ laalʋ niipinee banɛsɛ kala lɛ.
Dɩ baala nɛ nyɩɛ wɩaa a pɩ ʋ haala arɩ ʋ bɩ hapuŋ ŋaa, ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ to
13Dɩ baal nɛ jaa haala a kɛnʋ pɩŋ aŋ bɩra bɩ haal-la cho, 14a chei haal-la yɩrɩŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ jaaʋ ʋ bɩ hapuŋ ŋaa, 15dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, haal-la nɩaa maga dɩ ba joŋ gɛrɩ-la ba sɩ jaa dɔŋɔ a kaa jɛrɛ pɩŋ. Dɩ chalɩŋ nɛ hɛ gɛrɩ-la lɛ nɛ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa hapuŋ nɛ, dɩ ba kaa mʋ lee-la ba taŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩɩ hilimu a dagɛba. 16Haal-la nyɩmma jaŋ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ joŋ mɩ tolo pɩ baala deeŋ ʋ jaa nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ bɩra bɩ ʋ cho. 17Ʋ chei ʋ yɩrɩŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ jaaʋ ʋ bɩ hapuŋ ŋaa, na kʋ-la sɩ daga arɩ mɩ tolo fa ŋaa hapuŋ nɛ.” Ba jaŋ kɛŋ gɛrɩ-la a jɛrɛ ba taŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba na. 18Nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ na gɛrɩ-la ŋɩɩ, ba jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ bala-la a dɔgʋsʋ. 19Ba jaŋ keri warɩpʋla zɔlɔ chɩmɩŋ pʋ dɩ ʋ time pɩ tolo-la nyɩmma, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ chei Iziral tɩŋŋaa tolo sɩ ŋaa hapuŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ. Tolo-la ha jaŋ ŋaa ʋ haal ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ vɩaʋ.
20Dɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ bala-la sɩ bʋla ma nɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ, dɩ kʋŋkala nɛ tuo sɩ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ haal-la ŋaa hapuŋ nɛ, 21ŋɩɩ-na ba jaŋ kɛŋ tolo-la a mʋ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa boiŋ niiŋ, dɩ ʋ jaŋ baalaa yagʋ kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa hɩɩsɩ wɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Iziral kala lɛ, ʋ sɩ hɛ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa lɛ a bɩ bala jaa aŋ pɩpɩŋ baalaa. Ʋ maga dɩ ma giri wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ ta nɛ ma tʋɔŋ.
22Dɩ baal nɛ kɛŋ ʋ dɔŋɔ haala pɩŋ dɩ ma kɛnʋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋ baal-la arɩ haal-la kala nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ má giri wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ ta nɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ.
23Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sʋgɛ tolo taŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ jaa, dɩ baal dɔŋ kɛnʋ pɩŋ taŋ-la lɛ, 24ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ baal-la sɩ kɛnʋ pɩŋ arɩ tolo-la kala a lɩɩ ba jaŋ lɛ, a yagɛba kpʋ arɩ tabɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa jaŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, ka tolo-la vɩa dɩ ʋ ŋmoo niiŋ dɩ ba laaʋ ta. Baal-la ma maga dɩ ʋ sʋʋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋ haal nɛ ʋ kaa pɩŋ. Ʋ maga dɩ má giri wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ ta nɛ ma tʋɔŋ.
25Dɩ baal nɛ gurigi tolo gɩrɩŋ lɛ nʋʋ sɩ sʋga dɩ ʋ jaa, baal-la dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga dɩ ba kpʋ. 26Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaa haal-la wɩɩkala, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa chei sɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ naga nʋʋ sɩ mʋ gurigi ʋ naambie a kpʋʋ nɛ. 27Baal-la sɩ gurigi tolo-la nʋʋ sɩ sʋga dɩ ʋ jaa, ʋ jaŋ wuo ŋmoo niiŋ lee-la, ka nʋʋkala tuo dɩ ʋ laaʋ ta.
28Dɩ baal nɛ na hapuŋ nʋʋ ha sɩ bɩ sʋga a gurigu, dɩ ba nɛ kɛmba, 29baal-la maga dɩ ʋ tiŋ warɩpʋla mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ a pɩ tolo-la nyɩmma. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ jaa tolo-la nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ cheyu. Ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo vɩa tolo-la.
30Baal kala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma haala pɩŋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ hɩɩsɛ ʋ nyɩmma nɛ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 23
Content:
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ba guoli La TƖƖNA nɩaa tʋɔŋ
1Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ba feri koo dɩ ʋ peniŋ nɛ ba kere ta, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ guoli La TƖƖNA nɩaa tʋɔŋ. 2Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa mɛŋgaa-bii, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ guoli La TƖƖNA nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a chɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ a kaa mʋ ʋ doho doho fii sɩ jaŋ to ʋ harɩŋ kɔ.
3Amɔŋ tɩɩna kala koo Mʋab tɩɩna koo ba doho nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ guoli La TƖƖNA nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a chɩŋ ba lɛ a kaa mʋ ba doho doho fii sɩ jaŋ to ba harɩŋ kɔ, 4bɛɛ wɩaa, bʋa-la lɛ ma fa sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti lɛ a kʋkɔ, ba vɔmma lɩɩŋ arɩ kʋdiilee nɛ aŋ mʋ kpal Balam sɩ ŋaa Bioo nanʋala a lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Pɛtɔ a hɛ Mesopotemia lɛ, dɩ ʋ kalɩbɛ hɛ ma lɛ. 5Ama ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ choma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bɩ jegile nɩɩ Balam teeŋ, aŋ leŋ ŋmɩaŋ-la mɩɩra wasɛma. 6Má mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, má pɔ ma dɩ ba sɩ́ wɩɩ pɛ.
7Ma pɔ má sɩ́ Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa bɛrʋ, ba ŋaa ma naambiiriŋ nɛ. Má sɩ́ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa ma bɛrʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma fa ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa nɛ ba tinteeŋ lɛ. 8Ba doho doho tʋmbʋ-tori ha sɩ jaŋ to ba harɩŋ kɔ jaŋ wuo guoli La TƖƖNA nɩaa tʋɔŋ.
Wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ
9Dɩ ma nɛ ŋmoo buguŋ dɩ ma yuo ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ lɛ. 10Dɩ ma baala-la kʋŋ nɛ pɩŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ a duoso fɩɩ bafɩɩrɩŋ, ŋɩɩ leŋe ʋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ. 11Dɩ dɩdaanɩŋ nɛ kʋ yi, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ fo lɩɩŋ, dɩ wɩɩ-muluŋ nɛ jʋa, ʋ mɩɩra kʋ jʋʋ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ.
12Ʋ maga dɩ má lɩɩ dɩhɔnʋŋ lɛ nɛ a chɛ lee ma sɩ jaŋ mʋ a fɩfɩɩ fɩɩrɩŋ aŋ nyɩnyɛ bɩnɩŋ. 13Ma kʋŋkala maga dɩ ʋ pɛ kɛŋ kʋŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa lu bʋa a nyɛ bɩnɩŋ a fɩɩ fɩɩrɩŋ hɛ aŋ gbaa tɔ nɛ. 14Má leŋ dɩ ma dɩhɔnʋŋ zɔŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩaa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ ma dɩ-hɔnɩɩ-la lɛ, a pʋpɔma, a leŋ ma yuo didii ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ. Ma pɔ dɩ má sɩ́ wɩɩkala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ ŋaa dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ mɩɩrɛ ma harɩŋ.
Wombie-la dɔnsʋŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ tuto
15Dɩ nʋʋ yomo nɛ fá kɔ ŋ teeŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ laaʋ ta, sɩ́ ʋ kaa mɩɩra mʋ pa ʋ tɩɩna. 16Leŋ dɩ ʋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lee na-kala ʋ sɩ cho arɩ taŋ na-kala ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa lɛ, sɩ́ ʋ dɔgʋsʋ.
17Iziral tɩɩna kala, baal koo haal bɩ maga dɩ ʋ jʋʋ vene kala, dɩ bachɔrʋŋ koo hachɔrʋŋ wɩaa nɛ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩmɩŋ. 18Ma pɔ má sɩ́ haal koo baal sɩ ŋaa wʋchɔrʋŋ a dʋa kʋŋ kaa kʋ jʋʋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩa a lɩɩsɛ niiŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa ka kɩsɛ wʋdosunu-la nɛ.
19Dɩ ma kʋŋ nɛ joŋ moribiee koo kʋdiilee koo kʋŋ na-kala a chɩŋ ŋ naambii Iziral tɩɩna, sɩ́ lɩɩŋ kaa daŋ. 20Ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daŋ a pɩ nʋhʋɔraa, ama ŋ naambie-na, ŋ bɩ ŋɩɩ wuo ŋaa. Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ lɩɩŋ kaa daŋa pɩ ma naambiiriŋ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-kala ma sɩ jaŋ tɩtɩŋ tintee-la ma sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ.
21Dɩ ma kʋŋ nɛ ta niiŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ dieni ka ŋ lɩɩsɛ nii-la. Ma Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ lɩɩsɛ nii-la, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋ lɛ. 22Dɩ ŋ nɛ paala bɩ niiŋ ta, ŋ bɩ wɩɩkala cheye. 23Wɩɩkala ŋ sɩ suri ŋ niiŋ a bʋl La TƖƖNA teeŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ ta nii-la ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa teeŋ.
24Dɩ ŋ nɛ jʋʋ ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna tɩɩnɛnɛɛ baga, ŋ jaŋ wuo dii a magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ, ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ tɔrɛ a hɛ ŋ lʋaga lɛ. 25Dɩ ŋ nɛ jʋʋ ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna kuori-mɩaa baga, ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ a kɩɩlɛ mʋa a chaŋ, ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ kɛŋ sɩa jʋʋ a ta.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 24
Content:
1Dɩ baal nɛ jaa haal, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɩɩ haal-la, dɩ baal-la chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ vɩa haal-la, a ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ haal-la aŋ kiru ta ʋ lɩɩ ʋ dɩa lɛ, 2haal-la sɩ lɩa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ nɛ mʋ a jaa baal dɔŋ, 3dɩ baal-la ma bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ haal-la aŋ vɩaʋ a kiru ʋ lɩɩ ʋ dɩa lɛ, koo dɩ baal-la nɛ sʋba, 4ʋ bala-la fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ a jaaʋ aŋ kiru ta bɩra bɩ maga dɩ ʋ jaaʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa haal-la kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ kɩsɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Má sɩ́ disiniŋ ŋaa hɛ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ.
5Dɩ baal nɛ jaa ha-falɩŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ma leŋ dɩ ʋ mʋ laalɩŋ koo a pʋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-dɔŋ kala. Ʋ maga dɩ ʋ hɔŋ dɩa lɛ nɛ jɩna, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ haal-la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.
6Nʋʋkala pʋpɔ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna nɔmʋŋ koo nɔŋ-biiŋ joŋ a tɩŋ chɩmɩŋ wɩaa, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ naga tɩɩna mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ ŋŋ chɛ ŋ lɩɩsɛ ŋɩɩ.
7Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna kala nɛ gaa kɛŋ ʋ naambie a leŋ ʋ ŋaa ʋ yomo aa dɔgʋsʋ koo a yallʋ, ʋ maga dɩ má kpʋ gaarʋ-la. Ʋ maga dɩ ma giri wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ ta nɛ ma tʋɔŋ.
8Dɩ dayalɩbɩŋ nɛ jʋʋ ma jaŋ, má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to Levi doho sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa niiŋ. Wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛba, má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a toba. 9Má liise yi wɩɩ-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ ŋaa Mɩrɩam lɛ wombiiŋ lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.
10Dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ kʋŋkala a chɩchɩŋ ŋ naambie, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ jʋʋ ʋ dɩa a joŋ kʋ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋo bil chɩŋ-la bʋbʋɔŋ. 11Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ chɩŋ jeeŋ harɩŋ nɛ, ka dɩ ʋ tɩtɩa jʋʋ a joŋ kʋ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo bil chɩŋ-la bʋbʋɔŋ a kaa kʋ lɩɩ pɩŋ. 12Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa summu aŋ joŋ ʋ gɛrɩŋ a bil chɩŋ-la bʋbʋɔŋ a pɩŋ, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ gɛrɩ-la chʋa ŋ teeŋ. 13Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛrɩ-la mʋ pʋ nɛ, ka dɩ wɩa-na jʋʋ, dɩ ʋ kaa tɔ ʋ tɩtɩa. Ʋ jaŋ lɔllʋŋ, dɩ ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa ma na arɩ tʋɔpʋl wɩɩ nɛ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.
14Dɩ Iziral tɩɩna koo nɩwogusu-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ kʋŋ nɛ ŋaa summu, a tɩma pɩpɩŋ ka dɩ ŋ titimu, pʋpɔ dɩ ŋ sɩ́ ʋ gʋrʋ. 15Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala, joŋ ʋ time pʋ ka wɩa-na jʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ sɩ ŋaa summu ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ, time-la lɛ nɛ ʋ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ vɩa, ʋ jaŋ yele pɩ La TƖƖNA, ŋɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ a pɩŋ.
16Dɩ nʋʋ bii nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋ ʋ nyɩmma a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la wɩaa, dɩ nyɩmma ma nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋ ʋ bie a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Nʋʋkala maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ a tɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔmʋŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa nɛ.
17Má sɩ́ nɩwogusuŋ arɩ biisinsiŋ gʋrʋ, koo dɩ ŋ nɛ joŋ kʋŋ a chɩŋ yo-haala, sɩ́ ʋ gɛrɩŋ laa bil chɩŋ-la bʋbʋɔŋ lɛ. 18Má liise yi arɩ ma fa ŋaa yosi nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa laama ta, a kɛmma lɩɩ nɩmɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ sɩ ma to wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋɩɩ.
19Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ma baga kɩaa, kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ gɛllɛ ta, má bɩra sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ kuuni. Má lemba a pɩ nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa pɛ ma lɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ tɩŋ lɛ. 20Dɩ ma nɩɩ tɔrɛ ma olif nɛnɛɛ, kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ gɛllɛ ta, má bɩra sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ tɔrɛ, má lemba a pɩ nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa. 21Dɩ ma nɩɩ tɔrɛ girep nɛnɛɛ ma bagɩsɩŋ lɛ, kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ gɛllɛ ta, má bɩra sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ tɔrɛ, má lemba a pɩ nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa. 22Má liise yi arɩ ma fa ŋaa yosi nɛ Ijipiti lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ sɩ ma to wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋɩɩ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 25
Content:
1Dɩ nɩaa balɩa nɛ kɛŋ kaalɛrɛ, a kɛŋ wɩɩ-la mʋ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ, sarɩya diiree maga dɩ ba dii sarɩya-la a joŋ cheeriŋ a pɩ nɩɩ-la kɩaa sɩ bɩ sɩŋ, aŋ bʋla pɛ nɩɩ-la kɩaa sɩ sɩma lɛ. 2Dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ laa cheeriŋ nɛ maga dɩ ba vɩɩrʋ, sarɩya diiru-la maga dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ nɩɩ-la tuu pɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ, dɩ ba vɩɩrʋ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ wɩɩŋ sɩ maga. 3Kpaasa naansɩɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ maga dɩ ʋ laa. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ʋ kieli ŋɩɩ lɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ vɩɩrʋ kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ʋ yaraa jaŋ faasa fol dɩ ʋ nagɛ ʋ ŋaa nɩtɔɔ nɛ.
4Dɩ nɛŋ nɩɩ ŋmoo mɩaa, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ŋ vɔɔ ʋ niiŋ tɔ.
5Dɩ naambiiriŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ dɩ dɔŋɔ sʋʋ aŋ bɩ bii lʋla, ʋ haala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ lɩɩ dɩa-la lɛ a mʋ jaa baal dɔŋ. Ʋ bala-la naambii nɛ maga dɩ ʋ joŋ yo-haal-la a jaa dɩ ʋ ŋaa ʋ haala. 6Dɩ ba nɛ lʋl ba bii-bumbuŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa hambolibie, ʋ nɛ jaŋ chɩŋ ʋ naambile sɩ sʋba nyuŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ sɩ́ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ lɛl.
7Dɩ ʋ naambile nɛ bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋ yo-haal-la jaa, haal-la maga dɩ ʋ mʋ ba taŋ boiŋ niiŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ bala naambie ka chɛ ʋ naambile sɩ sʋba yɩrɩŋ lɛl nɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩ chɛ ʋ jommi jaa dɩ la lʋl biiriŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ ʋ naambile nyuŋ.” 8Ʋ taŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ jaŋ yɩrʋ a bʋl wɩaa pʋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ ha vɩa aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ jaa haal-la,” 9yo-haal-la jaŋ mʋ ʋ bala naambile teeŋ nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩpaaŋ a kɛŋ baal-la nɛntɛbɩŋ dɔŋɔ lɩɩsɛ aŋ tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ hɛ ʋ sɩaa lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Ŋ-la nɛ maga dɩ ba ŋaa baal-la sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ naambie yo-haala jaa dɩ ba lʋl biiriŋ dɩ ba chɩŋ ʋ naambie nyuŋ lɛ.” 10Iziral tinteeŋ kala lɛ, baal-la biiriŋ nɛ ba jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ nɛntɛŋ-bala doho nɩaa.
11Dɩ baalaa balɩa nɩɩ loo, dɩ dɔŋɔ haala kɔ dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ bala lɛ a kɛŋ baal-la dɔŋɔ luroo lɛ, 12má kɛŋ haal-la a ta ʋ nɩsɩŋ keri, má sɩ́ ʋ nenige fá.
13Má sɩ́ sanɩa balɩa kɛŋ dɩ dɔŋɔ yuŋŋie kɩɩ dɔŋɔ. 14Sɩ́ sanɩa balɩa kɛŋ ŋ dɩa lɛ dɩ dɔŋɔ yʋgɛ, ka dɔŋɔ muuri. 15Ʋ maga dɩ ma kɛŋ sanɩaba la sɩ maga a mɩmagɩsɛ kɩaa, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma wuo hɔŋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma lɛ a dieni. 16Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa bɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ gʋrɛ nɩaa nɛ.
17Má liise yi wɩɩ-la Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa ma lɛ, ma sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kʋkɔ. 18Bʋa-la lɛ ma kala fa sɩ lɔlɔ a pʋgʋmɛ, ba bɩ Wɩa fá aŋ kʋ lɩɩ chemma wombiiŋ lɛ a kɛrɛ yuo nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ nɛrɩgɛ tuto ma harɩŋ. 19Dɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ leŋe dɩ ma na wiese ma dʋndɔmɔ-la kala sɩ gollima chu nɩsɩŋ lɛ, tintee-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ lɛ, má kpʋ Amalɛk tɩŋŋaa doho kala dɩ ba yɩrɩŋ lɛl dʋnɩa lɛ. Má sɩ́ wɩɩŋ deeŋ yʋ.

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 26
Content:
Kʋdii-falaa arɩ kpaalɩŋ fii-la kʋbala sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA kʋa
1Dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋŋ a hɔŋ nɩmɛ, 2ma kʋŋkala maga ʋ ŋaa ʋ kʋdii falaa ʋ sɩ pɛrɛ tintee-la lɛ a hɛ sime tʋɔŋ, a kaa mʋ lee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dagɛ dɩ ma zizilu nɩmɛ. 3Má bʋla pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ aa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa bʋa-la lɛ, “Jɩnɩŋ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ dagɛ a pɩ mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa arɩ mɩ jʋʋ tintee-la ʋ fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ la naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla nɛ.” 4Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara jaŋ laa sime-la arɩ kʋdiile-la ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a joŋo bil ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa koru-la sɩpaaŋ. 5La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, ŋ jaŋ bɩra bʋl wɩaa deemba: “Mɩ nyɩmma fa ŋaa Siiria tɩɩna nɛ, a gɔllɔɔ baarɛ, ʋ doho nɩaa fa bɩ yʋgɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ hɔŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, nɩmɛ nɛ ba pʋŋa yʋgɛ a ŋaa tintee sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ arɩ doluŋ. 6Ama Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa dɔgɩsɛla nɛ nɩmɛ a leŋ la tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ a na hɛɛŋ. 7Ŋɩɩ nɛ la ŋmoo niiŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa la naabalɩmaba Wɩa, ʋ nɩɩ la bunso a na ŋɩɩ ba sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛla, hɛɛ-la la sɩɩ na arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ nyagɛla bil. 8Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA kɛŋ ʋ doluŋ a ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ a kɛnla kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. 9Ʋ kɛnla kaa kɔ daha nɛ, a joŋ tinteeŋ deeŋ sɩ sɩma a kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ a pɩla. 10Ŋɩɩ nɛ lɛɛlɛ mɩ kɛŋ tintee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ kʋdii falaa mɩ sɩ pɛrɛ a kaa kɔ dɩ mɩ pʋ.” Ŋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, joŋ sime-la a bil ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩpaaŋ aŋ kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlʋ. 11Ŋ dɩ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ nɩwogusu-la kala sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ maga dɩ má gbieli ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ kʋzɔmɔ-la kala ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩ ŋ dɩ ŋ dɩa nɩaa.
12Ma sɩ yie kɛŋ ma kɩaa a kpaa leree fii a joŋ kʋbala-la a pɩ La TƖƖNA jɩ-tori lɛ, má joŋo pɩ Levi doho nɩaa, nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haala-la kala sɩ hɛ ma tasɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba dii a vɔgɛ. 13Ŋ jaŋ bʋla pɩ ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa, “Mɩ dɩa lɛ, mɩ lɩɩsɛ kpaal-la kala sɩ ŋaa ŋ kʋa nɛ a joŋo pɩ Levi doho nɩaa, nɩwogusuŋ, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa, arɩ ŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ bɩ ŋ niiŋ wɩaa vɩa, mɩ bɩ ba kʋbala ma yʋa. 14Mɩ bɩ ŋ kpaal-la mʋa ma die mɩ sɩɩ yel yoho, mɩ bɩ mʋa ma lɩɩsa bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ, mɩ bɩra bɩ ba mʋa ma joŋo a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ lɛlɛɛ. Mɩ to ŋ-na mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ nɛ, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ dagɛmɛ. 15Ŋ sɩ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ, ŋ dɩ-jʋʋlɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, gʋra bee na ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa a pɛ la lɛ aŋ wasɛ tintee-la sɩ sɩma a kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ, dɩ ʋ wasa zɔŋ woruŋ arɩ ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩ la naabalɩmaba.”
Má to La TƖƖNA niiriŋ
16Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis bɩra bʋl, “Jɩnɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa bʋlaa pɩma dɩ ma tuto ʋ niiriŋ, ʋ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a kɛŋ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩwɩɩ kala a toba. 17Jɩnɩŋ ma daga arɩ ma TƖƖNA nɛ ma Wɩa, ma jaŋ sɛyʋ a to ʋ wombiee, ʋ niiriŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga. 18Jɩnɩŋ La TƖƖNA daga arɩ ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa nɛ. Ma nɛ ŋaa ʋ nɩcholoo arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ pɩma, ʋ saa sɩ ʋ maga dɩ ma to wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga. 19Ʋ daga arɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nɛ kɩɩ tinteyee kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa, a kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ dɩ nɩaa bɩbɛsɛ ma lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma ʋ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩma ŋɩɩ.”

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 27
Content:
Ba saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛbal lɛ
1Mosis arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ bʋla pɩ ba nɩaa, “Má to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛma jɩnɩŋ. 2Dɩ ma nɛ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la a mʋ tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma, má paa tabɩaa sɩ jalɩa a pɛ, a taarɛ. 3Má ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa niiriŋ deemba kala a hɛ ba lɛ dɩ ma nɛ jʋʋ tintee-la sɩ sɩma a kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ, tintee-la ma TƖƖNA, ma naabalɩmaba Wɩa sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma. 4Dɩ ma nɛ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, má pɛ tabɩa-la peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛbal lɛ a taarɛ arɩ mɩ sɩ dagɛma ŋɩɩ jɩnɩŋ. 5Má kɛŋ tabɩaa a saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ nɩmɛ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. Má sɩ́ tɩntɩnnɩ kʋŋkala sɩ ŋaa hɔɔŋ kaa digi tabɩa-la. 6Ʋ maga dɩ má kɛŋ tabɩa-la ba sɩ bɩ saa nɛ a saa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa koruŋ, a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ʋ nyuŋ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. 7Má kpʋ ma pʋsʋŋ a sʋl nɩɩ-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɩmɛ a diiba aŋ gbigbieli ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. 8Má ŋmʋnsɛ niiri-la hɛ tabɩa-la ma sɩ taara lɛ dɩ ba chaasa lɩɩ woruŋ.”
Ba jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛbal a kalɩbɛ
9Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mosis arɩ Levi doho Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bʋl wɩaa pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa a bʋl, “Má kɛŋ goŋ aŋ jegile nɩɩ. Lɛɛlɛ ma ŋaa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa nɩaa nɛ, 10ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa teeŋ, a to ʋ niiŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ.”
11Tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa Mosis bɩra bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ: 12“Dɩ ma nɛ chol Jɔdaŋ fuo-la, doho doho deemba nɛ maga dɩ ba jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɛrɩzɩm a sʋl Wɩa pɩ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Simioŋ doho nɩaa, Levi doho nɩaa, Juda doho nɩaa, Ɩsaka doho nɩaa, Josɛf doho nɩaa arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa. 13Dosunuŋ deemba ma nɛ jaŋ jɩl peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛbal a kalɩbɛ. Rubiŋ doho, Gad doho nɩaa, Asa doho nɩaa, Zebuluŋ doho nɩaa, Daŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa. 14Levi doho nɩaa jaŋ heeli a bʋl wɩaa deemba: 15‘La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nʋʋkala sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ koo tɩɛrɩŋ koo hɔɔŋ a ŋaa tɔmʋŋ a lʋara kpʋkpaarɛ. La TƖƖNA ka kɩsɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ laa bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ.’ 16‘La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ ka zil.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ laa bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ.’ 17‘La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ naambie tinteeŋ bʋa magɩlɩŋ gɩrɩmɛ.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ laa bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ.’ 18‘La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ dagɛ nyʋlɩma ʋ yeŋŋi.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ laa bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ.’ 19‘La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ gʋrɛ nʋhʋɔraa, biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ laa bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ.’ 20‘Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma haala pɩŋ, hɩɩsɛ ʋ nyɩmma nɛ, La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii tɩɩna.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ laa bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ.’ 21‘La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ pʋna pɩŋ.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ laa bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ.’ 22‘La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ ʋ dɩhaala pɩŋ, dɩ ʋ nyɩmma tolo nɛ koo dɩ ʋ naaŋ tolo nɛ.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ laa bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ.’ 23‘La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ kɛŋ ʋ hɩɩlɩ-haala pɩŋ.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ laa bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ.’ 24‘La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ lʋara kpʋ ʋ naambie.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ laa bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ.’ 25‘La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa kpalaa aŋ kpʋ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ laa bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ.’ 26‘La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ dii nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩa dɩ ʋ to Wɩa niiriŋ deemba arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga.’ Nɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ laa bʋl, ‘Amɩɩ.’

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 28
Content:
La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɛɩ ʋ niiŋ lɛ
1Dɩ ma nɛ fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ arɩ ʋ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kɩɩ tinteye-la kala nɩaa sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ. 2Dɩ ma nɛ sɛɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ arɩ wɩaa deemba: 3Ʋ jaŋ wasɛ ma tasɩŋ arɩ ma bagɩsɩŋ kala. 4Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma lʋl biiriŋ a yʋgɛ, a leŋ dɩ kʋdiilee pʋrɩgɛ ma tinteeŋ lɛ, dɩ ma nɛsɩŋ, piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa ma pʋŋ. 5Ʋ jaŋ wasɛ ma baga kʋpɛrɛɛ arɩ kʋdiile-la ma sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ŋaa. 6Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.
7La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma yuo dii ma dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ a yuyuoma. Ba jaŋ to dɩ-bala kɔ ma lɛ aŋ mɩɩra fá pɩsɛ dɩ ba laa ba tɩtɩa.
8La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a leŋ dɩ ma virisiŋ su a leŋ dɩ ma tɩntɩmɩɩ-kala wasɛ. Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ tintee-la lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma lɛ.
9Dɩ ma nɛ to ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wombiee, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ a pɩma. 10Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ na La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsɛma ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ba fɩfáma. 11La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɩma dʋa a yʋgɛ tintee-la ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ a pɩ ma naabalɩmaba arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma lɛ. Ma jaŋ lʋl biiriŋ woruŋ, a kɛŋ nɛsɩŋ arɩ kʋdiilee yʋgɛ.
12La TƖƖNA jaŋ suri duonuŋ a leŋ dɩ ʋ nɩɩ ʋ bʋa lɛ a pɩma tintee-la lɛ, aŋ pɛ ma lɛ ma tɩntɩmɩɩ-kala lɛ. Tinteyee jaŋ yʋgɛ a chɩŋ kɩaa ma teeŋ, ama ma-na bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ kʋŋ nʋʋkala teeŋ. 13La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa sɩpaalaara, ma bɩ jaŋ ŋaa harɩ-tooro. Dɩ ma nɛ jegile a nɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, a fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a toba, ma jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ wɩɩkala lɛ, ma bɩ jaŋ to harɩŋ. 14Ma pɔ má sɩ́ harɩŋ joŋo yɩa wɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, a sɩ́ begile mʋ nadiiŋ koo nagʋa, a mʋ tuto vesiŋ a kpʋkpaarɛba.
Ŋmɩaŋ-la sɩ jaŋ dii nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ ka to
15Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛla a jegile nɩɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ a to ʋ wombiee arɩ ʋ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ joŋo dagɛma jɩnɩŋ, ŋmɩaŋ deemba nɛ jaŋ diima: 16La TƖƖNA jaŋ kalɩba hɛ ma tasɩŋ arɩ ma bagɩsɩŋ lɛ. 17Ʋ jaŋ kalɩba hɛ ma baga kʋpɛrɛɛ arɩ kʋdiile-la ma sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ŋaa lɛ. 18Ʋ ŋmɩaŋ jaŋ diima, ʋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ ma lʋl biiriŋ yʋgɛ, a leŋ dɩ kʋdiilee nyaa ma tinteeŋ lɛ, ma nɛsɩŋ, piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa ma bɩ jaŋ pʋŋ. 19La TƖƖNA jaŋ kalɩba hɛ wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ.
20Dɩ ma nɛ vɩa La TƖƖNA, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma wɩɩkala vʋgʋmɛ, dɩ wʋwalɩmaa jʋʋma dɩ ma to ŋɩɩ lɛ a kala guu chei, a tɩŋ wʋbɔŋ-la ma sɩ ŋaa lɛ. 21La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ a hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma kala sʋʋ dɛrɛ tintee-la ma sɩɩ jʋʋ dɩ ma tɩɩ lɛ. 22La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ nyanyalɩa-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma yʋɔlɛ a hɛ ma lɛ, ʋ jaŋ joŋ yarɩ-lɩŋŋaa hɛ ma lɛ a leŋ dɩ ma yaraa ŋmɛrɛ aŋ leŋ dɩ leriŋ faasa lɩŋ, dɩ hɩlɩŋ chɩŋ dɩ ma baga kɩaa ŋmaamɛ. Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba jaŋ ŋaa ma lɛ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ dɩ ma sʋʋ dɛrɛ. 23Ma jaŋ lɛ, duonuŋ bɩ jaŋ nɩɩ, dɩ ma tinteeŋ dol a nagɛ hɔɔŋ. 24La TƖƖNA fa sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra leŋ dɩ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ arɩ hagɩla lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a kʋ tɔma dɩ ma sʋʋ.
25La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diima. Ma jaŋ to dɩ-bala a mʋ dɩ ma yuoba, ama ba jaŋ kirima dɩ ma fá pɩsɛ a chɩchɛ dɩ ma laa ma tɩtɩa. Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ma lɛ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛmba. 26Ma jaŋ sʋʋ dɩ zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa didii ma kʋsʋʋnʋŋ, ka nʋʋkala jaŋ tuo dɩ ʋ kiriba. 27La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ mɔpʋllʋ-la doho ʋ fa sɩ joŋo hɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa lɛ a hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma yaraa kala ŋaa naawɩɩlaa a tɩtɩsɛ. Daaluno kala tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo vaarɛma. 28La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ nyɩnyɛrɩŋ arɩ nyʋlʋmʋŋ a hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ kala vʋgʋmɛ. 29Ma jaŋ gɔllɔ laarɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ a nagɛ nyʋlɩma, aŋ bɩ jaŋ na wɛnɩŋ. Ma wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ wasa. Tapʋlɩɩ-kala nɩaa jaŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛma a kɛŋ ma kɩaa lɩlaa, aŋ ka nʋʋ tuo dɩ ʋ laama ta.
30Ma jaŋ sʋgɛ haala dɩ ma jaa, ka dɩ nʋʋ kɛŋ haal-la pɩŋ. Ma jaŋ saa dɩa aŋ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ. Ma jaŋ pɛrɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga aŋ bɩ jaŋ dii ʋ nɛnɛɛ. 31Nʋʋ jaŋ kɛŋ ma nɛŋ kpʋ ma sɩɩŋ lɛ, ama ma bɩ jaŋ chaŋ ʋ nammɩa. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ma kakumo laa ma teeŋ, a kaa viiri. Ba jaŋ laa ma piesee a pɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, ka nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ laaba pɩma. 32Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ma biiriŋ laa pɩ tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa, ma jaŋ bibeŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ wʋwɩɩ, ka ma bɩ wɩɩkala wuo ŋaa. 33Nɩwogusu-la ma sɩ paala bɩ jɩŋ nɛ jaŋ dii ma baga kɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ suolo na, ka dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛma ŋɩɩ ma mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ. 34Wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ na jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nyaasɛ. 35La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɔpʋllʋŋ sɩɩ wɩɩ kɩŋkɛŋ ŋmɛrɛ ma naadʋsʋŋ arɩ ma naasɩŋ lɛ ma sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo tɩɩbɛ. Ba jaŋ ŋmɛrɛ a chɩŋ ma naachɛyɛɛ lɛ a kaa jɩl ma nyu-gbaŋa.
36La TƖƖNA jaŋ kiri ma dɩ ma kuoro kala a mʋ hɛ tintee-wogo lɛ ma dɩ ma nyɩmmaba ha sɩ bɩ jɩŋ. Nɩmɛ ma jaŋ kpaarɛ vesiŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ daasɩŋ arɩ tabɩaa a ŋaa. 37Tintee-wogusu-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ kirima mʋ hɛ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ wʋkpuŋkpere dɩ ba mʋmɔmma aŋ sisieri ma lɛ. 38Ma jaŋ duu kɩaa a yʋgɛ ma bagɩsɩŋ lɛ, ama kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa bɩ jaŋ yʋgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa hɔbɔ jaŋ diiba. 39Ma jaŋ pɛrɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ a yʋgɛ, a wasa hɛba, ama ma bɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ tɩɩnɛnɛ-la koo a nyʋa ba sɩnɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nanchʋɔlaa jaŋ dii tɩɩsɩ-la kala. 40Olif tɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ yʋgɛ ma tinteeŋ lɛ, ama ma bɩ jaŋ na nʋʋŋ a dii, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɛnɛɛ kala jaŋ yuoro ta. 41Ma jaŋ kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ hantolibiisiŋ, ama ma bɩ jaŋ tɩɩba, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jaŋ yuo kɛsɛba dɩ ba ŋaa yosi. 42Hɔbɩ-laalɩŋ jaŋ dii ma tinteeŋ tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ma bagɩsɩŋ kɩaa kala.
43Nʋhʋɔra-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ nyuŋ kɩɩma, ka dɩ ma-na mɩɩra hɛ naasɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ. 44Ba nɛ jaŋ mɩɩra joŋ kɩaa a chɩchɩmma, ma-na bɩ jaŋ wuo joŋ kʋŋkala a chɩmba. Ba nɛ jaŋ mɩɩra ŋaa ma sɩpaalaaraa, ka dɩ ma tuto ba harɩŋ.
45Ŋmɩaŋ deemba kala jaŋ diima. Ba jaŋ kire to ma harɩŋ a yuo diima dɩ ma kala mʋ dɛrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma vɩa dɩ ma sɛɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ a to ʋ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ dagɛma nɛ. 46Wɩaa deemba jaŋ ŋaa magɩl ma dɩ ma doho nɩaa kala teeŋ aa chagɩlɛma a kaa mʋ wuu, 47a tɩŋ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋ dʋa-la kala a pɩma, ka ma vɩa dɩ ma tutou arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. 48Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ma jaŋ kɛŋ losuŋ, lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ, yarɩ-biree, a nyaabɛ, aŋ pɛ tɩma pɩpɩ ma dʋndɔmɔ-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo hɛ ma lɛ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma chaasa na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ sʋʋ.
49La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛŋ tinteeŋ nɩaa yikoro ma sɩ bɩ nɩɩ a lɩɩ dʋnɩa lee sɩ bolie a kʋ hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ba yuoma a nagɛ kachuuŋ sɩ yie kʋ tuu jiŋŋee lɛ ŋɩɩ. 50Ba ŋaa tintee nɩaa sɩ bɔmɔ nɛ a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ, ba bɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ ka zil a bɩ hambiisiŋ ma nenige ka fá. 51Ba jaŋ kpʋ ma pʋsʋŋ a chei ma tinteeŋ kʋpɛrɛɛ kala ŋɩɩ dɩ losuŋ kpʋma dɩ ma sʋʋ. Ba bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩaa, tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ koo nʋʋ. Ba bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nɛsɩŋ koo piesee koo bʋʋnaa kʋŋkala kɛŋ bii ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ, dɩ ma kala sʋʋ dɛrɛ. 52Ba jaŋ kʋ gollo chu ma tinteeŋ tasɩŋ kala a yuo dii tasɩ-la ma sɩ saa kɛrɩ-duoruŋ sɩ leŋie a golli a joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ dɩ ba kala tel. Ba jaŋ kʋ gollo chu tintee-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma tasɩŋ kala, a pɔ ma sɩ́ kʋŋkala kaa kʋ jʋʋ koo a kaa lɩɩ, 53a tɩŋ hɛɛ-la ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ jaŋ joŋ hɛ ma lɛ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ gollo chu ma tasɩŋ a pɔ ma sɩ́ kʋŋ kaa jʋʋ koo a kaa lɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ gʋra kɛsɛ ma biiri-la ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma a chɩchaŋ. 54Baal-la sɩ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a ŋaa sɩɩ-fɩɛlɛ tɩɩna ma a bɩ nɩaa ka gbesi, ʋ paala bɩ jaŋ fá ʋ naambie nenige koo ʋ hachooluŋ koo ʋ biiriŋ. 55Dɩ ʋ nɛ kpʋ biiri-la kʋŋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ yʋ aŋ chɔgɔ pɩ ʋ hachoolii-la koo ʋ naambii, bɛɛ wɩaa ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kʋ gollo chuba dɩ ba yuo diiba ŋɩɩ, kʋ-la kala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. 56Ma tʋɔŋ haal-la sɩaa sɩ fɩɛla a bɩ ʋ nɩaa ka gbesi, a bɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ jʋʋ nʋʋ wɩɩ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa ʋ bala sɩ ŋaa, 57a tɩŋ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ gollo chu ba tasɩŋ hɛɛ-la jʋʋba wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ lʋara chaŋ ʋ bii-mulo arɩ biriŋ kala aŋ vɔŋ ʋ bala arɩ ʋ biiriŋ.
58Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛla a to Wɩa niiŋ arɩ ʋ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa a hɛ teniŋ deeŋ lɛ, a bɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa yɩrɩ-bal-la sɩ kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ kaa tɩtɩŋ, 59La TƖƖNA Wɩa jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ a hɛ ma dɩ ma doho nɩaa lɛ dɩ ma na hɛɛŋ a dieni kɩŋkɛŋ. Nyanyalɩa-la bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ daaluno kala. 60Ʋ jaŋ joŋ nyanyalɩa-la kala ʋ fa sɩ joŋo hɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa lɛ a hɛ ma lɛ. 61La TƖƖNA bɩra jaŋ joŋ nyanyalaa arɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la doho ba sɩ bɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa wombiee teniŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ, a hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma kala sʋʋ a dɛrɛ. 62Ma fa yʋga nɛ woruŋ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, ama ma kala jaŋ dɛrɛ aŋ ka nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ, a tɩŋ ma sɩ vɩa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa. 63La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɔ ʋ ŋaa ma pʋŋ a kɛŋ dʋa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ʋ cheima. Ba jaŋ kirima tintee-la ma sɩɩ jʋʋ dɩ ma tɩɩ lɛ. 64La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛmma pɩsa hɛ dʋnɩa tinteyee kala lɛ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ma jaŋ kpaarɛ vesiŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ arɩ tabɩaa a ŋaa, vesi-la ma dɩ ma naabalɩmaba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ. 65Tinteye-la lɛ, ma bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ lee ma sɩ jaŋ hɔnɔ wiesi. La TƖƖNA bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala a tɩŋ tʋɔ-cheeŋ arɩ wʋwalɩmaa wɩaa. 66Ma wɩɩkala jaŋ ŋaa logo logo dɩ fawʋllʋŋ jʋʋma tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala, dɩ ma chɩl ma mɩɩsɩŋ wɩaa. 67Chʋchʋɔŋ ma jaŋ bʋl, ‘Dɩ dɩdaanɩŋ nɛ fa.’ Dɩdaanɩŋ ma, ma jaŋ bɩra bʋl, ‘Dɩ chʋchʋɔŋ nɛ fa,’ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ na arɩ fawʋllɩɩ-la sɩ jʋʋma wɩaa. 68La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ paama mɩɩra mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, lee-la mɩ sɩ sɩ ma bɩra sɩ́ mɩɩra mʋ. Nɩmɛ ma jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ma joŋ ma tɩtɩa a yalla pɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ a ŋaa yosi, ka nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ yɔɔma.”

Title: MOSIS BƖRA WULLI WƖA WOMBIIŊ 29
Content:
Nii-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bile ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ
1Nii-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bile ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ Mosis daga pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la, a pɛ nii-la ʋ sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ Sɩnaɩ peel-la lɛ.
