Ʋ kɛmba mʋ a leŋ dɔnsʋŋ hɔŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hala lɛ, dɔnsʋŋ ma hɔnɔ kpagɛ fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Habɔ a hɛ Goza tinteeŋ. Ka dɔnsʋŋ ma hɔŋ tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ Medis tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ lɛ.
Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa mʋ yoŋ-baga
7Wɩaa deemba kala ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ, a tɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la a chei ba TƖƖNA Wɩa tʋɔŋ nɛ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ laaba ta Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ka ba vɩaʋ aŋ kpʋkpaarɛ vesiŋ. 8Ba faa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa tinteye-la nɩaa fa sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ La TƖƖNA kiriba ta tintee-la lɛ ka Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ hɔŋ, arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la Iziral kuoroo sɩ ŋaa dagɛba. 9Iziral tɩŋŋaa lʋara ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa tʋɔŋ ka tɔrɛ nɛ. Ba saa vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa nɛ ba tasɩŋ kala lɛ, kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli arɩ tabiisi-la ba sɩ bɩ kɛrɛ saa golli kala lɛ. 10Ba fa bil tabɩaa nɛ, a pɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ dundolluŋ nyuŋ arɩ tɩɩ-lugunuŋ bʋbʋɔsʋŋ kala a kpʋkpaarɛ. 11Vesiŋ dɩ-kpaarɩa-la kala lɛ, ba yie nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ a nagɛ wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa tinteye-la nɩaa fa sɩɩ ŋaa nɛ tintee-la lɛ La TƖƖNA kiriba ta ka Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ hɔŋ. Ba ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la nɛ a leŋ La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ sii. 12La TƖƖNA fa sɩ dɩ ba sɩ́ vʋɩyaa kpaarʋ nɛ, ka ba vɩa aŋ kpʋkpaarɛ. 13La TƖƖNA fa to ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa arɩ ʋ sɩɩnaaraa lɛ nɛ a bʋl ŋ-la a chagɩlɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Juda nɩaa kala, “Má bɩrɩma lɩɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ. Má to mɩ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛ ma naabalɩmaba dɩ ba to, arɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ to mɩ tɩntɩnna-la sɩ ŋaa mɩ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ a bʋla pɩma.”
14Ama Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa bɩ jegile nɩɩ. Ba nyuŋ fa dolie a nagɛ ba nyɩmmaba-la sɩ bɩ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa wɩaa laa dii nɛ. 15Ba vɩa ʋ wombiiŋ arɩ nii-la ʋ fa sɩ bile pɩ ba nyɩmmaba nɛ arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ fa sɩ kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa. Ba to vʋɩyaa sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ harɩŋ nɛ, a kʋ ŋaa nɩyaayasɩ. Tinteye-la sɩ golliba wʋŋaalaa nɛ ba chesi. La TƖƖNA fa sɩ dɩ ba sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa nɛ, ka ba vɩa aŋ ŋaa.
16Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa vɩa ba TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ kala nɛ, aŋ mɛ kɩaa balɩa ba nagɛ nɛ-biisiŋ a pɛ Asɩra daaŋ, a bɩra mɛ kɩaa ba nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa a kpʋkpaarɛ ba dɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal kala. 17Ba yie kɛsɛ ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba toloo kpʋ a nyɩga pɩpɩ vesiŋ, a vʋvʋgɛ, a joŋ ba tɩtɩa kala hɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, a leŋ ʋ baanɩŋ sii.
18Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA chaasa na baanɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ, a kiriba ta ʋ sɩpaaŋ, aŋ leŋ Juda doho nɩaa dʋndʋŋa. 19Juda tɩŋŋaa ma fa bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ daga to. Ba fa mɩɩra to Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa nɛ. 20Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA vɩa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala ta, aŋ dɔgɩsɛba a leŋ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔhɛɛŋ kɛsɛba a kaa viiri.
21Bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ leŋe Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɔrɛ Juda doho nɩaa lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa leŋ Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam ŋaa ba kuoro. Jerobuam leŋ ba vɩa La TƖƖNA, aŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-balaa. 22Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa to Jerobuam naabʋɔsʋŋ a ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa ʋ sɩ ŋaa nɛ, 23a kaa kɔ bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ kiriba ta ʋ sɩpaaŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ fa sɩ to ʋ tɩntɩnnaa sɩ ŋaa ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ a kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa yuo kɛsɛba a kaa mʋ ba tinteeŋ, ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.
Asiiria tɩŋŋaa mʋ hɔŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ
24Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asiiria kuoro kɛsɛ nɩaa tasɩŋ deemba lɛ: Babɩlɔŋ, Kuta, Ava, Hamaf arɩ Safavem a kaa kʋ holli Samarɩa tinteeŋ tasɩ-la lɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ hɔnɔ. Ba mɩɩra laa Samarɩa tinteeŋ tɩɩ a hɔŋ nɩmɛ. 25Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ buumo hɔŋ nɩmɛ, ba fa bɩ La TƖƖNA ka to. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ naachigee kʋ kpʋ ba dɔnsʋŋ. 26Ba tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Asiiria kuoro, “Nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ kaa kʋ holli Samarɩa tinteeŋ tasɩŋ lɛ, ba bɩ tintee-la vene sɩɩ chɛ wɩalɩŋ jɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ naachigee kʋ jʋʋ ba tʋɔŋ a kpʋkpʋba.”
27Asiiria kuoro bʋla pɩba, “Má kɛŋ Iziral tɩmma-la la sɩ yuo kɛsɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɔŋɔ, kaa mʋ Samarɩa nɩaa teeŋ dɩ ʋ dagɛba ba tintee-la vene wɩaa.” 28Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɔŋɔ, a kaa mɩɩra mʋ Iziral tinteeŋ. Ʋ hɔŋ Bɛtɛl lɛ a dɩdagɛ nɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ dɩdɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA.
29Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ Samarɩa tintee-la lɛ, tintee na-kala nɩaa ha mɛ ba vesiŋ nɛ a joŋo bil vesiŋ dɩ-kpaarɩa-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ saa lɛ. 30Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa mɛ ba vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sʋkɔf Bɛnɔf, Kuta nɩaa ma mɛ ba vene baa yɩrɛ Nɛgal, Hamaf nɩaa ma mɛ ba vene baa yɩrɛ Asɩma, 31Ava tɩŋŋaa ma mɛ ba vesiŋ baa yɩrɛ Nibihas arɩ Taatak, Safavem tɩŋŋaa ma mɛ ba vesiŋ baa yɩrɛ Adɩramɛlɛk arɩ Anamɛlɛk a kɛsɛ ba biiriŋ a nyɩga pɩpɩ ba. 32Nɩaa deemba faa chʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA nɛ, ama ba ha lɩɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ ba tʋɔŋ ba ŋaa veŋ-kpaarɛ hɩasɩŋ, a kpʋkpaarɛ vesi-la sɩ hɛ veŋ-kpaarɛ lere-la. 33Ba faa chʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA nɛ, aŋ pɛ kpʋkpaarɛ ba vesiŋ ma a nagɛ ba tinteye-la ba sɩ lɩɩ kɔ naabarɩŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.
34Arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala, ba haa to ba faafaa wʋŋaalaa nɛ. Ba kʋŋkala bɩ La TƖƖNA dʋndʋŋa nɩɩ dɛnnɛ. Ba bɩ wombie-la ʋ sɩ bile ka to, arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga arɩ ʋ niiri-la arɩ wɩɩ na-kala ʋ sɩ joŋo dagɛ Jekɔb doho nɩaa, nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kaa yɩrɛ Iziral. 35Bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ bil niiŋ ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Má pɔ ma sɩ́ vesiŋ to koo a kpirimi ba sɩpaaŋ, má sɩ́ ba to koo a kpʋkpaarɛba. 36Ama má tuto mɩ dʋndʋŋa, mɩ nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛmma kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ arɩ doluŋ. Mɩ nɛ maga ma tuto. Mɩ sɩpaaŋ nɛ maga dɩ ma kpirimi, mɩ nɛ maga dɩ ma kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a sʋl Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩpa. 37Ʋ maga dɩ ma fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a to mɩ wombiee arɩ mɩ niiŋ wɩaa, a to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ daga dɩ ma tuto. Má pɔ ma sɩ́ vene kala kpaarʋ. 38Má pɔ ma sɩ́ nii-la mɩ sɩ bile mɩ dɩ ma pɛgɛ yʋ. Má sɩ́ vene kala kpaarʋ. 39Má tuto mɩ dʋndʋŋa, mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ laama ta ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”
40Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ bɩ jegile nɩɩ, aŋ ha ŋɩŋaa ba naabalɩmaba wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa. 41Nɩaa deemba faa to La TƖƖNA nɛ, aŋ ha pɛ kpʋkpaarɛ ba vesiŋ ma. Arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala ba biiriŋ arɩ ba nihee ma haa kpaarɛ vesi-la nɛ, arɩ ba nyɩmmaba fa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

Title: 2 KUOROO 18
Content:
Hezikaaya dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ
1Ɛla nanʋala Hosia sɩ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ jɩ-tori lɛ nɛ Ahas nanʋala Hezikaaya ma dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. 2Hezikaaya fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ banɔŋ nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ nibi. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Abija, a ŋaa Zɛkarɩya tolo. 3Ʋ fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ a nagɛ ʋ naabalɩma Devit fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. 4Hezikaaya fa chei vesiŋ dɩ-kpaarɩa-la nɛ, a yɛrɛ tabɩa-la ma ba fa sɩɩ kpaarʋ, aŋ keri Asɩra daasɩ-la ma lo. Ʋ fa ŋmoo dɩŋ-la ma Mosis fa sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ libi ba nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pʋpʋ a bori nɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa faa yɩrɛ dɩŋ-la Nɛhʋsɩtaŋ nɛ.
5Hezikaaya fa laa La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa dii nɛ woruŋ. Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo kala tʋɔŋ, ba kʋŋkala fa tuo a nagʋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ a dii kuoruŋ ʋ lɛ koo nɩalɩŋ sɩ to ʋ harɩŋ a dii kuoruŋ. 6Ʋ fa joŋ ʋ wʋtɩtɩɩ kala hɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ nɛ, a tuto wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo dagɛ Mosis ʋ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto.
7La TƖƖNA fa chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ nɛ, ʋ wɩɩkala wasɛ. Hezikaaya fa vɩa Asiiria kuoro nɛ a bɩ ʋ niiŋ to. 8Ʋ fa yuo dii Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa tabala-la kala ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli arɩ tabiisi-la ba sɩ bɩ kɛrɛ saa golli, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gaza arɩ lere-la sɩ gollu.
9Hezikaaya sɩ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ jɩ-nɛsɛ lɛ, dɩ Ɛla nanʋala Hosia ma sɩ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ ma jɩ-pɛɩ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asiiria tinteeŋ kuoro Salɩmanɛsa kʋ tɔ Samarɩa hɛ a yuyuou. 10Ʋ yuou ŋɩɩ nɛ jɩsɩŋ batori, aŋ yuo dii. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ dɩ Hezikaaya sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ balɩdʋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Hosia ma sɩ dii Iziral tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, ʋ ma jɩ-nibi lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. 11Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asiiria kuoro kɛsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala a kaa mʋ Asiiria tinteeŋ. Ʋ kɛmba mʋ a leŋ dɔnsʋŋ hɔŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hala lɛ, dɔnsʋŋ ma hɔnɔ kpagɛ fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Habɔ sɩ hɛ Gozaŋ tinteeŋ. Ka dɔnsʋŋ ma hɔŋ tasɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ Medis tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ lɛ. 12Wɩaa deemba kala ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ, a tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa niiŋ to nɛ, aŋ chei nii-la ʋ sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna Mosis sɩ dagɛba. Ba bɩ wɩalɩŋ jegile nɩɩ koo a toba.
13Hezikaaya sɩ kʋ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ banɛsɛ tʋɔŋ nɛ, Asiiria kuoro Sanakɛrɩb arɩ ʋ nɩaa sii kʋ yuo dii Juda tabala-la kala ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli, a kɛsɛba. 14Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya tɩŋ ba mʋ bʋla pɩ Asiiria tinteeŋ kuoro Sɛnakɛrɩb sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lakɩs lɛ, “Mɩ cheye nɛ. Bɩra sɩ́ mɩ tinteeŋ yuo. Mɩ jaŋ pɩŋ kʋŋ na-kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asiiria tinteeŋ kuoro bʋla pɩ Hezikaaya arɩ ʋ jaŋ laa hɔpʋla yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo bʋɩ fii arɩ sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo bʋɩ ʋ teeŋ.
15Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya paa hɔpʋla-la kala sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la arɩ kuoru dɩa kala lɛ a pʋ. 16Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ Hezikaaya lɛrɛ sɛlɩmɛ-la kala ba sɩ joŋo taarɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la borusuŋ arɩ boro daasɩŋ kala, a joŋo pa ba kaa mʋ pɩ Asiiria kuoro Sɛnakɛrɩb.
Sɛnakɛrɩb fugisi Jerusalɛm tɩŋŋaa
17Asiiria kuoro tɩŋ ʋ nɩaa deemba batori: Ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala nɩhɩaŋ, ʋ tɩntɩnnaa kala nɩhɩaŋ arɩ ʋ laal-baga nɩhɩaŋ ba kɛŋ laalɩyuori daŋ lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lakɩs a mʋ Hezikaaya teeŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la arɩ ba nɩaa sɩ kɔ Jerusalɛm, ba chɩŋ pɩl-la sɩ hɛ nyuŋ lɩɩ-libe-la sɩɩ pɛllʋ a hɛ wombii-la sɩɩ mʋ lee-la ba sɩɩ chɛsɛ kɩaa lɛ nɛ. 18Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ yɩrɛ kuoro Hezikaaya arɩ Ɛlɩakɩm nanʋala Hɩlɩkaaya, nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa kuoro dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ, Sɛbɩna, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba tenniŋ, a pɛ Asaf nanʋala Jʋab lɛ, nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ bil ba tenniŋ. Ba kʋ chemba.
19Laal-baga nɩhɩa-la bʋla pɩba, “Má pɩɛsɛ kuoro Hezikaaya dɩ wɩɩ-la Asiiria kuoru-balɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ jɩŋ nɛ, ‘Kʋbɛɛ lɛ nɛ ma yɩɛlaa paala hɛ?’ 20Ma sɩ sɩ ma kɛŋ laalɩŋ-yuonuŋ jɩma arɩ doluŋ nɛ, ama ma wʋbʋlɩɩ-la kala ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ lɛ nɛ ma joŋ ma yɩɛlaa a daŋ aŋ vɩamɛ?
21Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro lɛ nɛ ma joŋ ma yɩɛlaa daŋ. Ʋ saa nagɛ mɔrʋŋ nɩa sɩ joŋo a kaa ŋaa dantɩga a vɩvɛŋ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ bori a tʋrɛ ma nɩsaa lɛ a pɩrɛma. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ nagɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa daŋ ʋ lɛ. 22Dɩ ma nɛ saa bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ arɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa lɛ nɛ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ, ʋ leree arɩ ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ korunuŋ dee Hezikaaya ŋmoo giri ŋɩɩ, aŋ bʋla pɩ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa, arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ba dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ deeŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛɛ? 23Má kɔ dɩ ma dɩ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ sɩ ŋaa Asiiria kuoro bʋla nɩɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ joŋ janɩŋ bʋɩ balɩa a pɩma, dɩ ma nɛ jaŋ wuo na nɩaa dɩ ba jɩlba. 24Ma sɩ paala joŋ ma wɩɩkala a daŋ Ijipiti janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ba ja-jɩllaa lɛ ŋɩɩ, ma bɩɩna ma jaŋ wuo yuo dii mɩ nɩhɩaŋ tɩntɩnnaa tʋɔŋ kʋbie naa? 25Ma bɩɩna mɩ tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ mɩɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ yuo tinteeŋ deeŋ a cheyu ŋɩɩ? La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ pɩmɛ wombiiŋ dɩ mɩ kʋ yuo ma tinteeŋ a cheyu.” 26Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hɩlɩkaaya nanʋala Ɛlɩakɩm arɩ Sɛbɩna arɩ Jʋa ma bʋla pɩ Asiiria kuoro laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la, “Laa sʋlʋŋ, kɛŋ Aramek tɩŋŋaa yikoro bʋl wɩalɩŋ a pɩla, laa nɩɩʋ nɛ, aŋ leŋ Hiburu tɩŋŋaa yikoro. La bɩ chɛ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sagɛ kɛrɛ nyuŋ nɩɩ.”
27Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asiiria kuoro laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la ma bʋl, “Ma bɩɩna ma nɩhɩaŋ arɩ ma dʋndʋŋa teeŋ nɛ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ tɩmmɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ bʋl wɩaa deemba? Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ sagɛ kɛrɛ-la nyuŋ pɛ nɛ. Ma kala jaŋ gʋra dii ma tɩtɩa bɩnɩŋ aŋ nyʋa ma tɩtɩa fɩɩrɩŋ ma.”
28Ŋɩɩ nɛ laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la kɛŋ Hiburu yikoro a faasa bʋl, “Má jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Asiiria kuoro sɩ ŋaa kuoru-balɩŋ sɩ bʋla. 29Ba nɛ ŋ-la: Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Hezikaaya nyɩsɛma, ʋ bɩ ma wuo laa ta. 30Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Hezikaaya nyɩsɛma dɩ ma joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ ma TƖƖNA lɛ, arɩ ʋ sɩ sɩ ma TƖƖNA bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ joŋ ma tabal-la a pɩ Asiiria kuoro. 31Má sɩ́ Hezikaaya teeŋ jegilu. Asiiria kuoro sɩ: Má kɔ mɩ teeŋ dɩ la ŋaa sɩma, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma kʋŋkala jaŋ wuo dii ma tɩtɩa girep nɛnɛɛ aŋ nyʋa ma vilee ma lɩɩŋ, 32ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɛmma mʋ lee-la sɩ nagɛ ma tɩtɩa tinteeŋ, a kɛŋ mɩaa ma sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa kʋdiilee, girep nɛnɛɛ ma sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa sɩnɩŋ, nʋʋŋ tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ tʋʋŋ. Má bagɩsa lɩɩsɛ mɩɩsɩŋ aŋ leŋ sʋʋŋ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Hezikaaya kɛmma yeŋŋi, dɩ ʋ nɛ sɩ, ‘Ma TƖƖNA jaŋ laama ta.’ 33Ma ha na tintee dɔŋ vene dɩ ʋ wuo laa ʋ tinteeŋ Asiiria kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛɛ? 34Nɩɩ nɛ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hamaf arɩ Apad vesiŋ hɛ? Nɩɩ nɛ tasɩ-la ma ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛfavem, Hɛna arɩ Iva vesiŋ hɛ? Ba wuo laa Samarɩa ta nɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛɛ? 35Vesiŋ deemba kala tʋɔŋ, ba kʋbɛɛ nɛ wuo laa ʋ tinteeŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ? Ɛɛ nɛ saa ma TƖƖNA jaŋ wuo ŋaa a laa Jerusalɛm ta mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ?”
36Ka nɩalɩŋ kala tɔrɛ ba niiŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa kuoro Hezikaaya bʋla pɩba nɛ arɩ ba sɩ́ wɩɩkala laa bʋl ʋ teeŋ.
37Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hɩlɩkaaya nanʋala Ɛlɩakɩm sɩ ŋaa kuoru dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ arɩ Sɛbɩna ma sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba tenniŋ arɩ Jʋa ma sɩɩ bil ba tenniŋ, kɛŋ ba gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aa dagɛ tʋɔ-cheeŋ, aŋ mɩɩra mʋ Hezikaaya teeŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala Asiiria kuoro laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la sɩ bʋla a pʋ.

Title: 2 KUOROO 19
Content:
Ba bʋl Jerusalɛm laatanɩŋ wɩaa
1Kuoro Hezikaaya sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aa dagɛ tʋɔ-cheeŋ, aŋ paa tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ laalɛ a mʋ jʋʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. 2Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tɩŋ Ɛlɩakɩm sɩ ŋaa kuoru dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ arɩ Sɛbɩna, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba tenniŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ba laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ a mʋ Amos nanʋala Azaaya sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ teeŋ. 3Ba mʋ bʋla pʋ, “Wɩɩ-la Hezikaaya sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Jɩnɩŋ la tʋɔŋ kala nɛ cheye, hɛɛŋ jʋʋla nɛ, hɩɩsɩŋ ma diila. La nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl nɛ aŋ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl. 4Ŋ bɩ pɔ ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Asiiria kuoro sɩ tɩŋ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ ʋ kɔ a tʋʋsɛ Wɩa sɩ weye joŋŋoo. Ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa sɛnɛ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ nɛ, ʋ jaŋ lɛrɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ bʋlba dɩgɩlɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, sʋl Wɩa pɩ la nɩkaana-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ.’ ” 5Azaaya sɩ nɩɩ kuoro Hezikaaya tɩndaarɩŋ, 6ʋ ma bɩra tɩmba, “Má mʋ bʋla pɩ ma nɩhɩaŋ dɩ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la, ‘Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ Asiiria kuoro tɩndaara-la sɩ bʋla a tʋʋsɛ mɩ-na Wɩa joŋŋoo. 7Mɩ-na ma Tɩɩna jaŋ joŋ dɩma kʋbala a hɛ ʋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ nɩɩ ba sɩ a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ, a sii mʋ nɩmɛ dɩ ba kpʋ.’ ” 8Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asiiria kuoro laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ-la nɩɩ dɩ Asiiria kuoro lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lakɩs lɛ a mʋ yuyuo Lɩbɩna tabalɩŋ, ʋ mɩɩra mʋ ʋ teeŋ. 9Bʋa deeŋ tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ Asiiria kuoro Sanakɛrɩb nɩɩ dɩ Tɩɩhaka, Kus tɩɩna-la sɩ ŋaa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa kuoro kɛŋ laalɩyuoroo kʋkɔ dɩ ba yuou nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ, a tɩŋ ba kaa mʋ pɩ Hezikaaya. 10Ŋ-la nɛ teŋ-la bʋl, “Má bʋla pɩ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Hezikaaya dɩ ʋ sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Wɩa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa hɛ nyɩsʋ arɩ Asiiria kuoro bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo dii Jerusalɛm. 11Ŋ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Asiiria kuoro sɩ ŋaa tinteyee kala lɛ nɛ a chei ba kala. Ŋ bɩɩna ŋ-na jaŋ wuo laa ŋ tɩtɩa? 12Mɩ naabalɩma fa yuo dii tabalaa deemba ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gozaŋ, Haraŋ, Rɛzɛf arɩ Ɛdɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛl Asaa a chei ba kala nɛ. Ba fa kɛŋ vesiŋ nɛ, ka ba kʋŋ bɩ wuo laaba ta. 13Nɩɩ nɛ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hamaf, Apad, Sɛfavem, koo Hɛna koo Iva kuoroo hɛ?” 14Hezikaaya sɩ laa teniŋ tɩndaara-la teeŋ a karɩmɛ, ʋ sii kaa jɩl La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kaa jɛrɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, 15aŋ sʋlʋ, “La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, ŋ sɩ hɔŋ ŋ kuoru kpasa-la sɩ hɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa pɛgɛ, ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa, a bibeŋ tinteye-la kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ. 16La TƖƖNA, jegile nɩɩ aŋ bɩra bee na Sanakɛrɩb sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala a tʋʋsɛ ŋ-na Wɩa sɩ weye joŋŋoo. 17Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA, Asiiria kuoroo chei nɩ-daŋ nɛ, ka ba tinteyee pɩŋ jikpeeŋ. 18Ba paa ba vesi-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa ŋaa a nyɩgɛ nɛ. Daasɩŋ arɩ tabɩaa nɛ nuhuobiinee kaa ŋaaba. 19La TƖƖNA Wɩa, laala ta Asiiria tɩŋŋaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ dʋnɩa kuoroo arɩ ba nɩaa kala jɩŋ arɩ ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa.”
Sanakɛrɩb tele
20Ŋɩɩ nɛ Amos nanʋala Azaaya tɩŋ tɩndaarɩŋ pɩ Hezikaaya: “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la, ‘Ŋ sɩ sʋlmɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ tɩgɛ Asiiria kuoro Sanakɛrɩb lɛ, mɩ nɩa nɛ. 21Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
Zaayɔŋ nɩaa ka mɔŋ Sɛnakɛrɩb nɛ a sisieri ʋ lɛ.
Jerusalɛm nɩaa kɛŋ nyuŋ kpukpegisi nɛ,
ka ʋ fɩfá dɩ ʋ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ.
22Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ bɩɩnɛ ŋ tʋʋsa aŋ chichei ŋɩɩ?
Kʋbɛɛ nyuŋ nɛ ŋ ŋɩŋaa goŋ arɩ babii-ballɩŋ ŋɩɩ?
Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ teeŋ nɛ
ŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deembaa?
23Ŋ leŋe ŋ tɩndaaraa tʋʋsɛ La TƖƖNA joŋŋoo nɛ woruŋ.
Ŋ sɩ: Mɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba sɩ yʋga ŋɩɩ,
ba nɛ mɩ kaa jɩl Lɛbanɔŋ peelee nyu-gbaŋa,
a jʋʋ ʋ duuŋ tʋɔŋ a keri ʋ kuolu tɩɩ-duduosuŋ
arɩ bʋtʋnsʋŋ tɩɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ kala lo.
24Ŋ sɩ ŋ lu vilee nɛ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ
a nyʋnyʋa lɩɩŋ nɩmɛ.
Ŋ sɩ ŋ naachɛɛŋ nɛ
ŋ kaa nʋɔsɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ fuonuŋ kala tɔ ba hɩl.
25Sanakɛrɩb, ŋ bɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ-na La TƖƖNA
sɩ bɩɩna bil faafaa kala dɩ mɩ ŋaa nɩa?
Lɛɛlɛ mɩ ŋaaba nɛ.
Mɩ nɛ pɩŋ doluŋ ŋ kaa kɛŋ tasɩ-la kala ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli bɩrɩmɛ
ba nagɛ tabɩaa sɩ daŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ ŋɩɩ.
26Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ lee-la bɩra bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ,
ba bugumo nɛ ka hɩɩsɩŋ diiba.
Ba fa nagɛ yaŋ sɩ miire ŋmaŋkaaŋ lɛ nɛ,
koo yaŋ sɩ nyʋ lusuŋ nyuŋ a bɩ waa, ka hɩlɩŋ leŋ ba hɩl.
27Mɩ jɩŋ ŋ wɩɩkala nɛ,
wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa arɩ lee-la
ŋ sɩɩ mʋ arɩ baaŋ-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ arɩ mɩ.
28A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ faasa kɛŋ baaŋ-la arɩ mɩ
arɩ babiibal wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla mɩ nɩɩ,
lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ joŋ hɛmɩŋ tɔɔ gɩrɩgɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ,
a joŋ mɩ koŋ ma a hɛ ŋ niiŋ.
Mɩ jaŋ lɛrɩŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩra joŋ wombii-la ŋ sɩ to kɔ a mʋ.
29Wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa magɩl a pɩ ŋ-na Hezikaaya nɛ:
Jɩna deeŋ ŋ jaŋ dii mɩɩ-tɩarɩŋ,
harɩŋ jɩna ma ŋ ha jaŋ dii mɩɩ-tɩarɩŋ.
Ama jɩ-tori lɛ, duu kɩaa a kʋŋ,
a chɔnsɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ ma a tɔrɛ ba nɛnɛɛ dii.
30Juda doho nɩaa nɩkaana-la wɩaa jaŋ chɩŋ woruŋ,
a nagɛ tɩa naapoloo sɩ jʋʋ tinteeŋ woruŋ a nɛŋ.
31Nɩaa ha jaŋ ka Jerusalɛm
arɩ Zaayɔŋ peel-la lɛ a pɛ.
Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna chaasa kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ.
32Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ŋ-la nɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA bʋl a mʋ tɩgɛ Asiiria kuoro lɛ:
Ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kʋ jʋʋ taŋ deeŋ
koo a yuo hɛmɩŋ ʋ lɛ.
Ʋ laalɩyuoroo bɩ jaŋ wuo golli taŋ deeŋ chu a yuou,
ba bɩ jaŋ wuo saa lusuŋ-choluŋ a to nɩmɛ jʋʋ.
33Wombii-la ʋ sɩ to kɔ, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ jaŋ bɩra to a mɩɩrɛ,
ʋ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ taŋ deeŋ.
Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.
34Mɩ jaŋ pɔ taŋ deeŋ woruŋ
a tɩŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ arɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna kuoro Devit wɩaa.’ ”
35Tɩtaŋ-la tɩtɩa nɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa tɩndaara mʋ lee-la Asiiria tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɔnɔ, a kpʋ ba laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ banɔŋ. Taŋ ka pʋl dɩ lee-la kala suo arɩ sʋʋnʋŋ. 36Asiiria kuoro Sanakɛrɩb leŋ laal-la ʋ fa sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ yuo aŋ mɩɩra mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɩnɩvɛ a hɔŋ nɩmɛ.
37Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Sanakɛrɩb sii a jʋʋ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɩsɩrɔk dɩa a kpʋkpaarɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩa, Adɩramɛlɛk arɩ Sarɛza jʋʋ kpʋʋ arɩ tokobiiŋ, aŋ lɩɩ fá mʋ Ararat tinteeŋ. Ka ʋ nanʋala dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asahadɔŋ dii kuoruŋ.

Title: 2 KUOROO 20
Content:
Hezikaaya nyanyalaa
1Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Hezikaaya faa wɩɩlʋ, a ka mʋa dɩ ʋ sʋba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Azaaya sɩ ŋaa Amos nanʋala sii mʋ ʋ teeŋ a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ: ‘Kɛŋ ŋ tinteeŋ wɩaa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ duori.’ ” 2Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa bɩrɩma chaasɛ jeeŋ aŋ sʋl La TƖƖNA. 3“Mɩ Tɩɩna, liisi ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ laaŋ dii a toŋ arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ.” Ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ aŋ chaasa yel woruŋ. 4Ka dɩ Azaaya-na fa mɩɩra lɩɩ kuoru dɩa kaala sɩ hɛ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ lɛ, La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pʋ, 5“Mɩɩra mʋ bʋla pɩ mɩ nɩaa sɩpaalaara Hezikaaya arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa ʋ naabalɩma Devit Wɩa sɩ, ‘Mɩ nɩɩ ŋ sʋla nɛ a na ŋ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ ma. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ duori. A lɩɩ jɩnɩŋ kaa mʋ tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ, ŋ jaŋ mɩɩra jʋʋ mɩ-na Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. 6Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ banɔŋ a pɛ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ laa ŋ dɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala ta Asiiria kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Mɩ jaŋ pɔ taŋ deeŋ woruŋ a tɩŋ mɩ dɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna Devit wɩaa.’ ” 7Azaaya fa bʋla pɩ Hezikaaya, “Leŋ dɩ ba tugi tutogo nɛnɛɛ a paa taa mɔpʋla-la.” Ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ ʋ fɩɛlɛ. 8Hezikaaya ma pɩɛsɛ Azaaya, “Magɩlɩ bɛɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋo dagɛ arɩ mɩ jaŋ duori a mʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tapʋlaa batori chɛɛŋ?” 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ Azaaya bʋl, “Magɩlɩŋ deeŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ kaa dagɛ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa. Ŋ jaŋ cho dɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ daaliimiŋ mʋ sɩpaaŋ naakieliŋ fii koo ŋ jaŋ cho dɩ ʋ mʋ harɩŋ naakieliŋ fii?” 10Hezikaaya bʋl, “Ʋ ŋaa mɔlɩɩ nɛ dɩ daaliimiŋ mʋ sɩpaaŋ naakieliŋ fii, ama mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ mɩɩra mʋ harɩŋ nɛ naakieliŋ fii.” 11Ŋɩɩ nɛ Azaaya, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la ŋmoo niiŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, ʋ leŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ daaliimiŋ mɩɩra mʋ harɩŋ naakieliŋ fii, lee-la kuoro Ahas lusuŋ-choluŋ sɩ chɩna.
Tɩndaara-la sɩ lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ
12Bʋa-la lɛ baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Merodak-Baladaŋ nɛ fa ŋaa Babɩlɔŋ kuoro. Ʋ fa ŋaa Baladaŋ nanʋala nɛ. Ʋ sɩ nɩa dɩ Hezikaaya wɩɩla nɛ aŋ duori, ʋ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a joŋ kɩaa pɛ, a tɩŋ nɩaa dɩ ba kaa mʋ dii zile ʋ lɛ. 13Hezikaaya cheme laa tɩndaara-la, a kɛmba gɔllɔ dagɛ ʋ dʋa-la kala sɩ hɛ ʋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ: hɔpʋla, sɛlɩmɛ, tegisiŋ, nʋʋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ ʋ bayuori kɩaa a pɛ kʋŋkala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ lɛ. Kʋŋkala fa tuo ʋ kuoru dɩa arɩ lee-la kala ʋ sɩɩ beŋ lɛ ʋ bɩ kaa dagɛba. 14Ŋɩɩ nɛ Azaaya Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la kɔ kuoro Hezikaaya teeŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Nɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ lɩɩ? Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ba kʋ bʋl?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya sɩ, “Ba lɩɩ dɩ-bolii nɛ, Babɩlɔŋ nɛ ba lɩɩ.” 15Azaaya bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “Bɛɛ kɩaa nɛ ba na ŋ dɩa lɛ?” Hezikaaya sɩ, “Ba na kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ mɩ kuoru dɩa lɛ nɛ. Kʋŋkala tuo mɩ kɩaa tʋɔŋ mɩ sɩ bɩ kaa dagɛba.” 16Ŋɩɩ nɛ Azaaya bʋla pɩ Hezikaaya, “Jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla: 17Bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi, kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ŋ kuoru dɩa lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ŋ naabalɩmaba sɩ dʋa a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ, ba jaŋ chʋŋ ba kala a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ. Kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ ka. La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. 18Ba jaŋ kɛsɛ ŋ doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ arɩ ŋ tɩtɩa bii-lʋlaa a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ a feriba dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro dɩa lɛ.” 19Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya bʋla pɩ Azaaya, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ.” Ʋ bʋl ŋɩɩ bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ-na fa bɩɩna La TƖƖNA sɩ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ fɩɛlɩŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, wʋwalɩmɩɩ kala bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ-ʋ. 20Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Hezikaaya sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa a laa yɩrɩŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ lu pɩlɩŋ a hɛ lɩɩ-libe lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ kʋʋ jʋʋ ba taŋ tʋɔŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. 21Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hezikaaya sʋʋ, ka ʋ nanʋala Manasɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

Title: 2 KUOROO 21
Content:
Manasɛ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ
1Manasɛ fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ aŋ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Hefiziba. 2Manasɛ fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, a tuto wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa tinteye-la fa sɩ hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ sɩɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA kiriba ta ka Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ hɔŋ. 3Ʋ wasa saa vesiŋ dɩ-kpaarɩa-la kala ʋ nyɩmma Hezikaaya fa sɩ ŋmoo giri nɛ, aŋ saa korunuŋ a pɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal, aŋ pɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daaŋ ma, arɩ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Ahab fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ʋ fa kpirime aa chʋɔlɛ wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa kala ma nɛ. 4Ʋ saa fa vʋɩyaa korunuŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ tʋɔŋ, lee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla arɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ jaŋ hɛ. 5Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kaalɩsɩ-la balɩa kala lɛ nɛ ʋ saa korunuŋ aa chʋɔlɛ wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa. 6Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa nanʋala a kpʋ nɛ a nyɩga pɩ vesiŋ. Ʋ faa vʋgʋ nɛ, a ŋɩŋaa chichiribi wɩaa a yɩyɩrɛ kantɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ lɛlɛɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ a leŋ La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ chaasa sii ʋ nyuŋ.
7Manasɛ fa joŋ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daa-la ʋ sɩ saa a bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ nɛ. Ama La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩ Devit arɩ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ, “Jerusalɛm arɩ mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa Iziral doho doho kala tʋɔŋ nɛ ba jaŋ zizilmi nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. 8Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɩɩ tintee-la lɛ mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩ ba naabalɩmaba, dɩ ba nɛ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ ba sɩaa a to wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛba a mʋ tɩgɛ wombie-la kala mɩ tɩntɩnna Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto.” 9Ama Juda doho nɩaa bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ to. Manasɛ leŋe ba yeŋŋi nɛ, a wasa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a kɩɩ tinteye-la fa sɩ hɛ lee-la La TƖƖNA cheiba ka Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ hɔŋ.
10Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA to ʋ tɩntɩnnaa sɩ ŋaa ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ a bʋl, 11“Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Manasɛ sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba, ba nɛ kɩɩ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la. Ʋ leŋe Juda doho nɩaa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa nɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. 12Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ dɩgɩlaa jaŋ ŋaa zim. 13Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Jerusalɛm nɩaa arɩ mɩ fa sɩ dɔgɩsɛ Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa arɩ Iziral kuoro Ahab arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa ŋɩɩ. Mɩ jaŋ kpʋ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala gbelem gbelem, a nagɛ nɩa sɩ tiisi gbaŋa a tɩɩgɛ lɩɩ-suosoo kala ta aŋ kaa bɩrɩma chu. 14Mɩ jaŋ vɩa mɩ nɩaa nɩkaana-la ma sɩ bɩ sʋba, aŋ jomba hɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ yuo diiba a paa ba kɩaa kaa viiri, 15bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ mɩ sɩɩŋ lɛ, a leŋ mɩ baanɩŋ sii a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ ba naabalɩmaba sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ.”
16Manasɛ ha pɛ kpʋ nɩaa sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye a yʋgɛ nɛ a leŋ Jerusalɛm kala ŋaa disiŋ, a pɛ ʋ sɩ leŋe Juda nɩaa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la, a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. 17Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Manasɛ sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala ʋ sɩ ŋaa, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. 18Ŋɩɩ nɛ Manasɛ sʋʋ. Ba joŋu hugi baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Uza ŋmaŋkaaŋ lɛ a kpagɛ kuoru dɩa. Ka ʋ nanʋala Amɔŋ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.
Amɔŋ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ
19Amɔŋ fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ balɩa nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ balɩa nɛ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Mɛsʋlɛmɛf. Mɛsʋlɛmɛf ma naaŋ nɛ fa Harus a lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jotiba. 20Amɔŋ ma fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, arɩ ʋ nyɩmma Manasɛ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. 21Wɩalɩŋ ʋ nyɩmma sɩ ŋaa tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ ma ŋaa. Tɔmɔ-la ʋ nyɩmma fa sɩɩ kpaarʋ, ba tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ ma fa kpʋkpaarɛ, a kpikpirimi ba sɩpaaŋ. 22Ʋ vɩa La TƖƖNA nɛ, ʋ naabalɩmaba Wɩa, a bɩ ʋ wombiiŋ to.
23Ŋɩɩ nɛ Amɔŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ vʋʋrɛ a kpʋʋ ʋ kuoru dɩa lɛ. 24Juda nɩaa ma kpʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ vʋʋra kpʋ Amɔŋ, aŋ leŋ ʋ nanʋala Josaaya dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.
25Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Amɔŋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. 26Ba joŋu hugi ʋ tɩtɩa bʋa lɛ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Uza ŋmaŋkaaŋ lɛ a kpagɛ kuoru dɩa. Ka ʋ nanʋala Josaaya dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

Title: 2 KUOROO 22
Content:
Ba gbille a na Wɩa wombiee teniŋ
1Josaaya fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ chori nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ kʋbala nɛ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Jedida. Jedida ma naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Adaaya a lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bozikaf. 2Josaaya fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ fa to wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ naabalɩma Devit sɩ to nɛ, ʋ bɩ begile mʋ nadiiŋ koo nagʋa.
3Ʋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ chori lɛ, ʋ tɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ʋ tenniŋ baa yɩrɛ Safaŋ, sɩ ŋaa Azalɩa nanʋala, a ŋaa Mesulam ma nihiŋ dɩ ʋ mʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la. Ʋ sɩ, 4“Mʋ Hɩlɩkaaya teeŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ, a bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ laa moribie-la ba sɩ kaa kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la, kɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ dɩa-la sɩ laa nɩaa teeŋ. 5Bʋla pɩ Hɩlɩkaaya dɩ ʋ joŋ moribie-la pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa dɩ ba tiŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ wasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. 6Ba tiŋ kapɩntaba arɩ meesimba arɩ dɩɩ-saara-la sɩ pɛ, aŋ yɔɔ daasɩŋ arɩ tabɩɩ-yɛrɛɛ dɩ ba kaa wasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. 7Ama ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba ŋmʋnsɛ moribie-la ba sɩ die niiŋ a bibil, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋaa nɩtɩtɩɩba nɛ.”
8Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hɩlɩkaaya, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ bʋla pɩ Safaŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ kuoro teniŋ, “Mɩ na teŋ-la lɛ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa wombiee hɛ nɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ.” Hɩlɩkaaya joŋ teŋ-la a pɩ Safaŋ ʋ laa karɩmɛ. 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ Safaŋ mɩɩra mʋ kuoro teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ laa moribie-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ nɛ a joŋo pɩ tɩntɩnnaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ Wɩa dɩa-la tɩntɩŋŋaa. 10Ama kuoru, wɩɩ dɔŋ ma nɛ ha hɛ nɩmɛ. Hɩlɩkaaya, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ nɛ joŋ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩmɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Safaŋ faasa suri yikoro a karɩmɛ teŋ-la kuoro sɩpaaŋ.
11Kuoro Josaaya sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa wombiee teŋ-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aa dagɛ tʋɔ-cheeŋ. 12Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩ Hɩlɩkaaya sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara arɩ Safaŋ nanʋala Ahɩkam arɩ Mɩkaaya nanʋala Akɩbɔ arɩ Safaŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba tenniŋ arɩ kuoro nanzɔɔ Asaaya, 13“Má mʋ chɛ na La TƖƖNA teeŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ a pɩ mɩ dɩ Juda nɩaa kala. La TƖƖNA chaasa na baanɩŋ nɛ la nyuŋ, a tɩŋ la naabalɩmaba sɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ to, a bɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa a mʋ tɩgɛ la lɛ ŋaa.”
14Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hɩlɩkaaya sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ, Ahɩkam, Akɩbɔ, Safaŋ arɩ Asaaya mʋ haal kʋbala sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ teeŋ baa yɩrɛ Hulida, dɩ ba chɛ na. Haal-la bala nɛ fa Salum, sɩ ŋaa Tɩkɩva nanʋala. Tɩkɩva ma nyɩmma nɛ fa Hahas. Salum nɛ faa beŋ gɛnnɩ-la ba sɩɩ bil Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ. Hulida ma fa hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ aa jʋʋ jechigi falɩɩ-la.
15Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Má mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmma mɩ teeŋ, 16arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ, ‘Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ hɛ Jerusalɛm arɩ ʋ nɩaa kala lɛ, arɩ teŋ-la Juda tinteeŋ kuoro sɩ karɩma sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, 17bɛɛ wɩaa ba vɩamɛ nɛ aŋ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ vesiŋ, a leŋ mɩ baanɩŋ sii tɔmɔ-la ba tɩtɩa sɩ mɛ lɛ. Mɩ baanɩŋ chaasa sii ba nyuŋ nɛ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ.’ 18Má mʋ bʋla pɩ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Josaaya, nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmma dɩ ma kʋ chɛ na wɩaa La TƖƖNA teeŋ, ‘Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bʋla a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ nɩa lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: 19A tɩŋ ŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ cheye ŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa muuri mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, ŋ sɩ nɩa arɩ mɩ jaŋ chei Jerusalɛm arɩ ʋ nɩaa, ka dɩ lee-la pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, ŋ kɛŋ ŋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ a yel mɩ sɩpaaŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jegile nɩɩ ŋ sʋla nɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla. 20Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ sʋʋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Ŋ sɩɩŋ bɩ jaŋ na wʋlɔrʋnʋ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa Jerusalɛm arɩ ʋ nɩaa lɛ.’ ” Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ mɩɩra mʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la Hulida sɩ bʋla a pɩ kuoro.

Title: 2 KUOROO 23
Content:
Josaaya wasa wulli Wɩa wombiee
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Josaaya yɩrɛ Juda tinteeŋ arɩ Jerusalɛm taŋ-la nɩhɩasɩŋ kala hɛ dɔŋɔ. 2Ba mʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ, Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda tinteeŋ nɩbalaa arɩ nɩbiisiŋ kala. Nɩmɛ nɛ Josaaya karɩmɛ Wɩa wombiee teŋ-la kala ba sɩ na La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, nʋʋkala nɩɩ. 3Kuoro Josaaya sii chɩŋ ʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ, jebii-la sɛmɛ a hɛ niiŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ jaŋ to ʋ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ daga arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ wɩɩ wɩɩkala, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ teŋ-la tʋɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɛɩ arɩ ba jaŋ to nii-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa wombiee teŋ-la tʋɔŋ.
4Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro bʋla pɩ Hɩlɩkaaya, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩa boiŋ niiŋ dɩ ba paa kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ ba kaa kpʋkpaarɛ vesi-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal arɩ Asɩra arɩ chɛnwʋlaa a kaa kʋ lɩɩ. Ba paa kʋ lɩɩ, ʋ kɛmba kaa lɩɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kaa mʋ Kɩdɩrɔŋ fuonaaŋ sɩ hɛ ʋ harɩŋ, a nyɩgɛba nɩmɛ, a paa ba tʋɔrʋŋ kaa mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛtɛl. 5Kuoro Josaaya bɩra kiri nɩalɩŋ Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo fa sɩ lɩɩsa vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa ba kpʋkpaarɛ vesi-la sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩŋ arɩ tasɩ-la kala sɩ golli Jerusalɛm, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal, chɛnɛ, chɛnwʋlaa, arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kɩaa. 6Ʋ jʋʋ joŋ veŋ-haal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daaŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ a kaa mʋ Kɩdɩrɔŋ fuonaa-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm harɩŋ a nyɩgɛ, a paa nɔŋ ba bɩɩ ʋ joŋo mɩsɛ ba sʋʋnʋŋ dɩ-huguŋ. 7Ʋ bɩra ŋmoo dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ baalaa jʋʋ a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ a lo. Dɩɩsɩ-la lɛ nɛ haalaa ma fa sʋsʋa gɛnnɩ-la ba sɩ laala kpʋkpaarɛ Asɩra vene-la.
8Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josaaya kɛsɛ veŋ-kpaarɛ hɩasɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩŋ lɛ a kaa kɔ Jerusalɛm, aŋ chei korunu-la kala lɛ ba fa sɩɩ kpaarɛ vesi-la, a chɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Geba lɛ a kaa mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛɛsɩba. Josaaya fa bɩra chei vesi-la sɩ chɩŋ ba taŋ-la nagʋa boi-baalɩŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Josua boiŋ niiŋ nɛ. 9Veŋ-kpaara-la fa bɩ La TƖƖNA koruŋ lɛ ka tɩŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ, ama ba pɛ ba naambiiri-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɛ a didii boroboro-la sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ. 10Josaaya fa bɩra chei vesiŋ dɩ-kpaara-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɔfɛf a hɛ Bɛŋ Hɩnɔm fuonaaŋ lɛ, dɩ nɩaa bɩra sɩ́ ba biiriŋ kaa mʋ kpʋ a nyɩga pɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk. 11Kɩalɩŋ Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo fa sɩ mɛ ba nagɛ janɩŋ ba kaa chʋchʋɔlɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, ʋ kiri. Janɩ-la fa hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kaala tʋɔŋ nɛ a kpagɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Netaŋ-Mɛlɛk dɩa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josaaya nyɩgɛ janɩŋ torukoba-la ma ba fa sɩ kaa chʋchʋɔlɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ.
12Josaaya ŋmoo vʋɩyaa korunu-la Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo sɩ saa lo, kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ lusuŋ nyuŋ a kpagɛ Ahas lusuŋ-nyuŋ dɩa. Ʋ bɩra ŋmoo korunu-la Manasɛ fa sɩ saa bil Wɩa dɩa kaalɩsɩŋ balɩa-la lɛ. Ʋ ŋmoo ba kala yɛrɛ muno muno a paa yuo hɛ Kɩdɩrɔŋ fuonaaŋ lɛ. 13Kuoro Josaaya fa bɩra chei vesiŋ dɩ-kpaarɩa-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, a hɛ dundolo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Cheeriŋ Dundolo wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, lere-la Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Solomoŋ fa sɩ saa a pɩ Sɩdɔŋ tɩŋŋaa veŋ-bɔŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩtɔrɛf, arɩ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa veŋ-bɔŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Chɛmɔs arɩ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa veŋ-bɔŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɔlɛk. 14Ʋ ŋmoo tabɩa-la ba sɩ bile a kpʋkpaarɛ yɛrɛ aŋ keri Asɩra daa-la ma lo, aŋ chʋŋ nuhuobiine haŋgbelee kʋ su lee-la kala.
15Kuoro Josaaya fa bɩra chei koru-la sɩ hɛ Bɛtɛl lɛ arɩ vesiŋ dɩ-kpaarɩ-la Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam sɩ saa, nɩɩ-la sɩ leŋe Iziral tɩŋŋaa jʋʋ wʋbɔmʋŋ. Koru-la arɩ vesi-la dɩ-kpaarɩŋ kala nɛ ʋ ŋmoo lo aŋ nyɩgɛ vʋɩyaa dɩ-kpaarɩŋ a nɔŋ ba kala ba nagɛ munuŋ aŋ nyɩgɛ Asɩra daa-la ma. 16Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Josaaya bene golli a na vaamaa dundolo nyuŋ. Ʋ mʋ chaarɛ haŋgbelee a kaa mʋ nyɩgɛ koru-la nyuŋ a ŋaa koru-la kɛŋ disiniŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA wʋlaabʋlla fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.
17Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro bɩra na vaamɩŋ dɔŋɔ ma a pɩɛsɛ, “Kʋbɛɛ vaamɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ taŋ-la nɩaa bʋla pʋ, “Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la fa sɩ lɩɩ Juda, ʋ vaamɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ nɛ fa bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa a tɩgɛ Bɛtɛl koru-la lɛ.”
18Kuoro Josaaya bʋl, “Má leŋ vaaŋ-la-na. Má sɩ́ ʋ haŋgbelee chaarʋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba leŋ ʋ haŋgbelee a pɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la fa sɩ lɩɩ Samarɩa kɔ haŋgbelee lɛ.
19Vesiŋ dɩ-kpaarɩa-la kala Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro fa sɩ saa Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, Josaaya fa chei ba kala nɛ arɩ ʋ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛtɛl lɛ. 20Josaaya fa kpʋ veŋ-kpaara-la kala ba veŋ-kpaarɛ korunu-la nyuŋ nɛ, a nyɩgɛ nuhuobiine haŋgbelee korunu-la kʋŋkala nyuŋ, aŋ mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm.
21Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Josaaya bʋla pɩ Juda tinteeŋ nɩaa, “Má gbieli La TƖƖNA dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele-la arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa wombiee teŋ-la tʋɔŋ.” 22Iziral tinteeŋ koo Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo kʋŋkala ha bɩ gbiele deeŋ gbiele a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ wajɩaba fa sɩɩ beŋ Iziral tinteeŋ a kaa kɔ tapʋlɩɩ-la. 23Ama kuoro Josaaya fa sɩ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ, ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ chori lɛ nɛ, ba gbieli La TƖƖNA dɩɩsɩŋ kiele bal gbiele deeŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ.
24Josaaya fa paala kiri vʋgʋraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɩrɛ kantɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, a chei vesiŋ arɩ tɔŋŋɔɔ kala Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm tinteeŋ kala lɛ, ka dɩ ba wuo kɛŋ Wɩa wombie-la ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa hɛ teŋ-la lɛ kaa tɩŋ, teŋ-la Hɩlɩkaaya, nɩɩ-la fa sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ sɩ gbille na Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. 25Kuoro-la kala sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ dii kuoruŋ Josaaya lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ to ʋ harɩŋ a dii, ba kʋŋkala fa bɩ Josaaya naga. Ʋ fa to La TƖƖNA nɛ arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ doluŋ arɩ ʋ wɩɩ wɩɩkala, a to wɩalɩŋ kala Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto.
26Ama La TƖƖNA fa ha na baanɩŋ nɛ woruŋ Juda nɩaa nyuŋ, a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la Manasɛ sɩ ŋaa a leŋ ʋ baanɩŋ sii. 27Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Mɩ jaŋ kiri Juda tɩŋŋaa ta mɩ sɩpaaŋ arɩ mɩ fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kiri Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta ŋɩɩ. Mɩ jaŋ vɩa Jerusalɛm, taŋ-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa arɩ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la mɩ sɩ sɩ ba chʋchʋɔlɛmɛ nɩmɛ.” 28Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Josaaya sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. 29Bʋa-la lɛ Josaaya fa sɩ ŋaa kuoro, Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro Neko fa kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo mʋ Yufireti fuo-la dɩ ʋ pɛ Asiiria kuoro lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josaaya arɩ laalɩyuoroo ma mʋ chemba ba yuo laalɩŋ, ama ba kpʋ Josaaya Mɛgɩdɔ lɛ. 30Ŋɩɩ nɛ Josaaya tɩntɩnnaa joŋ ʋ kʋsʋʋŋ hɛ laalɩŋ jaaba toruko lɛ a lɩɩ Mɛgɩdɔ a kaa kɔ Jerusalɛm. Ba joŋu hugi ʋ tɩtɩa bʋa lɛ. Aŋ ka Juda taŋ-la nɩaa lɩɩsɛ ʋ nanʋala Jehuahas a ŋaa nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ ʋ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyɩmma nyuŋ lɛ.
Jehuahas dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ
31Jehuahas fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ batori nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba chɛnsɩŋ batori nɛ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɛ nɛ fa Hamʋtal, Jɛrɩmaaya tolo. Ʋ fa lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lɩbɩna nɛ. 32Jehuahas ma fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ arɩ ʋ naabalɩmaba fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. 33Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Neko kɛŋ kuoro Jehuahas kaa tɔɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hamaf a hɛ Siiria tinteeŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ wuo beŋ Jerusalɛm. Ʋ keri chɩmɩŋ warɩpʋla bʋɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ arɩ sɛlɩmɛ ma yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo mara arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ a pɩ Juda tinteeŋ nɩaa. 34Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro Neko leŋ Josaaya nanʋala Ɛlɩakɩm dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyɩmma nyuŋ lɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ a yɩyɩrʋ Jehoyakim. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro kɛŋ Jehuahas kaa mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ ʋ sʋʋ nɩmɛ. 35Jehoyakim ŋaa nɩalɩŋ chɛ warɩpʋla-la arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la ʋ laa tiŋ chɩŋ-la Neko fa sɩ keri pɩba. Ʋ fa laa kɩalɩŋ a magɛ nʋʋkala dʋa sɩ maga ŋɩɩ nɛ.
Jehoyakim dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ
36Jehoyakim fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ banɔŋ nɛ aŋ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ kʋbala nɛ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Zebida, Pedaaya tolo. Ʋ lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ruma nɛ. 37Ʋ fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, arɩ ʋ naabalɩmaba fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.

Title: 2 KUOROO 24
Content:
1Jehoyakim kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza kʋ yuo dii Juda tinteeŋ a kɛŋ Jehoyakim a fʋgʋ hɛ ʋ tou jɩsɩŋ batori. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ vɩa Nebukadineza harɩŋ tonuŋ. 2Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa, Siiria tɩŋŋaa, Mʋab tɩŋŋaa arɩ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa kʋ yuo a chei Juda tinteeŋ, arɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ to ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ a bʋl ŋɩɩ. 3La TƖƖNA nɛ leŋe wɩalɩŋ ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ nɩaa lɛ, dɩ ʋ kiriba ta ʋ sɩpaaŋ a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la kuoro Manasɛ fa sɩ ŋaa wɩaa, 4a wasa nyaŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye, aŋ ka Manasɛ kpʋba. La TƖƖNA fa bɩ cho dɩ ʋ joŋ wɩɩ-la chɛʋ.
5Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Jehoyakim fa sɩ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ a ŋaa, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Juda tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. 6Jehoyakim sʋʋ, aŋ ka ʋ nanʋala Jehoyachiŋ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.
7Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro Neko arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo bɩra bɩ ba tinteeŋ lɛ lɩa dɩ ʋ yuo Juda tinteeŋ nɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa Babɩlɔŋ kuoro fa laa Ijipiti tinteeŋ kala nɛ, a chɩŋ fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Yufireti a kaa mʋ yi Ijipiti tinteeŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa bʋa.
Jehoyachiŋ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ
8Jehoyachiŋ fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ chori nɛ aŋ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba chɛnsɩŋ batori. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Nehusita. Nehusita fa ŋaa Elinataŋ tolo nɛ a lɩɩ Jerusalɛm. 9Ʋ fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, arɩ ʋ nyɩmma fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. 10Jehoyachiŋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ bɩ diene, ka Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza leŋ laalɩyuoroo mʋ golli Jerusalɛm chu. 11Bʋa-la lɛ ba fa sɩ golli Jerusalɛm chu a yuyuou, kuoro Nebukadineza ma tɩtɩa kɔ lee-la nɛ. 12Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Jehoyachiŋ, ʋ naaŋ, ʋ tɩntɩnnaa, ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, sɛɩ pɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro. Nebukadineza sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ chori lɛ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ Jehoyachiŋ ʋ ŋaa dansarɩka. 13Nebukadineza sii paa kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ kuoru dɩa lɛ, a pɛ sɛlɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ kala Solomoŋ fa sɩ ŋaa bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ. 14Nebukadineza fa kɛsɛ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala nɛ kaa mʋ ba ŋaa ʋ yosi, tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Nɩalɩŋ kala ʋ fa sɩ kɛsɛ ŋaa bʋɩ fii nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ dʋndʋŋa nɛ fa ka Jerusalɛm lɛ.
15Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nebukadineza yuo kɛŋ Jehoyachiŋ a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ a pɛ kɛŋ ʋ naaŋ, ʋ haalaa, tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ Juda tinteeŋ sɩpaalaaraa kala. 16Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza fa pɛ kɛsɛ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ balɩpɛ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ bʋɩ, a pɛ libiree lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kala fa ŋaa nɩduoruŋ nɛ a magɛ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ.
17Ŋɩɩ nɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro leŋ Jehoyachiŋ nyɩmma kʋbie ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mataanɩa dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ a yɩyɩrʋ Zedikaaya.
Zedikaaya dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ
18Zedikaaya fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ kʋbala nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ kʋbala nɛ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Hamʋtal, Jɛrɩmaaya tolo, a lɩɩ Lɩbɩna. 19Ʋ fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ, arɩ Jehoyakim fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. 20La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ fa chaasa sii Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda tinteeŋ nɩaa nyuŋ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, ʋ vɩaba ta. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ dɩ Zedikaaya vɩa Babɩlɔŋ kuoro niiŋ.

Title: 2 KUOROO 25
Content:
Jerusalɛm tele
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zedikaaya vɩa Babɩlɔŋ kuoro niiŋ. Ʋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ nibi, chɛŋ fii, tapʋl fii lɛ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza sii kɛsɛ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala ba kʋ yuo Jerusalɛm. Ba fa ŋmoo buguŋ taŋ-la harɩŋ nɛ aŋ saa vaŋkumba a golli tabal-la jebiiŋ ba sɩ jaŋ to jʋʋ tabal-la tʋɔŋ. 2Ba tɔ taŋ-la nɩaa hɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi Zedikaaya kuoruŋ jɩ-fii arɩ kʋbala lɛ. 3Chɛŋ-nɛsɛ tʋɔŋ tapʋl nibi lɛ, losuŋ faasa jʋʋ tabal-la woruŋ, kʋdiilii kala tuo dɩ ba dii. 4Ŋɩɩ nɛ Babɩlɔŋ laalɩyuoro-la ŋmoo taŋ-la kɛrɛ lo. Zedikaaya arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo sii tɩtaŋɩŋ a fá to boi-baal-la sɩ hɛ kɛrɩsɩŋ balɩa pɛgɛ a kpagɛ kuoro ŋmaŋkaaŋ a lɩɩ, arɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ fa sɩ golli tabal-la ma kala. Ba fá to Jɔdaŋ fuo-la dɩɩrɩŋ a mʋ. 5Ama Babɩlɔŋ laalɩyuoro-la kire to ba harɩŋ, a mʋ puuba Jeriko tintee-taalɩ-la lɛ, Zedikaaya laalɩyuoroo kala fá pɩsɛ aŋ kaʋ. 6Ba kɛnʋ kaa mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rɩbɩla, Nebukadineza diiu sarɩya, a joŋ cheeriŋ pʋ. 7Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kpʋ Zedikaaya hambolibiisiŋ kala ʋ sɩɩŋ lɛ, aŋ kɔrɩgɔ chaarɛ ʋ tɩtɩa sɩaa aŋ hɛʋ chɔrʋmɔɔ a lɛrʋ kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ.
8Nebukadineza sɩ dii kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ nibi, chɛŋ nɔŋ, tapʋl-pɛɩ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Nebuzaradaŋ sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoro nɩhɩaŋ, aŋ pɛ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ kɔ Jerusalɛm. 9Ʋ sɩ kɔ, ʋ nyɩgɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la, kuoru dɩa arɩ Jerusalɛm dɩɩsɩŋ kala. Dɩɩ-nyuŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ ʋ nyɩgɛ. 10Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nebuzaradaŋ leŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋmoo kɛrɛ-la ba fa sɩ saa golli Jerusalɛm a lo. 11Nebuzaradaŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ kuoro nɩhɩaŋ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ka Jerusalɛm lɛ, a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga a pɛ nɩalɩŋ Nebukadineza fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kɛsɛ mʋ lɛ. 12Ama Nebuzaradaŋ leŋ summo-la dɔnsʋŋ nɛ dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ lɛ arɩ bagɩsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ lɛ. 13Babɩlɔŋ laalɩyuoro-la ŋmoo kɔlɩɩŋ jebie-la sɩ chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩpaaŋ giri, a yɛrɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ libi ba nagɛ torukoba a kɛŋ naasɩŋ a vɩvɛŋ, a pɛ kɔlɩɩŋ taasɩ-gbaŋ-gugulii-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ mʋga lɛ. Ba sɩ yɛrɛ kɩalɩŋ, ba paa kɔlɩɩ-la kala a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ. 14Ba fa pɛ paa kɩaa deemba ma kaa viiri nɛ: Puposuŋ, safʋlba, kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa wasɛ chaaŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ tɩta, gbansɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kala ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa a kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. 15Nebuzaradaŋ fa pɛ paa kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ koo hɔpʋla kaa ŋaa nɛ, kʋmɩsɩrɩ gbansɩŋ arɩ nyiniŋ hɛntɛrɛɛ. 16Kɔlɩɩ-la Solomoŋ fa sɩ kaa libi jebie-la balɩa sɩ chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩpaaŋ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ torukoba a kɛŋ naasɩŋ a vɩvɛŋ arɩ taasɩ-gbaŋ-gugulii-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ mʋga, ba fa yʋga kɩɩ magɩsɩŋ nɛ. 17Kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ libi ba nagɛ jebiee, ba kala fa nagɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Ba kʋŋkala leŋiŋ fa ŋaa naakieliŋ chori nɛ. Kɔlɩɩŋ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ sagɛ jebie-la nyuŋ a nagɛ nyunchuuluŋ, ba leŋiŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ, ba kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ kampoi nɛnɛɛ a kpɩɛra golli.
18Nebuzaradaŋ fa pɛ kɛsɛ Sɛraaya sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ nɛ arɩ Zefanaaya ma sɩɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ batori sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boyee. 19Nɩalɩŋ ha sɩ ka tabal-la lɛ, ʋ kɛsɛ nɩhɩaŋ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo arɩ nɩaa banɔŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlɛ kuoro. Ʋ fa kɛŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la ma sɩɩ dɩɩsɛ tintee-la nɩaa nɛ, a pɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔnsʋŋ mahɩŋ batori sɩ hɛ tabal-la lɛ. 20Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ kuoro nɩhɩaŋ Nebuzaradaŋ kɛsɛ ba kala a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro teeŋ Rɩbɩla lɛ. 21Rɩbɩla tinteeŋ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hamaf lɛ nɛ kuoro leŋ ba kpʋba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda nɩaa mʋ yoŋ-baga a kagɛ ba tinteeŋ lɛ.
22Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nebukadineza lɩɩsɛ Ahɩkam nanʋala Gedalia sɩ ŋaa Safaŋ nihiŋ dɩ ʋ bibeŋ nɩkaana-la fa sɩ ka Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. 23Juda tinteeŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ba nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ nɩa arɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro lɩɩsɛ Gedalia nɛ dɩ ʋ bibemba, ba sii kɔ ʋ teeŋ Mɩzɩpa lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɔ yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la: Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl, Karɩa nanʋala Johanaŋ, Tanhʋmɛf nanʋala Sɛraaya sɩ ŋaa Netofa tɩɩna, Jaazanɩa sɩ ŋaa Maaka tɩɩna arɩ ba nɩaa. 24Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gedalia ŋmɩɛsa pɩ ba dɩ ba nɩaa a bʋl, “Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a tɩŋ Babɩlɔŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la wɩaa. Má hɔŋ Juda tintee-la lɛ a to Babɩlɔŋ kuoro niiŋ, wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ pɩma.” 25Chɛŋ-pɛɩ lɛ nɛ Nɛtanɩa nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl, sɩ ŋaa Ɛlɩsama nihiŋ a ŋaa kuoro doho nʋʋ kɛsɛ baalaa fii ba kɔ Mɩzɩpa, a kpʋ Gedalia arɩ Juda nɩaa arɩ Babɩlɔŋ tɩmma-la kala fa sɩ hɛ ʋ teeŋ. 26Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Mɩzɩpa lɛ, nɩbiisiŋ arɩ nɩbalaa kala, a tɩŋ Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa wɩaa. Ba lɩɩ fá mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ.
Ba lɩɩsɛ Jehoyachiŋ bɩnɩŋ dɩa lɛ
27Ba fa sɩ kɛŋ Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Jehoyachiŋ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ baal kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Evil-Merodak kʋ dii Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, a leŋ ba lɩɩsɛ Jehoyachiŋ bɩnɩŋ dɩa lɛ chɛŋ fii arɩ balɩa tapʋlaa mara arɩ balɩpɛ chɛɛŋ. 28Evil-Merodak fa kɛŋ Jehoyachiŋ nɛ woruŋ, a pʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ a kɩɩ kuorusu-la dɔnsʋŋ kala ba fa sɩ kɛsɛ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa Babɩlɔŋ lɛ. 29Kuoro fa leŋe Jehoyachiŋ wuri ʋ dansarɩka gɛnnɩŋ ta nɛ aŋ lɩlaalɛ ʋ tɩtɩa gɛnnɩŋ, a didii kɩaa kuoro dɩa lɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala. 30Tapʋlɩɩ kala Babɩlɔŋ kuoro yie pɩ Jehoyachiŋ moribiee nɛ, bʋa-la kala ʋ sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ.

Title: 1 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 1
Content:
Adam doho nɩaa a kaa mʋ yi Abɩraham lɛ
1Adam doho nɩaa nɛ fa Sɛf, Ɛnɔs, 2Kenaŋ, Mahalalɛl, Jarɛd, 3Ɛnɔk, Mɛtʋsɛla, Lamɛk arɩ Nowa. 4Nowa hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Sɛm, Ham arɩ Jafɛf.
Jafɛf doho nɩaa
5Jafɛf ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ fa ŋaa: Goma, Magɔg, Madaɩ, Javaŋ, Tubal, Mɛsɛk arɩ Tɩras. 6Goma ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ fa ŋaa: Asɩkɛnas, Rɩfaf arɩ Togaama. 7Javaŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ fa ŋaa: Ɛlɩsa, Taasɩs, Kɩtɩm arɩ Rodanim.
Ham doho nɩaa
8Ham ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Kus, Mizirem, Puti arɩ Kɛnaŋ. 9Kus ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ fa ŋaa: Sɛba, Havɩla, Sabɩta, Raama arɩ Sabɩtɛka. Raama ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Sɛɛba arɩ Dɛdaŋ. 10Kus nɛ lʋl Nɩmɩrɔd, ʋ sii waa a ŋaa laalɩyuori-duo dʋnɩa lɛ. 11Mizirem doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Lud tɩŋŋaa, Anam tɩŋŋaa, Lɛhab tɩŋŋaa, Nafituhi tɩŋŋaa, 12Pafurusi tɩŋŋaa, Kasilu tɩŋŋaa arɩ Kafɩtɔ tɩŋŋaa. Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa lɩɩ nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ nɛ. 13Kɛnaŋ nɛ lʋl Sɩdɔŋ, ʋ bii-hɩaŋ, Hiti tɩŋŋaa, 14Jebus tɩŋŋaa, Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Gɩgasɩ tɩŋŋaa, 15Hivi tɩŋŋaa, Akɩ tɩŋŋaa, Sini tɩŋŋaa, 16Avad tɩŋŋaa, Zɛma tɩŋŋaa, arɩ Hama tɩŋŋaa.
Sɛm doho nɩaa
17Sɛm hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ɛlam, Asu, Afaza, Lud arɩ Aram. Aram ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Yus, Hul, Gɛda arɩ Mɛsɛk. 18Afaza nɛ lʋl Sɛla, ʋ ma sii lʋl Ɛbɛ. 19Ɛbɛ ma lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ, dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Pɛlɛg. Bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lʋl Pɛlɛg nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa suomo pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a hɔŋ hɔŋ leree. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba hɛ yɩrɩ-la pʋ. Ʋ yɩrɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ “pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ.” Pɛlɛg ŋaana ma yɩrɩŋ nɛ Jɔkɩtaŋ. 20Jɔkɩtaŋ ma nɛ lʋl Alɩmɔdad, Sɛlɛf, Hazaamavɛf, Jɛra, 21Hadɔra, Uzal, Dɩkɩla 22arɩ Obal, Abɩmɛl, Sɛba, 23arɩ Ofi, Havɩla arɩ Jobab. Ba kala ŋaa Jɔkɩtaŋ biiriŋ nɛ.
Sɛm doho nɩaa a kaa mʋ yi Abɩraham lɛ
24Sɛm, Aafaza, Sɛla, 25Ɛbɛ, Pɛlɛg, Rɛʋ, 26Sɛrʋg, Nahɔ, Tɛra 27arɩ Abɩram (Abɩraham nɛ ŋɩɩ).
Abɩraham dɩa nɩaa
28Abɩraham hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Aɩzɩk arɩ Ɩsɩmɛl. 29Ba doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Ɩsɩmɛl bii-hɩaŋ nɛ Nɛbayɔf, Kɛda, Adɩbɛɛl, Mibisam, 30Mɩsɩma, Duma, Masa, Hadad, Tɛma, 31Jetuu, Nafɩs arɩ Kɛdɛma. Ɩsɩmɛl hambolibiisiŋ yɩraa nɛ ŋɩɩ.
Ketura hambolibiisiŋ
32Abɩraham sɩ bil haal-la aŋ bɩ jaa, baa yɩrɛ Ketura. Ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Zimiraŋ, Jokisaŋ, Mɛdaŋ, Midiaŋ, Ɩsɩbak arɩ Sʋa. Jokisaŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Sɛba arɩ Dɛdaŋ. 33Midiaŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ɛfa, Ɛfɛ, Hanɔk, Abɩda arɩ Ɛlɩdaa. Nɩaa deemba kala ŋaa Ketura doho nɩaa nɛ. 34Abɩraham bie Aɩzɩk ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Ɛsɔ arɩ Iziral. 35Ɛsɔ hambolibiisiŋ yɩraa nɛ: Ɛlɩfas, Rɛwɛl, Jeyus, Jalam arɩ Kora. 36Ɛlɩfas hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋaa: Tɛmaŋ, Omaa, Zefo, Gatam, Kɛnas arɩ Amalɛk. Amalɛk naaŋ nɛ fa Tɩmɩna. 37Rɛwɛl hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋaa: Nahaf, Zɛra, Sama arɩ Mɩza.
Sɛɛ tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Ɛdɔm lɛ
38Sɛɛ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Lotaŋ, Sobal, Zibioŋ, Ana, Dɩsɔŋ, Ɛza arɩ Disaŋ. 39Lotaŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Hori arɩ Homam. Lotaŋ dɩhaala nɛ Tɩmɩna. 40Sobal ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Alɩvaŋ, Manahaf, Ɛbal, Sefo arɩ Onam. Zibioŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Aya arɩ Ana. 41Ana nanʋala nɛ Dɩsɔŋ. Dɩsɔŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Hemidaŋ, Ɛsɩbaŋ, Ɩtɩraŋ arɩ Keraŋ. 42Ɛza hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Bilihaŋ, Zaavaŋ arɩ Akaŋ. Dɩsaŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Yus arɩ Araŋ.
Ɛdɔm kuoroo
43Kuoroo deemba nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ dii kuoruŋ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ lɛ aŋ ka pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa: Bioo nanʋala Bɛla, ʋ fa hɔŋ ba tabalɩŋ Dɩnɩhaba lɛ nɛ a dii kuoruŋ. 44Bɛla sʋʋ, ka Zɛra nanʋala Jobab sɩ lɩɩ Bozira dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. 45Jobab ma sɩ sʋba, Husam sɩ lɩɩ Tɛma tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. 46Husam ma sɩ sʋba, Bɛdad nanʋala Hadad ma nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ fa yuo dii Midiaŋ nɩaa Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ tabalɩŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Avif. 47Hadad ma sɩ sʋba, Samɩla sɩ lɩɩ Masɩrɛka nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. 48Samɩla ma sɩ sʋba, Sawʋl sɩ lɩɩ Rehobɔf a kpagɛ fuoŋ niiŋ nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. 49Sawʋl ma sɩ sʋba, Akɩbɔ nanʋala Baal-Hanaŋ ma nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. 50Baal-Hanaŋ ma sɩ sʋba, Hadad ma nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. Ʋ tabalɩŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Pɔɔ. Ʋ haala yɩrɩŋ nɛ Mɛhɛtabɛl. Mezahab tolo Matɩrɛd nɛ fa ŋaa ʋ naaŋ. 51Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hadad ma sʋʋ. Ɛdɔm kuoroo nɛ fa ŋ-la: Tɩmɩna, Alɩva, Jɛfɛf, 52Oholibama, Ɛla, Pɩnɔŋ, 53Kenas, Tɛmaŋ, Mibizaa, 54Magɩdɩɛl arɩ Ɩram. Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ kuoroo nɛ ŋɩɩ.

Title: 1 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 2
Content:
Jekɔb hambolibiisiŋ
1Jekɔb hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Rubiŋ, Simioŋ, Levi, Juda, Ɩsaka, Zebuluŋ, 2Daŋ, Josɛf, Bɛnjamɩŋ, Nafɩtalɩ, Gad arɩ Asa. 3Juda hambolibiisiŋ nɛ fa: Ɛɛ, Onaŋ arɩ Sɛla. Ʋ dɩ ʋ haala Bafɩsʋa, Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa tolo-la nɛ lʋl biiriŋ deemba batori. Juda bii-hɩaŋ Ɛɛ fa ŋaa nɩbɔŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA kpʋʋ. 4Juda arɩ ʋ bii-haala Tama ma lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ: Pɛrɛs arɩ Zɛra. Juda hambolibiisiŋ kala fa ŋaa banɔŋ nɛ.
5Pɛrɛs hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Hɛzɩrɔŋ arɩ Hamʋl. 6Zɛra hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Zimiri, Ɛtaŋ, Hemaŋ, Kalɩkɔl arɩ Daada. Ba ŋaa banɔŋ nɛ. 7Kaamɩ nanʋala nɛ Ekaŋ. Ʋ nɛ lɛrɛ wɩaa kʋ hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ sɩ vɩa nii-la ba sɩ bile aŋ paa kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ sɩ ba chei, a faa. 8Ɛtaŋ nanʋala nɛ Azarɩa.
Kuoro Devit doho nɩaa
9Hɛzɩrɔŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jɛramɛɛl, Ram arɩ Kalɩb. 10Ram nanʋala nɛ Amɩnadab. Amɩnadab ma nanʋala nɛ Nasɔŋ, ʋ fa ŋaa Juda nɩaa sɩpaalaarʋ nɛ. 11Nasɔŋ nanʋala nɛ Salɩmɔŋ. Salɩmɔŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Bʋas. 12Bʋas ma nanʋala nɛ Ɔbɛd. Ɔbɛd ma nanʋala nɛ Jesi. 13Jesi fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩpɛ nɛ. Ba nɛ ŋ-la, a chɩŋ kʋhɩaŋ lɛ a kaa tuu kʋbie: Ɛlɩab, Abɩnadab, Sɩmɩa, 14Nɛtanɛl, Radaɩ, 15Ozem arɩ Devit. 16Jesi fa kɛŋ toloo balɩa ma nɛ: Zeruya arɩ Abɩgɛl. Zeruya hambolibiisiŋ nɛ fa: Abɩsaɩ, Jʋab arɩ Asahɛl. 17Abɩgɛl bala nɛ fa Jɛta. Jɛta ŋaa Ɩsɩmɛl doho nʋʋ nɛ. Ba nanʋala yɩrɩŋ nɛ Amasa.
Hɛzɩrɔŋ doho nɩaa
18Hɛzɩrɔŋ nanʋala Kalɩb fa jaa Azuba nɛ, ba lʋl hantolibie a hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Jɛrɩɔf. Jɛrɩɔf ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jɛsa, Sobab arɩ Aadɔŋ. 19Azuba sɩ sʋba, Kalɩb mɩɩra jaa Ɛfɩraf, ba lʋl Huu. 20Huu nanʋala nɛ Uri, Uri ma nanʋala nɛ Bɛzalɛl. 21Hɛzɩrɔŋ sɩ ŋaa jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ batori, ʋ jaa Makɩɩ tolo sɩ ŋaa Gɩlɩad dɩhaala, ba lʋl Sɛgub. 22Sɛgub nanʋala nɛ fa Jaa. Ʋ faa beŋ tasɩŋ mara arɩ batori nɛ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ lɛ. 23Bʋa kʋbala lɛ, tinteye-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gesu arɩ Aram yuo dii tasɩŋ mahɩŋ batori tintee-la lɛ, a pɛ Jaa arɩ Kenaf tabiisiŋ lɛ, arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ kpagɛba. Nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ hɛ lee-la ŋaa Gɩlɩad nyɩmma Makɩɩ doho nɩaa nɛ. 24Hɛzɩrɔŋ sɩ sʋba, Kalɩb joŋ ʋ nyɩmma haala Ɛfɩraf a jaa. Ba lʋl hambolibie a hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Asihu. Ʋ nɛ suomi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛkʋa.
Jɛramɛɛl doho nɩaa
25Hɛzɩrɔŋ bii-hɩaŋ Jɛramɛɛl fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ banɔŋ nɛ: Ram, Buna, Ɔrɩŋ, Ozem arɩ Ahija. 26Jɛramɛɛl fa kɛŋ haal dɔŋ ma nɛ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Atara. Ʋ nɛ lʋl Onam. 27Jɛramɛɛl bii-hɩaŋ Ram hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Maas, Jamɩŋ arɩ Ɛka. 28Onam ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Samaɩ arɩ Jada. Samaɩ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Nadab arɩ Abisu. 29Abisu haala yɩrɩŋ nɛ Abɩhɛɛl, ʋ nɛ lʋl Abaŋ arɩ Molid. 30Nadab ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Sɛlɛd arɩ Apem. Sɛlɛd bɩ bii lʋla aŋ sʋʋ. 31Apem nanʋala nɛ Ɩsɩ, Ɩsɩ ma nanʋala nɛ Sɛsaŋ, Sɛsaŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Alaɩ. 32Samaɩ naambie Jada hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jɛta arɩ Jonataŋ. Jɛta bɩ bii lʋla aŋ sʋʋ. 33Jonataŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Pɛlɛf arɩ Zaza. Nɩaa deemba kala fa ŋaa Jɛramɛɛl doho nɩaa nɛ. 34Sɛsaŋ fa bɩ hambolibie lʋla, toloo dʋndʋŋ nɛ ʋ lʋl. Ʋ fa kɛŋ yomo nɛ sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, baa yɩrɛ Jaaha. 35Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sɛsaŋ joŋ ʋ tolo pɩ ʋ yoŋ-la ʋ kaa lʋl Ataɩ. 36Ataɩ nanʋala nɛ Netaŋ, Netaŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Zabad. 37Zabad ma nanʋala nɛ Ɛfɩlal, Ɛfɩlal ma nanʋala nɛ Ɔbɛd, 38Ɔbɛd ma nanʋala nɛ Jehu, Jehu ma nanʋala nɛ Azarɩa, 39Azarɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Hɛlɛs, Hɛlɛs ma nanʋala nɛ Ɛlɩasa, 40Ɛlɩasa ma nanʋala nɛ Sɩsɩmaɩ, Sɩsɩmaɩ ma nanʋala nɛ Salum, 41Salum ma nanʋala nɛ Jɛkamaaya, Jɛkamaaya ma nanʋala nɛ Ɛlɩsama.
Kalɩb doho nɩaa
42Jɛramɛɛl naambie Kalɩb hambolibii-hɩaŋ nɛ Mɛsa. Mɛsa nanʋala nɛ Zɩf, Zɩf ma nanʋala nɛ Marɛsa, Marɛsa ma nanʋala nɛ Hɛbʋrɔŋ. 43Hɛbʋrɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Kora, Tapʋa, Rɛkɛm arɩ Sɛma. 44Sɛma ma nanʋala nɛ Raham, Raham ma nanʋala nɛ Jɔkɩam. Rɛkɛm ma nanʋala nɛ Samaɩ. 45Samaɩ nanʋala nɛ Mayɔŋ. Mayɔŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Bɛf Zuu. 46Kalɩb sɩ bil haal-la aŋ bɩ jaa baa yɩrɛ Ɛfa, ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Haraŋ, Moza arɩ Gazɛs. Haraŋ ma nanʋala yɩrɩŋ nɛ Gazɛs. 47Jadaɩ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Regem, Jotam, Gesaŋ, Pɛlɛt, Ɛfa arɩ Saaf. 48Kalɩb haal-la dɔŋɔ ma ʋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa baa yɩrɛ Maaka, ʋ nɛ lʋl Sɛba arɩ Tɩɩhana. 49Ʋ nɛ ha lʋl Saaf, Saaf ma lʋl Madɩmana. Ʋ nanʋala dɔŋɔ ma nɛ Sɛva. Sɛva ma lʋl Makɩbɛna arɩ Gɩbɩa. Kalɩb tolo nɛ fa Akɩsa. 50Kalɩb doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Huu nɛ fa ŋaa Kalɩb arɩ ʋ haala Ɛfɩraf bii-hɩaŋ. Huu hambolibiisiŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ Sobal, ʋ nɛ suomi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɩrɩaf Jɩarɩm. 51Dɔŋɔ ma nɛ Salɩma, ʋ ma nɛ suomi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm. Dɔŋɔ ma nɛ Harɛf, ʋ ma nɛ suomi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf Gada. 52Sobal, nɩɩ-la sɩ suomi Kɩrɩaf Jɩarɩm doho nɩaa nɛ: Harɔɩ arɩ Manaha tɩŋŋaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, 53arɩ Kɩrɩaf Jɩarɩm nyɩŋ-nɩaa deemba: Ɩtɩrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Puti tɩŋŋaa, Suma tɩŋŋaa arɩ Mɩsɩra tɩŋŋaa. Nɩaa deemba lɛ nɛ Zɔra tɩŋŋaa arɩ Ɛsɩtɔl tɩŋŋaa kala lɩɩ. 54Salɩma ma doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Bɛtɩlɛhɛm tɩŋŋaa, Netofa tɩŋŋaa, Atɩrɔf Bɛf Jʋab tɩŋŋaa, arɩ Manaha tɩŋŋaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, Zori tɩŋŋaa, 55arɩ kerichiba sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ doho nɩaa sɩ hɛ Jabɛs tinteeŋ lɛ: Tɩra tɩŋŋaa, Sɩmɩa tɩŋŋaa arɩ Suka tɩŋŋaa. Nɩaa deemba ŋaa Keni tɩŋŋaa nɛ, Hamaf doho nɩaa. Hamaf nɛ fa ŋaa Rekab tɩŋŋaa naabalɩma.

Title: 1 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 3
Content:
Kuoro Devit doho nɩaa
1Hambolibiisi-la Devit sɩ lʋla Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
Ʋ bii-hɩaŋ nɛ Amɩnɔŋ. Amɩnɔŋ naaŋ nɛ Ahɩnʋam a lɩɩ Jɛzɩrɛl. Devit bii-lɩa nɛ Danɩɛl. Danɩɛl ma naaŋ nɛ Abɩgɛl a lɩɩ Kamɛl. 2Ʋ bii-tori nɛ ŋaa Abɩsalɔm. Abɩsalɔm ma naaŋ nɛ Maaka. Maaka nyɩmma nɛ Talɩmaɩ. Talɩmaɩ nɛ ŋaa Gesu tɩŋŋaa kuoro. Devit bii-nɛsɛ nɛ Adonija, ʋ naaŋ nɛ Hagɩf. 3Devit bii-nɔŋ nɛ Sɛfatɩa, ʋ naaŋ nɛ Abɩtal. Ʋ bii-dʋ ma nɛ Ɩtɩrɩm. Ɩtɩrɩm ma naaŋ nɛ Ɛgɩla. 4Devit lʋl ʋ biiriŋ deemba kala balɩdʋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ nɛ, lee-la ʋ fa sɩ dii kuoruŋ a hɔŋ jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ arɩ chɛnsɩŋ balɩdʋ.
Devit sɩ dii kuoruŋ, ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm ma lɛ jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ batori nɛ. 5Biiri-la ma ʋ sɩ lʋla nɩmɛ nɛ ŋaa:
Samʋa, Sobab, Netaŋ arɩ Solomoŋ. Nɩaa deemba banɛsɛ naaŋ nɛ Bafɩsɛba, Amɩɛl tolo. 6Devit hambolibiisiŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ ha: Ɩbɩha, Ɛlɩsʋa, Ɛlɩfɛlɛt, 7Noga, Nɛfɛg, Jafɩa, 8Ɛlɩsama, Ɛlɩada arɩ Ɛlɩfɛlɛt, ba kala ŋaa nibi nɛ. 9Devit hambolibiisiŋ nɛ nɩaa deemba kala, haala-la ʋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa hambolibiisiŋ-na bɩ pɛ. Devit fa kɛŋ tolo ma nɛ baa yɩrɛ Tama.
Kuoro Solomoŋ doho nɩaa
10Solomoŋ nanʋala nɛ Rihobuam, Rihobuam ma nanʋala nɛ Abija, Abija ma nanʋala nɛ Asa, Asa ma nanʋala nɛ Jehosafat, Jehosafat ma nanʋala nɛ 11Joram, Joram ma nanʋala nɛ Ahazɩa, Ahazɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Jʋas, Jʋas ma nanʋala nɛ 12Amazɩa, Amazɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Azarɩa, Azarɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Jotam, Jotam ma nanʋala nɛ 13Ahas, Ahas ma nanʋala nɛ Hezikaaya. Hezikaaya ma nanʋala nɛ Manasɛ. Manasɛ ma nanʋala nɛ 14Amɔŋ. Amɔŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Josaaya. 15Josaaya hambolibiisiŋ nɛ:
Johanaŋ ʋ bii-hɩaŋ,
Jehoyakim ʋ bii-lɩa,
Zedikaaya ʋ bii-tori,
Salum ʋ bii-nɛsɛ. 16Jehoyakim hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jehoyachiŋ arɩ Zedikaaya.
Kuoro Jehoyachiŋ doho nɩaa
17Jehoyachiŋ, kuoru-la ba fa sɩ yuo kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩpɛ nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ: Sɩalɩtɩɛl, 18Malɩkɩram, Pedaaya, Sɛnaza, Jɛkamaaya, Hosama, arɩ Nɛdabaaya. 19Pedaaya hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Zerubabɛl arɩ Sɩmɛɩ. Zerubabɛl ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Mɛsʋlam arɩ Hananaaya. Ba dɩhaala nɛ Sɛlɔmɩf. 20Zerubabɛl fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ banɔŋ ma nɛ: Hasuba, Ohel, Bɛrɛkɩa, Hasadɩa arɩ Jusab-Hɛsɛd. 21Hananaaya hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Pɛlatɩa arɩ Jesaaya. Jesaaya nanʋala nɛ Refaaya, Refaaya nanʋala nɛ Anaŋ, Anaŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Obadaaya. Obadaaya ma nanʋala nɛ Sɛkanɩa. 22Sɛkanɩa nanʋala nɛ Sɛmaaya, Sɛmaaya ma hambolibiisiŋ ŋaa banɔŋ nɛ: Hatus, Ɩgal, Barɩa, Nɩarɩa arɩ Safat. 23Nɩarɩa ma hambolibiisiŋ ŋaa batori nɛ: Elionai, Hizikia arɩ Azirikam. 24Elionai ma kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩpɛ nɛ: Hodavia, Ɛlɩasɩb, Pɛlaaya, Akub, Johanaŋ, Delaaya arɩ Ananɩ.

Title: 1 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 4
Content:
Juda doho nɩaa
1Juda hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Pɛrɛs, Hɛzɩrɔŋ, Kaamɩ, Huu arɩ Sobal. 2Sobal nanʋala nɛ Reeya, Reeya ma nanʋala nɛ Jahaf. Jahaf ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Ahumai arɩ Lahad. Zora nyɩŋ-nɩaa nɛ fa ŋɩɩ. 3-4Huu nɛ fa ŋaa Kalɩb haala Ɛfɩraf bii-hɩaŋ. Ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ saa tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm. Huu fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Ɛtam, Pɛnʋɛl arɩ Ɛza. Ɛtam ma kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Jɛzɩrɛl, Ɩsɩma arɩ Ɩdɩbas. Ba dɩhaala yɩrɩŋ nɛ Hazɛlɛlɩpɔnɩ.
5Asihu, nɩɩ-la sɩ saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛkʋa fa kɛŋ haalaa balɩa nɛ: Hɛla arɩ Naara.
6Ʋ dɩ Naara lʋl biiriŋ banɛsɛ nɛ: Ahuzam, Hefa, Temeni arɩ Haahasɩtarɩ.
7Asihu arɩ Hɛla ma lʋl hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ:
Zɛrɛf, Zoha arɩ Ɛtɩnaŋ. 8Anub arɩ Hazɔbɛba nyɩmma nɛ Kos, ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa Harum nanʋala Ahahɛl nyɩŋ-nɩaa naabalɩma.
9Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ baa yɩrɛ Jabɛs, ʋ fa kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ a kɩɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ kala. Ʋ naaŋ fa hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Jabɛs bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ aŋ lʋlʋ.” 10Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala Jabɛs sʋl Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, a bʋl, “Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, pɛ mɩ lɛ a leŋ dɩ mɩ tinteeŋ jalla pɛ. Pɔmɛ dɩ wʋbɔŋ kala sɩ́ mɩ jʋʋ dɩ mɩ na hɛɛŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa laa ʋ sʋla. 11Suha naambie Kelub nanʋala nɛ Mehi. Mehi ma nanʋala nɛ Ɛsɩtɔŋ. 12Ɛsɩtɔŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Bɛf Rafa, Pasɩa arɩ Tɛhɩna. Tɛhɩna nɛ saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nahas. Nɩaa deemba fa hɛ Rɛka lɛ nɛ. 13Kenas fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ, Ofiniel arɩ Sɛraaya. Ofiniel ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Hataf arɩ Mionotai. 14Mionotai nɛ saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɔfɩra. Sɛraaya ma nanʋala nɛ Jʋab, Jʋab ma nɛ saa taŋ-la nɩaa sɩ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, baa yɩrɛ Ge-Harasim.
15Jefuni nanʋala Kalɩb hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Iru, Ɛla arɩ Naam. Ɛla ma nanʋala nɛ Kenas.
16Jehalɛlɛl hambolibiisiŋ nɛ:
Zɩf, Zɩfa, Tɩrɩa arɩ Asarɛl.
17Ɛzɩra hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jɛta, Mɛrɛd, Ɛfɛ arɩ Jalɔŋ. Mɛrɛd haala Bɩtɩa sɩ ŋaa Ijipiti kuoro tolo nɛ lʋl Mɩrɩam, Samaɩ arɩ Ɩsɩba. Ɩsɩba nɛ saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛsɩtɛmʋa. 18(Ʋ haala dɔŋɔ ʋ sɩ jaa lɩɩ Juda ma lʋl hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Jɛrɛd, ʋ nɛ saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɛdɔ, Hɛba, ʋ ma nɛ saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Soko, arɩ Jɛkʋtɩɛl, ʋ ma nɛ saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zanʋa.)
19Baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hodia nɛ fa jaa Naham dɩhaala.
Ba doho nɩaa nɛ ŋaa Gaam nyɩŋ-nɩaa a hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɛɛla lɛ, arɩ Maaka nyɩŋ-nɩaa ma sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛsɩtɛmʋa lɛ.
20Sɩmɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Amɩnɔŋ, Rɩna, Bɛŋ-Hanaŋ arɩ Tiloŋ. Ɩsɩ doho nɩaa nɛ: Zɔhɛf arɩ Bɛŋ-Zɔhɛf.
21Juda nanʋala dɔŋɔ nɛ fa Sɛla. Sɛla doho nɩaa nɛ, Ɛɛ, nɩɩ-la sɩ saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lɛka, Laada, ʋ ma nɛ saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Marɛsa, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuo gɛrɩpɛ-zɔŋŋɔɔ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf-Asɩbɩa lɛ, 22dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ Jokim, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Koziba lɛ a pɛ Jʋas arɩ Saraf, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ Mʋab arɩ Jasubi Lɛhɛm tinteeŋ. (Wɩaa deemba ŋaa faafaa wɩaa nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa bil.) 23Doho deeŋ nɩaa nɛ ŋaa pupoi mɛɛrɛ-la sɩ hɛ tasɩŋ deemba lɛ: Netem arɩ Gɛdɛra. Ba hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ a tɩma pɩpɩ kuoro.
Simioŋ doho nɩaa
24Simioŋ fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ banɔŋ nɛ: Nɛmʋɛl, Jamɩŋ, Jarɩb, Zɛra arɩ Sawʋl. 25Sawʋl nanʋala nɛ Salum, Salum ma nanʋala nɛ Mibisam, Mibisam ma nanʋala nɛ Mɩsɩma. 26Mɩsɩma nanʋala nɛ Hamʋɛl, Hamʋɛl ma nanʋala nɛ Zakɔ, Zakɔ ma nanʋala nɛ Sɩmɛɩ. 27Sɩmɛɩ kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ fii arɩ balɩdʋ nɛ, toloo ma balɩdʋ. Ama ʋ naambiiriŋ-na fa bɩ biiriŋ lʋla yʋgɛ. Ŋɩɩ leŋ Simioŋ doho nɩaa bɩ yʋga magɛ Juda doho nɩaa. 28Ba fa hɔŋ tasɩŋ deemba lɛ nɛ: Bɛɛsɩba, Molada, Haza-Sʋal, 29Biliha, Ɛzɛm, Tolad, 30Bɛtʋɛl, Hɔma, Zɩkɩlag, 31Bɛf-Maakabɔf, Haza-Susim, Bɛf-Biri arɩ Saarem. Ba tasɩŋ nɛ fa ŋɩɩ a kʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Devit sɩ dii kuoruŋ. 32Ba fa hɔŋ tabiisiŋ deemba banɔŋ ma lɛ nɛ: Ɛtam, Ayɩŋ, Rimoŋ, Tɔkɛŋ arɩ Asaŋ, 33arɩ tabiisi-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ golliba a kaa mʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baalaf. Lere-la Simioŋ doho nɩaa sɩ hɔnɔ hɔnɔ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Nʋʋkala arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa dɩhɔnʋŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil nɛ ŋɩɩ. 34Baalaa deemba nɛ fa ŋaa ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa: Mɛsobab, Jamɩlɛk, Amazɩa nanʋala Josa, 35Jowɛl, Asɩɛl nanʋala Sɛraaya sɩ lʋl Josibia, ʋ ma nanʋala Jehu, 36arɩ Elionai, Jaakoba, Jesohaaya, Asaaya, Adɩɛl, Jɛsɩmɩɛl, Bɛnaaya, 37arɩ Ziza. Ʋ nyɩmma nɛ Sifi, Alɔŋ nanʋala. Alɔŋ ma nyɩmma nɛ Jedaaya, Jedaaya ma nyɩmma nɛ Sɩmɩrɩ, Sɛmaaya nanʋala.
38Ba sɩpaalaaraa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba dɩa dɩa nɩaa fa pʋŋa nɛ woruŋ. 39Ba fa sɩɩ chɛ yaŋ dɩ ba pɩ ba pʋsʋŋ, ba vɛŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ mʋ yi fuonaa-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɛdɔ. 40Nɩmɛ nɛ ba na pʋsʋŋ ya-zɔmʋŋ, tintee-la ma jal woruŋ, a fɩɛla pɩŋ sɔm, wʋwalɩmɩɩ ma kala tuo. Ham tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ fa hɔŋ lee-la aŋ ka.
41Ama Hezikaaya sɩ kʋ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, Simioŋ doho nɩalɩŋ yɩraa la sɩ daga mʋ yuo kiri Ham tɩŋŋaa arɩ Mɩʋŋ tɩŋŋaa ta tintee-la lɛ aŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ, a tɩŋ lee-la sɩ kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ ya-diiliŋ. 42Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ baalaa zɔɔ-banɔŋ lɩɩ Simioŋ doho nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ a mʋ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ. Ɩsɩ hambolibiisiŋ deemba nɛ fa laa ba sɩpaaŋ: Pɛlatɩa, Nɩarɩa, Refaaya arɩ Ʋzɩɛl. 43Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ kpʋ Amalɛk nɩkaana-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, aŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ.

Title: 1 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 5
Content:
Rubiŋ doho nɩaa
1Rubiŋ nɛ fa ŋaa Jekɔb bii-hɩaŋ, ama ʋ bɩ wuo dii hɩasɩŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ ʋ nyɩmma haala pɩŋ, ŋɩɩ leŋ ba joŋ hɩasɩŋ mɩɩra pɩ Josɛf. 2Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala Juda doho nɩaa nɛ ha wuo kɛŋ doluŋ a lɩɩsɛ sɩpaalaara ʋ bibeŋ ba doho doho-la kala. 3Jekɔb bii-hɩaŋ Rubiŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Hanɔk, Pallu, Hɛzɩrɔŋ arɩ Kaamɩ. 4Jowɛl doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Sɛmaaya, Gɔg, Sɩmɛ, 5Mɩka, Reeya, Baal 6arɩ Bɛɛra, nɩɩ-la Asiiria kuoro Tɩgɩlaf-Pɩlɩsa sɩ yuo dii a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga. Bɛɛra fa ŋaa Rubiŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaarʋ nɛ. 7Ba dɩa wɩaa ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil daga arɩ Rubiŋ doho nyɩŋ-nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa nɛ ŋ-la: Jɛyɛl, Zɛkarɩya, 8arɩ Azas nanʋala Bɛla sɩ ŋaa Sɛma nihiŋ a ŋaa Jowɛl nyɩŋ-nʋʋ. Ba fa hɔnɔ kpagɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Arowa nɛ, a kaa mʋ yi tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nebo arɩ Baal Mioŋ. 9Ba pʋsʋŋ fa yʋga Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba hɔŋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Yufireti fuo-la. 10Sɔɔl kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ, Rubiŋ doho nɩaa mʋ yuo dii Hagi tɩŋŋaa, aŋ laa ba tintee-la kala sɩ hɛ Gɩlɩad wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a hɔŋ.
Gad doho nɩaa
11Gad doho nɩaa ma nɛ fa hɔnɔ kpagɛba lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Basaŋ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Salɛka. 12Jowɛl nɛ fa ŋaa ba sɩpaalaaraa Basaŋ lɛ, Safam tɩtɩgɛ, a saa pɛ Janaɩ arɩ Safat lɛ. 13Ba naambiiriŋ nɛ: Maakɩl, Mɛsʋlam, Sɛba, Jorai, Jakaŋ, Zɩa arɩ Ɛba, ba kala fa ŋaa balɩpɛ nɛ. 14Ba kala fa ŋaa Huri nanʋala Abɩhɛɛl doho nɩaa nɛ. Huri nyɩmma nɛ Jarʋa. Jarʋa ma nyɩmma nɛ Gɩlɩad, Gɩlɩad ma nyɩmma nɛ Maakɩl, Maakɩl ma nyɩmma nɛ Jɛsɩsaɩ, Jɛsɩsaɩ ma nyɩmma nɛ Jado, Jado ma nyɩmma nɛ Bus. 15Guni nanʋala Abɩdɩɛl ma nanʋala Ahi nɛ fa ŋaa ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa kʋhɩaŋ. 16Gad doho nɩaa fa hɔŋ Basaŋ arɩ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ tabiisiŋ lɛ nɛ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Sarɔŋ tinteeŋ pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diiliŋ.
17Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ba doho wɩaa deemba kala a bil nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ Jotam sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, arɩ bʋa-la lɛ Jerobuam sɩ dii Iziral tinteeŋ kuoruŋ.
18Rubiŋ doho nɩaa, Gad doho nɩaa arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, ba kala fa kɛŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ banɛsɛ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩpɛ arɩ mahɩŋ batori nɛ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ. Ba fa ŋaa laalɩyuoroo ba sɩ daga ba jɩŋ hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ, tokobiee arɩ tosuŋ kaa yuo laalɩŋ nɛ. 19Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba mʋ yuo Hagi, Jɛtɔ, Nafɩs arɩ Nodab tɩŋŋaa. 20Laalɩyuoroo deemba sɩ mʋa dɩ ba yuo Hagi tɩŋŋaa, ba joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ Wɩa lɛ nɛ a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba wuo yuo dii Hagi tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ pɛ ba lɛ. 21Ba wuo yuo diiba, aŋ kɛsɛ ba bʋntaŋŋaba bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, piesee bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩa mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, kakusuŋ ma bʋɩ balɩa arɩ nɩaa bʋɩ zɔlɔ. 22Hagi tɩŋŋaa jesiŋ kala sʋʋ laal-la lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa faa yuoba nɛ. Rubiŋ doho, Gad doho arɩ Manasɛ doho kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la nɩaa fa hɔŋ lee-la nɛ a kaa kɔ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kɛsɛba kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga Asiiria tinteeŋ lɛ.
Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ
23Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la fa sɩ hɔŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ fa yʋga nɛ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɔŋ Basaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Baal Hɛmɔŋ tinteeŋ, Sɛnɩ arɩ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛmɔŋ. 24Ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa nɛ: Ɛfɛ, Ɩsɩ, Ɛlɩɛl, Azɩrɩɛl, Jɛrɩmaaya, Hodavia arɩ Jadɩɛl. Ba fa ŋaa laalɩyuori-duori nɛ, nɩaa jɩmba woruŋ. 25Ama ba fa bɩ ba nyɩmmaba Wɩa to, aŋ mɩɩra kpʋkpaarɛ tinteye-la Wɩa sɩ kire ta vesiŋ. 26Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa yigi Asiiria kuoro Pul (ʋ yɩrɩŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ Tɩgɩlaf Pɩlɩsa) hɛ ʋ kʋ yuo dii Iziral doho doho deemba: Rubiŋ doho, Gad doho arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la, a kɛsɛba kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga Asiiria tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ fʋgɛba ba hɔŋ tasɩŋ deemba lɛ: Hala, Habɔ arɩ Hara, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma hɔnɔ kpagɛ Gozaŋ fuo-la a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ.

Title: 1 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 6
Content:
Levi doho nɩaa
1Levi fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Gɛsɔŋ, Kohaf arɩ Mɛrarɩ.
2Kohaf ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Amɩram, Ɩzɩha, Hɛbʋrɔŋ arɩ Ʋzɩɛl. 3Amɩram ma biiriŋ nɛ: Arɔŋ, Mosis arɩ Mɩrɩam. Arɔŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Nadab, Abihu, Elieza arɩ Ɩtama.
4Elieza nanʋala nɛ Finihas. Finihas ma nanʋala nɛ Abɩsʋa, 5Abɩsʋa ma nanʋala nɛ Buki, Buki ma nanʋala nɛ Uzi. 6Uzi ma nanʋala nɛ Zɛrahɩa, Zɛrahɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Mɛrayɔf, 7Mɛrayɔf ma nanʋala nɛ Amarɩa, Amarɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Ahitub, 8Ahitub ma nanʋala nɛ Zadɔk, Zadɔk ma nanʋala nɛ Ahɩmaas, 9Ahɩmaas ma nanʋala nɛ Azarɩa, Azarɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Johanaŋ, 10Johanaŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Azarɩa (ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la Solomoŋ sɩ saa Jerusalɛm lɛ), 11Azarɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Amarɩa, Amarɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Ahitub, 12Ahitub ma nanʋala nɛ Zadɔk, Zadɔk ma nanʋala nɛ Salum, 13Salum ma nanʋala nɛ Hɩlɩkaaya, Hɩlɩkaaya ma nanʋala nɛ Azarɩa, 14Azarɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Sɛraaya, Sɛraaya ma nanʋala nɛ Jehozadak. 15Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza fa pɛ kɛŋ Jehozadak mʋ yoŋ-baga nɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ leŋe Nebukadineza kɛsɛ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ.
16Levi hambolibiisi-la batori, Gɛsɔŋ, Kohaf arɩ Mɛrarɩ, ba ma kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ. 17Gɛsɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Libini arɩ Sɩmɛɩ. 18Kohaf ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Amɩram, Ɩzɩha, Hɛbʋrɔŋ arɩ Ʋzɩɛl. 19Mɛrarɩ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Mali arɩ Musi.
Nɩaa deemba kala nɛ fa ŋaa Levi doho nɩaa nyɩŋ-nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa.
20Gɛsɔŋ nanʋala nɛ Libini, Libini ma nanʋala nɛ Jɛhaf, Jɛhaf ma nanʋala nɛ Zɩma, Zɩma ma nanʋala nɛ 21Jʋa, Jʋa ma nanʋala nɛ Ido, Ido ma nanʋala nɛ Zɛra. Zɛra ma nanʋala nɛ Jɛtɩraɩ. 22Kohaf doho nɩaa nɛ: Amɩnadab, Amɩnadab nanʋala nɛ Kora, Kora ma nanʋala nɛ Asɛɛ, Asɛɛ ma nanʋala nɛ 23Ɛlɩkaana, Ɛlɩkaana ma nanʋala nɛ Ɛbɩasaf, Ɛbɩasaf ma nanʋala nɛ Asɛɛ, Asɛɛ ma nanʋala nɛ 24Tahaf, Tahaf ma nanʋala nɛ Ʋrɩɛl, Ʋrɩɛl ma nanʋala nɛ Uzia, Uzia ma nanʋala nɛ Sawʋl. 25Ɛlɩkaana hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Amasaɩ arɩ Ahimof, 26Ahimof doho nɩaa nɛ: Ɛlɩkaana, Zofai, Nahaf, 27Ɛlɩab, Jeroham, Ɛlɩkaana arɩ Samʋɛl. 28Samʋɛl hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jowɛl ʋ bii-hɩaŋ arɩ Abija ʋ bii-lɩamɩŋ. 29Mɛrarɩ doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Mali, Mali ma nanʋala nɛ Libini, Libini ma nanʋala nɛ Sɩmɛɩ, Sɩmɛɩ ma nanʋala nɛ Uza, Uza ma nanʋala nɛ 30Sɩmɩa, Sɩmɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Hagɩa, Hagɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Azaaya.
Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa
31Ba sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la kɔ Jerusalɛm, ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, nɩaa deemba nɛ Devit lɩɩsɛ ba ŋaa kʋduuroo arɩ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa La TƖƖNA dɩa lɛ. 32Ba fa yie du kɩaa a yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ, lɛbɩ-la lɛ La Tɩɩna sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ ka Solomoŋ-na saa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ba fa yie ŋaa ba wɩaa ŋɩɩ ba sɩ dagɛba dɩ baa ŋaa nɛ.
33Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ yie du kɩaa aŋ yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa, ba dɩ ba dɩa nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la:
Kohaf doho nɩaa: Hemaŋ nɛ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩra-la sɩpaalaara, ʋ nyɩmma nɛ Jowɛl, Jowɛl ma nyɩmma nɛ Samʋɛl, 34Samʋɛl ma nyɩmma nɛ Ɛlɩkaana, Ɛlɩkaana ma nyɩmma nɛ Jeroham, Jeroham ma nyɩmma nɛ Ɛlɩɛl, Ɛlɩɛl ma nyɩmma nɛ Tʋa, 35Tʋa ma nyɩmma nɛ Zuf, Zuf ma nyɩmma nɛ Ɛlɩkaana, Ɛlɩkaana ma nyɩmma nɛ Mahaf, Mahaf ma nyɩmma nɛ Amasaɩ, 36Amasaɩ ma nyɩmma nɛ Ɛlɩkaana, Ɛlɩkaana ma nyɩmma nɛ Jowɛl, Jowɛl ma nyɩmma nɛ Azarɩa, Azarɩa ma nyɩmma nɛ Zefanaaya, 37Zefanaaya ma nyɩmma nɛ Tahaf, Tahaf ma nyɩmma nɛ Asɛɛ, Asɛɛ ma nyɩmma nɛ Ɛbɩasaf, Ɛbɩasaf ma nyɩmma nɛ Kora, 38Kora ma nyɩmma nɛ Ɩzɩha, Ɩzɩha ma nyɩmma nɛ Kohaf, Kohaf ma nyɩmma nɛ Levi. Levi ma nyɩmma nɛ Jekɔb.
39Nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ tɩgɛ Hemaŋ lɛ nɛ ŋaa Asaf. Asaf nyɩmma nɛ Bɛrɛkɩa, Bɛrɛkɩa ma nyɩmma nɛ Sɩmɩa, 40Sɩmɩa ma nyɩmma nɛ Maakɩl, Maakɩl ma nyɩmma nɛ Basɛya, Basɛya ma nyɩmma nɛ Malɩkɩja, 41Malɩkɩja ma nyɩmma nɛ Ɛfɩnɩ, Ɛfɩnɩ ma nyɩmma nɛ Zɛra, Zɛra ma nyɩmma nɛ Adaaya, 42Adaaya ma nyɩmma nɛ Ɛtaŋ, Ɛtaŋ ma nyɩmma nɛ Zɩma, Zɩma ma nyɩmma nɛ Sɩmɛɩ, 43Sɩmɛɩ ma nyɩmma nɛ Jahaf, Jahaf ma nyɩmma nɛ Gɛsɔŋ, Gɛsɔŋ ma nyɩmma nɛ Levi.
44Ɛtaŋ ma nɛ fa ŋaa nɩ-lɩa-la sɩɩ tɩgɛ Hemaŋ lɛ. Ɛtaŋ ŋaa Mɛrarɩ nyɩŋ-nʋʋ nɛ. Ʋ nyɩmma nɛ Kɩsɩ, Kɩsɩ ma nyɩmma nɛ Abidi, Abidi ma nyɩmma nɛ Maluk, 45Maluk ma nyɩmma nɛ Hasabɩa, Hasabɩa ma nyɩmma nɛ Amazɩa, Amazɩa ma nyɩmma nɛ Hɩlɩkaaya, 46Hɩlɩkaaya ma nyɩmma nɛ Amizi, Amizi ma nyɩmma nɛ Banɩ, Banɩ ma nyɩmma nɛ Sɛma, 47Sɛma ma nyɩmma nɛ Mali, Mali ma nyɩmma nɛ Musi, Musi ma nyɩmma nɛ Mɛrarɩ, Mɛrarɩ ma nyɩmma nɛ Levi.
48Ba Levi doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ faa tɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tɩntɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ kala. 49Ama Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ fa yie kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kaa mʋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ koruŋ teeŋ. Ba nɛ faa tɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ tɩntɩŋŋaa, a ŋɩŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Wɩa joŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba, arɩ Wɩa tɩntɩnna Mosis sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.
50Arɔŋ doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Elieza, Finihas, Abɩsʋa, 51Buki, Uzi, Zɛrahɩa, 52Mɛrayɔf, Amarɩa, Ahitub, 53Zadɔk, Ahɩmaas.
54Arɔŋ doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ ŋaa Kohaf nyɩŋ-nɩaa, ba nɛ fa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ joŋ tasɩŋ pa.
55Ba fa joŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛbʋrɔŋ sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ pɩba, a pɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diiliŋ sɩ golli taŋ-la. 56Ama bagɩsɩ-la arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ golli Hɛbʋrɔŋ nɛ ba fa joŋo pɩ Jefuni nanʋala Kalɩb. 57Tasɩŋ deemba arɩ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee nɛ ba fa joŋo pɩ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa: Hɛbʋrɔŋ, taŋ-la ba sɩ jaŋ fá mʋ yuyuori, Libina, Jatɛ arɩ Ɛsɩtɛmʋa, 58Hileŋ, Dɛbɛ, 59Asaŋ, Juta arɩ Bɛf Sɛmɛs. 60Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa ma tinteeŋ lɛ ba joŋ tasɩŋ deemba nɛ pɩba: Geba, Alɛmɛf arɩ Anatɔf a pɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee lɛ. Tasɩŋ fii arɩ batori nɛ ba joŋo pɩ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa.
61Kohaf doho nɩaa nɩkaanaa fa laa tasɩŋ fii nɛ Manasɛ nyɩŋ-nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ teeŋ.
62Gɛsɔŋ nyɩŋ-nɩaa laa tasɩŋ fii arɩ batori nɛ a lɩɩ doho doho deemba leriŋ: Ɩsaka, Asa, Nafɩtalɩ arɩ Manasɛ doho-la dɔŋɔ sɩ hɛ Basaŋ lɛ.
63Levi nyɩŋ-nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Mɛrarɩ lɛ, laa tasɩŋ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ a lɩɩ doho doho deemba leriŋ: Rubiŋ, Gad arɩ Zebuluŋ.
64Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa joŋ tasɩŋ arɩ pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diile-la sɩ golli tasɩ-la a pɩ Levi doho nɩaa ba hɔŋ. 65Ba tɔnsɔ nɛ a chaarɛ tasɩ-la la sɩ daga a lɩɩ doho doho deemba lɛ: Juda, Simioŋ arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ.
66Kohaf nyɩŋ-nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ laa ba tasɩŋ Efirem doho nɩaa tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ. 67Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ, ba joŋ Sɛkɛm pɩba, taŋ-la ba sɩ jaŋ fá mʋ yuyuori arɩ Geza. 68Jokimiam, Bɛf-Horoŋ 69Aɩjalɔŋ arɩ Gaf Rimoŋ, a pɛ lere-la ba pʋsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ didii. 70Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la ma sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, ba joŋ tasɩŋ deemba nɛ pɩ Kohaf nyɩŋ-nɩaa nɩkaana-la: Ana arɩ Biliam, a pɛ lere-la ba pʋsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ didii.
71Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa ma laa tasɩŋ deemba nɛ Manasɛ doho kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ: Golaŋ sɩ hɛ Basaŋ tinteeŋ lɛ arɩ Asɩtarɔf, a pɛ lere-la ba pʋsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ didii.
72Ɩsaka doho nɩaa ma tinteeŋ lɛ, tasɩŋ deemba nɛ ba laa: Kɛdɛs, Dabɛraf, 73Ramɔf arɩ Anem, a pɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee lɛ. 74Asa doho nɩaa ma tinteeŋ lɛ, ba laa tasɩŋ deemba nɛ: Masal, Abɩdɔŋ, 75Hukok arɩ Rehob, a pɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee lɛ.
76Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa ma tinteeŋ lɛ, tasɩŋ deemba nɛ ba laa: Kɛdɛs sɩ hɛ Galilii tinteeŋ lɛ, Hamɔŋ arɩ Kɩrɩatam, a pɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee lɛ.
77Mɛrarɩ doho nɩkaana-la ma laa tasɩŋ deemba nɛ: Zebuluŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, ba laa Rimono arɩ Tabɔ, a pɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee lɛ.
78Rubiŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Jɔdaŋ cholo, a hɛ Jeriko ma wɩɩpɔsʋŋ, ba laa tasɩŋ deemba nɛ: Bɛza sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ, Jaza, 79Kɛdɛmɔf arɩ Mɛfaaf, a pɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee lɛ.
80Gad doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ ba laa tasɩŋ deemba nɛ: Ramɔf sɩ hɛ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ lɛ, Mahanem, 81Hɛsɩbɔŋ arɩ Jaza, a pɛ ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee lɛ.

Title: 1 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 7
Content:
Ɩsaka doho nɩaa
1Ɩsaka hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Tola, Pʋa, Jasub arɩ Sɩmɩrɔŋ. Ba kala fa ŋaa banɛsɛ nɛ.
2Tola ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Uzi, Refaaya, Jɛrɩɛl, Jamaɩ, Ɩbɩsam arɩ Samʋɛl. Ba fa ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ ba doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ a ŋaa laalɩyuori-duoru ma. Devit kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ Tola doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo fa ŋaa bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ nɛ.
3Uzi nanʋala nɛ Izirahia. Izirahia ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Maakɩl, Obadaaya, Jowɛl arɩ Ɩsɩa. Ba kala banɔŋ fa ŋaa kuoroo nɛ. 4Ba jaa haalaa yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ leŋ ba lʋl biiriŋ a yʋgɛ. Ba doho nɩaa fa kɛŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩdʋ nɛ.
5Ɩsaka doho wɩaa ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil daga arɩ ba doho fa kɛŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ balɩpɛ nɛ.
Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa
6Bɛnjamɩŋ fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Bɛla, Bɛka arɩ Jɛdayɛl. 7Bɛla fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ banɔŋ nɛ: Ɛzɩbɔŋ, Uzi, Ʋzɩɛl, Jɛrɩmɔf arɩ Iri. Ba fa ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa tʋɔŋ, a ŋaa laalɩyuori-duoru ma. Ba doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo fa ŋaa bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa arɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil. 8Bɛka hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Zɛmɩra, Jʋas, Elieza, Elionai, Omiri, Jɛrɛmɔf, Abija, Anatɔf arɩ Alɛmɛf. 9Ba doho wɩaa ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil daga arɩ ba dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ ba laalɩyuoroo ŋaa bʋɩ mara arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ. 10Jɛdayɛl nanʋala nɛ Bilihaŋ. Bilihaŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Jeyus, Bɛnjamɩŋ, Ehud, Kɛnaana, Zɛtaŋ, Taasɩs arɩ Ahɩsaha. 11Jɛdayɛl hambolibiisiŋ deemba kala fa ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ. Ba fa kɛŋ laalɩyuoroo ma bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ. 12Iri hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Supim arɩ Hupim. Aha ma nanʋala nɛ Husim.
Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa
13Nafɩtalɩ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Jazɩɛl, Guni, Jeza arɩ Sɩlɛm. Ba fa ŋaa Nafɩtalɩ naaŋ Biliha doho nɩaa nɛ.
Manasɛ doho nɩaa
14Manasɛ arɩ haal-la ʋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa a kaa lɩɩ Siiria tinteeŋ, ba lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ: Asɩrɩɛl arɩ Makɩɩ. Makɩɩ nanʋala nɛ Gɩlɩad. 15Ŋɩɩ nɛ Makɩɩ jaa haalaa pɩ Hupim arɩ Supim. Makɩɩ bii-lɩa yɩrɩŋ nɛ Zelofihad. Zelofihad fa lʋl toloo dʋndʋŋ nɛ.
16Makɩɩ arɩ ʋ haala Maaka fa lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ: Pɛrɛs arɩ Sɛrɛs. Pɛrɛs ma lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ: Ulam arɩ Rakɛm.
17Ulam ma nanʋala nɛ Bɛdaŋ. Nɩaa deemba kala ŋaa Makɩɩ nanʋala Gɩlɩad sɩ ŋaa Manasɛ nihiŋ doho nɩaa nɛ. 18Gɩlɩad dɩhaala Hamɔlɛkɛf fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Ɩsɔd, Abieza arɩ Mala.
19Sɛmɩda hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ahɩaŋ, Sɛkɛm, Likihi arɩ Anɩam.
Efirem doho nɩaa
20Efirem doho nɩaa nɛ: Sʋtɛla, Bɛrɛd, Tahaf, Ɛlɩada, Tahaf, 21Zabad arɩ Sʋtɛla. Gaf taŋ nɩaa fa kpʋ Ɛza arɩ Ɛlɩad nɛ ba sɩ mʋa dɩ ba gaa ba pʋsʋŋ. 22Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba nyɩmma Efirem yel ba yoho a dieni, ʋ naambiiriŋ kɔ dɩ ba pʋ kenyiri. 23Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ haala bɩra pɛ bɔsɔ, ʋ kɛŋ luoruŋ a lʋl hambolibie, a hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Bɛrɩa, a tɩŋ nyu-bɔŋ-la sɩ jʋʋ ʋ dɩa. 24Ʋ tolo nɛ fa Sɛɛra, nɩɩ-la sɩ saa tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf-Horoŋ, nyuŋ arɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kala, a pɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Uzeŋ Sɛɛra lɛ.
25Efirem nanʋala dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Refa. Refa doho nɩaa nɛ: Resef, Tɛla, Tahaŋ, 26Ladaŋ, Amihud, Ɛlɩsama, 27Nuŋ arɩ Josua.
28Efirem doho nɩaa fa laa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛtɛl arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ gollu nɛ a hɔŋ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Naaraŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a bɩra kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Gɛza sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ ʋ tabiisiŋ. Ba tinteeŋ nɛ ha tabala-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛkɛm arɩ Aya kala arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ golliba. 29Manasɛ doho nɩaa nɛ fa tɩɩ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf-Saŋ, Tanak, Mɛgɩdɔ arɩ Doo, a pɛ tabiisi-la sɩ golliba lɛ. Jekɔb nanʋala Josɛf doho nɩaa nɛ fa hɔŋ tasɩŋ deemba lɛ.
Asa doho nɩaa
30Asa hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Imina, Isiva, Isivi arɩ Bɛrɩa. Ba dɩhaala nɛ fa ŋaa Sɛra. 31Bɛrɩa ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Hɛba arɩ Malɩkɩɛl. Malɩkɩɛl nanʋala nɛ fa Bɛzaɩf. 32Hɛba hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jafɩlɛt, Soma arɩ Hotam a pɛ ba dɩhaala Sʋa lɛ. 33Jafɩlɛt hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Pasak, Bɩmɩhal arɩ Asɩvaf. 34Soma ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ahi, Roga, Huba arɩ Aram. 35Jafɩlɛt naambie Hotam (ʋ nɛ ha Hɛlɛm) ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Zofa, Imina, Sɛlɛs arɩ Amal. 36Zofa hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Sʋa, Haanɛfa, Sʋal, Beri, Ɩmɩra, 37Bɛza, Hod, Sama, Sɩlɩsa, Ɩtɩraŋ arɩ Bɛɛra. 38Jɛta hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jefuni, Pɩsɩpa arɩ Ara. 39Ula hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ara, Hanɩɛl arɩ Rɩzɩa. 40Nɩaa deemba kala fa ŋaa Asa doho nɩaa nɛ. Ba fa ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɩaa sɩɩ zil nɛ, a ŋaa laalɩyuori-duoruŋ ma. Laalɩyuoro-la sɩ hɛ Asa doho tʋɔŋ, ba kala fa ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩdʋ nɛ ba sɩ dɩɩsa a ŋmʋnsa bil.

Title: 1 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 8
Content:
Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa
1Bɛnjamɩŋ bii-hɩaŋ nɛ Bɛla, Asɩbɛl ŋaa ʋ bii-lɩa, Ahara ŋaa ʋ bii-tori, 2Noha nɛ ŋaa ʋ bii-nɛsɛ, Rafa ŋaa ʋ bii-nɔŋ. 3Bɛla hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ada, Gɛra, Abihud, 4Abɩsʋa, Naamaŋ, Ahʋa, 5Gɛra, Sɛfʋfaŋ arɩ Huram.
6Ehud doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ a fa hɔŋ Geba lɛ, ba fʋga lɩɩsɛba ba mʋ hɔŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Manahaf lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: 7Naamaŋ, Ahija arɩ Gɛra. Gɛra fa ŋaa Uza arɩ Ahihud nyɩmma nɛ, ʋ nɛ fa laa ba sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba mʋ. 8-9Saharem fa jaa haalaa balɩa nɛ aŋ vɩaba: Husim arɩ Baara. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mʋ hɔŋ Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ a jaa Hɔdɛs a lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩpɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ: Jobab, Zɩbɩa, Mɛsa, Malɩkam, 10Jɛʋs, Sakɩa arɩ Mɩɩma. Ʋ hambolibiisi-la kala kʋ ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ. 11Saharem arɩ ʋ haala Husim ma fa lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ: Abitub arɩ Ɛlɩpaal.
12Ɛlɩpaal hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ɛba, Mɩsam, Sɛmɛd (ʋ nɛ saa tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ono arɩ Lod arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ golliba), 13Bɛrɩa arɩ Sɛma. Ba fa ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ a hɔŋ tabal-la ba sɩ yɩrɛ Aɩjalɔŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kiri nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔŋ Gaf tabal-la lɛ ba lɩɩ.
14Bɛrɩa ma doho nɩaa nɛ: Ahio, Sasak, Jɛrɛmɔf, 15Zɛbadɩa, Arad, Ɛda, 16Maakɩl, Ɩsɩpa arɩ Joha.
17Ɛlɩpaal doho nɩaa nɛ: Zɛbadɩa, Mɛsʋlam, Hiziki, Hɛba, 18Ɩsɩmɛraɩ, Izilia arɩ Jobab.
19Sɩmɛɩ ma doho nɩaa nɛ: Jakɩm, Zikiri, Zabidi, 20Ɛlɩɛnaɩ, Ziletai, Ɛlɩɛl, 21Adaaya, Bɛraaya arɩ Sɩmɩraf.
22Sasak ma doho nɩaa nɛ: Ɩsɩpaŋ, Ɛba, Ɛlɩɛl, 23Abɩdɔŋ, Zikiri, Hanaŋ, 24Hananaaya, Ɛlam, Antotija, 25Ifideya arɩ Pɛnʋɛl.
26Jeroham doho nɩaa nɛ: Samɩsɛraɩ, Sɛharaya, Atalɩa, 27Jaarɛsɩa, Ɩlaaja arɩ Zikiri.
28Nɩaa deemba kala ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ ba doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, aŋ pɛ ŋaa nɩbalaa, ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil. Ba fa hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ.
29Jɛyɛl nɛ fa saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gibioŋ, a hɔŋ nɩmɛ. Ʋ haala yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Maaka. 30Ʋ bii-hɩaŋ ma nɛ Abɩdɔŋ. Ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ: Zuu, Kɩs, Baal, Nɛɛ, Nadab, 31Gɛdɔ, Ahio, Zɛka, 32arɩ Mɩkɩlɔf sɩ ŋaa Sɩmɩa nyɩmma. Ba ma hɔnɔ kpagɛ ba naambiiriŋ nɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.
33Nɛɛ nanʋala nɛ Kɩs, Kɩs ma nanʋala nɛ Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jonataŋ, Malɩkɩ-Sʋa, Abɩnadab arɩ Ɛsɩ-Baal.
34Jonataŋ ma nanʋala nɛ Mɛrɩb-Baal, Mɩka nyɩmma.
35Mɩka hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Pɩtɔŋ, Mɛlɛk, Tarɩa arɩ Ahas. 36Ahas ma nanʋala nɛ Jehuada, Jehuada ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Alɛmɛf, Azɩmavɛf arɩ Zimiri. Zimiri ma nanʋala nɛ Moza. 37Moza ma nanʋala nɛ Bɩnɩa, Bɩnɩa ma nanʋala nɛ Rafa, Rafa ma nanʋala nɛ Ɛlɩasa, Ɛlɩasa ma nanʋala nɛ Azɛl.
38Azɛl fa lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩdʋ nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ: Azɩrɩkam, Bokeru, Ɩsɩmɛl, Sɩarɩa, Obadaaya arɩ Hanaŋ.
39Azɛl naambie Ɛsɛk ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Ulam, ʋ bii-hɩaŋ, Jeyus ʋ bii-lɩa arɩ Ɛlɩfɛlɛt ʋ bii-tori. 40Ulam hambolibiisiŋ fa ŋaa bayuori-wajɩaba nɛ, a yuyuo toŋ woruŋ. Ba fa kɛŋ biiriŋ arɩ nihee zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii nɛ. Nɩaa deemba kala ŋaa Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa nɛ.

Title: 1 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 9
Content:
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm
1Ba fa ŋmʋnsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho nɩaa kala yɩraa a hɛ Iziral kuoroo teniŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ.
Ba fa kɛsɛ Juda doho nɩaa-na kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ nɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ Wɩa teeŋ. 2Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ mɩɩra kɔ ba tasɩŋ, a hɔŋ ba dɩ-tɩɩlaa nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi doho nɩaa, Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ.
3Nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Juda doho, Bɛnjamɩŋ doho, Efirem arɩ Manasɛ doho doho a fa hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ: 4Utai, ʋ nyɩmma nɛ Amihud, Amihud nyɩmma nɛ Omiri, Omiri ma nyɩmma nɛ Imiri, Imiri ma nyɩmma nɛ Banɩ. Utai ʋ fa ŋaa Juda nanʋala Pɛrɛs doho nʋʋ nɛ. 5Sɛla dɩa nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ mɩɩra kɔ nɛ: Asaaya, ʋ hambolibii-hɩaŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ. 6Zɛra dɩa nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ mɩɩra kɔ nɛ: Jɛwɛl arɩ ʋ nɩaa. Juda doho nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ mɩɩra kʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ fa ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩdʋ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ fii nɛ.
7Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa ma nɛ: Salu, Salu nyɩmma nɛ Mɛsʋlam, Mɛsʋlam ma nyɩmma nɛ Hodavia, Hodavia ma nyɩmma nɛ Hasenua, 8Jeroham nanʋala Ɩbɩnɩa, Uzi nanʋala Ɛla sɩ ŋaa Mikiri nihiŋ arɩ Sɛfatɩa nanʋala Mɛsʋlam. Sɛfatɩa nyɩmma nɛ Rɛwɛl, Rɛwɛl ma nyɩmma nɛ Ibinija. 9Nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ kala ŋaa zɔlɔ nibi arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ balɩdʋ nɛ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil. Baalaa deemba kala ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ.
10Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma sɩ mɩɩra kɔ nɛ: Jedaaya, Jehoyarib, Jakɩŋ, 11Hɩlɩkaaya nanʋala Azarɩa. Hɩlɩkaaya nyɩmma nɛ Mɛsʋlam, Mɛsʋlam ma nyɩmma nɛ Zadɔk, Zadɔk ma nyɩmma nɛ Mɛrayɔf, Mɛrayɔf ma nyɩmma nɛ Ahitub.
