Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa kʋ pɛ dɩ ba 9keri daasɩ-la yʋgɛ woruŋ pɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-ballɩŋ dɩ ʋ yʋgɛ nɛ a chaasa zɔŋ woruŋ. 10Mɩ jaŋ tiŋ ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ keri daasɩ-la mɛmpɛ bɔtɔ bʋɩ balɩa, mɩaa bɔtɔba bʋɩ balɩa, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ galamba bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa, a pɛ olif nʋʋŋ ma galamba bʋɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ fii lɛ.” 11Ŋɩɩ nɛ Taaya kuoro Hiram ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ Solomoŋ a bʋl,
“A tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ cho ʋ nɩaa wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ leŋ ŋ ŋaa ba kuoro.”
12Ʋ bɩra bʋl:
“Má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ. Ʋ joŋ hambolibie sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa woruŋ a pɩ Devit dɩ ʋ nɛ saa dɩa a pɩ La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kuoru dɩa.
13Mɩ leŋe Huram-Abi nɛ kʋkɔ ŋ teeŋ, ʋ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ woruŋ. 14Ʋ naaŋ ŋaa Daŋ doho nʋʋ nɛ, ka ʋ nyɩmma lɩɩ Taaya. Huram-Abi jɩŋ sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, kɔlɩɩŋ, hɔɔŋ, tabɩaa, daasɩŋ, gɛrɩpɛ-vachalɩŋ, gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine, gɛrɩpɛ-fɩaŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ chaasa jɩŋ kɩaa higiŋ nɛ woruŋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo higiŋ kʋŋkala ŋ sɩ dagʋ. Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa lɛ arɩ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ Devit, ŋ nyɩmma gɔgɔɔ lɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ.
15Lɛɛlɛ leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ mɛmpɛ-la, mɩa-la, olif nʋʋŋ arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩŋ-la ŋ sɩ sɩ ŋ jaŋ pɩla kaa kɔ. 16Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba keri dolo-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ a vɔɔ paa hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ a duoro kaa kɔ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jopa a pɩŋ, dɩ ŋ paa mʋ Jerusalɛm.”
17Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ dɩɩsɛ nɩwogusu-la kala sɩ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba kala ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ. Ʋ nyɩmma Devit fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ dɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ, ʋ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. 18Ʋ leŋ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ baalaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii chʋŋ dɩa-la kɩaa kʋkɔ, ka baalaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ ma yɩyɛrɛ tabɩaa dundolluŋ nyuŋ, ka baalaa bʋɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ ma bibeŋ tɩntɩnna-la.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 3
Content:
Solomoŋ suomi Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la saanɩŋ
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ suomo sɩsaa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la Jerusalɛm lɛ Moria peel-la nyuŋ. Lee-la nɛ La TƖƖNA fa kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ Solomoŋ nyɩmma Devit. Jebus tɩŋŋaa Araʋna taha nɛ fa ŋɩɩ. Devit nɛ fa chɛ lee-la bil. 2Solomoŋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-nɛsɛ lɛ, chɛŋ-lɩa tapʋl lɩa tʋɔŋ nɛ ʋ suomi Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la saanɩŋ. 3Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kuoro Solomoŋ sɩ saa tʋɔŋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mara arɩ fii nɛ. Ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ fii. 4Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la zawʋra ŋ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ aŋ-na jʋʋ dɩa-la tɩtɩa tʋɔŋ jalɩŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii nɛ, ʋ dɩ dɩa-la jalɩŋ kala magɛ dɔŋɔ, ka ʋ leŋiŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ.
Ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ taarɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ. 5Ʋ joŋ bʋtʋma daasɩŋ nɛ a kɩɛla tɔ Wɩa dɩa-la dɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ jeeŋ kala a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taarɛ, aŋ higi kɩaa sɩ nagɛ abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ chɔrʋmɔɔ a hɛ ba lɛ. 6Ʋ kɛŋ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa nɛ a kpɩɛrɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. Sɛlɩmɛ-la ʋ sɩ kaa tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la, ʋ fa kaa lɩɩ Paavem tinteeŋ nɛ. 7Ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ taara tɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la nyuŋ doloo, boro daasɩŋ, jeyee, arɩ ʋ borusuŋ kala, aŋ saa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a hɛ jebiee lɛ.
8Ʋ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ, ʋ duomuŋ magɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la jalɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii nɛ, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ fii. Ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo bʋɩ balɩa nɛ a taara tɔ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala. 9Ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa hɛŋŋɛɛ yuŋuŋ fa ka mʋa ka dɩ ʋ yi kilo bala. Dɩɩsɩ-la ma sɩ hɛ nyuŋ, ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ a taarɛ ba kala.
10Solomoŋ bɩra leŋ ba kɛŋ hɔɔŋ libi kɩaa balɩa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taara tɔ a joŋo bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ lɛ. 11Kɩalɩŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ banɛsɛ kala duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii nɛ. Bumbuŋ kʋa kɩŋkɛŋɛ dɔŋɔ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la jeeŋ lɛ. Kɩŋkɛŋɛ dɔŋɔ ma duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ cheŋ dɔŋ-la. 12Lɩamɩŋ tɩɩna ma kɩŋkɛŋɛ dɔŋɔ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la jeeŋ lɛ, ka kɩŋkɛŋɛ dɔŋɔ ma duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ tɩgɛ bumbuŋ kʋ-la kɩŋkɛŋɛ lɛ. 13Ba kɩŋkɛsɩ-la kala duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ nibi nɛ. Ba chɩŋ ba naasɩŋ lɛ nɛ a chaasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la dɩ-balɩŋ.
14Ʋ kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ nɛ a ŋaa patɩɩsaŋ, a kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine arɩ ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ arɩ ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ a sʋa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a hɛ.
15Kuoro leŋe ba saa kɩaa balɩa nɛ a nagɛ jebiee dɩ ʋ joŋo pɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ. Ba kala balɩa leŋiŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii arɩ balɩpɛ arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Ba ŋaa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ nyunchuuluŋ a sagɛ jebie-la nyuŋ. Ba kʋŋkala leŋiŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. 16Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ ba ŋaa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ ʋ joŋo daŋ jebie-la nyuŋ, aŋ libi kɩaa sɩ nagɛ kampoi nɛnɛɛ zɔlɔ a hɛ chɔrʋmɔ-la lɛ. 17Ʋ joŋ kɔlɩɩŋ jebie-la a pɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ. Dɔŋɔ chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, dɔŋɔ ma chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa. Kʋ-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ ʋ hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Jakɩŋ, a hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa kʋa ma yɩrɩŋ Bʋas.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 4
Content:
Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ kpɩɛraa
1Kuoro Solomoŋ leŋe ba kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ, ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ fii, ka ʋ leŋiŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋnɔŋ arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ. 2Huram kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ a libi taasɩ-gbaŋ-balɩŋ ʋ ŋaa gulogulo. Ʋ jalɩŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋnɔŋ a chɩŋ niiŋ dɔŋɔ a mʋmʋ dɔŋɔ, ʋ luŋuŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ gulluŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ fii arɩ banɔŋ. 3Gbaŋa-la niipiniŋ lɛ, ʋ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ a ŋaa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ nɛ-belliŋ naaderee balɩa a golli. Naakieliŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ na-kala pɛgɛ, nɛ-belliŋ fii nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ.
4Taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la sagɛ nɛ-belliŋ fii arɩ balɩa nyuŋ nɛ. Nɛ-belli-la batori sɩaa chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa nɛ, batori ma sɩaa chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, batori ma chaasɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ, ka batori ma chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ. Gbaŋa-la sagɛ ba nyuŋ nɛ ka ba kala bʋbʋɔŋ chaasɛ dɔŋɔ. 5Taasɩ-gbaŋa-la barɩmɩŋ ŋaa vama nɛ, aŋ ka ʋ niipiniŋ nagɛ nyʋnyʋala niipiniŋ, a nagɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa. Ʋ tʋɔŋ lɩɩŋ ŋaa galamba bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ nɛ.
6Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa taasɩ-gbaŋ-biisiŋ fii dɩ ba kaa sʋsɔŋ nɩsaa, a joŋ banɔŋ bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, aŋ joŋ banɔŋ ma bil wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa. Ba tʋɔŋ nɛ ba chɩchɛsɛ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa. Ama taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la tʋɔŋ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ sʋsɔŋ ba tɩtɩa.
7Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa chaaŋ daaŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ dagʋ, kɩaa fii a joŋo bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Banɔŋ chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, banɔŋ ma chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa. 8Ʋ ŋaa teebʋlba ma fii nɛ a joŋo bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Banɔŋ chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa, banɔŋ ma chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ. Ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ a ŋaa kʋmɩsɩrɩ-gbansɩŋ ma zɔlɔ. 9Ʋ saa kaalɩ-bie a pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, aŋ saa kaalɩ-balɩŋ ma a ŋaa ba borusuŋ, a kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ taara tɔ. 10Ʋ joŋ taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la a bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ pɛgɛ gʋnʋŋ lɛ nɛ.
11Huram bɩra ŋaa puposuŋ, safʋlba arɩ kʋmɩsɩrɩ gbansɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Huram tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la kala kuoro Solomoŋ sɩ sɩ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ a dɛrɛ. Kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: 12Jebie-la balɩa, kɩalɩŋ balɩa ʋ sɩ libe ba nagɛ gbaŋa a sagɛ jebie-la balɩa nyuŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa ba nagɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ ba kaa kpɩɛrɛ gbansɩ-la sɩ sagɛ jebie-la nyuŋ, 13kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ kampoi nɛnɛɛ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ libi tʋŋ-bʋlɩa (a kɛmba kɩɛlɛ naadere-la balɩa, a kpɩɛrɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ gbaŋa a sagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ jebie-la nyuŋ), 14taasɩ-gbansɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ nyuŋ ba sɩɩ chɩŋ, 15taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la arɩ nɛ-belli-la fii arɩ balɩa nyuŋ ʋ sɩ saga, 16puposuŋ, safʋlba, lɛsɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ kerikee ba kaa lɩɩsɛ nammɩa, arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ. La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la kɩalɩŋ kala Huram-Abi sɩ ŋaa pɩ kuoro Solomoŋ, kɔlɩɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ ʋ kaa ŋaa. 17Kuoro leŋe ba chɔ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ a bɩsa hɛ chʋrʋŋ ba sɩ kaa mɛ kɩaa lɛ a ŋaa kɩalɩŋ Sʋkɔf arɩ Zarɛtaŋ pɛgɛ, Jɔdaŋ tintee-taala-la lɛ. 18Kɩaa deemba kala Solomoŋ sɩ leŋe ba ŋaa fa yʋga nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ wuo jɩŋ kɔlɩɩŋ yuŋuŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ ba kaa ŋaaba. 19Solomoŋ bɩra leŋ ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ a ŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kɩaa deemba: Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ, teebʋlba-la nyuŋ ba sɩ yie joŋ boroboro daŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, 20chaaŋ daasɩŋ arɩ ba chaanaa, dɩ ba hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a didii arɩ ba sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. 21Kpɩɛra-la ba sɩ ŋaa ba nagɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa, chaanaa arɩ chɛŋŋɛɛ. Sɛlɩmɛ tɩtɩa nɛ ba kaa ŋaaba. 22Kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ, kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa kikeri chaaŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ, kʋmɩsɩrɩ gbansɩŋ, gbansɩŋ, kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ hɛnsɩŋ arɩ nyiniŋ hɛntɛrɛɛ. Sɛlɩmɛ tɩtɩa nɛ ba kaa ŋaaba, a pɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la borusuŋ lɛ. Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ borusuŋ arɩ Wɩa dɩa-la dɩɩ-balɩŋ borusuŋ, sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ ba kaa ŋaa ba kala.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 5
Content:
1Solomoŋ sɩ tɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa kala dɛrɛ, ʋ paa kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ nyɩmma Devit fa sɩ joŋo pɩ La TƖƖNA a kaa jʋʋ bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, ba dʋa dɩ-biliŋ. Kɩalɩŋ nɛ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla arɩ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ.
Ba joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la kɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ
2Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Solomoŋ yɩrɛ Iziral doho doho nɩhɩasɩŋ, arɩ ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa nɩhɩasɩŋ kala dɩ ba kɔ ʋ teeŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ dɩ ba joŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la Zaayɔŋ lɛ, Devit tabal-la lɛ. 3Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa baalaa kala kɔ kuoro Solomoŋ teeŋ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ gbieli ba lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele, chɛŋ-pɛɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛtanɩm tʋɔŋ.
4Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩ-la kala sɩ kɔ, Levi doho nɩaa joŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la, 5arɩ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa nɛ chʋŋ kɩalɩŋ. 6Ka kuoro Solomoŋ arɩ Iziral tɩmma-la kala sɩ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ laa daga-la sɩpaaŋ, a kpʋ piesee arɩ nɛsɩŋ a yʋgɛ woruŋ, nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.
7Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kɛŋ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ sɩpaaŋ lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ, a joŋo bil kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ. 8Kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa kɛŋ ba kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ jɛrɛ tɔ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la arɩ ʋ daa-duduosu-la lɛ ba sɩ kaa jujoŋ. 9Daasɩŋ deemba fa duomo nɛ woruŋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ tʋɔŋ a chɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo naba, ama dɩ ŋ nɛ hɛ ʋ harɩŋ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo naba. Daasɩ-la ha hɛ nɩmɛ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. 10Kʋŋkala fa tuo Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la tʋɔŋ a pɛ tabɩɩ-taala-la balɩa Mosis sɩ joŋo hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ Sɩnaɩ peel-la lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ niiŋ ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ, ba sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ harɩŋ.
11Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa mɩɩra lɩɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ lɛ a kʋ lɩɩ. Ba kala pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta, a bɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ kɛmba kpaa bugoo lɛ to. 12Levi doho nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa: Asaf, Hemaŋ, Jedutuŋ arɩ ba hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ba naambiiriŋ kala fa chɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ nɛ a laalɛ gɛrɩ-fʋfʋlaa a chɩchɩgɩsɛ buguloo, a dudu kɔnɛba arɩ chenniŋ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa zɔlɔ arɩ mara ma nɛ fa pɛ ba lɛ a ŋmʋŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ. 13Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋmʋʋ nyilli-la arɩ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩra-la, kalenleŋ-duuroo, kɔnɩ-duuro arɩ cheŋ-duuro faasa yɩɩ yɩɩlaa hɛ dɔŋɔ a dɩdɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA aŋ pɛ lɔllʋ a bʋl,
“La TƖƖNA wɩaa zɔmɔ,
ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.”
Ŋɩɩ nɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ kʋ tɔ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la, 14Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩra bɩ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA tʋla fa tɔ dɩa-la kala nɛ.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 6
Content:
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a bʋl, “Mɩ Tɩɩna, ŋ sɩ ŋ jaŋ hɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-bine tʋɔŋ. 2Lɛɛlɛ mɩ saa ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ a pɩŋ, lee ŋ sɩ jaŋ hɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.”
3Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa hilime chɩŋ lee-la nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Solomoŋ bɩrɩma chaasɛba, a sʋl Wɩa pɩba. 4Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa. Ʋ kɛŋ nii-la ʋ sɩ hɛ pɩ mɩ nyɩmma Devit a tɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ fa sɩ, 5‘A chɩŋ bʋa-la mɩ sɩ kɛŋ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ, mɩ bɩ tabal kala lɩɩsa Iziral doho doho-la tʋɔŋ dɩ ba saa mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩ ba zizilmi nɩmɛ. Mɩ bɩ nʋʋ ma lɩɩsa dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaarʋ. 6Ama lɛɛlɛ, mɩ lɩɩsɛ Jerusalɛm nɛ dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlɛmɛ nɩmɛ, a lɩɩsɛ Devit ma dɩ ʋ bibeŋ mɩ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa.’
7Mɩ nyɩmma Devit fa kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa nɩmɛ. 8Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ mɩ nyɩmma Devit, ‘Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ ŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ŋ saa mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ pɩmɛ dɩ ba zizilmi nɩmɛ. 9Ama ŋ dee nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ saa mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ pɩmɛ. Ama ŋ tɩtɩa bii-lʋlʋŋ nɛ jaŋ saa mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlɛmɛ nɩmɛ.’ 10La TƖƖNA kɛŋ nii-la ʋ fa sɩ hɛ kaa tɩŋ nɛ. Mɩ laa mɩ nyɩmma Devit nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ nɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, a saa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ ma dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa nɩmɛ. 11Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ nɛ mɩ joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la bil, daga-la tʋɔŋ nɛ tabɩɩ-taalɩ-la balɩa lɛ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ niiri-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bile ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ a hɛ.”
Solomoŋ sʋl Wɩa hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ
12Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ sii chɩŋ La TƖƖNA koru-la arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩpaaŋ, a kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa je. 13Ʋ fa kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa kʋ-taala nɛ, ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, ka ʋ leŋiŋ ŋaa naakieli-bala arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, ʋ joŋo bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la harɩŋ kaala-la tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ jɩl kʋ-la nyuŋ a tuu kpirimi Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩpaaŋ, a kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa je wɩa-nyuŋ. 14Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a bʋl: “Ou, La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, kʋŋkala tuo wɩa-nyuŋ koo tinteeŋ lɛ a magɩŋ. Ŋ sɩ cho ŋ nɩaa a hɛ nii-la ŋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ, ŋ bɩ ʋ wɩaa yʋa. Ŋ yie chɩŋ ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ kala a tuto wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga harɩŋ nɛ. 15Ŋ kɛŋ nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ pɩ mɩ nyɩmma Devit sɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ a tɩŋ nɛ. Jɩnɩŋ ŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pʋ arɩ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ. 16La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, ŋ hɛ niiŋ a pɩ mɩ nyɩmma Devit sɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ a bʋl, ‘Nʋʋ jaŋ lɩɩ ŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ bʋa na-kala a dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoruŋ, dɩ ba nɛ fɩɛlɛ ba sɩaa a to wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto arɩ ŋ-na Devit sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.’ 17Lɛɛlɛ mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, leŋ dɩ nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ pɩ ŋ tɩntɩnna Devit sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ.
18Ama Wɩa, ŋ sɛnɛ jaŋ hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ a guoli nuhuobiinee tʋɔŋ? Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ balegi balegi ma paala bɩ jalɩa magɛ ŋ jʋʋnʋŋ. Ɛɛ nɛ saa ŋ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ saa tinteeŋ lɛ? 19Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa, jegile nɩɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna sʋla a ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ pɩmɛ. 20Ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ nɛ ŋaa lee-la ŋ sɩ sɩ ŋ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlʋŋ nɩmɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, bibeŋ ʋ nyuŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala. Dɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna nɛ joŋ mɩ sɩaa chaasʋ aŋ sʋlʋŋ, jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. 21Mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa ŋ nɩaa. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, bʋa na-kala dɩ la kʋŋ nɛ joŋ sɩaa a chaasɛ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ a sʋlʋŋ, ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ a laa la sʋla a joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛla. 22Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ a chei ʋ dɔŋɔ, a magɛ dɩ tɩɩna kʋ jʋʋ chɩŋ ŋ koruŋ sɩpaaŋ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ lɛ a ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ ʋ bɩ wɩɩ jɩŋ, 23ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ a laa wɩɩ-la jɩŋ. Dɔgɩsɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ laa cheeriŋ, aŋ joŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye ta. 24Dɩ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a cheyiŋ dɩ ŋ leŋ dɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diiba, dɩ ba nɛ mɩɩra kɔ ŋ teeŋ a sʋsʋlʋŋ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ lɛ arɩ ba cheye nɛ, 25ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ ba sʋla a joŋo chɛba aŋ mɩɩra kɛmba kɔ tintee-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩ ba dɩ ba naabalɩmaba. 26Dɩ ŋ nɩaa nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ cheyiŋ dɩ ŋ dɔgɩsɛba a pɔ dɩ duonuŋ sɩ́ nɩɩ, dɩ ba nɛ joŋ ba sɩaa chaasɛ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ a yɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ a sʋlʋŋ arɩ ba cheye nɛ aŋ leŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la, 27ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ a joŋo chɛba. Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa dagɛba dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ, aŋ leŋ dɩ duonuŋ bɩra nɩɩ tintee-la lɛ ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩba ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ. 28Dɩ losuŋ nɛ jʋʋ tinteeŋ a tɩŋ kʋduuloo sɩ cheye wɩaa koo hɔbɔ sɩ die koo dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ kʋ gollo chu ba tasɩ-la dɔŋɔ koo nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ jʋa, koo wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ koo nyanyalaa nɛ jʋʋ kpʋkpʋ nɩaa, 29dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋŋ tʋɔŋ chei a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa je a chaasɛ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ a sʋlʋŋ, 30ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ a joŋ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛʋ aŋ pɛ ʋ lɛ. Ŋ jɩŋ nʋʋkala tʋɔbɩɩnaa arɩ ʋ mɛlɛ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ŋaa ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa nʋʋkala lɛ. 31Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ nɩaa jaŋ fɩfáŋ a tuto ŋ wombiee, bʋa-la kala ba sɩ hɛ tintee-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩ la naabalɩmaba ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ lɛ. 32Dɩ nʋhʋɔra-la ma sɩ bɩ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋŋ ŋaa nɛ nɩɩ ŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ wɩaa, ŋ doluŋ wɩaa arɩ wʋduoru-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa a lɩɩ tinteye-la sɩ bolie a kɔ dɩ ʋ chʋɔlʋŋ, a joŋ ʋ sɩaa chaasɛ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ a sʋlʋŋ, 33ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ nʋhʋɔrʋ-la sʋla a ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ pʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ jɩmɩŋ a fɩfáŋ arɩ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, aŋ bɩra jɩŋ arɩ mɩ saa ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ a pɩŋ nɛ dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlʋŋ nɩmɛ. 34Dɩ ŋ nɛ hɛ ŋ nɩaa dɩ ba mʋ laalɩŋ a yuo ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ ba joŋ ba sɩaa chaasɛ tabalɩŋ deeŋ ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa arɩ ŋ dɩɩ-bal-la mɩ sɩ saa dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlʋŋ nɩmɛ a sʋlʋŋ, 35ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ ba sʋla a leŋ dɩ ba yuo dii ba dʋndɔmɔ-la. 36Nʋʋkala tuo ʋ bɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ ka ŋaa. Ama dɩ ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, dɩ ŋ baanɩŋ sii ba nyuŋ a leŋ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ yuo diiba a kɛsɛba kaa mʋ tintee-wogusuŋ, dɩ lee-la kpaga koo ʋ bolie, 37dɩ ba nɛ hɛ tintee-la ba sɩ kɛsɛba mʋ ba ŋaa yosi lɛ, aŋ bɩrɩmɛ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa a sʋlʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa ba cheye nɛ, 38dɩ ba nɛ sɛnɛ sɛɩ cheeriŋ aŋ joŋ ba sɩaa chaasɛ tintee-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩ ba naabalɩmaba arɩ taŋ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa mɩ saa ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩ ba chʋchʋɔlʋŋ nɩmɛ a sʋlʋŋ, 39ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, jegile nɩɩ ba sʋla a fá ba nenige a joŋo chɛba. 40Mɩ Wɩa, suri ŋ sɩaa pɩla, leŋ dɩ ŋ dɩgɩlaa hɛ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ lɛ bʋa na-kala dɩ la nɛ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ nɩɩ. 41Lɛɛlɛ mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, sii kʋ jʋʋ ŋ dɩa, la joŋ ŋ niiriŋ daga-la bil nɩmɛ nɛ, kʋ-la sɩ ŋaa ŋ doluŋ magɩlɩŋ. Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa, ŋaa dɩ ŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa leŋ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ laa nɩaa tɩta. Dɩ ŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. 42Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, sɩ́ mɩ-na nɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ lɩɩsa vɩa ta. Liisi ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ ŋ tɩntɩnna Devit arɩ ŋ jaŋ dagɛ ŋ chonuŋ a pʋ.”

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 7
Content:
Ba joŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ
1Solomoŋ sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa dɛrɛ, nyiniŋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a kʋ tuu joŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kala dii. Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA tʋla su ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ. 2Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa bɩ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA tʋla tɔʋ nɛ. 3Iziral tɩmma-la kala sɩ na nyiŋ-la sɩ kʋʋ tuu arɩ La TƖƖNA tʋla-la sɩ tɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ, ba kala tuu kpirimi a kɛŋ sɩaa chu tinteeŋ a chʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA a lɔllʋ a bʋl,
“La TƖƖNA wɩaa zɔmɔ,
ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.”
4Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Solomoŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA. 5Kuoro Solomoŋ fa kpʋ nɛ-belliŋ bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa nɛ, piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa ma bʋɩ zɔlɔ arɩ mara. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala joŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. 6Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa chɩŋ lee-la sɩ maga dɩ ba chɩŋ, Levi doho nɩaa ma chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnɩŋ a kori ba kʋduulo-la kuoro Devit fa sɩ ŋaa dɩ ba kaa dɩdɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA. Ba yie du kɩalɩŋ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA a bʋl, “Ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.” Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma yie chɩna chaasɛ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ a ŋmʋŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ, ka Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala chɩŋ.
7Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ joŋ kaala-la sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la sɩpaaŋ tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, aŋ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a nyɩgɛ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋsʋ-la nʋʋŋ leree. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ bɛɛ wɩaa kɔlɩɩŋ koru-la ʋ fa sɩ ŋaa muuro nɛ arɩ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ kala daŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.
8Solomoŋ arɩ Iziral nɩ-daŋ-la kala chaasa gbieli lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele-la tapʋlaa balɩpɛ nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ chaasa yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ a lɩɩ lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lebo Hamaf sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa a kaa mʋ Ijipiti fuonaa luŋii-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kala a kɔ. 9Ba kɛŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ nɛ a joŋ Wɩa koru-la hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, aŋ gbieli lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele-la ma tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. Ba sɩ dɛrɛ, taŋ sii pʋl, ba kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA. 10Chɛŋ-pɛɩ tapʋlaa mara arɩ batori chɛɛŋ, Solomoŋ ta nɩalɩŋ kala ba mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ. Ba tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ woruŋ a tɩŋ wʋzɔmɔ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa pɩ Devit arɩ Solomoŋ arɩ ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa.
La TƖƖNA bɩra kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ Solomoŋ
11Solomoŋ sɩ saa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la arɩ ʋ kuoru dɩa dɛrɛ, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ ŋaa ba lɛ a dɛrɛ, 12bʋa kʋbala lɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagʋ tɩtaŋɩŋ, aŋ bʋl:
“Mɩ nɩɩ ŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ. Mɩ lɩɩsɛ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ ʋ ŋaa mɩ kʋŋ nɛ, lee-la nɩaa sɩ jaŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a pɩpɩmɛ.
13Dɩ mɩ nɛ pɔ dɩ duonuŋ sɩ nɩɩ, koo a leŋ dɩ hɔbɔ kʋ dii ma tinteeŋ, koo a leŋ dɩ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ kʋ jʋʋ mɩ nɩaa, 14dɩ mɩ nɩaa nɛ jaŋ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa muuri a sʋla chɩchɛmɛ, aŋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, mɩ hɛ mɩ jaŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ nɩɩ ba sʋla a joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba aŋ leŋ dɩ ba tinteeŋ fɩɛlɛ. 15Lɛɛlɛ mɩ jaŋ bibeŋ leriŋ deeŋ a jegile nɩɩ nʋʋkala Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɩmɛ, 16bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ lɩɩsɛ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ nɛ ʋ ŋaa mɩ kʋŋ dɩ ba zizilmi nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Mɩ tʋɔŋ arɩ mɩ sɩaa jaŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ bʋa na-kala.
17Ŋ-na Solomoŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ tomi arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ nyɩmma Devit fa sɩ tomi, a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ daga, a to mɩ niiriŋ arɩ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile, 18mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ, arɩ mɩ fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ mɩ dɩ ŋ nyɩmma Devit pɛgɛ ŋɩɩ, bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ sɩ, ‘Ŋ doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ didii kuoruŋ Iziral lɛ.’
19Ama dɩ ma nɛ vɩa mɩ niiriŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma aŋ mɩɩra mʋ tuto vesiŋ a kpʋkpaarɛba, 20ŋɩɩ-na, mɩ jaŋ kiri ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta tintee-la mɩ sɩ joŋo pɩma lɛ, aŋ vɩa mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa ʋ ŋaa mɩ kʋŋ dɩ ba zizilmi nɩmɛ a ta. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋtɔɔ, dɩ nɩaa mʋmɔŋ. 21Lɛɛlɛ-na mɩ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, ama dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa, nʋʋkala sɩ jaŋ to dɩa deeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ bɩbal jaŋ naʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaaʋ wʋkpuŋkpere dɩ ʋ pɩɛsɛ, ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ La TƖƖNA ŋaa tinteeŋ deeŋ arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ ŋ-la?’ 22Nɩaa jaŋ bʋla pɩba, ‘Ba vɩa dɩ ba to ba TƖƖNA, ba nyɩmmaba Wɩa sɩ kɛmba kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ, aŋ mɩɩra tuto vesiŋ a kpʋkpaarɛba, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ joŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ deemba kala ŋaa ba lɛ.’ ”

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 8
Content:
Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Solomoŋ sɩ ŋaa
1Jɩsɩŋ mara nɛ Solomoŋ fa joŋ a saa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la arɩ ʋ kuoru dɩa. 2Kuoro Solomoŋ fa bɩra wasa saa tabiisi-la Hiram sɩ joŋo pʋ nɛ a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hɔŋ ba lɛ. 3Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ mʋ yuo dii taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hamaf Zoba. 4Ʋ bɩra saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tadɩmɔ sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ arɩ tabala-la lɛ ba sɩɩ bil kɩaa ʋ sɩ saa Hamaf tinteeŋ lɛ. 5Solomoŋ fa bɩra wasa saa tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf Horoŋ sɩ hɛ nyuŋ arɩ Bɛf Horoŋ sɛmɛ-la sɩ hɛ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ a saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli a hɛ boi-niiree arɩ daa-doloo ba sɩ jaŋ kaa tʋtɔ. 6Ʋ bɩra saa taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baalaf, a pɛ tasɩ-la kala lɛ ʋ sɩ saa ʋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩ-bilee arɩ tabala-la lɛ ʋ janɩŋ arɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba sɩɩ chɩŋ. Ʋ saa dɩa na-kala ʋ sɩ cho nɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ arɩ Lɛbanɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ arɩ lere-la kala ʋ sɩɩ beŋ lɛ.
7Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ ka tintee-la lɛ nɛ ŋaa: Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa, Hivi tɩŋŋaa arɩ Jebus tɩŋŋaa (nɩaa deemba fa bɩ Iziral tɩmma ŋaa). 8Nɩalɩŋ doho nɩkaana-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ bɩ kpʋa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba nɛ Solomoŋ leŋ ba ŋaa ʋ yosuŋ ʋ fʋga hɛ ba tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa, arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. 9Ama Solomoŋ fa bɩ leŋe Iziral tɩɩna kala ŋaa ʋ yomo a tɩtɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ba nɛ fa ŋaa ʋ laalɩyuoroo, ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ torukoba-la vɩvɛŋ. 10Ba nɛ fa bɩra ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii Solomoŋ sɩ lɩɩsa ba bibeŋ tɩntɩnna-la.
11Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ kɛŋ ʋ haala sɩ ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro tolo lɩɩ Devit tabal-la lɛ a kɔ kuoru dɩa-la ʋ sɩ saa pʋ, aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ haala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Devit kuoru dɩa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la fa hɛ tabal-la lɛ nɛ, lee na-kala ʋ sɩ hɛ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.”
12Solomoŋ yie vɛnɛ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ koru-la ʋ sɩ saa nyuŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA lɛ nɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la zawʋra sɩpaaŋ. 13Ʋ fa sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto sɩ daga dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa tapʋlɩɩ kala nɛ: Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele arɩ gbiele-la batori ba sɩ yie vɛnɛɛ gbieli, boroboro sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ gbiele, yɔɔsʋŋ gbiele arɩ lɛŋŋɛɛ gbiele. 14Solomoŋ fa to wɩalɩŋ ʋ nyɩmma Devit sɩ dagʋ nɛ, a dagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ba sɩ kaa kpaa bugoo ba chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa tapʋlɩɩ kala. Ʋ leŋ Levi doho nɩaa laa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩpaaŋ ba yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa chɛɛ kala, ʋ bɩra dagɛ nɩalɩŋ ma ba sɩ kaa kpaa bugoo ba pʋpɔ boi-balaa arɩ Wɩa tɩntɩnna Devit sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. 15Ba fa bɩ wɩalɩŋ kuoro Devit sɩ daga a tɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa lɛ koo Levi doho nɩaa lɛ dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa kʋŋkala lɛ yeŋŋe, a pɛ ba chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩ-bilee wɩaa lɛ.
16Wɩalɩŋ kala Solomoŋ fa sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ ŋaa, ʋ ŋaa ba kala nɛ a chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la ba sɩ suomo bil La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la gentine a kaa mʋ ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba saa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la dɛrɛ.
17Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ sii mʋ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛzɩɔŋ Geba arɩ Ɛlaf sɩ hɛ Ɛdɔm tinteeŋ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ niiŋ. 18Hiram joŋ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ a tɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ lɩɩŋ woruŋ. Ba pɛ Solomoŋ nɩaa lɛ ba duori lɩɩŋ a mʋ tintee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ofi a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ yi kilo bʋɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ a kaa mɩɩra kʋ pɩ kuoro Solomoŋ.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 9
Content:
Sɩɩba ha-kuoru kʋbala kɔ Solomoŋ teeŋ
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal kʋbala sɩ dii kuoruŋ Sɩɩba tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ Solomoŋ yɩrɩŋ sɩɩ sii. Ʋ sii kɔ Jerusalɛm dɩ ʋ magɩsʋ a pɩɛsʋ wɩaa sɩ hɛyɛ. Ʋ sɩɩ kɔ, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa yʋgɛ nɛ ba jɩl bʋntaŋŋaba a chʋŋ tegisiŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma, arɩ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ yʋga arɩ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa yalɩŋ sɩ hɛyɛ a kaa kɔ Solomoŋ teeŋ. Ʋ sɩ kɔ, ʋ joŋ wɩɩ na-kala ʋ sɩ kɛnɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ a pɩɛsɛ Solomoŋ. 2Solomoŋ ma chaarɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ pɩɛsa sɩaa. Wɩalɩŋ kʋŋkala fa bɩ wʋhaa ŋaa Solomoŋ teeŋ. 3Sɩɩba kuoru-la sɩ na wʋjɩmɩɩ-la Solomoŋ sɩ kɛnɛ arɩ ʋ kuoru dɩa-la ʋ sɩ saa, 4kʋdiile-la ʋ sɩɩ dii, dɩɩsɩ-la ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ sɩɩ jʋʋ, arɩ gɛnnɩ-la ʋ tɩntɩnnaa sɩɩ laalʋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kori ʋ nyʋnyʋalʋsʋŋ arɩ gɛnnɩ-la ba sɩɩ laalʋ, arɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la Solomoŋ sɩ sʋla La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, ʋ sɩaa biri.
5Ʋ bʋla pɩ kuoro Solomoŋ, “Mɩ sɩ hɛ mɩ tinteeŋ lɛ aŋ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa arɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la ŋ sɩ kɛnɛ, sɛnɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. 6Ama mɩ fa bɩ laa dii, see mɩ tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ sɩ na ŋ-la. Mɩ paala bɩ ŋ wɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma nɩa. Ŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ yʋga kɩɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ nɩa nɛ. 7Ŋ nɩaa ŋaa nyu-sɩŋ tɩmma nɛ. Ŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ bʋa na-kala ŋaa tʋɔtɔrɛ tɩmma nɛ, ba sɩ jaŋ nɩnɩɩ ŋ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la. 8Mɩɩ dɛnnɛ ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa, ʋ tʋɔŋ sɩ tɔrɛ ŋ nyuŋ, ʋ leŋ ŋ dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoruŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. A tɩŋ ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ cho Iziral tɩŋŋaa aa chɛ dɩ ʋ pɔba a kaa mʋ wuu nɛ tɩɩ ʋ joŋuŋ ŋ ŋaa ba kuoro, dɩ ŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔpʋla a bemba.”
9Ŋɩɩ nɛ haal-la sɩ ŋaa Sɩɩba kuoro joŋ sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ kɩɩ kilo bʋɩ banɛsɛ a pɩ Solomoŋ, arɩ tegisiŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma a yʋgɛ woruŋ arɩ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa. Nʋʋkala ha bɩ tegisi-la doho kaa kʋ pɩ kuoro Solomoŋ a magɛ kɩalɩŋ Sɩɩba kuoro sɩ joŋo pʋ.
10Ŋɩɩ nɛ Hiram arɩ Solomoŋ tɩntɩnnaa kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ lɩɩ Ofi tinteeŋ kɔ, a pɛ daasɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ woruŋ arɩ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa. 11(Kuoro kɛŋ daa-zɔmɔ-la nɛ a ŋaa lusuŋ-chol-sɩaa a hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la arɩ ʋ kuoru dɩa lɛ, aŋ bɩra kɛmba ŋaa chenniŋ arɩ kɔnɛba a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa. Ba ha maachie kala bɩra bɩ daa-zɔmɔ-la doho na Juda tinteeŋ lɛ.)
12Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Solomoŋ pɩ Sɩɩba kuoro kɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ pɩɛsaa chɛ. Kɩalɩŋ Solomoŋ sɩ joŋo pʋ nɛ kɩɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kaa kʋ pɩ Solomoŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa mɩɩra mʋ ba tinteeŋ.
Solomoŋ dʋa
13Jɩna na-kala Solomoŋ yie laa sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ yi kilo bʋɩ mara arɩ batori nɛ. 14Lampoo-la bayalaa sɩ yie time pʋ-na bɩ pɛ. Arebia kuoroo kala arɩ Iziral tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ ma yie kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla kʋ pʋʋ nɛ.
15Kuoro Solomoŋ fa leŋe ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ a libi hɔɔtaalɩ-la ba sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ kʋjalaa zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ. Sɛlɩmɛ-la ba sɩ kaa libi ba kʋŋkala yuŋuŋ ŋaa kilo balɩpɛ nɛ. 16Ʋ bɩra leŋ ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ-la a libi hɔɔtaalɩ-la kʋbiisiŋ ma zɔɔ-batori. Sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo batori nɛ ba kaa libi ba ma kʋŋkala. Kuoro jomba a bil ʋ kuoru dɩa lɛ, lee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lɛbanɔŋ duuŋ.
17Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro leŋ ba kɛŋ batu-nyɩlɩŋ ŋaa kuoru kpasɩ-bal, aŋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ taara tɔ. 18Kuoru kpasa-la kɛŋ lusuŋ-chol sɩaa balɩdʋ nɛ. Ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa naasɩŋ dɩdaŋɩŋ a mɛrɛ ʋ lɛ. Kpasa-la sɛsɩŋ balɩa kala lɛ, nɩsaa dɩdaŋɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, ka kɩaa sɩ nagɛ naachigee balɩa chɩŋ a challɛ dɔŋɔ. 19Lusuŋ-chol sɩa-la balɩdʋ lɛ, kɩaa sɩ nagɛ naachigee fii arɩ balɩa chɩŋ ba sɛsɩŋ. Lusuŋ-chol sɩɩ kala niipiniŋ lɛ, balɩa hɛ nɩmɛ, dɔŋɔ chɩŋ nadiiŋ, dɔŋɔ ma chɩŋ nagʋa. Ba ha bɩ kuoru kpasa deeŋ doho ŋaa tintee dɔŋ kala lɛ. 20Kuoro Solomoŋ nyʋnyʋalʋsʋŋ kala, sɛlɩmɛ nɛ ba kaa ŋaa. Ʋ kuoru dɩa gbansɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ dɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lɛbanɔŋ duuŋ lɛ, sɛlɩmɛ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ba kaa ŋaa. Kʋŋkala fa tuo ba kɛŋ hɔpʋla ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ hɔpʋla fa bɩ yuŋuŋ kɛnɛ. 21Kuoro fa kɛŋ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ ma nɛ. Hiram tɩntɩnnaa kaa duori lɩɩŋ mʋmʋ bayalɩŋ. Jɩsɩŋ batori na-kala ba yie mɩɩra kɔ bala nɛ, a chʋŋ sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, batu-nyɩlaa, ŋmaŋŋaa arɩ fɔsʋŋ.
22Kuoro Solomoŋ nɛ fa kɛŋ kɩaa arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ a kɩɩ kuoru kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ. 23Dʋnɩa kuoroo kala fa cho dɩ ba kʋ jegile nɩɩ Solomoŋ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pʋ nɛ. 24Jɩna kala, nʋʋ na-kala sɩ kɔ dɩ ʋ na Solomoŋ yie kɛŋ kɩaa nɛ kʋ dii zile pʋ: hɔpʋla kɩaa, sɛlɩmɛ kɩaa, gɛnnɩŋ, laalɩyuori kɩaa arɩ tegisiŋ, janɩŋ arɩ kakusuŋ.
25Solomoŋ fa kɛŋ ja-dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba dɩɩsɩŋ bʋɩ banɛsɛ nɛ. Janɩŋ ma bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩa, ʋ joŋo bil tabala-la lɛ ʋ sɩɩ bil ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma hɛ ʋ teeŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. 26Solomoŋ nɛ faa beŋ kuorusu-la kala a chɩŋ Yufireti fuo-la lɛ a kaa mʋ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tinteeŋ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ bʋa. 27Bʋa-la lɛ Solomoŋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ, hɔpʋla fa pʋrɩga nɛ woruŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a nagɛ tabɩaa, kuolu daasɩŋ ma pʋrɩgɛ woruŋ a nagɛ tutogusuŋ sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ nyuŋ. 28Solomoŋ fa yie leŋ ʋ bayalaa mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ arɩ tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ nɛ a yɔɔ ʋ janɩŋ.
Solomoŋ sʋba
29Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Solomoŋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa a chɩŋ ʋ dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa deemba tenniŋ lɛ: Netaŋ, Ahija sɩ lɩɩ Sɩlɔ arɩ Ido sɩ ŋaa Wɩa sɩɩ-naara, ʋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam lɛ ŋɩɩ. 30Kuoro Solomoŋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ, a beŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ. 31Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi Jerusalɛm lɛ, Devit tabal-la, ka ʋ nanʋala Rihobuam dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 10
Content:
Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɩɩ Rihobuam harɩŋ
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rihobuam sii mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛkɛm. Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala fa mʋ nɩmɛ nɛ dɩ ba bilu kuoruŋ. 2Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, bʋa-la lɛ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ fá Solomoŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a mʋ hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mɩɩra lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kɔ. 3Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tɩma yɩrɛ Jerobuam, ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala to dɔŋɔ a mʋ Rihobuam leriŋ a bʋla pʋ: 4“Ŋ nyɩmma fa fʋgɛla hɛ nɛ la tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ woruŋ, ama dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ duoru-la doho, ŋɩɩ-na la jaŋ sɛɩ a toŋ a tɩma pɩpɩŋ.”
5Rihobuam bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ tapʋl tori chɛɛŋ.” Nɩalɩŋ mɩɩra viiri. 6Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Rihobuam pɩɛsɛ nɩhɩasɩ-la fa sɩ tɩma pɩ ʋ nyɩmma Solomoŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa lɛ, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ dagɛmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩ nɩaa deemba?”
7Nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ, “Dɩ ŋ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ nɩaa deemba toŋ a tɩma pɩpɩŋ, kɛŋ zile ba teeŋ a ŋaa wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ chɛ pɩba.”
8Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rihobuam vɩa wɩɩ-la nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ dagʋ, aŋ mɩɩra mʋ pɩɛsɛ bapʋɔsɩa-la sɩ ŋaa ʋ wielee aŋ lɛɛlɛ tɩma pʋpʋ. 9Ʋ pɩɛsɛba, “Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma ma kɛŋ dɩ ma bʋl? Wʋbɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ mɩ lɩɩsɛba tɩntɩŋ-duoru-la lɛ mɩ nyɩmma sɩ jomba hɛ?”
10Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bapʋɔsɩa-la bʋl, “Bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋmɛŋ ŋ teeŋ arɩ ŋ nenii-bie nɛ paala barɩma kɩɩ ŋ nyɩmma tɩŋa. (Ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, ʋ tʋɔŋ nɛ paala hɛyɛ kɩɩ ʋ nyɩmma.) 11Bʋla pɩba arɩ ŋ nyɩmma leŋe ba tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ nɛ, ama ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba wasa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ. Ŋ nyɩmma vɩɩrɛba arɩ kpaasa nɛ, ama ŋ-na jaŋ joŋ hɔɔnʋŋ a hɛ kpaasɩ-biee niiriŋ lɛ a kaa vɩɩrɛba.”
12Tapʋlaa batori harɩŋ, Jerobuam arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala mɩɩra kɔ Rihobuam teeŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ bʋla. 13Rihobuam vɩa wɩɩ-la nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ dagʋ, aŋ bʋl wɩaa kpɩa nɩalɩŋ lɛ arɩ baanɩŋ, 14aŋ to wɩɩ-la ʋ bapʋɔsɩa-la sɩ dagʋ a bʋl, “Mɩ nyɩmma leŋe ma tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ nɛ, ama mɩ-na jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma wasa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-duoruŋ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ nyɩmma vɩɩrɛma arɩ kpaasa nɛ, ama mɩ-na jaŋ joŋ hɔɔnʋŋ a hɛ kpaasɩ-bie-la niiriŋ lɛ a kaa vɩɩrɛma.” 15Wɩa faa chɛ dɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ to ʋ wʋlaabʋlla Ahija sɩ lɩɩ Sɩlɔ lɛ a bʋla pɩ Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam kʋ ŋaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ kuoro bɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la niiŋ jegile nɩɩ ŋɩɩ.
16Iziral tɩmma-la kala sɩ na dɩ kuoro bɩ ba teeŋ jegile nɩɩ, ba ma bʋl: “La dɩ Jesi nanʋala Devit doho nɩaa bɩ wɩɩ pɛ. Iziral tɩmma, má leŋ dɩ la mɩɩra mʋ la dɩɩsɩŋ, ka dɩ Rihobuam bibeŋ ʋ nɩaa.”
Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ. 17Ama Iziral tɩmma-la fa sɩ hɔŋ tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ, Rihobuam nɛ faa bemba.
18Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Rihobuam tɩŋ Adoniram, nɩɩ-la fa sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ fʋga hɛ ba tɩtɩŋ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ, ama Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋ lɩɩ yagʋ arɩ tabɩaa ʋ sʋʋ. Ka kuoro Rihobuam-na wuo fá a mʋ jʋʋ ʋ laalɩŋ jaaba toruko a fá mʋ Jerusalɛm. 19A chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ a kaa kɔ, Iziral doho doho-la kala sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa arɩ Devit doho nɩaa bɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ wuo arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 11
Content:
1Rihobuam sɩ mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm, ʋ yɩrɛ Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ hɛ dɔŋɔ, dɩ ba mʋ yuo Iziral tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ a bɩra laa kuorii-la pɩ Rihobuam.
2Ama La TƖƖNA fa bʋla pɩ Sɛmaaya sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ, 3“Bʋla pɩ Solomoŋ nanʋala Rihobuam sɩ ŋaa Juda kuoro arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ, 4arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ, ‘Ma pʋpɔ má sɩ́ ma naambiiriŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa yuo. Má mʋ ma dɩɩsɩŋ, mɩ nɛ leŋe wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa.’ ” Ba sɛɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ a mɩɩrɛ a bɩ Jerobuam yuo.
Rihobuam saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli Juda tasɩŋ
5Rihobuam hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ a saa tasɩŋ deemba ba ŋaa ʋ dɩ-duoruŋ dɩ ʋ kaa pɔ Juda tinteeŋ. Tasɩ-la nɛ ŋ-la: 6Bɛtɩlɛhɛm, Ɛtam, Tɛkʋa, 7Bɛf Zuu, Soko, Adulam, 8Gaf, Marɛsa, Zɩf, 9Adorem, Lakɩs, Azɛka 10Zora, Aɩjalɔŋ arɩ Hɛbʋrɔŋ. Tasɩŋ deemba nɛ ba fa saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli, Juda tinteeŋ arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ. 11Ʋ leŋe dɩ-duoru-la dol nɛ woruŋ, aŋ leŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ hɛ ba kʋŋkala lɛ. Ʋ joŋ kʋdiilee, olif nʋʋŋ arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ a bil tasɩ-la lɛ, 12arɩ hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoro sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori-hɛŋŋɛɛ a pɛ tiŋŋee lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa a wuo beŋ Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ.
13Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ hɛ Iziral doho doho-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa tʋɔŋ fa chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ nɛ. 14Levi doho nɩaa fa vɩa ba pʋsʋŋ dɩ-diilee arɩ ba dʋa kala ta nɛ aŋ kɔ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm a tɩŋ Jerobuam arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ sɩ vɩaba arɩ ba dee bɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ŋaa. 15Jerobuam lɩɩsɛ nɩaa sɩ bɩ Levi doho nɩaa ŋaa a hɛ veŋ-kpaarɛ lere-la, aŋ lɩɩsɛ dɔnsʋŋ ma ba kpʋkpaarɛ tɔmɔ-la ba sɩ mɛ ba nagɛ bʋʋnaa arɩ nɛ-biisiŋ. 16Iziral tɩmma-la kala sɩ kɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ a tuto La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa to Levi doho nɩalɩŋ harɩŋ a mʋ Jerusalɛm dɩ ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ ba TƖƖNA ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa. 17Ba fa pɛ Solomoŋ nanʋala Rihobuam lɛ nɛ jɩsɩŋ batori a leŋ Juda tinteeŋ chaasa kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ. Ba fa to Rihobuam niiŋ nɛ woruŋ arɩ ba fa sɩ to Devit arɩ Solomoŋ niiŋ ŋɩɩ.
Rihobuam dɩa nɩaa
18Rihobuam fa jaa Mahalaf nɛ, ʋ nyɩmma nɛ Jɛrɩmɔf sɩ ŋaa Devit nanʋala. Mahalaf naaŋ nɛ Abɩhɛɛl sɩ ŋaa Ɛlɩab tolo. Jesi ma nihi-lɩɛrɛ nɛ fa Mahalaf. 19Rihobuam arɩ Mahalaf fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la: Jeyus, Sɛmarɩa arɩ Zaham. 20Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rihobuam bɩra jaa Abɩsalɔm tolo Maaka, ba hambolibiisiŋ nɛ fa ŋ-la: Abija, Ataɩ, Ziza arɩ Sɛlɔmɩf. 21Rihobuam fa cho ʋ haala Maaka sɩ ŋaa Abɩsalɔm tolo a kɩɩ ʋ haalaa kala, kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ jaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bile aŋ bɩ jaa. Ʋ haalaa fa ŋaa fii arɩ chori nɛ, kɩalɩŋ ma naasɩŋ ʋ sɩ bɩ to ma ŋaa mahɩŋ batori. Ʋ hambolibiisiŋ ŋaa mara arɩ chori nɛ, ʋ hantolibiisiŋ ma ŋaa mahɩŋ batori.
22Rihobuam lɩɩsɛ Maaka nanʋala Abija nɛ ʋ ŋaa ʋ kuoru-bii-hɩaŋ ʋ naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ nɛ laa ʋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ. 23Rihobuam fa ŋaa wʋjɩnnɩ wɩɩ nɛ, a kɛŋ ʋ hambolibiisi-la dɔnsʋŋ a pɩsa hɛ Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ arɩ tabala-la kala ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli lɛ ba bibeŋ. Ʋ fa pɩba kɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ a jaa haalaa ma yʋgɛ a pɩba.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 12
Content:
Sɩsak kʋ yuo Jerusalɛm
1Rihobuam sɩ dii kuoruŋ, ʋ kuoruŋ chaasa chɩŋ a kɛŋ doluŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala sɩ hɛ ʋ teeŋ vɩa dɩ ba to La TƖƖNA wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto. 2A tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ La TƖƖNA to arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro Sɩsak kʋ yuo Jerusalɛm. Rihobuam sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-nɔŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. 3Sɩsak fa kɛŋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba bʋɩ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ, ja-jɩllaa ma bʋɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ laalɩyuoroo sɩ yʋga nʋʋ bɩ ba wuo dɩɩsɛ a lɩɩ tasɩŋ deemba: Libiya, Sʋkɔf arɩ Kus. 4Ʋ fa yuo dii Juda tinteeŋ tabala-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli nɛ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Jerusalɛm.
5Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la ba sɩ yɩrɛ Sɛmaaya kɔ Rihobuam arɩ Juda sɩpaalaara-la sɩ hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ teeŋ a tɩŋ ba sɩɩ fá Sɩsak wɩaa a bʋla pɩba, “Ŋ-la nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, ‘Má vɩamɛ nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ ma vɩama hɛ Sɩsak nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.’ ”
6Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral sɩpaalaaraa arɩ kuoro sɛɩ arɩ ba cheye nɛ aŋ bʋl, “La TƖƖNA kɩaa sɩma nɛ.”
7La TƖƖNA sɩ na dɩ ba sɛyɛ arɩ ba cheye nɛ, ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ wʋlaabʋlla Sɛmaaya, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ folo sɛɩ arɩ ba cheye nɛ, mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ cheiba, ama mɩ jaŋ laaba ta ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni. Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ a leŋ dɩ Sɩsak chei Jerusalɛm. 8Ama mɩ ha jaŋ leŋ dɩ Sɩsak yuo diiba a bibemba, dɩ ba to ŋɩɩ lɛ a jɩŋ arɩ ba sɩ tomi mɩ bibemba nɛ zɔmɔ a kɩɩ ba sɩ to dʋnɩa kuoroo ba bibemba.”
9Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ijipiti kuoro Sɩsak kʋ yuo Jerusalɛm, a paa sɩɩfɩaŋ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la arɩ kuoru dɩa kala lɛ. Ʋ pɛ paa Solomoŋ fa sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ libi hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ a kaa viiri. 10Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Rihobuam leŋ ba kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ libi hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ, a hɛ sɛlɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ paa nyuŋ lɛ. Ʋ joŋ kɩalɩŋ hɛ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ pɔ kuoru dɩa boiŋ niiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. 11Bʋa na-kala dɩ kuoro nɩɩ mʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ lee-la yie paa hɔɔtaalɩ-la ba sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ a to ʋ harɩŋ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa wɩaa dɛrɛ, ba bɩra mɩɩra kaa jʋʋ bil nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ dɩa lɛ.
12A tɩŋ Rihobuam sɩ bɩrɩma a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɩ La TƖƖNA, La TƖƖNA bɩra bɩ baanɩŋ na ʋ nyuŋ a cheyu dɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa Juda lɛ.
13Kuoro Rihobuam fa leŋe ʋ kuoruŋ chaasa chɩŋ nɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ kʋbala nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ balɩpɛ, tabal-la La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa Iziral doho doho kala tʋɔŋ dɩ ba zizilu nɩmɛ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Naama, a ŋaa Amɔŋ tɩɩna. 14Rihobuam fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa bɩ La TƖƖNA to arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala.
15Wɩalɩŋ Rihobuam sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, a chɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Sɛmaaya arɩ Wɩa sɩɩ-naara Ido tenniŋ lɛ. Ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ ba doho nɩaa wɩaa tʋɔŋ. Laalɩŋ fa hɛ Rihobuam arɩ Jerobuam pɛgɛ nɛ bʋa na-kala. 16Ŋɩɩ nɛ Rihobuam sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi Devit tabal-la lɛ ʋ nyɩmmaba tʋɔŋ, ka ʋ nanʋala Abija laa ʋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 13
Content:
Abija dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ
1Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam sɩ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, ʋ jɩ-fii arɩ chori lɛ nɛ Abija ma dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. 2Ʋ fa hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ batori nɛ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Maaka, Ʋrɩɛl sɩ ŋaa Gɩbɩa tɩɩna tolo. Laalɩŋ fa hɛ Abija arɩ Jerobuam pɛgɛ nɛ. 3Abija fa kɛŋ laalɩyuori-duoruŋ bʋɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ a mʋ dɩ ʋ yuo Jerobuam, ŋɩɩ nɛ Jerobuam ma kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuori-duoruŋ bʋɩ zɔlɔ chori a kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ.
4Abija fa chɩŋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zɛmarem sɩ hɛ Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ nɛ aŋ bʋl, “Jerobuam arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. 5Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa hɛ niiŋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ birige nɛ a joŋ Iziral kuoruŋ a pɩ Devit arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa a kaa mʋ wuu? 6Ama Nɛbat nanʋala Jerobuam ma fa sɩ ŋaa Devit nanʋala Solomoŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ dɔŋɔ vɩa ʋ nɩhɩaŋ kuoro Solomoŋ niiŋ nɛ. 7Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩtɔɔnʋŋ sii a chɩŋ Solomoŋ nanʋala Rihobuam lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ dɩ ʋ fa ŋaa hambie, ʋ fa bɩ wɩaa ma jɩŋ dɩ ʋ wuo kiriba.
8Lɛɛlɛ ŋ dɩ ŋ laalɩyuori-daŋ-la bɩɩna ma jaŋ wuo sii chɩŋ a yuo laa kuorii-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo hɛ Devit doho nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛɛ? Vesi-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ, sɛlɩmɛ nɛ Jerobuam kaa ŋaaba ba nagɛ nɛ-biisiŋ pɩma. 9Ma paala kiri Arɔŋ biiriŋ sɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa ta nɛ, aŋ chaarɛ ma tɩtɩa nɩaa arɩ tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Nʋʋ na-kala nɛ kɛŋ nɛ-bel-pɔrʋŋ arɩ pie-belliŋ balɩpɛ kaa kʋ pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta, ma yie lɩɩsʋ nɛ ʋ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ vesi-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa ŋaa.
10Ama, La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa la-na Wɩa, la bɩ ʋ vɩa. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ŋaa Arɔŋ biiriŋ, Levi doho nɩaa ma nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛ ba lɛ ba tɩtɩŋ. 11Tapʋlɩɩ na-kala chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ dɩdaanɩŋ, ba nɛ yie ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma a pɩ La TƖƖNA. Ba yie joŋ boroboro a daŋ teebʋl-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ, aŋ nyɩgɛ chaana-la ma sɩ sagɛ sɛlɩmɛ kʋ-la nyuŋ dɩdaaŋ kala. Laa to wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ nɛ. Ama ma-na vɩaʋ nɛ. 12Wɩa hɛ la teeŋ nɛ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa la sɩpaalaara. Ʋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ ŋmʋʋ ba banyilliŋ a yɩrɛ laalɩŋ hɛ ma lɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa, má sɩ́ La TƖƖNA, ma nyɩmmaba Wɩa kaa yuo yuosuŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma bɩ jaŋ wuo yuo dii.”
13Dɩ Jerobuam fa leŋe ʋ laalɩyuoroo dɔnsʋŋ mʋ faa Juda tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo harɩŋ, ka ʋ ma tɩtɩa faa Juda nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ. 14Juda tɩŋŋaa ka jɩŋ dɩ laalɩyuoroo golliba, a hɛ ba sɩpaaŋ arɩ ba harɩŋ kala. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋmoo niiŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA. La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ŋmʋʋ ba banyilliŋ, 15ŋɩɩ nɛ Juda tɩŋŋaa ŋaa laalɩyuori goŋ. Ba sɩ ŋaa goŋ-la ŋɩɩ, Wɩa yuo dii Jerobuam arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo kala Abija arɩ Juda nɩaa sɩɩŋ lɛ. 16Iziral tɩmma-la fá Juda tɩŋŋaa sɩpaaŋ dɩ ba laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa leŋe ba kɛŋ doluŋ kɩɩba nɛ. 17Abija arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo fa bolimi Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ a kpʋ ba laalɩyuori duoruŋ bʋɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ. 18Juda nɩaa nɛ wuo Iziral nɩaa a yuo diiba chɛɛ-la, bɛɛ wɩaa ba joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ ba TƖƖNA, ba nyɩmmaba Wɩa lɛ nɛ.
19Abija arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kire to Jerobuam laalɩyuoroo harɩŋ a mʋ laa Iziral tabalaa deemba: Bɛtɛl, Jesana arɩ Ɛfʋrɔŋ, a pɛ tabiisi-la sɩ golliba lɛ. 20Jerobuam bɩra bɩ wuo laa doluŋ Abija kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ. Ka La TƖƖNA ŋmobu lo, ʋ sʋʋ.
21Ama Abija-na doluŋ fa wasa pʋŋa pɛ nɛ. Ʋ fa jaa haalaa fii arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ, a lʋl hambolibiisiŋ mara arɩ balɩa, hantolibiisiŋ ma fii arɩ balɩdʋ.
22Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Abija sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Ido tenniŋ tʋɔŋ.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 14
Content:
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abija sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi Devit tabal-la lɛ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Asa dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. Asa kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ, fɩɛlɩŋ fa hɛ ba tinteeŋ lɛ jɩsɩŋ fii nɛ.
Asa dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ
2Asa fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ, a tuto ba bʋa lɛ ʋ Tɩɩna Wɩa teeŋ. 3Ʋ fa chei vʋɩyaa korunuŋ arɩ vʋɩyaa dɩ-kpaaraa nɛ, a yɛrɛ vʋɩyaa tabɩaa, a keri vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩ-la ma lo. 4Asa fa leŋe Juda nɩaa to La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa nɛ, a tuto ʋ wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga. 5Ʋ fa chei vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa arɩ korunu-la lɛ ba sɩɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩŋ kala lɛ nɛ. Ʋ kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ, fɩɛlɩŋ fa hɛ ba tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ. 6Tintee-la fa sɩ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ saa tabalaa Juda tinteeŋ lɛ a saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli. Jɩsɩ-la lɛ nʋʋkala fa bɩ ʋ kaa yuo laalɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA leŋe ʋ na wiese nɛ.
7Asa fa bʋla pɩ Juda nɩaa, “Má leŋ dɩ la saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli tabalaa, a saa jebii-duduosuŋ, a hɛ boi-baalaa arɩ daa-doloo a wuo kaa tʋtɔ. Tintee-la ha ŋaa la kʋŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la to La TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ ʋ leŋ la na wiese sɛmɛ kala.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba saa kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ daga, a dʋa woruŋ. 8Asa laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ zɔɔ-batori nɛ fa lɩɩ Juda a kori hɔɔtaalɩ-la ba sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ kʋjalaa arɩ tiŋŋee, ka laalɩyuoro bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ ma lɩɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ a ma kori hɔɔtaalɩ-la ba sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ kʋbiisiŋ arɩ tosuŋ. Nɩaa deemba kala fa ŋaa laalɩyuori bɔɩ-duo tɩmma nɛ.
9Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zɛra sɩ ŋaa Kus tɩɩna kɛŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ bʋɩba arɩ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba zɔɔ-batori kɔ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Marɛsa dɩ ʋ chemba. 10Asa ma kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ʋ chemu, ba laalɩyuoro-la kala chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ Zɛfata fuonaaŋ lɛ a kpagɛ Marɛsa. 11Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asa sʋl ʋ Tɩɩna Wɩa a bʋl, “La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ jaŋ wuo pɛ nɩpʋgʋŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ yuo dii nɩduoŋ. La TƖƖNA Wɩa, pɛ la lɛ, la yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ nɛ la kɔ dɩ la yuo laalɩyuori-daŋ deeŋ. La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ la Wɩa, sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nuhuobiine yuo diiŋ.”
12Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA pɛ Asa arɩ Juda laalɩyuoroo lɛ ba yuo dii Kus tɩmma-la, ba fá. 13Asa arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kiriba a mʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gɛra. La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo fa chaasa kpʋ Kus tɩmma-la yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ, ba bɩra bɩ wɩɩkala wuo ŋaa. Ka Juda laalɩyuoroo paa ba kɩaa yʋgɛ woruŋ a kaa viiri. 14Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tabiisi-la ma kala sɩ golli Gɛra sɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ leŋ Juda laalɩyuoroo wuo mʋ yuo diiba mɔlɩɩ a paa ba kʋzɔmɔ-la kala ba sɩɩ chɛ tasɩ-la lɛ a kaa viiri. 15Ba bɩra mʋ yuo dii kʋdaaraa ma bugoo lɛ a laa piesee, bʋʋnaa arɩ bʋntaŋŋaba a yʋgɛ woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 15
Content:
Asa kɛŋ wɩaa bɩrɩmɛ
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa dɩma kʋ jʋʋ Ɔdɛd nanʋala Azarɩa. 2Ʋ lɩɩ Asa teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Kuoro Asa, ŋ dɩ Juda doho nɩaa arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa kala, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ. La TƖƖNA jaŋ chɩna gbɛrɛma dɩ ma nɛ chɩna gbɛrʋ. Dɩ ma nɛ chɛʋ, ma jaŋ naʋ ma, ama dɩ ma nɛ vɩaʋ, ʋ ma jaŋ vɩama ta. 3Ʋ fa diene kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ bɩ Wɩɩ-tɩtɩɩ-la to, a bɩ nʋʋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ ma kɛnɛ dɩ ʋ dagɛba Wɩa wombiee ʋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto. 4Ama dɩ hɛɛŋ nɛ jʋʋba, ba yie mɩɩra mʋ La TƖƖNA, Iziral Wɩa teeŋ a chɛ naʋ. 5Bʋa-la lɛ wombiiŋ vɛnɩŋ fa kɛŋ bɔɩ-joŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa tinteeŋ kala fa vʋgʋma nɛ. 6Tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa fa yie sii mʋ yuo tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa nɛ, tabalɩŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa ma yie mʋ yuo tabalɩŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa, Wɩa nɛ faa walɩmɛba ba nɩna hɛɛŋ. 7Ama ma-na, má kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ. Wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa, ma jaŋ na ba nyʋʋrʋŋ.”
8Asa sɩ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba Ɔdɛd nanʋala Azarɩa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ-la sɩ bʋla, ʋ nyuŋ nyaasɛ. Ʋ chei tɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ arɩ tasɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ yuo laa Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ. Ʋ wasa bɩrɩmɛ La TƖƖNA koru-la sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la zawʋra sɩpaaŋ.
9Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ yɩrɛ Juda nɩaa, Bɛnjamɩŋ nɩaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Efirem, Manasɛ nɩaa arɩ Simioŋ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ guoli ba tʋɔŋ. Nɩalɩŋ fa yʋga nɛ woruŋ a lɩɩ Iziral tinteeŋ a kɔ ʋ teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba na dɩ La TƖƖNA chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ nɛ.
10Ba hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩ Asa sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ banɔŋ chɛŋ-tori tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. 11Tapʋlɩɩ-la, ba kɛsɛ nɛ-belliŋ zɔɔ-balɩpɛ, piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa ma zɔɔ-balɩpɛ a lɩɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo laa kaa lɩɩ Gɛra kɔ tʋɔŋ a kpʋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA. 12Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ arɩ ba jaŋ to La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa arɩ ba tʋɔŋ arɩ ba wɩɩwɩɩ kala. 13Ba sɛɩ arɩ nʋʋ na-kala nɛ vɩa dɩ ʋ to La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ, dɩ tɩɩna ŋaa nɩhɩaŋ koo hambie, baal koo haal. 14Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ niiŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA arɩ ba jaŋ tou, aŋ faasa ŋaa goŋ, a ŋmʋʋ banyilliŋ arɩ nyilliŋ. 15Juda nɩaa tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ hɛ nii-la arɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala. Ba chɛ La TƖƖNA arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, ʋ laa ba sʋla a leŋ ba na wiese ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɩsɩŋ lɛ.
16Kuoro Asa nahɩma Maaka nɛ fa paala ŋaa haalaa kuoro ʋ kaa laa, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ pɛ veŋ-haal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daaŋ a kpʋkpaarɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asa keri daa-la lo a bori ʋ kala a kaa mʋ Kɩdɩrɔŋ fuonaaŋ a nyɩgɛ. 17Asa fa bɩ vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa kala cheye Iziral lɛ, ama ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ ʋ chaasa to La TƖƖNA nɛ. 18Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ paa hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ nyɩmma fa sɩ joŋo pɩ La TƖƖNA a kaa kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ.
19Ba fa bɩra bɩ laalɩŋ yuo deeŋ deeŋ a kaa mʋ yi Asa sɩ dii kuoruŋ jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ lɛ.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 16
Content:
Wɩalɩŋ Asa sɩ to harɩŋ ŋaa
1Asa sɩ dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩdʋ lɛ, Iziral kuoro Baasa sii mʋ yuo Juda nɩaa, a chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ saa kɛrɛ golli taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rama, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ Juda kuoro Asa leriŋ lɩɩ mʋ lee koo a kʋ jʋʋ nɩmɛ.
2Ŋɩɩ nɛ Asa sii paa warɩpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la sɩ hɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ arɩ ʋ kuoru dɩa lɛ, a joŋo tɩŋ ba kaa mʋ pɩ Siiria tinteeŋ kuoro Bɛŋ-Hadad sɩ hɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ aŋ bʋla pʋ, 3“Leŋ dɩ mɩ dɩŋ pɛ niiŋ a ŋaa kʋbala, arɩ la nyɩmmaba fa sɩ pɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ. Mɩ joŋ warɩpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ pa nɛ dɩ ba kaa kʋ pɩŋ chɔgɩta. Leŋ ŋ dɩ Iziral kuoro Baasa pɛgɛ chei dɩ ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo lɩɩ mɩ tinteeŋ lɛ.”
4Bɛŋ-Hadad sɛɩ wɩɩ-la kuoro Asa sɩ bʋla a leŋ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ba nɩaa mʋ yuo Iziral tasɩŋ. Ba yuo dii Ɩjɔŋ, Daŋ, Abɛl Bɛf Maaka arɩ Nafɩtalɩ tinteeŋ tabala-la kala lɛ ba sɩɩ bil kɩaa. 5Baasa sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ʋ leŋ Rama saanɩŋ ta. 6Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Asa ŋaa ba bʋla pɩ Juda nɩaa kala ba paa tabɩa-la arɩ daasɩ-la Baasa fa sɩ kaa sɩsaa dɩ ʋ golli Rama. Ba nɛ kuoro Asa kaa saa golli tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Geba arɩ Mɩzɩpa.
7Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩɩ-naara Hanani kɔ Juda kuoro Asa teeŋ a bʋla pʋ, “A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ Siiria kuoro lɛ aŋ vɩa ŋ Tɩɩna Wɩa, ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ŋ wuo yuo dii Siiria kuoro laalɩyuoroo. 8Kus arɩ Libiya laalɩyuoroo fa dolie nɛ woruŋ, a kɛŋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba arɩ ja-jɩllaa ma a yʋgɛ, ama ŋ sɩ joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ, ʋ leŋe ŋ yuo diiba nɛ. 9La TƖƖNA sɩaa hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɛ a bee chɩchɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tou arɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala dɩ ʋ pɩba doluŋ. Nɩyaarɛ wɩɩ nɛ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. A chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ kaa mʋ ŋ dɩ laalɩŋ puu dɔŋɔ nɛ.”
10Asa sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ baanɩŋ chaasa sii woruŋ, ʋ kɛŋ Hanani Wɩa sɩɩ-naarʋ-la tɔ dɩa. Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ Asa fa chaasa dɔgɩsɛ ʋ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ woruŋ.
11Wɩalɩŋ kala Asa sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, a chɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Juda arɩ Iziral kuoroo wʋŋaalaa tenniŋ tʋɔŋ. 12Asa sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ nibi lɛ, naasɩŋ nyanyalɩɩ kʋbala ŋmobu bil. Ʋ nyanyalɩɩ-la fa jʋʋ ʋ lɛ nɛ woruŋ, ama ʋ vɩa dɩ ʋ sʋl La TƖƖNA nɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ ʋ lɛ, aŋ joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ daaluŋ-ŋaaraa lɛ. 13Asa sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ kʋbala lɛ nɛ ʋ sʋʋ. 14Ba joŋu hugi bʋa-la ʋ sɩ lu bil ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ Devit tabal-la lɛ. Ba joŋ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ arɩ tʋlaalɩɩba nɛ a mɩsʋ aŋ joŋu hugi, aŋ hɛ nyiŋ-balɩŋ a yel ʋ yoho.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 17
Content:
Jehosafat dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehosafat dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyɩmma Asa nyuŋ lɛ, a chaasa kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ woruŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ́ wuo yuoba. 2Ʋ joŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo hɛhɛ Juda tabala-la kala lɛ ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli nɛ, a leŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo ŋmoo bugoo Juda arɩ Efirem tasɩ-la ʋ nyɩmma Asa sɩ yuo laa lɛ.
3La TƖƖNA fa chɩŋ Jehosafat harɩŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa, ʋ sɩ buumo dii kuoruŋ, ʋ fa to ʋ nyɩmma Devit naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal kpaara. 4Ʋ to ʋ nyɩmma Wɩa wombiee arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga nɛ, aŋ vɩa vene-la Iziral kuoroo fa sɩɩ kpaarʋ. 5Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ Jehosafat kuoruŋ chaasa chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. Juda nɩaa kala kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ ŋaa zile pʋpʋ. Ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ chaasa kɛŋ dʋa woruŋ, nɩaa ma zizilu. 6Ʋ fa kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala nɛ a to La TƖƖNA wombiee woruŋ. Ʋ chei vesiŋ dɩ-kpaara-la kala sɩ hɛ dundolluŋ nyuŋ nɛ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ, a bori vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ ma.
7Jehosafat sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-tori lɛ, ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ deemba: Bɛŋ-Hel, Obadaaya, Zɛkarɩya, Nɛtanɛl arɩ Mɩkaaya dɩ ba mʋ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩŋ a dagɛ nɩaa. 8Levi doho nɩaa nibi arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩaa balɩa nɛ fa to ba harɩŋ. Levi doho nɩalɩŋ nɛ fa: Sɛmaaya, Nɛtanɩa, Zɛbadɩa, Asahɛl, Sɛmɩramɔf, Jehonataŋ, Adonija, Tobija arɩ Tob-Adonija, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma nɛ fa Ɛlɩsama arɩ Jehoram. 9Ba fa joŋ Wɩa wombiiŋ ʋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto teŋ-la nɛ a kaa gɔllɛ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩŋ kala, a dagɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ wɩaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ.
10La TƖƖNA fa leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteye-la sɩ golli Juda nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba bɩ kuoro Jehosafat kaa yuo laalɩŋ. 11Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ kɛŋ warɩpʋla yʋgɛ nɛ arɩ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kaa kʋ tiŋ lampoo pɩ Jehosafat. Arab tɩŋŋaa ma kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ kaa kʋ pʋ: piesee bʋɩ balɩpɛ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩpɛ, bʋʋnaa ma bʋɩ balɩpɛ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩpɛ.
12Jehosafat doluŋ wasa pʋŋa pɛ woruŋ, ʋ saa dɩɩ-duoruŋ arɩ tabala-la lɛ ʋ sɩɩ bil kɩaa Juda lɛ 13a joŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ a bil tasɩ-la lɛ. Ʋ fa bɩra joŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ woruŋ a bil Jerusalɛm lɛ. 14Ba sɩ kɛmba hɛ nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa a chɩŋ Juda laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩba nɛ fa ŋ-la: Adɩna faa beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ zɔɔ-batori nɛ, 15nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩga nɛ Jehohanaŋ, ʋ ma faa beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩa mahɩŋ banɛsɛ nɛ, 16Zikiri nanʋala Amasɩa ma nɛ tɩga, ʋ-na tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ sɛɩ dɩ ʋ tɩma pɩ La TƖƖNA, ʋ ma faa beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩa nɛ. 17Bɛnjamɩŋ nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ, Ɛlɩada sɩ ŋaa laalɩyuori babiibal, ʋ ma faa beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩa sɩ nyɩgɩla arɩ tosuŋ a kori hɔ-taalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ. 18Nɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋaa Jehozabad, ʋ ma faa beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩ zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ sɩ nyɩgɩla a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ nɛ. 19Nɩaa deemba nɛ fa tɩma pɩ kuoro Jerusalɛm lɛ, a pɛ laalɩyuoro-la ʋ sɩ leŋe ba hɛ Juda tabala-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli lɛ.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 18
Content:
Mɩkaaya bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Ahab lɛ
1Juda tinteeŋ kuoro Jehosafat sɩ kʋ kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ, nɩaa zizilu, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa mʋ mɛrɛ Iziral kuoro Ahab lɛ a leŋ ʋ nanʋala jaa Ahab tolo. 2Jɩsɩŋ baŋmɛnɛ harɩŋ, Jehosafat sii mʋ Samarɩa dɩ ʋ na Iziral kuoro Ahab. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahab kpʋ piesee arɩ nɛsɩŋ yʋgɛ woruŋ a hʋɔrɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa, aŋ yigu hɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ yuo taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ramɔf Gɩlɩad. 3Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral kuoro Ahab pɩɛsɛ Juda kuoro Jehosafat, “Ŋ jaŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ la mʋ yuo Ramɔf Gɩlɩad?” Jehosafat bʋla pɩ Iziral kuoro, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ, mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa ma kɛŋ la tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. La jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ dɩ la mʋ yuo laal-la. 4Ama leŋ dɩ la laa sɩpaaŋ pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA na.”
5Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahab yɩrɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa zɔɔ-banɛsɛ a pɩɛsɛba, “Mɩ mʋ yuo Ramɔf Gɩlɩad koo mɩ sɩ́ mʋ?” Ba bʋl, “Mʋ yuou, Wɩa jaŋ joŋu hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.” 6Jehosafat bɩra pɩɛsɛ, “La TƖƖNA wʋlaabʋllʋ tuo daha dɩ la to ʋ lɛ a pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA naa?”
7Iziral kuoro Ahab bʋla pɩ Jehosafat, “Nʋʋ dɔŋ ha hɛ nɩmɛ la sɩ jaŋ wuo to ʋ lɛ a pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA na. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Mɩkaaya, a ŋaa Imila nanʋala. Ama mɩ bɛrʋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ha bɩ wʋzɔŋ kala bʋla pɩmɛ Wɩa doluŋ lɛ, see wʋbɔŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehosafat bʋl, “Kuoro, sɩ́ ŋɩɩ bʋl.”
8Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahab yɩrɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ dɔŋɔ a bʋl, “Mʋ kɛŋ Imila nanʋala Mɩkaaya kɔ daha lɛɛlɛ.”
9Ka Iziral kuoro arɩ Juda kuoro Jehosafat kala laalɛ ba kuori gɛnnɩŋ a hɔŋ ba kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ lɛ taha-la sɩ kpagɛ Samarɩa taŋ-la boi-baalɩŋ niiŋ. Wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la chɩŋ ba sɩpaaŋ a bʋbʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa. 10Wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la dɔŋɔ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Zedikaaya, a ŋaa Kɛnaana nanʋala. Ʋ fa kɛŋ hɔɔŋ libi banyilliŋ nɛ, ʋ kaa heele bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Kɩaa deemba nɛ ŋ jaŋ kaa tɩɩgɛ Siiria tɩŋŋaa kala kpʋ.’ ” 11Wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la kʋkaanaa ma kala bʋl ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa. Ba sɩ, “Mʋ yuo Ramɔf Gɩlɩad, ŋ jaŋ yuo diiu, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋu hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”
12Nɩɩ-la ba sɩ tɩma dɩ ʋ yɩrɛ Mɩkaaya bʋla pʋ, “Na, Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la bʋl wʋbala nɛ. Ba sɩ, ‘Kuoro jaŋ yuo dii.’ Dɩ ŋ nɛ mʋa, ŋ ma chɩŋ ba kʋa lɛ a bʋl ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa.”
13Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɩkaaya bʋl, “La TƖƖNA sɩ weye wɩaa, wɩɩ-la mɩ Wɩa sɩ bʋla, ʋ nɛ mɩ jaŋ bʋl.”
14Mɩkaaya sɩ kɔ, kuoro Ahab pɩɛsʋ, “La mʋ yuo taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ramɔf Gɩlɩad koo la sɩ́ mʋ?” Ʋ bʋl, “Má mʋ yuou. La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋu hɛ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”
15Kuoro Ahab bɩra pɩɛsʋ, “Naansɩɩŋ bʋŋmɛɛ nɛ maga dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋmɩɛsɛ aŋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ pɩmɛ La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ lɛ?”
16Ŋɩɩ nɛ Mɩkaaya bʋl, “Mɩ na Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala dɩ ba pɩsa su dundolluŋ nyuŋ, a nagɛ piesee sɩ bɩ pie-daara kɛnɛ, ka La TƖƖNA bʋl, ‘Nɩaa deemba bɩ sɩpaalaarʋ kɛnɛ. Leŋ dɩ ba mɩɩra mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.’ ”
17Kuoro Ahab bʋla pɩ Jehosafat, “Mɩ bɩ bʋla pɩŋ arɩ ʋ ha bɩ wʋzɔŋ kala sɩ jaŋ ŋaa bʋla pɩmɛ see wʋbɔŋ?”
18Mɩkaaya bɩra bʋl, “Má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla: Mɩ na La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ, ka ʋ tɩndaaraa chɩŋ ʋ nadiiŋ arɩ ʋ nagʋa. 19Ka La TƖƖNA pɩɛsɛ, ‘Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ mʋ nyɩsɛ Iziral kuoro Ahab hɛ dɩ ʋ mʋ yuo Ramɔf Gɩlɩad tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɩmɛ?’ Dɔnsʋŋ bʋl ŋ-la, dɔnsʋŋ ma bʋl wɩɩ dɔŋ. 20Ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, dɩma kʋbala kʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ a bʋl, ‘Mɩ jaŋ mʋ nyɩsʋ.’ La TƖƖNA pɩɛsʋ, ‘Ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ to?’ 21Dɩma-la bʋl, ‘Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ a hɛ ʋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bʋl wɩaa pʋpʋ niiŋ lɛ.’ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl, ‘Mʋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo nyɩsʋ.’ ”
22Mɩkaaya bʋl, “La TƖƖNA joŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ dɩma hɛ nɩaa deemba sɩ bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩŋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ. La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa bʋla arɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋŋ.”
23Ŋɩɩ nɛ Zedikaaya sɩ ŋaa Kɛnaana nanʋala mʋ fallɛ Mɩkaaya, aŋ pɩɛsʋ, “Bʋa bɛɛ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA dɩma-la lɩɩ mɩ lɛ, a kɔ ŋ teeŋ a bʋl wɩaa pɩŋ?”
24Mɩkaaya bʋl, “Tapʋlɩɩ-la ŋ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa jʋʋ faa dɩa sɩpaaŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ.”
25Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Ahab bʋl, “Má kɛŋ Mɩkaaya mɩɩra mʋ taŋ nɩhɩaŋ Amɔŋ arɩ mɩ nanʋala Jʋas teeŋ. 26Má bʋla pɩba arɩ ba laaʋ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa a pʋpʋ boroboro mʋa mʋa arɩ lɩɩŋ dʋndʋŋ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.”
Ba kpʋ Ahab Ramɔf Gɩlɩad lɛ
27Mɩkaaya bʋl, “Dɩ ŋ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa, ŋɩɩ-na, La TƖƖNA dee bɩ mɩ lɛ to a bʋl wɩaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ bɩra bʋl, “Ma nɩaa deemba kala, má magɩlɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla bil.” 28Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral kuoro arɩ Juda kuoro Jehosafat sii kɛŋ ba laalɩyuoroo mʋ dɩ ba yuo Ramɔf Gɩlɩad. 29Iziral kuoro bʋla pɩ Jehosafat, “Dɩ laalɩŋ nɛ suomo, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa bɩrɩmɛ a jʋʋ laalɩŋ tʋɔŋ, ama ŋ-na laalɛ ŋ kuoru gɛnnɩŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral kuoro kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa bɩrɩmɛ a jʋʋ laal-la tʋɔŋ.
30Siiria kuoro fa bʋla pɩ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba, “Má sɩ́ nʋʋkala yuo, see Iziral kuoro Ahab dʋndʋŋa.” 31Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩ na Jehosafat, ba bɩɩnɛ a bʋl, “Iziral kuoro Ahab nɛ ŋ-la.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bɩrɩmɛ dɩ ba yuou. Ama Jehosafat ŋmoo niiŋ, La TƖƖNA Wɩa pɛ ʋ lɛ a kiriba ba mɩɩrɛ. 32Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩ na dɩ Iziral kuoro dee, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba leŋu.
33Laal-la tʋɔŋ, laalɩyuoro-la dɔŋɔ yuo to-hɛmɩŋ bine, ʋ to Ahab laalɩyuori gɛrɩŋ pɛgɛ a jʋʋ kɛnʋ. Ʋ bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ toruko vɩvɛŋ, “Mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ a kɛmmɛ lɩɩ laal-la tʋɔŋ, ba bolimimi nɛ.” 34Tapʋlɩɩ-la kala laalɩŋ hoso nɛ woruŋ, ka kuoro hɔnɔ tɩɛnɛ a yelli ʋ toruko-la a bibeŋ Siiria tɩmma-la a kaa mʋ yi dɩdaanɩŋ. Wɩɩ-muluŋ tuu jʋjʋʋ dɩ ʋ sʋba.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 19
Content:
1Juda kuoro Jehosafat mɩɩra mʋ ʋ kuoru dɩa sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. 2Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa sɩɩ-naara Jehu, Hanani nanʋala mʋ naʋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Ŋ bɩɩna ʋ maga dɩ ŋ pɛ nɩbɔmʋŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛrɛ La TƖƖNA bɩrɩmɛ ŋ sɩma nɛ koo? Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa leŋe La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ nɛ ŋ nyuŋ. 3Ama arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, ŋ ha ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ mʋa nɛ. Ŋ sɩ chei vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ, aŋ kɛŋ ŋ tʋɔŋ a to Wɩa.”
Jehosafat lɩɩsɛ sarɩya diiree
4Jehosafat fa hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ, ama ʋ yie lɩɩ a gɔllɛ ʋ tinteeŋ kala, a chɩŋ Bɛɛsɩba lɛ a kaa mʋ yi Efirem tintee-la peelee sɩ yʋga lɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩ ʋ nɩaa dɩ ba bɩrɩmɛ a tuto La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa. 5Ʋ fa lɩɩsɛ sarɩya diiree nɛ Juda tinteeŋ tabala-la kala lɛ ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli. 6Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Má fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a didii nɩaa sarɩya, bɛɛ wɩaa nuhuobiinee doluŋ dee ma kaa dii sarɩya-la, ama La TƖƖNA doluŋ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ bʋa na-kala dɩ ma nɩɩ dii sarɩya. 7Má fá La TƖƖNA, a fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a didii sarɩya. La TƖƖNA Wɩa bɩ chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ bɩrɩmɛ, ʋ bɩ chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ nɩaa kaa pɔrɛ koo a lɩlaa kpalaa nɩaa teeŋ.”
8Jerusalɛm ma lɛ, Jehosafat fa lɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ dɩ ba dɩdagɛ La TƖƖNA wombiiŋ dɩ ba tuto, dɩ nɩaa nɛ kɛŋ kaalɛrɛ ma, dɩ ba bʋla wasɛ. 9Wɩaa deemba nɛ ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ʋ maga dɩ ma fá La TƖƖNA a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔ-bala a tɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa. 10Dɩ ma taŋ nɩaa kʋŋ nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩkala kɔ ma teeŋ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ba kpʋ, koo wɩɩ-la tɩgɛ Wɩa wombiiŋ ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto lɛ nɛ koo wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga lɛ nɛ koo Wɩa niiriŋ lɛ nɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ma bʋl wɩaa chagɩlɛba dɩ ba sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ʋ baanɩŋ jaŋ sii ma dɩ ma naambiiriŋ nyuŋ. Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ a sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ ŋaa. 11Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ Amarɩa nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ma nɩhɩaŋ wɩɩ na-kala sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ. Ka dɩ Ɩsɩmɛl nanʋala Zebadia sɩ ŋaa Juda doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara ma nɛ ŋaa ma nɩhɩaŋ wɩɩ na-kala sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ kuoro lɛ. Levi doho nɩaa ma nɛ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ chɩŋ. Má kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ a tɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa, La TƖƖNA jaŋ chɩŋ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa woruŋ harɩŋ.”

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 20
Content:
Jehosafat yuo dii Mʋab arɩ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa
1Bʋa kʋbala lɛ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa, Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Mewuni tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ sii kɔ dɩ ba yuo Jehosafat. 2Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa kʋ bʋla pɩ kuoro Jehosafat, “Laalɩyuori-daŋ nɛ lɩɩ Ɛdɔm a to mʋgʋ-balɩŋ sɛmɛ kʋkɔ dɩ ba yuoŋ. Ba paala hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hazazɔŋ Tama lɛ.” (Ʋ nɛ ha Ɛŋ-Gedi.) 3Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ Jehosafat, ʋ pɩɛsɛ La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ na wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa, aŋ heele bʋla pɩ Juda tinteeŋ nɩaa kala ba vɔɔ niiŋ. 4Juda nɩaa lɩɩ ba tasɩŋ kala a kʋ hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ dɩ ba sʋl La TƖƖNA dɩ ʋ pɛ ba lɛ.
5Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehosafat sii chɩŋ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kʋ hilimi La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la kaalɩ-falɩɩ-la sɩpaaŋ, 6aŋ bʋl,
“La TƖƖNA, la naabalɩmaba Wɩa, ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋ nɩɩ beŋ tinteyee kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Doluŋ kala hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ ŋ sɩpaaŋ wuo chɩŋ. 7La Wɩa, ŋ nɛ kiri tinteye-la nɩaa fa sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ deeŋ lɛ ta ŋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaaŋ, aŋ joŋo pɩ ŋ nandɔŋɔ Abɩraham doho nɩaa dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba kʋŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. 8Ba hɔŋ tintee-la lɛ nɛ a saa ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩ ba ziziliŋ nɩmɛ, aŋ bʋl, 9‘Dɩ wʋbɔŋ kala nɛ kʋ jʋʋla, dɩ laalɩŋ nɛ koo dɩ nyanyal-bɔŋ nɛ koo dɩ losuŋ nɛ, la jaŋ kɔ ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ deeŋ lɛ ba sɩɩ ziliŋ a chɩŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ a yel la hɛɛŋ pɩŋ dɩ ŋ nɩɩ a laala ta.’
10Ama lɛɛlɛ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa, Mʋab tɩŋŋaa arɩ Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa kʋʋ yuola nɛ. Ba tinteeŋ nɛ ŋ fa bʋla pɩ la naabalɩmaba dɩ ba sɩ́ jʋʋ ŋɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kieliba bal, ba bɩ ba cheye. 11Lɛɛlɛ, na ŋɩɩ ba sɩ joŋo ŋɩŋaa la lɛ, ba kɔ nɛ dɩ ba kirila ta tintee-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩla dɩ ʋ ŋaa la kʋŋ lɛ. 12Ŋ nɛ la Wɩa, dɔgɩsɛba, bɛɛ wɩaa la bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ la yuo laalɩyuori-daŋ deeŋ sɩ kʋʋ yuola. La-na bɩ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la kala la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa, ama laa beŋ ŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ ŋ pɛ la lɛ.”
13Juda tɩŋŋaa baalaa arɩ ba haalaa arɩ ba biiriŋ kala fa chɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ nɛ.
14Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA Dɩma kʋ jʋʋ Jahazɩɛl sɩ ŋaa Zɛkarɩya nanʋala dɩ ʋ fa chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hilime tʋɔŋ. Zɛkarɩya nyɩmma nɛ Bɛnaaya, Bɛnaaya ma nyɩmma nɛ Jɛyɛl, Jɛyɛl ma nyɩmma nɛ Matanɩa, a ŋaa Levi tɩɩna sɩ lɩɩ Asaf doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ. 15Ʋ bʋl, “Kuoro Jehosafat arɩ ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ, má jegili, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩma nɛ ŋ-la, ‘Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma bɔyɛ joŋ koo dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ a tɩŋ laalɩyuori-daŋ-la wɩaa. Ma dee bɩ jaŋ yuo laal-la, ama Wɩa nɛ jaŋ yuo. 16Má chie lɩɩ tuu cheme yuoba. Ba jaŋ to Zɩs wombii-bie-la sɩ hɛ peelee tʋɔŋ a kʋʋ jɩl. Ma jaŋ naba fuonaa-la sɩ hɛ Jɛrʋɛl tintee-hɩlɩŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ. 17Ma dee bɩ jaŋ yuo laal-la, ma-na chɩŋ ma dɩchɩnaa, a gbɛrɛ na ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ laama ta. Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm tɩmma, má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ. Má chie lɩɩ cheme yuoba, La TƖƖNA jaŋ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ.’ ”
18Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Jehosafat tuu kpirimi a kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa chu tinteeŋ, Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa ma kala tuu kpirimi a chʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA. 19Levi doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ Kohaf arɩ Kora nyɩŋ-nɩaa tʋɔŋ sii chɩŋ a faasa ŋaa goŋ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa. 20Taŋ sɩ pʋla chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla nɩalɩŋ sii mʋ Tɛkʋa tintee-hɩlɩŋ. Ba sɩ lɩa dɩ ba mʋ, Jehosafat sii chɩŋ aŋ bʋl, “Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm tɩmma, má jegili mɩ teeŋ, má laa ma TƖƖNA Wɩa dii, ʋ jaŋ chagɛma kɩɩ. Má laa wɩalɩŋ ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ bʋla dii dɩ ma wɩaa wasɛ.” 21Jehosafat sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ teeŋ dɛrɛ, ʋ lɩɩsɛ nɩaa dɩ ba laa laalɩyuoro-la sɩpaaŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a pɩ La TƖƖNA, a dɛnnʋ a tɩŋ ʋ tʋla arɩ zɔmʋŋ wɩaa a bʋl,
“Má lɔllɛ La TƖƖNA,
ʋ chonuŋ bɩ dɛrɛ.”
22Ba sɩ suomo yɩɩ yɩɩla-la, La TƖƖNA kɛŋ Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa, Mʋab tɩŋŋaa arɩ Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoro-la sɩ kɔ dɩ ba yuo Juda wɩɩkala vʋgʋmɛ. 23Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa mɩɩra gʋra yuo Ɛdɔm laalɩyuoroo a kpʋ ba kala. Ba sɩ kpʋ Ɛdɔm nɩalɩŋ dɛrɛ, ba ma tɩtɩa gʋra kpʋ dɔŋɔ.
24Juda nɩaa sɩ kʋ yi lee-la ba sɩ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ aŋ bibeŋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la, ba na dɩ ba dʋndɔmɔ-la kala sʋba a pɩŋ, nɩbala ma bɩ foro fa. 25Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehosafat arɩ ʋ nɩaa sii mʋ dɩ ba paa nɩalɩŋ kɩaa. Ba sɩ mʋa, ba na laalɩyuori kʋ-daŋ nɛ a pɛ gɛnnɩŋ lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ yuŋuŋ lɛ. Kɩalɩŋ fa yʋga kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ, ba joŋ tapʋlaa batori a paaba. 26Tapʋl nɛsɛ chɛɛŋ ba hilimi fuonaa kʋbala lɛ baa yɩrɛ Bɛraka a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛŋ fuonaa-la yɩyɩrɛ Bɛraka arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. (Ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ ‘ŋ lɔlʋŋ’.) 27Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehosafat laa Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala sɩpaaŋ, ba jʋɔsɛ a mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA leŋe ba yuo dii ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ. 28Ba sɩ mʋ yi Jerusalɛm, ba du chenniŋ arɩ kɔnɛba a ŋmʋʋ banyilliŋ a mʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la. 29Tinteye-la kala sɩ golliba a nɩɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa sɩ yuo dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba a tɩŋ Wɩa wɩaa. 30Jehosafat fa sɩɩ beŋ lee-la kala fɩɛla pɩŋ sɔm, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa pʋ wiese nɛ sɛmɛ kala.
Jehosafat kuoruŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ
31Jehosafat fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ banɔŋ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Azuba, a ŋaa Silihi tolo. 32Wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ nyɩmma Asa sɩ ŋaa, ba tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ ma ŋaa, ʋ bɩ kʋŋ kere ta. Ʋ fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ. 33Ama ʋ fa bɩ vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa cheye, nɩalɩŋ fa ha bɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala joŋo hɛ ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa lɛ.
34Wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ Jehosafat sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, a chɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Hanani nanʋala Jehu teniŋ tʋɔŋ a hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. 35Harɩŋ nɛ, Juda kuoro Jehosafat kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa mʋ mɛrɛ Iziral kuoro Ahazɩa lɛ. Ahazɩa fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ woruŋ. 36Ba pɛ niiŋ dɩ ba kpaasɛ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ dɩ ba kaa mʋ bayalɩŋ Taasɩs lɛ. Ba sɩ kpaasa dɛrɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛzɩɔŋ Geba lɛ, 37Dodavahu nanʋala Elieza sɩ lɩɩ Marɛsa a ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ bʋl wɩaa tɩgɛ Jehosafat lɛ a bʋl, “Ŋ sɩ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa mʋ mɛrɛ Ahazɩa lɛ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA jaŋ chei kɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ lɩɩŋ daborusu-la yɛrɛ, ba bɩ wuo kaa mʋ bayalɩŋ Taasɩs lɛ.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 21
Content:
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehosafat sʋʋ, ba joŋu hugi Devit tabal-la lɛ ʋ naabalɩmaba tʋɔŋ. Ka ʋ nanʋala Jehoram dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. 2Jehoram fa kɛŋ naambiiriŋ nɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ: Azarɩa, Jɛhɩɛl, Zɛkarɩya, Azarɩahu, Maakɩl arɩ Sɛfatɩa. Ba kala fa ŋaa kuoro Jehosafat hambolibiisiŋ nɛ. 3Ba nyɩmma joŋ kʋ-daŋ nɛ pɩba, hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ kɛŋ yuŋuŋ, a pɛ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩ-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ golli lɛ. Ama ʋ fa lɩɩsɛ ʋ bii-hɩaŋ Jehoram nɛ ʋ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.
Jehoram dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ
4Jehoram sɩ dii ʋ nyɩmma kuorii-la ʋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ a kɛŋ doluŋ, ʋ kpʋ ʋ naambiiri-la kala a pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa dɔnsʋŋ lɛ. 5Jehoram fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a beŋ Juda tinteeŋ jɩsɩŋ chori nɛ. 6Jehoram fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ. Ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa Iziral kuoroo sɩ ŋaa nɛ a jaa Ahab tolo. Ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa Ahab dɩa nɩaa fa sɩ ŋaa. 7Ama La TƖƖNA fa tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩnna Devit wɩaa nɛ a bɩ Juda tinteeŋ cheye, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa hɛ niiŋ nɛ ʋ dɩ Devit pɛgɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ didii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.
8Jehoram kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ, Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa fa vɩa dɩ ba to Juda tinteeŋ kuoro nɛ, aŋ ma bil ba kuoro. 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehoram sii kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba ba mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛdɔm. Nɩmɛ nɛ Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa tɔ ʋ dɩ nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba-la hɛ. Ama tɩtaŋɩŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba nɩhɩasɩ-la foro fá. 10Ɛdɔm tɩŋŋaa ha vɩa dɩ ba to Juda nɩaa nɛ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lɩbɩna nɩaa ma vɩa dɩ ba to Juda kuoro Jehoram a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa.
11Ʋ fa saa vesiŋ dɩ-kpaaraa nɛ Juda dundolluŋ nyuŋ a leŋ Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda nɩaa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa a yeŋŋi. 12Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Ɩlaaja ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ Jehoram. Teŋ-la tʋɔŋ ʋ sɩ, “Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA, ŋ nyɩmma Devit Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la, ‘Ŋ bɩ ŋ nyɩmma Jehosafat koo ŋ naabalɩma Juda kuoro Asa naabʋɔsʋŋ to. 13Ama ŋ mɩɩra to Iziral kuoroo naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ, a leŋ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa a nagɛ Ahab arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ŋ paala kpʋ ŋ naambiiriŋ nɛ, ŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛ nyɩmma, nɩalɩŋ sɩ paala kpɩaŋ. 14A tɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa, La TƖƖNA ka chɛ dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ ŋ nɩaa, ŋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ŋ haalaa nɛ, a chei ŋ dʋa kala. 15Luoruŋ nyanyal-bɔŋ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ tɩtɩa a dɔgʋsʋŋ ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ dɩ ŋ luobiee lɩɩ.’ ” 16Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA yigi Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa arɩ Arab tɩmma-la sɩ hɔnɔ kpagɛ Kus tɩŋŋaa a hɛ Jehoram lɛ. 17Ba kʋ yuo Juda tinteeŋ a paa kʋzɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ kuoru dɩa lɛ, aŋ kɛsɛ Jehoram hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ haalaa kaa viiri. Ʋ nanʋa-bie Ahazɩa dʋndʋŋ nɛ fa ka. 18Wɩaa deemba harɩŋ, La TƖƖNA joŋ luoruŋ nyanyal-bɔŋ ba sɩ bɩ wuo tɩɩbɛ a hɛ Jehoram lɛ. 19Jɩ-lɩa tʋɔŋ bʋa kʋbala lɛ, ʋ luobiee kʋ lɩɩ. A tɩŋ nyanyalɩɩ-la wɩaa, ʋ na hɛɛŋ woruŋ a sʋʋ. Ʋ nɩaa fa bɩ yoho nyiŋ-balɩŋ hɛ zilu a yel ʋ yoho arɩ ba fa sɩ hɛ ŋɩɩ a pɩ ʋ naabalɩmaba. 20Jehoram fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ chori nɛ. Ʋ sɩ sʋba nʋʋkala tʋɔŋ fa bɩ cheye, ba joŋu hugi Devit tabal-la lɛ, ama kuoroo dɩ-huguŋ lɛ dee.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 22
Content:
Ahazɩa dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ
1Arab tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ fa kʋ lʋara yuo kpʋ kuoro Jehoram hambolibii-hɩasɩŋ kala nɛ, aŋ ka ʋ nanʋa-bie Ahazɩa dʋndʋŋa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jerusalɛm nɩaa lɩɩsɛ Ahazɩa ʋ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyɩmma nyuŋ lɛ. 2Ahazɩa fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ balɩa nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ, a hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩna. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Atalɩa, a ŋaa Iziral kuoro Omiri nihiŋ. 3Ŋɩɩ leŋ ʋ ma ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa Ahab dɩa nɩaa fa sɩ ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ naaŋ nɛ yigu hɛ.
4Ʋ fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ La TƖƖNA teeŋ arɩ Ahab dɩa nɩaa fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nyɩmma sʋʋŋ harɩŋ, ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ leŋe ʋ tel. 5Ahazɩa fa to nɩalɩŋ niiŋ nɛ a to Ahab nanʋala Joram harɩŋ a mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ramɔf Gɩlɩad dɩ ba yuo Siiria tɩŋŋaa kuoro Hazɛɛl. Nɩmɛ nɛ Siiria tɩŋŋaa bolimi Joram. 6Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ mɩɩra mʋ ʋ jaŋ Jɛzɩrɛl dɩ ʋ vaarɛ ʋ tɩtɩa. Jehoram nanʋala Ahazɩa sɩ ŋaa Juda kuoro mʋ nɩmɛ dɩ ʋ na ʋ nyanyalaa.
7Ahazɩa sɩ mʋ na Joram nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa leŋ ʋ tel. Ahazɩa sɩ mʋa, ʋ dɩ Joram lɩɩ dɩ ba na Nimisi nanʋala Jehu, nɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ʋ chei Ahab dɩa. 8Jehu fa sɩɩ kpʋ Ahab dɩa nɩaa arɩ Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ na Juda nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Ahazɩa malɩma biiriŋ sɩ to ʋ harɩŋ kɔ, Jehu kpʋ ba kala. 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ lɛɛlɛ gɔllɔ chɩchɛ Ahazɩa, Jehu nɩaa chɛ mʋ naʋ dɩ ʋ faa Samarɩa lɛ, ba kɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛnʋ kʋ pɩ Jehu ʋ kpʋʋ. Ba joŋu hugi aŋ bʋl, “Ʋ ŋaa Jehosafat, nɩɩ-la fa sɩ to La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala nihii nɛ.” Nʋʋkala fa bɩra tuo Ahazɩa dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ a bemba.
Atalɩa dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ
10Ahazɩa naaŋ Atalɩa sɩ kʋ jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nanʋala Ahazɩa sɩ ŋaa Juda kuoro sʋba nɛ, ʋ wʋwalɩmɛ dɩ ʋ kpʋ nʋʋkala sɩ jaŋ wuo dii kuorii-la ba dɩa lɛ. 11Ama kuoro Jehoram tolo Jehoseba sɩ ŋaa Ahazɩa dɩhaala lʋara kɛŋ kuoro Ahazɩa hambolibiisi-la ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋ tʋɔŋ dɔŋɔ a faa. Bile yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Jʋas. Ʋ fa kɛŋ ʋ dɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ benu nɛ a kaa jʋʋ faa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩɩ-pɩnɩŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Jehoseba fa ŋaa Jehoram tolo nɛ, a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada ma haala, aŋ ŋaa Ahazɩa dɩhaala, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kɛŋ bile faa, Atalɩa bɩ wuo kpʋʋ. 12Jʋas fa faa ba teeŋ nɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ ŋɩɩ jɩsɩŋ balɩdʋ, ka Ahazɩa naaŋ Atalɩa dii kuoruŋ a bibeŋ Juda tinteeŋ.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 23
Content:
1Ʋ jɩ-pɛɩ lɛ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ maga ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ ʋ dɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ deemba sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba bil niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ: Jeroham nanʋala Azarɩa, Jehohanaŋ nanʋala Ɩsɩmɛl, Ɔbɛd nanʋala Azarɩa, Adaaya nanʋala Maasɛya arɩ Zikiri nanʋala Ɛlɩsafat. 2Ba gɔllɛ Juda tinteeŋ tasɩŋ kala a yɩrɛ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ba kala kɔ Jerusalɛm, 3a hilimi Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. Nɩmɛ nɛ ba dɩ kuoro nanʋala Jʋas bil niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ. Jehoyada bʋla pɩba, “Kuoro nanʋala Jʋas nɛ maga dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ hɛ niiŋ ŋɩɩ arɩ Devit doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ didii kuoruŋ. 4Wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ma ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa bugoo batori jaŋ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Buguŋ dɔŋɔ jaŋ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ-niiree, 5dɩ dɔŋɔ ma pɔ kuoro dɩa, dɩ dɔŋɔ ma pɔ boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gentine Boi-baalɩŋ, ka dɩ nɩkaanaa ma hɛ La Tɩɩna dɩɩ-bal-la kaalɩsɩŋ tʋɔŋ. 6Nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, see Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa sɩ hɛ tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ. Ba-na jaŋ wuo jʋʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta nɛ. Ama nɩkaana-la maga dɩ ba sɛɩ ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ daga nɛ a hɛ kaala tʋɔŋ.
7Levi doho nɩaa maga dɩ ba chɩna golli kuoro nɛ a pɔʋ, a kori ba laalɩyuori kɩaa. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kʋ jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ nɛ. Má kpagɛ kuoro lee na-kala ʋ sɩɩ mʋ.” 8Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ Juda nɩaa ŋaa ŋɩɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada sɩ dagɛba. Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la leŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba mʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ maga dɩ ba wiesi, ba kala mʋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada bɩ leŋe ba kʋŋkala viiri. 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ paa kuoro Devit tiŋŋee arɩ hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoro sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori-hɛŋŋɛɛ kʋbalaa arɩ kʋbiisiŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ a pɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba. 10Ʋ leŋ baala-la kala sɩɩ pɔ lee-la kori ba laalɩyuori kɩaa a chɩna golli kuoro a kpagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a pɔ kuoro Jʋas, a chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ.
11Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehoyada arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kɛŋ Ahazɩa nanʋala Jʋas kʋ lɩɩ a joŋ kuoru nyunchuulo chuu, aŋ joŋ teniŋ pʋ. Teŋ-la lɛ nɛ ba ŋmʋnsɛ wombie-la kuoroo sɩ maga dɩ ba to a bibeŋ tintee-la hɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ a dagɛ arɩ ʋ nɛ lɛɛlɛ ŋaa kuoro. Nɩalɩŋ kala ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “A leŋ dɩ kuoro mɩɩsɩŋ duomi.”
12Atalɩa sɩ nɩa dɩ nɩalɩŋ gɔllɔ fá a ŋaa goŋ a nyɩnyaasɛ kuoro nyuŋ, ʋ sii mʋ ba teeŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. 13Ʋ sɩ bene, ʋ na kuoro Jʋas dɩ ʋ chɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ a kpagɛ jebiiŋ, ka laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ chɩŋ ʋ sɛmɛ. Tintee-la nɩaa kala jʋjʋɔsɛ aŋ ŋmʋŋmʋʋ nyilliŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ du kɩaa nɛ fa kɛŋ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa ba gbigbieli. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Atalɩa tʋɔŋ chei, ʋ kɛŋ ʋ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ aŋ ŋaa goŋ a bʋl, “Ma ŋaamɛ zɛmbɛ, ma ŋaamɛ zɛmbɛ.”
14Jehoyada bɩra bʋla pɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba, “Má kɛŋ Atalɩa pɩɛga to nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ tʋɔŋ kʋ lɩɩ, má kpʋ nʋʋkala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ laaʋ ta, ama má sɩ́ Atalɩa kpʋ a kpagɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lee-kala.” 15Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛnʋ, dɩ ʋ yi boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Janɩŋ Boi-baalɩŋ a kpagɛ kuoru dɩa, a kpʋʋ nɩmɛ.
16Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada, kuoro Jʋas arɩ nɩalɩŋ hɛ niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ arɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA nɩaa. 17Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala mʋ ŋmoo Baal vene-la dɩa-la lo a yɛrɛ ʋ korunuŋ kala, a ŋmoo tɔmɔ-la kala yɛrɛ muno muno, aŋ kpʋ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ kpaarɛ Baal baa yɩrɛ Mataŋ korunu-la sɩpaaŋ.
18Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jehoyada joŋ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa hɛ dɩ ba nɛ tɩtɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. Ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ kuoro Devit fa sɩ joŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la pa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Ba nɛ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩpɩ La TƖƖNA arɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ ba tuto sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a jʋjʋɔsɛ arɩ Devit fa sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. 19Jehoyada fa bɩra leŋe nɩaa pɔ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiree nɛ, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ sɩ wuo jʋʋ. 20Ka ʋ kɛŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba arɩ nɩbalaa, sɩpaalaaraa arɩ tintee-la nɩaa kala, ba kɛŋ kuoro Jʋas a lɩɩ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, a to boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nyuŋ Boi-baalɩŋ a jʋʋ kuoru dɩa, a hollu ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ. 21Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ jʋjʋɔsɛ. Jerusalɛm kala lɛɛlɛ fɩɛla pɩŋ sɔm, a tɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋ Atalɩa wɩaa.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 24
Content:
Jʋas wasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ
1Jʋas fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Zɩbɩa, a lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛɛsɩba. 2Jʋas fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ, Jehoyada sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa kala lɛ. 3Jehoyada fa jaa haalaa balɩa nɛ pʋ, ʋ kaa lʋl hambolibiisiŋ arɩ hantolibiisiŋ.
4Harɩŋ bʋa-kʋbala lɛ Jʋas kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ wasɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la. 5Ʋ yɩrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa a bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ Juda tasɩŋ kala a laa moribie-la ba sɩ vɛnɛ titiŋ jɩna kala ba kaa wasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ lɩma.” Ama Levi doho nɩalɩŋ bɩ moribie-la lɩma laa.
6Ŋɩɩ wɩaa Jʋas yɩrɛ Jehoyada, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ a pɩɛsʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ ha bɩ leŋe Levi doho nɩaa laa moribie-la Juda nɩaa arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa sɩ yie vɛnɛɛ tiŋ? Moribie-la La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna Mosis arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa sɩ sɛyɛ arɩ ba jaŋ titiŋ dɩ ba kaa wʋwasɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ.”
7Atalɩa, ha-bɔŋ-la hambolibiisiŋ fa boro jʋʋ paa kʋzɔmɔ-la ba sɩ joŋo hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɔnsʋŋ nɛ a kaa kpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Baal.
8Kuoro leŋ ba ŋaa dagɩ-bie a joŋo bil La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ jeeŋ harɩŋ. 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba heele bʋla pɩ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa dɩ nʋʋkala kʋ tiŋ lampoo-la a pɩ La TƖƖNA, kʋ-la Wɩa tɩntɩnna Mosis fa sɩ leŋe Iziral tɩŋŋaa tiŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. 10Nɩalɩŋ arɩ ba sɩpaalaaraa kala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, ba kɛŋ moribie-la kaa kʋ hɛ dagɩ-bie-la tʋɔŋ ʋ su. 11Bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ Levi doho nɩaa nɛ joŋ daga-la a kaa mʋ kuoro tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ teeŋ, dɩ ba na dɩ moribiee suo, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋnsɛ kuoro teniŋ arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ yie chaarɛ nɛ, aŋ leŋ ba kaa mɩɩra mʋ bil ʋ dɩ-biliŋ. Ba ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ bʋa na-kala a laa moribiee yʋgɛ woruŋ. 12Kuoro arɩ Jehoyada joŋ moribie-la pɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ lɩɩsa ba bibeŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ wasɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la. Ba laa, a chɛ dɩɩ-saaraa, kapɩntaba, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ hɔɔŋ arɩ kɔlɩɩŋ tɩtɩŋ dɩ ba wasɛ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la.
13Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ beŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ tɩŋ woruŋ, ba wasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la ʋ bɩra nagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ fa sɩ naga nɛ, a kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ. 14Ba sɩ wasɛ dɩa-la dɛrɛ, ba kɛŋ moribii kaanaa kʋ pɩ kuoro arɩ Jehoyada. Ba kaa ŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa, tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, hɛntɛrɛɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla ŋaa. Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ Jehoyada mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ, baa ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ bʋa na-kala La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ.
15Jehoyada fa hɩɛsa nɛ woruŋ, ʋʋ sʋʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa jɩsɩŋ zɔlɔ arɩ mara arɩ fɩɩ nɛ. 16Ba joŋu hugi kuoroo dɩ-huguŋ Devit tabal-la lɛ, a tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-zɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ tɩma pɩ Wɩa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la.
Wʋbɔmɔ-la Jʋas sɩ ŋaa
17Jehoyada sʋʋŋ harɩŋ, Juda nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa sii kɔ kuoro Jʋas teeŋ a zilu, ʋ leŋ ba ŋaa wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ chɛ. 18Ba vɩa La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la ta nɛ, aŋ mɩɩra kpʋkpaarɛ vene-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ arɩ tɔŋŋɔɔ. Ba wʋbɔmɔ-la leŋ Wɩa na baanɩŋ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa nyuŋ. 19La TƖƖNA tɩŋ ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa dɩ ba kpʋrɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ dɩgɩlaa dɩ ba mɩɩra kɔ ʋ teeŋ, ama ba vɩa dɩ ba nɩɩ.
20Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa Dɩma kʋ jʋʋ Zɛkarɩya sɩ ŋaa Jehoyada, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nanʋala. Ʋ chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: ‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma vɩa wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ daga? Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩma. Ma sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA ŋɩɩ, ʋ ma vɩama nɛ.’ ”
21Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba vʋʋra sii chɩŋ ʋ lɛ, kuoro pa wombiiŋ ba yagʋ arɩ tabɩaa a kpʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la kaala lɛ. 22Kuoro Jʋas fa bɩ wʋzɔmɔ-la Zɛkarɩya nyɩmma Jehoyada fa sɩ ŋaa ʋ lɛ liise aŋ kpʋ ʋ nanʋala. Zɛkarɩya fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ sʋʋ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl, “A leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA na wɩɩ-la ŋ sɩɩ ŋaa a dɔgʋsʋŋ.”
23Jɩna dɩ-suomuŋ, Siiria tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuoroo sii kʋ yuo dii kuoro Jʋas, a tɔ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa hɛ a kpʋ ba sɩpaalaaraa kala, aŋ paa ba dʋa kala kaa mʋ pɩ ba kuoro sɩ hɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ. 24Siiria tɩmma-la laalɩyuoroo fa bɩ yʋgɛ, ka La TƖƖNA joŋ Juda tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori daŋ-la a hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a tɩŋ Juda nɩaa sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA to a dɔgɩsɛ Jʋas. 25Siiria tɩmma-la kʋʋ leŋ laal-la dɩ ba chaasa bolimi Jʋas nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ balɩa ma vʋʋrɛ a kpʋʋ ʋ kʋpɩnɩŋ nyuŋ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ kpʋ Zɛkarɩya, Jehoyada sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nanʋala wɩaa. Ba joŋu hugi Devit tabal-la lɛ. Ama kuoroo dɩ-huguŋ dee.
26Nɩalɩŋ sɩ vʋʋra kpʋʋ nɛ ŋaa: Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa tolo Sɩmɛɛf nanʋala Zabad arɩ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa tolo Sɔmɔ nanʋala Jehozabad. 27Wɩalɩŋ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ sɩ ŋaa arɩ wʋdaŋ-la kala Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ wasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ lɛ. Ʋ nanʋala Amazɩa nɛ dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ.

Title: 2 IZIRAL TƖŊŊAA NAABARƖŊ 25
Content:
Amazɩa dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ
1Amazɩa fa ŋaa jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ banɔŋ nɛ aŋ dii kuoruŋ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ nibi. Ʋ naaŋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Jehuadiŋ, a lɩɩ Jerusalɛm. 2Amazɩa fa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ nɛ, ama ʋ fa bɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala kaa to La TƖƖNA. 3Amazɩa kuoruŋ fa sɩ chɩna dɛrɛ, ʋ kɛsɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la fa sɩ kpʋ ʋ nyɩmma fa sɩ ŋaa kuoro a kpʋba. 4Ama ʋ fa bɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la sɩ kpʋ ʋ nyɩmma hambolibiisiŋ-na kpʋa, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo dagɛ Mosis ʋ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto bʋl ŋ-la nɛ: “Dɩ nʋʋ bii nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋ ʋ nyɩmma a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la wɩaa. Dɩ nyɩmma ma nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba kpʋ ʋ bie a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Nʋʋkala maga dɩ ba kpʋʋ a tɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔmɔ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa nɛ.”
5Kuoro Amazɩa yɩrɛ Juda nɩaa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a leŋ ba chɩŋ dɩa dɩa, ʋ jomba hɛ Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩba arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba nɩsɩŋ lɛ.
