Kpʋ kɩaa deemba a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la koruŋ nyuŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. 18Ŋ dɩ ŋ naambiiriŋ Juu tɩŋŋaa, jaŋ wuo kɛŋ warɩpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la sɩ ka a ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ma sɩ cho, arɩ wɩɩ-la sɩɩ tɔrɛ ma Wɩa tʋɔŋ. 19Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ joŋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ joŋo pɩŋ a pɩ Wɩa Jerusalɛm lɛ, dɩ ba kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa. 20Kʋŋkala ma ŋ ha sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ kaa tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, ŋ jaŋ wuo lɩɩsɛ kuori dɩa dʋa tʋɔŋ. 21Mɩ-na kuoro Atazɛzɛs bʋla pɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la kala sɩɩ beŋ Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ dʋa arɩ ba pɩ Ɛzɩra sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, aŋ pɛ dɩdagɛ nɩaa Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ wombiee kʋŋkala ʋ sɩ pɩɛsaa chɛ. 22Ma jaŋ wuo pʋ kɩalɩŋ a mʋʋ magɛ hɔpʋla yuŋuŋ sɩ yi kilo bʋɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ, mɩaa ma yuŋuŋ sɩ yi kilo bʋɩ fii, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ lonnuŋ bʋɩ balɩa, olif nʋʋŋ ma lonnuŋ bʋɩ balɩa arɩ yɩsɩŋ ma magɛ ŋɩɩ kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ. 23Ma maga ma fɩɛlɛ ma sɩaa a chɛ kɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ sɩ daga dɩ ba kaa saa ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ, dɩ ʋ baanɩŋ sɩ́ mɩ nyuŋ koo nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ to mɩ harɩŋ dii kuoruŋ nyuŋ sii. 24Ma bɩ wombii kɛnɛ dɩ ma laa lampoo nɩaa deemba teeŋ: Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi doho nɩaa, yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa, boi-pɔɔrɔɔ, Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnaa koo nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩ-bal-la lɛ. 25Ŋ-na Ɛzɩra, kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩŋ, a lɩɩsɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ sarɩya diiree dɩ ba bibeŋ Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ŋ Wɩa wombiee. Ʋ maga ŋ dagɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ Wɩa wombie-la jɩŋ. 26Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bɩ ŋ Wɩa wombie-la koo kuoro wombiee to, ʋ maga ŋ guu dɔgɩsɛ tɩɩna nɛ. Ŋ jaŋ kpʋʋ, koo ŋ kiru ta ʋ lɩɩ tintee-la lɛ, koo ŋ kɛŋ ʋ dʋa kala laa koo ŋ kɛnʋ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa.
Ɛzɩra dɛnnɛ Wɩa
27Ɛzɩra sɩ, “Má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, la naabalɩmaba Wɩa. Ʋ leŋe kuoro zil ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. 28Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, kuoro, ʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlʋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa nɩduoruŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ nɛ. Mɩ Wɩa pɩmɛ tʋɔ-doluŋ nɛ, mɩ wuo bʋl wɩaa pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyɩŋ-nɩaa nɩhɩasɩŋ jesiŋ ba to mɩ harɩŋ a mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm.”

Title: ƐZƖRA 8
Content:
Dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩ-la sɩ to Ɛzɩra harɩŋ a lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ
1Dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩ-la fa sɩ mʋ yoŋ-baga Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ aŋ mɩɩra to Ɛzɩra harɩŋ a kɔ Jerusalɛm bʋa-la lɛ Atazɛzɛs sɩ ŋaa kuoro nɛ ŋ-la: 2Finihas doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ Gesom, Itama doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ Danɩɛl, Devit doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ Hatus sɩ ŋaa Sɛkanɩa nanʋala, 3Parɔs ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Zɛkarɩya arɩ baalaa zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii. 4Pahaf-Mʋab doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Zɛrahɩa nanʋala Eliehonai arɩ baalaa zɔɔ-balɩa. 5Zatu ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Jahazɩɛl nanʋala Sɛkanɩa arɩ baalaa zɔɔ-batori. 6Adɩŋ ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Jonataŋ nanʋala Ɛbɛd arɩ baalaa mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii. 7Ɛlam ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Atalɩa nanʋala Jesaaya arɩ baalaa mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii.
8Sɛfatɩa doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ, Maakɩl nanʋala Zɛbadɩa arɩ baalaa mahɩŋ banɛsɛ.
9Jʋab doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ, Jɛhɩɛl nanʋala Obadaaya arɩ baalaa zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ fii arɩ chori.
10Banɩ doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ, Josifia nanʋala Sɛlɔmɩf arɩ baalaa zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ batori.
11Bɛbaɩ ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Bɛbaɩ nanʋala Zɛkarɩya arɩ baalaa mara arɩ chori.
12Azigad ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Hakataŋ nanʋala Johanaŋ arɩ baalaa zɔlɔ arɩ fii.
13Adonikam ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, ba nɛ to harɩŋ kɔ, ba yɩraa nɛ, Ɛlɩfɛlɛt, Jɛyɛl arɩ Sɛmaaya a pɛ baalaa mahɩŋ batori lɛ.
14Bɩgɩvaɩ doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ, Utai arɩ Zakɔ a pɛ baalaa mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii lɛ.
Ba mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm
15Mɩ yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala kʋ hilimi lɩɩ-libe kʋbala ba sɩ kpɛrɛ ʋ lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ mʋmʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ahava dɩɩrɩŋ. La hɔŋ nɩmɛ tapʋlaa batori nɛ. Mɩ sɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tʋɔŋ, mɩ bɩ Levi doho nʋʋkala na. 16Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tɩma yɩrɛ sɩpaalaaraa deemba nibi: Elieza, Arɩɛl, Sɛmaaya, Ɛlɩnataŋ, Jarɩb, Ɛlɩnataŋ, Netaŋ, Zɛkarɩya arɩ Mesulam, Joyarib arɩ Ɛlɩnataŋ. Nɩaa deemba kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ woruŋ. 17Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tɩmba Ido sɩ ŋaa sɩpaalaarʋ Kasɩfɩa lɛ teeŋ. Mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩ Ido arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔsʋŋ, Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ tɩntɩnnaa, dɩ ba pɩla nɩaa sɩ jaŋ kʋ tɩtɩŋ la Wɩa dɩa lɛ. 18A tɩŋ Wɩa naduo-la fa sɩ daŋ la lɛ wɩaa, ba pɩla Sɛrɛbɩa sɩ chaasa ŋaa baal, a ŋaa Levi doho nʋʋ, a lɩɩ Mali doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ fii arɩ chori ma to ʋ harɩŋ kɔ nɛ. 19Ba fa leŋe Hasabɩa arɩ Jesaaya sɩ ŋaa Mɛrarɩ doho nɩaa ma kɔ nɛ, a pɛ ʋ naambiiriŋ arɩ ba biiriŋ lɛ, ba kala ŋaa baalaa mara. 20Ba fa kɛŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnaa zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mara ma nɛ kɔ. Devit arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ nɛ fa lɩɩsɛ nɩaa deemba dɩ ba pɩpɛ Levi doho nɩaa lɛ. Ba fa ŋmʋnsɛ nɩaa deemba kala yɩraa nɛ.
21La sɩ hɛ Ahava lɩɩ-libe-la ba sɩ kpɛrɛ leriŋ, mɩ leŋ la vɔɔ niiŋ, dɩ la kɛŋ la tɩtɩa muuri la Wɩa sɩpaaŋ dɩ la dɩ la biiriŋ vɛŋ la wombiiŋ woruŋ arɩ la kɩaa kala. 22Hɩɩsɩŋ fa kɛmmɛ nɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ pɩɛsɛ kuoro dɩ ʋ pɩmɛ laalɩyuoroo arɩ ja-jɩllaa dɩ ba pɔla, dɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ la wɩɩ ŋaa wombiiŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la fa bʋla pɩ kuoro, “La Wɩa naduo-la daŋ nʋʋkala sɩɩ beŋ ʋ lɛ nɛ, ama ʋ yie chaasa na baanɩŋ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ vɩaʋ nyuŋ.” 23Ŋɩɩ nɛ la vɔɔ niiŋ aŋ sʋl la Wɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ la wombii-la vɛnɩŋ lɛ, ʋ laa la sʋla.
24Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa fii arɩ balɩa: Sɛrɛbɩa, Hasabɩa arɩ ba naambiiriŋ fii. 25Mɩ magɩsɛ hɔpʋla, sɛlɩmɛ arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kuoro, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlʋ, ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ joŋo pa dɩ ba kaa saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a pɩ ba. 26Mɩ magɩsɛ hɔpʋla yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa arɩ zɔlɔ, hɔpʋla tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa ma yuŋuŋ ŋaa kilo bʋɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ, sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ ma ŋaa kilo bʋɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ, 27sɛlɩmɛ gbansɩŋ mara yallɩŋ sɩ ŋaa sɛlɩmɛ moribii-biiŋ bʋɩ, arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa balɩa sɩ zɔmɔ ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ a nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ a ŋaa.
28Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩba, “Mɩ joŋ ma dɩ kɩaa deemba kala hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Hɔpʋla-la arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la ŋaa tʋɔtɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ kɩaa nɛ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, ma naabalɩmaba Wɩa. 29Má pɔ kɩalɩŋ woruŋ a kɛmba mʋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, a magɩsɛba chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩ-la lɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ.” 30Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa laa hɔpʋla-la, sɛlɩmɛ arɩ Wɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ magɩsa dɩ ba kaa mʋ la Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ.
31Chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋl fii arɩ balɩa chɛɛŋ nɛ la sii Ahava lɩɩ-libe-la ba sɩ kpɛrɛ leriŋ dɩ la mʋ Jerusalɛm. La Wɩa nɩsɩŋ fa daŋ la lɛ nɛ, a pɔla a lɩɩsɛla dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ arɩ gaara-la sɩɩ faa wombiiŋ lɛ. 32Ŋɩɩ nɛ la mʋ yi Jerusalɛm, a wiesi nɩmɛ tapʋlaa batori. 33Tapʋl nɛsɛ chɛɛŋ, la jʋʋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a magɩsɛ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ-la a pɛ Wɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ lɛ a joŋo hɛ Yuria nanʋala Mɛrɛmɔf sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Finihas nanʋala Elieza ma fa hɛ ʋ teeŋ nɛ, a pɛ Levi doho nɩaa Jesua sɩ ŋaa Jozabad nanʋala arɩ Binui nanʋala Nʋadɩa lɛ. 34Ba fa dɩɩsɛ kɩalɩŋ kala nɛ a jɩŋ ba niiŋ arɩ ba yuŋuŋ a ŋmʋnsa bil.
35Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa: Nɛ-belliŋ fii arɩ balɩa, pie-belliŋ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ fii arɩ balɩdʋ, pie-bel-biisiŋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ, aŋ kpʋ gbuŋgbogusuŋ ma fii arɩ balɩa a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ba fa nyɩgɛ kɩaa deemba kala nɛ a pɩ La TƖƖNA. 36Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ teŋ-la ma kuoro sɩ ŋmʋnsa a pɩ Yufireti wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba pɛ Iziral tɩmma-la lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa.

Title: ƐZƖRA 9
Content:
Ɛzɩra chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ nɩwogusuŋ jaanɩŋ lɛ
1La sɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala harɩŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa kɔ mɩ teeŋ a bʋl, “Iziral tɩŋŋaa, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa lɛ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɩɩsa wʋkɩsɩa-la nɩwogusu-la sɩ golliba sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ: Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa, Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa, Jebus tɩŋŋaa, Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa, Mʋab tɩŋŋaa, Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa. 2Ba jaa nɩaa deemba toloo nɛ, aŋ jaa pɩ ba hambolibiisiŋ ma, a leŋ Wɩa nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ guoli nɩwogusuŋ tʋɔŋ. Sɩpaalaaraa arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ nɛ paala laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ a chei.”
3Mɩ-na Ɛzɩra sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, mɩ kɛŋ mɩ gɛnnɩŋ kɩɛsɛ, a lɛrɛ mɩ nyu-pʋnaa arɩ tɔŋŋɔɔ churi aŋ hɔŋ a kala vɔgɛ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ. 4Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ fá Wɩa kɔ mɩ teeŋ, a tɩŋ wʋbɔŋ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa. Ka mɩ hɔŋ a kala vɔgɛ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ ŋaa dɩdaanɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.
5Dɩdaanɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ bʋa-la lɛ, mɩ sii lee-la mɩ fa sɩ hɔnɔ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ, aŋ ha laalɛ gɛnnɩ-la mɩ sɩ kaa kɩɛsɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tuu kpirimi mɩ naadʋsʋŋ nyuŋ a kɛŋ nɩsaa je mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa teeŋ, 6a sʋlʋ a bʋl,
“Ou mɩ Wɩa, hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ arɩ mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ sɩaa je ŋ sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chʋɔra nɛ a sii kɩɩ la nyusuŋ. La wʋcheelee paala jɩla yiyi wɩa-nyuŋ nɛ. 7A chɩŋ la naabalɩmaba bʋa lɛ a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ, la wʋcheelee chaasa yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ. A tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ŋ joŋ la dɩ la kuoroo arɩ ŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ kuoroo nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Ba kpʋla, a laa la kɩaa, aŋ kɛsɛ la dɔnsʋŋ kaa mʋ tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa. La dii hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, arɩ jɩnɩmba la ha sɩɩ dii hɩɩsɩŋ ŋɩɩ.
8Ama lɛɛlɛ, La TƖƖNA Wɩa, ŋ fá nisusuŋ a pɩla wiese mʋa nɛ, a leŋ la nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ ka a bɩ sʋba, ŋ pɩla leriŋ nɛ ŋ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ. Ŋ laala ta nɛ la fa sɩ ŋaa yosi lɛ a leŋ la na pʋlʋmʋŋ. 9La fa ŋaa yosi ma nɛ, ama ŋ-na la Wɩa bɩ la vɩa ta la yoŋ-baga-la lɛ. Ŋ dagɛ ŋ zile pɩla nɛ a leŋ Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoro cho la wɩaa, a leŋ la kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ dɩ la wasa saa ŋ dɩa-la a bɩrɩmɛ lere-la kala sɩ cheye, ŋ leŋe la Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa hɔŋ nɛ wɩɩ bɩ la walɩmɛ.
10Ama la Wɩa, wʋbɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩaa deemba kala harɩŋ lɛ? La bɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga to, 11wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ to ŋ tɩntɩnnaa sɩ ŋaa ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ a dagɛla. Ba bʋla pɩla, ‘Tintee-la ma sɩɩ mʋ, ʋ nɩaa ŋaa disiniŋ a chei ʋ kala nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ ŋaa wʋkɩsaa a leŋ ʋ kala kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.’ 12Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɩ́ ma toloo joŋo pɩ ba biiriŋ dɩ ba jaa, koo a jaa ba toloo a pɩ ma hambolibiisiŋ. Ma pʋpɔ má dɩ ba sɩ niiŋ pɛ a ŋaa nandɔsɛ, ka dɩ ma wuo kɛŋ doluŋ a dii tintee-la kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ ka pɩ ma biiriŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ba dʋa a kaa mʋ wuu.
13Wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa la lɛ, la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ la wʋcheelee sɩ faasa yʋgɛ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ. Ama ŋ-na la Wɩa, ŋ bɩ la dɔgɩsɔ a magɛ ŋɩɩ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ maga, aŋ leŋ la dɔnsʋŋ ka a bɩ sʋba. 14Lɛɛlɛ, ʋ sɛnɛ bɩra magɛ dɩ la dɩ nɩaa deemba sɩɩ ŋaa wʋkɩsaa deemba jɩjaa dɔŋɔ ba toloo? Dɩ la nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ŋ bɩ jaŋ chaasa na baanɩŋ la nyuŋ a cheila dɩ la kʋbala ma bɩra sɩ kaa? 15La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa, ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ. Ŋ leŋe la dɔnsʋŋ ka nɛ a bɩ sʋba. La kɔ ŋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ arɩ la cheeriŋ, arɩ la sɩ jɩma arɩ la bɩ wombiiŋ kɛnɛ dɩ la kɔ ŋ sɩpaaŋ ma kala.”

Title: ƐZƖRA 10
Content:
Nɩaa dagɛ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ
1Ɛzɩra fa sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa aŋ pɛ dɩdagɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa chei, a yiyel a foro titel Wɩa dɩa sɩpaaŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩ-daŋ, baalaa, haalaa arɩ hambiisiŋ kʋ chɩna gollu, a ma faasa yiyel. 2Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɛhɩɛl nanʋala Sɛkanɩa, Ɛlam doho nɩaa dɔŋɔ bʋla pɩ Ɛzɩra, “La bɩ La TƖƖNA niiŋ to la sɩ jaa nɩwogusuŋ sɩ golli la toloo. Ama la Iziral tɩŋŋaa ha kɛŋ yɩɛlaa nɛ. 3Lɛɛlɛ, má leŋ dɩ la bil niiŋ la dɩ la Wɩa pɛgɛ, aŋ kiri haala-la arɩ ba biiriŋ dɩ ba viiri. La jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ŋ-na mɩ kʋhɩaŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ zil la Wɩa sɩ daga. Má leŋ dɩ la ŋaa ŋɩɩ Wɩa wombiiŋ sɩ daga. 4Sii chɩŋ, wɩɩŋ deeŋ hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, la jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ aŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la.”
5Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛzɩra sii chɩŋ, a leŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa, a pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala lɛ ba ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la Sɛkanɩa sɩ bʋla. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba ŋmɩɛsɛ. 6Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛzɩra sii Wɩa dɩa-la sɩpaaŋ, a mʋ Ɛlɩasɩb nanʋala Jehohanaŋ dɩa, a chʋa nɩmɛ. Ama ʋ bɩ kʋŋkala die, ʋ bɩ lɩɩŋ ma nyʋa nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa haa yel nɛ a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ sɩ bɩ Wɩa niiŋ to.
7Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba heele bʋl Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm kala lɛ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ kala kʋ hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ. 8Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bɩ kɔ a kaa mʋ yi tapʋlaa batori pɛgɛ, ba jaŋ laa ʋ dʋa kala, arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, aŋ kiru ta nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ tʋɔŋ.
9Tapʋlaa batori-la pɛgɛ, chɛŋ-nibi tapʋl mara chɛɛŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, baala-la kala sɩ hɛ Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ lɛ kɔ Jerusalɛm, a hɔŋ ba dɩ-hilimiŋ, Wɩa dɩa-la sɩpaaŋ. Ba tʋɔŋ kala fa chaasa chei nɛ a tɩŋ hilime-la arɩ duonuŋ fa sɩɩ nɩɩ wɩaa. 10Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Ɛzɩra sii chɩŋ a bʋla pɩba, “Ma bɩ Wɩa niiŋ to, aŋ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo a leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa cheeriŋ wasɛ yʋgɛ. 11Lɛɛlɛ, má dagɛ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa chei a pɩ La TƖƖNA ma naabalɩmaba Wɩa aŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ. Má pɔrɛ ma tɩtɩa a lɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ gollima tʋɔŋ arɩ tintee-wogusuŋ toloo-la ma sɩ jaa lɛ.”
12Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hilime faasa suri ba yikorusuŋ a laa bʋl, “Ŋ bʋl woruŋ nɛ, la maga la ŋaa ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ bʋla nɛ. 13Ama la faasa yʋgɛ nɛ daha, ka ʋ ŋaa yibiiŋ ma. La bɩ jaŋ wuo chɩŋ jeeŋ harɩŋ. Bɩra ma, wɩɩŋ deeŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɛrɛ chɛ-bala koo tapʋlaa balɩa pɛgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la chaasa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ woruŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ. 14Leŋ dɩ la tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ laa la kala nyuŋ a ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩla. Leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ hɛ la tasɩŋ lɛ a jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo kɔ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ daga, ba dɩ taŋ-la sɩpaalaaraa arɩ sarɩya diiree, a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA baaŋ-la ʋ sɩ faasa na la nyuŋ a tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa sɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ.” 15Nɩaa deemba-na fa bɩ wɩɩ-la sɛyɛ, Asahɛl nanʋala Jonataŋ arɩ Tɩkɩva nanʋala Jazeya, Mesulam Sabɛtaɩ sɩ ŋaa Levi doho nʋʋ ma chɩŋ ba harɩŋ.
16Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ba sɩ daga. Ɛzɩra sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara lɩɩsɛ dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ. Ba kʋbala kala chɩŋ ʋ nyɩŋ-nɩaa nyuŋ, ba ŋmʋnsɛ ba kala yɩraa. Chɛŋ-fii tapʋl-bumbuŋ chɛɛŋ, ba suomi dɩ ba beŋ wɩalɩŋ na. 17Ʋ mʋʋ yi chɛŋ-bumbuŋ tapʋl-bumbuŋ chɛɛŋ, dɩ ba bʋl wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo wɩaa a dɛrɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo
18Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, nɩaa deemba nɛ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo: Jozadak nanʋala Jesua arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Maasɛya, Elieza, Jarɩb arɩ Gedalia. 19(Ba kala hɛ niiŋ nɛ arɩ ba jaŋ vɩa ba haala-la, aŋ ka ba kʋŋkala lɩɩsɛ pie-bele dɩ ba kaa ŋaa ba cheeriŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.) 20Ima ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Hanani arɩ Zɛbadɩa. 21Harɩm ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Maasɛya, Ɩlaaja, Sɛmaaya, Jɛhɩɛl arɩ Uzia. 22Pasɩhɔ doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo nɛ ŋ-la: Elionai, Maasɛya, Ɩsɩmɛl, Nɛtanɛl, Jozabad arɩ Ɛlasa. 23Levi doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ, nɩaa deemba nɛ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo: Jozabad, Sɩmɛɩ, Kɛlaaya (ʋ nɛ ha Kɛlɩta), Pɛtahɩa, Juda arɩ Elieza. 24Yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa ma tʋɔŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaa tintee wogo tolo nɛ Ɛlɩasɩb. Boi-pɔɔrɔɔ ma tʋɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo nɛ, Salum, Tɛlɛm arɩ Uri. 25Iziral tɩmma-la tʋɔŋ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toolo nɛ ŋ-la: Parɔs doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Ramɩa, Izia, Malɩkɩja, Mɩjamɩŋ, Eliaza, Malɩkɩja dɔŋɔ arɩ Bɛnaaya. 26Elam ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ: Matanɩa, Zɛkarɩya, Jɛhɩɛl, Abidi, Jɛrɛmɔf arɩ Ɩlaaja. 27Zatu ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ: Elionai, Ɛlɩasɩb, Matanɩa, Jɛrɛmɔf, Zabad arɩ Aziza. 28Bɛbaɩ ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Jehohanaŋ, Hananaaya, Zebai arɩ Afɩlaɩ. 29Banɩ doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ: Mesulam, Maluk, Adaaya, Jasub, Sɩal arɩ Jɛrɛmɔf. 30Pahaf-Mʋab ma doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ: Adɩna, Kɛlal, Bɛnaaya, Maasɛya, Matanɩa, Bɛzalɛl, Binui arɩ Manasɛ. 31Harɩm doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ: Elieza, Ɩsɩja, Malɩkɩja, Sɛmaaya, Simioŋ, 32Bɛnjamɩŋ, Maluk arɩ Sɛmarɩa. 33Hasum doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ: Matɛnaɩ, Mataata, Zabad, Ɛlɩfɛlɛt, Jɛrɛmaɩ, Manasɛ arɩ Sɩmɛɩ. 34Banɩ doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ: Maadaɩ, Amɩram, Uwel, 35Bɛnaaya, Bedeya, Keluhi, 36Vanɩa, Mɛrɛmɔf, Ɛlɩasɩb, 37Matanɩa, Matɛnaɩ arɩ Jaasʋ. 38Binui doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ: Sɩmɛɩ, 39Sɛlɛmaaya, Netaŋ, Adaaya, 40Makinadebai, Sasaɩ, Saraɩ, 41Azarɛl, Sɛlɛmaaya dɔŋɔ, Sɛmarɩa, 42Salum, Amarɩa arɩ Josɛf. 43Nebo doho nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ: Jɛyɛl, Matɩtɩa, Zabad, Zebina, Jadaɩ, Jowɛl arɩ Bɛnaaya. 44Nɩaa deemba kala fa jaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo nɛ, ba dɔnsʋŋ kɛŋ haala-la a lʋl biiriŋ.

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 1
Content:
Nɛhɩmaaya Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ
1Wɩalɩŋ Hakalɩa nanʋala Nɛhɩmaaya sɩ bʋla:
Atazɛzɛs sɩ dii Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara tʋɔŋ, chɛnɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɩsɩlɛ lɛ, dɩ mɩ-na Nɛhɩmaaya hɛ dɩ-duo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sʋsa sɩ ŋaa ba tabalɩŋ lɛ. 2Mɩ naambiiriŋ dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hanani arɩ baalaa dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Juda tinteeŋ kɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɛsɛba a mʋ tɩgɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɩkaana-la sɩ bɩ sʋba aŋ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ, a bɩra pɩɛsɛ ba Jerusalɛm ma wɩaa.
3Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩmɛ, “Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ sʋba yoŋ-baga lɛ mɩɩra kɔ tintee-la nɛ a chaasa hɛ wʋwalɩmaa arɩ hɩɩsɩŋ tʋɔŋ. Jebii-la sɩ golli Jerusalɛm kala nɛ ba ŋmoo lo a nyɩgɛ ʋ boi-baalaa kala.”
4Mɩ sɩ nɩɩ wɩaa deemba, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ hɔŋ a yel. Mɩ yel tapʋl daŋ, a vɔɔ niiŋ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ. 5Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl,
“Ou, La TƖƖNA Wɩa, ŋ sɩ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ, ŋ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ woruŋ, la chaasa fɩfáŋ. Ŋ kɛŋ nii-la sɩ hɛ ŋ dɩ ŋ nɩaa pɛgɛ kaa tɩtɩŋ nɛ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ choŋ a tuto ŋ wʋdagaa. 6La TƖƖNA, suri sɩaa pɩmɛ, aŋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna teeŋ, ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩɩ sʋlʋŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ a pɩpɩ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa. Mɩ dagɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ ŋaa ŋ lɛ aa pɩŋ nɛ. Mɩ dɩ mɩ naabalɩmaba kala ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ŋ lɛ. 7La ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ŋ lɛ, a bɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ daga to. La bɩ ŋ niiriŋ arɩ wombie-la ŋ sɩ to ŋ tɩntɩnna Mosis lɛ a joŋo dagɛla to.
8La TƖƖNA, liisi wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla pɩ ŋ tɩntɩnna Mosis a bʋl: ‘Dɩ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ kɛmma pɩsa hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ lɛ. 9Ama dɩ ma nɛ bɩra mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma, dɩ ma nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛsɛ mʋ yoŋ-baga nɛ paala hɛ dɩ-bolii ma, mɩ jaŋ kɛmba lɩɩ nɩmɛ a kaa kɔ lee-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ba chʋɔlɛmɛ nɩmɛ.’
10Ba ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnaa arɩ ŋ nɩaa nɛ. Ba nɛ ŋ kɛŋ ŋ dol-balɩŋ arɩ ŋ naduo-la laa ta ŋɩɩ. 11Mɩ Tɩɩna, jegile nɩɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna sʋla arɩ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa dɔnsʋŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, la nɩalɩŋ sɩ choŋ a ziziliŋ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna cheŋ nyu-sɩmɩŋ, a leŋ dɩ kuoro tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ.”
Bʋa deeŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ fa ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ kori kuoru-la nyʋnyʋala.

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 2
Content:
Kuoro Atazɛzɛs leŋe Nɛhɩmaaya mʋ Jerusalɛm
1Atazɛzɛs sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara tʋɔŋ, chɛnɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nisaŋ lɛ nɛ tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala, ba kɛŋ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ kɔ dɩ ba pʋ. Mɩ laa sɩŋ-la kaa mʋ pɩ kuoro. Mɩ tʋɔŋ ha bɩ cheye ʋ sɩpaaŋ aŋ ka. 2Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ kɛŋ sɩaa chei aŋ bɩ wɩɩlɛ ma? Wɩɩŋ deeŋ naga tʋɔ-chei wɩɩ nɛ jʋʋŋ.”
Fawʋllʋŋ fa kɛmmɛ woruŋ. 3Ama mɩ bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Kuoro, a leŋ dɩ ŋ mɩɩsɩŋ duomi. Mɩ tʋɔŋ cheye bɛɛ wɩaa, tabal-la lɛ ba sɩ hugi mɩ naabalɩmaba pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nɛ, ʋ boi-baalaa ma kala nɛ nyiniŋ dii chei.”
4Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ saa ŋ chɩchɛ?”
Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sʋl Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ, 5aŋ bʋla pɩ kuoro, “Dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɛ mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna nyuŋ, dɩ ŋ cho dɩ ŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ a pɩmɛ, leŋ dɩ mɩ mʋ Juda tinteeŋ tabal-la lɛ ba sɩ hugi mɩ naabalɩmaba a paa tabal-la wasa saa.”
6Dɩ kuoro haala fa hɔŋ ʋ sɛmɛ, ka ʋ pɩɛsɛmɛ, “Ŋ nɛ mʋa, ɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ diene magɛ aŋ mɩɩra kɔ?” Kuoro tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɔ nɛ ʋ cho dɩ mɩ mʋa, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ dagɛ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ a pʋ.
7Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra bʋla pʋ, “Kuoro dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ tɔrɛ ŋɩɩ lɛ, ŋɩɩ-na ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ pɩ mɩ dɩ mɩ kaa mʋ a pɩ Yufireti fuo-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ dɩ ba pɩmɛ wombiiŋ dɩ mɩ mʋ Juda tinteeŋ. 8Bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ dɔŋɔ ma dɩ mɩ joŋo pɩ Asaf, nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ ŋ duuŋ dɩ ʋ pɩmɛ doloo dɩ mɩ kaa ŋaa dɩ-duo-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baalaa, a pɛ tabal-la kɛrɛ arɩ lee-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ jʋjʋʋ lɛ. A tɩŋ mɩ Wɩa naduo-la sɩ daŋ mɩ lɛ wɩaa, kuoro sɛɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ.” 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mʋ Yufireti fuo-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩasɩŋ teeŋ, a joŋ kuoro tenni-la a pɩba. Kuoro fa leŋe laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ja-jɩllaa to mɩ harɩŋ mʋ nɛ.
10Sanbalat sɩ ŋaa Horo tɩɩna, arɩ Tobia ma sɩ ŋaa Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ba faasa na baanɩŋ a tɩŋ nʋʋ sɩ kɔ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔmʋŋ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa wɩaa.
Nɛhɩmaaya gɔllɔ beŋ Jerusalɛm kɛrɩsɩŋ
11Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mʋ Jerusalɛm a hɛ nɩmɛ tapʋlaa batori, 12tɩtaŋ kʋbala, mɩ dɩ baalaa baŋmɛnɛ lɩɩ gɔllɛ. Mɩ fa bɩ wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Jerusalɛm lɛ bʋla pɩ nʋʋkala. Mɩ fa bɩ pʋna kala kaa to mɩ harɩŋ lɩɩ, see kakumo-la mɩ sɩ jɩla dʋndʋŋa.
13Tɩtaŋ-la mɩ to boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Fuonaaŋ Boi-baalɩŋ nɛ lɩɩ a chaasɛ vil-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jolluŋ Viliŋ a mʋ yi boi-baal-la ma ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɛ-bɩnɩŋ Boi-baalɩŋ a gɔllɔɔ beŋ Jerusalɛm jebie-la ba sɩ ŋmoo lo, arɩ ʋ boi-baala-la nyiniŋ sɩ dii chei. 14Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mʋ boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Lɩɩ-bulo Boi-baalɩŋ a to ŋɩɩ mʋ fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kuoroo Pɩlɩŋ leriŋ. Ama leriŋ fa bɩ yʋgɛ dɩ mɩ kakumo wuo to bal. 15Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tuu fuonaa-la tɩtaŋ-la a gɔllɔɔ beŋ jebii-la, a bɩra mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ a to Fuonaaŋ Boi-baal-la mɩ sɩ to kʋ lɩɩ a jʋʋ. 16Taŋ-la tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ fa bɩ jɩŋ lee-la mɩ sɩ mʋa koo wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa. Mɩ fa ha bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla pɩ mɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, tintee-la nɩbalaa, ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ koo nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la.
17Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩba, “Ma tɩtɩa na wʋwalɩmɩa-la tʋɔŋ la sɩ hɛ nɛ. Jerusalɛm kala pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nɛ, ba nyɩgɛ ʋ boi-baalaa ma. Má kɔ dɩ la paa Jerusalɛm jebii-la wasa saa, a tɔ la hɩɩsɩŋ.” 18Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩba ŋɩɩ Wɩa naduo-la sɩ daŋ mɩ lɛ arɩ wɩɩ-la kuoro sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ bʋl, “Leŋ la suomo paa jebii-la wasa sɩsaa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba suomi tɩntɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ deeŋ.
19Ama Sambalat arɩ Tobia a pɛ Arab tɩɩna ma ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Gesem sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la, ba mɔŋ-la a sisierila a bʋl, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ maa ŋaa ŋ-la? Maa vɩa kuoro niiŋ nɛ koo?”
20Mɩ bʋla pɩba, “Wɩa sɩ hɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ jaŋ pɛ la lɛ dɩ la tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la dɛrɛ. La ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ, la jaŋ suomo sɩsaa jebii-la. Ama ma-na bɩ kpaal kala kɛnɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, a bɩ ʋ naaba wɩaa tʋɔŋ ma lɛ pɛ.”

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 3
Content:
Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ saa kɛrɛ
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ɛlɩasɩb sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔnsʋ-la ma sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara suomi ba tɩntɩŋŋaa, a wasa paa boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Piesee boi-baalɩŋ saa. Ba joŋo pɩ Wɩa, aŋ hɛ ʋ borusuŋ a saaʋ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi dɩɩ-leŋii-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zɔlɔ arɩ Hananɛl Dɩɩ-duduoŋ-la a joŋ ba ma pɩ Wɩa. 2Jeriko nɩaa ma nɛ saa tɩgɛ ba lɛ. Imiri nanʋala Zaku ma saa tɩgɛ Jeriko nɩaa lɛ.
3Hasɛna hambolibiisiŋ ma nɛ wasa paa Chenfilee Boi-baalɩŋ saa. Ba hɛ ʋ daa-doloo arɩ ʋ borusuŋ a pɛ ʋ hɔɔnʋŋ lɛ arɩ daasɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa gɩgɩrɩgɛ borusu-la lɛ. 4Mɛrɛmɔf sɩ ŋaa Yuria nanʋala, a ŋaa Hakɔs ma nihiŋ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ. Mesulam sɩ ŋaa Bɛrɛkɩa nanʋala a ŋaa Mɛsɛzabɛl ma nihiŋ ma nɛ wasa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Baana nanʋala Zadɔk ma nɛ wasa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ Mesulam lɛ. 5Tɛkʋa tɩŋŋaa ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Ama ba nɩbalaa vɩa dɩ ba tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ bemba ba tɩtɩŋ sɩ dagɛba nɛ.
6Pasɩa nanʋala Joyada arɩ Besodeya nanʋala Mesulam nɛ wasa saa boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jesana Boi-baalɩŋ. Ba hɛ ʋ daa-doloo arɩ ʋ borusuŋ a pɛ ʋ hɔɔnʋŋ lɛ arɩ daasɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa gɩgɩrɩgɛ borusu-la. 7Mɛlatɩa sɩ lɩɩ Gibioŋ, Jadɔŋ sɩ lɩɩ Mɛrɔnɔf arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ Gibioŋ arɩ Mizipa ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Ba saa ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi Yufireti fuo-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ dɩa. 8Hahaaya nanʋala Ʋzɩɛl sɩ ŋaa sɛlɩmɛ gɔgɔ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Hananaaya ma sɩ ŋaa tʋlaalɩ-ŋaarʋ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Ba wasa saa Jerusalɛm ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi Je-bii Jalɩɩ-la. 9Huu nanʋala Refaaya sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm tinteeŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ Hananaaya lɛ. 10Harumaf nanʋala Jedaaya ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Lee-la fa kpagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa dɩa nɛ. Hasabineya nanʋala Hatus ma nɛ bɩra saa tɩgɛ Jedaaya lɛ.
11Harɩm nanʋala Malɩkɩja arɩ Pahaf-Mʋab nanʋala Hasub ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga arɩ tabʋʋ-pumoo dɩɩ-leŋii-la. 12Halɔhɛs nanʋala Salum sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm tinteeŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Ʋ toloo ma fa pɛ ʋ lɛ ba tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nɛ.
13Hanuŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ Zanʋa lɛ ma nɛ wasa saa Fuonaaŋ Boi-baal-la. Ba saaʋ nɛ, a hɛ ʋ borusuŋ a pɛ ʋ hɔɔnʋŋ lɛ arɩ daasɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa gɩgɩrɩgɛ borusu-la. Ba fa bɩra wasa saa jebii-la naakieliŋ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Nɛ-bɩnɩŋ Boi-baal-la.
14Rekab nanʋala Malɩkɩja sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm sɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf Hakerem ma nɛ wasa saa Nɛ-bɩnɩŋ Boi-baal-la. Ʋ saaʋ nɛ a hɛ ʋ borusuŋ arɩ ʋ hɔɔnʋŋ arɩ daasɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa gɩgɩrɩgɛ borusu-la.
15Koli-Hoze nanʋala Salum sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm sɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mizipa ma nɛ wasa saa Lɩɩ-bul-sɩɩŋ Boi-baal-la. Ʋ saaʋ nɛ a pilimi, a hɛ ʋ borusuŋ arɩ ʋ hɔɔnʋŋ arɩ daasɩ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa gɩgɩrɩgɛ borusu-la. Ʋ bɩra wasa saa jebii-la sɩ hɛ Sɛla fuo-la leriŋ a tɩgɛ Kuoro Gaarɩŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi lusuŋ-chol-sɩa-la sɩɩ lɩɩ Devit tabal-la lɛ. 16Azibuk nanʋala Nɛhɩmaaya sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm sɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛf-zuu kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi kuoroo dɩ-huguŋ sɩ hɛ Devit tabalɩŋ lɛ arɩ pɩl-la ba sɩ luo a pɛ bawajɩaba dɩa-la lɛ.
17Nɩalɩŋ ma bɩra sɩ wasa saa jebii-la sɩ tɩgɛ Azibuk lɛ nɛ ŋaa Levi doho nɩaa. Banɩ nanʋala Rehum nɛ bemba ba saa. Hasabɩa sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm sɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɛɛla kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, ma nɛ laa lee-la nɩaa ʋ sɩɩ beŋ nyuŋ a saa tɩgɛ. 18Hɛnadad nanʋala Bavaɩ sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm sɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɛɛla kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la dɔŋɔ ma, ʋ ma nɛ wasa saa tɩgɛ. 19Jesua nanʋala Ɛza sɩɩ beŋ ba tinteeŋ sɛmɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mizipa ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga, a kpagɛ ba laalɩyuori kɩaa dɩ-biliŋ a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi lee-la jee-la sɩ gʋra. 20Nɩɩ-la ma bɩra sɩ wasa saa tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋaa Zabaɩ nanʋala Baruk. Ʋ wasa saa lee-la nɛ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ a chɩŋ lee-la jee-la sɩ gʋra a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ Ɛlɩasɩb dɩa boiŋ niiŋ. 21Nɩɩ-la ma sɩ wasa saa tɩgɛ nɛ ŋaa Mɛrɛmɔf sɩ ŋaa Yuria nanʋala, a ŋaa Hakɔs ma nihiŋ. Ʋ ma chɩŋ Ɛlɩasɩb dɩa boiŋ niiŋ nɛ aŋ wasa saa mʋ yagɛ ʋ dɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ.
22Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ hɛ lee-la ma nɛ wasa paa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ saa. 23Bɛnjamɩŋ arɩ Hasub ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ ba dɩa sɩpaaŋ. Azarɩa sɩ ŋaa Maasɛya nanʋala, aŋ ŋaa Ananɩa ma nihiŋ nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ ʋ ma dɩa sɩpaaŋ. 24Henadad nanʋala Binui ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga, a chɩŋ Azarɩa dɩa sɩpaaŋ a kaa mʋ yagɛ jee-la sɩ gʋra ʋ gʋnʋŋ lɛ. 25Uzai nanʋala Palal ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga, a chɩŋ je-gʋŋ-la lɛ a kaa mʋ dɩɩ-leŋii-la sɩ hɛ kuoru dɩa-la ba sɩ saa sugili nyuŋ, a kpagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ kaala. Nɩalɩŋ ma bɩra sɩ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga nɛ ŋaa Parus nanʋala Pedaaya 26arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnaa sɩ hɛ Ɔfɛl dundolo-la nyuŋ. Ba wasa saa ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ challɛ Lɩɩŋ Boi-baal-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ dɩɩ-leŋii-la sɩ chɔŋɔ lɩɩ. 27Tɛkʋa nɩaa ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ, a chɩŋ dɩɩ-leŋii-la sɩ chɔŋɔ lɩɩ lɛ a kaa mʋ yi Ɔfɛl jeeŋ.
28A chɩŋ Janɩŋ Boi-baalɩŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Ba kʋŋkala paa lee-la sɩ hɛ ʋ dɩa sɩpaaŋ nɛ a wasa saa. 29Ima nanʋala Zadɔk ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ a challɛ ʋ dɩa. Sɛkanɩa nanʋala Sɛmaaya sɩɩ pɔ Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ Boi-baalɩŋ ma wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩgɛ Zadɔk lɛ. 30Sɛlɛmaaya nanʋala Hananaaya arɩ Hanuŋ sɩ ŋaa Zalaf hambolibii-dʋ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la sɩ tɩga. Bɛrɛkɩa nanʋala Mɛsʋlam ma nɛ wasa saa tɩgɛ ba lɛ a challɛ ʋ dɩa. 31Malɩkɩja sɩ ŋaa sɛlɩmɛ tɩntɩnnʋ ma nɛ wasa saa lee-la tɩgɛ Mɛsʋlam lɛ. Ʋ fa saa jee-la ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnaa dɩa arɩ bayalaa dɩa, a chaasɛ boi-baal-la ba sɩɩ gbilli nɩaa a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi dɩa-la sɩ hɛ jee-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa gʋnʋŋ nyuŋ lɛ. 32Sɛlɩmɛ tɩntɩnna-la arɩ bayalɩa-la ma nɛ wasa saa dɩ-kaaŋ-la, a chɩŋ dɩa-la sɩ hɛ je-gʋŋ-la nyuŋ a kaa mʋ yi Piesee boi-baalɩŋ.

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 4
Content:
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɔ dɩ ba sɩ́ jebii-la wasa saa
1Baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sambalat sɩ nɩa dɩ la wasa paa jebii-la a sɩsaa nɛ, ʋ baanɩŋ chaasa sii woruŋ, ʋ sisieri la-na Juu tɩŋŋaa lɛ 2a bʋl ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ arɩ Samarɩa laalɩyuori hɩasɩŋ sɩpaaŋ, “Bɛɛ kɩaa wɩaa nɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa nɩpʋgʋnʋŋ deemba ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ? Ba jaŋ wuo wasa saa ba jebii-la a kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩ-sʋlaa? Ba bɩɩna ba jaŋ wuo saaʋ dɛrɛ tapʋl bala koo? Ba bɩɩna ba jaŋ wuo kuusi tabɩa-la arɩ nyiniŋ sɩ diiba ma kala koo?”
3Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ Tobia sɩ ŋaa Amɔŋ tɩɩna ma fa chɩŋ Sambalat sɛmɛ, a bʋl, “Kʋ-la ba sɩɩ saa, dɩ jolo ma nɛ paala jɩlʋ, ʋʋ bori ʋ tel nɛ.”
4Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sʋl Wɩa a bʋl, “La Wɩa, nɩɩ, ba bee muurila nɛ, leŋ dɩ jomo-la ba sɩ tʋʋsɛla gʋra dɛrɛ ba nyuŋ lɛ. Leŋ dɩ nɩaa kʋ laa ba kɩaa aŋ kɛsɛba mʋ tintee-wogo dɩ ba ŋaa yosi. 5Sɩ́ ba wʋcheelee joŋo chɛba koo a yʋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba tʋʋsɛ la nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ saa jebii-la nɛ.”
6Ŋɩɩ nɛ la wasa saa jebii-la ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi ʋ leŋiŋ kpaa-magɛ dɔŋɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ chaasa tɩŋ nɛ arɩ ba tʋɔŋ kala.
7Ama Sambalat, Tobia, Arab tɩŋŋaa, Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa arɩ Asɩdɔd tɩŋŋaa sɩ nɩa arɩ Jerusalɛm jebii-la saanɩŋ ka mʋ sɩpaaŋ, wuolo-la kala sɩ hɛ jebii-la lɛ tʋtɔ, ba baanɩŋ sii woruŋ. 8Ba kala vʋʋrɛ dɩ ba kʋ hɛ yuosuŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kɛŋ wɩaa vʋgʋmɛ. 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ la ma sʋl la Wɩa, aŋ lɩɩsɛ nɩaa ba pʋpɔ leriŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ vʋʋra lɛ.
10Ama Juda nɩaa sɩ, “Tɩntɩnnaa doluŋ kala dɛrɛ nɛ, ka tabɩaa arɩ tɩɛrɩŋ ma daŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ yʋgɛ. Ŋɩɩ leŋ la bɩ jaŋ wuo wasa paa jebii-la saa.”
11La dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ma bʋl, “Juu tɩmma-la jaŋ kʋ jɩjɩŋ koo a nɩnala dɩ la hɛ ba tʋɔŋ a kpʋba, ka dɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la birigi.”
12Ŋɩɩ nɛ la Juu tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ jʋʋ kpɩkpagɛba kʋ lɔgɔ pɩla bʋlɩa bʋlɩa wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ vʋʋra tɩgɛ la lɛ.
13Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ leŋ nɩalɩŋ nyɩgɩlɛ a kori tokobiee, tiŋŋee arɩ tosuŋ a chɩŋ dɩa dɩa, jebii-la lere-la ha sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ lɛ. 14Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ beŋ wɩaa jim, aŋ bʋla pɩ tinteeŋ nɩbalaa, tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩkaana-la, “Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a tɩŋ la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Má liisi ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ, nɩaa fɩfáʋ, aŋ yuo laa ma naambiiriŋ, ma hambolibiisiŋ, ma toloo, ma haalaa arɩ ma dɩɩsɩŋ.”
15La dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ nɩa arɩ la nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ vʋʋra a tɩgɛ la lɛ nɛ, Wɩa ma kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ vʋʋra vʋgʋmɛ, Ŋɩɩ nɛ la kala bɩra mʋ wasa sɩsaa jebii-la.
16A chɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la a kaa mʋ, mɩ nɩalɩŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ yie tɩtɩŋ, ka kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ ma nyɩgɩlɛ a kori tiŋŋee, hɔɔtaalɩ-la ba sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ arɩ tosuŋ. La tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala fa chɩna pɔ la Juu tɩŋŋaa nɛ, 17a chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ saa jebii-la harɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chʋŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa sɩsaa jebii-la fa yie kɛŋ nɩsɩŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ tɩtɩŋ aŋ kori bayuori kʋa ma nɩsɩŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ. 18Tɩntɩnna-la kʋŋkala fa yie gɩrɩgɛ ʋ tokobiiŋ nɛ aŋ tɩtɩŋ. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋmʋʋ banyile-na fa hɛ mɩ teeŋ nɛ.
19Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩ tintee-la nɩbalaa, tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala, “La tɩntɩmɩɩ-la jalla nɛ, ka la pɩsa golli jebii-la a bol arɩ dɔŋɔ. 20Dɩ ma nɛ nɩa ba ŋmʋʋ banyile, má fá kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lee-la ba sɩ ŋmʋa. La Wɩa jaŋ yuo pɩla.”
21Ŋɩɩ nɛ la ha tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la, a chɩŋ chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ pɔsɔ, baala-la kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ yie chɩna pɔ nɛ a kori tiŋŋee. 22Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Nʋʋkala arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ ba tɩtɩŋ maga dɩ ma hɛ Jerusalɛm tʋɔŋ nɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ, aa pɔ leriŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ aŋ tɩtɩŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ ma.” 23Mɩ-na arɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ arɩ mɩ tɩntɩnna-la sɩɩ to mɩ harɩŋ a pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔmɛ lɛ, la kʋŋkala bɩ la gɛnnɩŋ wuro tɩtaŋɩŋ ma. La kori la bayuori kɩaa nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ.

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 5
Content:
Nɛhɩmaaya pɛ summoo lɛ
1Bʋa kʋbala lɛ baalaa arɩ ba haalaa sii ŋmoo niiŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ ba naambiiriŋ Juu tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ lɛ. 2Ba dɔnsʋŋ sɩ, “La dɩ la biiriŋ yʋga, laa chɛ mɩaa nɛ dɩ la dii a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.”
3Dɔnsʋŋ ma bʋl, “La joŋ la bagɩsɩŋ, girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ arɩ la dɩɩsɩŋ nɛ aa bil bʋbʋɔŋ ka dɩ la wuo na kʋdiilee dɩ losuŋ sɩ́ la kpʋ.”
4Dɔnsʋŋ ma ha bʋl, “La yie chɩŋ moribiee nɛ a tiŋ la bagɩsɩŋ arɩ la girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ lampooba a pɩ kuoro. 5La ma ŋaa Juu tɩmma nɛ arɩ la naambiiri-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. La biiriŋ zɔmɔ nɛ arɩ ba biiriŋ sɩ zɔmɔ ŋɩɩ, ama wɩaa jʋʋla a magɛ dɩ la leŋ dɩ la biiriŋ ŋaa yosi nɛ. La toloo dɔnsʋŋ paala ŋaa yosi nɛ, ama la bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ tɩɩ bagɩsɩŋ arɩ la girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ.”
6Mɩ sɩ nɩɩ ba nii-ŋmobo arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ ŋmɛnɛ, mɩ baanɩŋ chaasa sii woruŋ. 7Mɩ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ bɩɩnɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ, aŋ bʋl tinteeŋ nɩbala-la arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la teeŋ. Mɩ bʋla pɩba, “Maa laa nyʋʋrʋŋ nɛ ma naambiiriŋ tɩtɩa teeŋ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ yɩrɛ hilim-bal dɩ mɩ chaasa bʋl ba teeŋ. 8Mɩ sɩ, “Lɛɛlɛ, la hɛ doluŋ nɛ aŋ mɩɩra time lɩlaa la Juu tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ joŋ ba tɩtɩa yalla pɩ tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa. Lɛɛlɛ ma tɩtɩa mɩɩra fʋgɛ ma naambiiriŋ nɛ dɩ ba joŋ ba tɩtɩa yalla pɩma.” Sɩpaa-laara-la kala tɔrɛ ba niiŋ bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ dɩ ba bʋl.
9Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra bʋl, “Wɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ ŋaa, ʋ bʋa lɛ dee ŋɩɩ. Ma maga má fá Wɩa nɛ aŋ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ, dɩ tinteye-la sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka to aŋ ŋaa la dʋndɔmɔ sɩ́ wuo na wombiiŋ a sieri la lɛ. 10Mɩ dɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ arɩ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa ma joŋ moribiee arɩ mɩaa chɩchɩŋ nɩalɩŋ nɛ. Lɛɛlɛ, má leŋ dɩ ma nyʋʋrɩɩ-la laanɩŋ dɛrɛ. 11Má ŋaa lɩma a joŋ ba bagɩsɩŋ, ba girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ, ba olif tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ pɩba, a pɛ nyʋʋrɩ-la kala ma sɩ laa ba teeŋ, moribiee, mɩaa, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ.”
12Nɩalɩŋ ma bʋl, “La jaŋ mɩɩra joŋ kɩalɩŋ pɩba. La bɩra bɩ jaŋ laa kʋŋkala ba teeŋ.” La jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ bʋla.
Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ yɩrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, a leŋ nɩbala-la arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ ba jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla. 13Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kɛŋ mɩ gɛrɩpɛ jalɩɩ-la sɩ vɔɔ mɩ tɩŋa puri a kaa kpesi aŋ bʋl, “Ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa jaŋ kɛŋ ma kʋŋkala sɩ jaŋ vɩa dɩ ŋ to niiŋ deeŋ a kpese ta. Wɩa jaŋ laa ŋ dɩa arɩ ŋ dʋa kala ka dɩ ŋ kɛŋ na-hɩllɩŋ.”
Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hilimi lee-la bʋl, “Amɩɩ,” aŋ dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA. Ŋɩɩ nɛ sɩpaalaara-la kɛŋ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla tɩŋ.
14Bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lɩɩsɛmɛ mɩ ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ, dɩ kuoro Atazɛzɛs ma sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ sɩ mʋ yi jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩa lɛ, dɩ mɩ ma sɩ ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ balɩa lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ dɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ kʋŋkala bɩ leŋe ba kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yie joŋo pɩ tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ kʋ pɩla. 15Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa tintee-la nɩhɩasɩŋ aŋ ka pɩmɛ joŋ wʋdaŋ nɛ a nyagɛ nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ. Tapʋlɩɩ kala ba yie laa warɩpʋla mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ, a pɛ ba kʋdiilee arɩ ba girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ ma joŋ wɩaa nyagɛ nɩalɩŋ nɛ. Ama a tɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ fá Wɩa, mɩ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. 16Mɩ joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa kala hɛ jebii-la saanɩŋ lɛ nɛ, mɩ bɩ tintee kala yɔbɔ. Mɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ tɩmaa pɩmɛ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a ma tɩŋ jebii-la tɩntɩŋŋaa.
17Juu tɩŋŋaa zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii a pɛ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ lɛ paala didii kɩaa mɩ dɩa lɛ nɛ, a saa pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ tinteye-la sɩ golli-la a kɔ lɛ. 18Tapʋlɩɩ kala mɩ yie lɩɩsɛ nɛ-fere, pie-zɔŋŋɔɔ balɩdʋ, a pɛ jiŋŋee lɛ ba ŋaa kʋdiilee pɩla. Tapʋlaa fii na-kala pɛgɛ, mɩ yie chɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ nɛ a yʋgɛ woruŋ. Arɩ mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba ma kala, mɩ ha bɩ pɩɛsa bʋl nɩalɩŋ pɩmɛ kʋdiile-la sɩ maga dɩ tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ laa, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa sɩ nyagɛ nɩalɩŋ nɛ.
19Mɩ Wɩa, liisi mɩ wɩaa aŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa pɩ nɩaa deemba.

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 6
Content:
Nɩaa ha bɩra pɔ dɩ ba sɩ́ jebii-la wasa saa
1Sambalat, Tobia, Arab tɩŋŋaa Gesem arɩ la dʋndɔmɔ-la kala nɩa dɩ mɩ wasa saa Jerusalɛm jebii-la kala wuol bɩ ka. Ama mɩ fa ha bɩ borusuŋ hɛ boi-baal-la lɛ. 2Ŋɩɩ nɛ Sambalat arɩ Gesem tɩŋ tɩndaarɩŋ deeŋ pɩmɛ: “Kɔ dɩ la cheŋ dɔŋɔ tabiisi-la dɔŋɔ sɩ hɛ Ono tintee-taala-la lɛ.”
Ama ba faa chɛ wombiiŋ nɛ dɩ ba ŋaamɛ wʋbɔŋ. 3Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tɩŋ nɩaa ba mɩɩra kɛŋ duoso deeŋ mʋ pɩba: Mɩɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-fɩaŋ nɛ mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo kɔ. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo vɩa tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ta aŋ kɔ ma teeŋ 4Naansɩɩŋ bʋnɛsɛ nɛ ba tɩŋ tɩndaarɩ-la tɩtɩa a pɩmɛ. Bʋa na-kala mɩ ma yie bʋl ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa a pɩba.
5Nɔŋ lɛ nɛ, Sambalat tɩŋ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩma pʋpʋ ʋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ arɩ tɩndaarɩ-la tɩtɩa, aŋ kori teniŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa a bɩ magɩlɩŋ hɛ. 6Teŋ-la tʋɔŋ ŋ-la nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ:
“Tinteyee tʋɔŋ nɩaa ka bʋl, arɩ ŋ dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ka vʋʋrɛ nɛ dɩ ma hɛ yuosuŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ma wasaa saa jee-la ŋɩɩ. Ba bɩra bʋla arɩ ŋŋ chɛ ŋ ŋaa ba kuoro nɛ, Gesem ma bʋl arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. 7Ŋ paala lɩɩsɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ ba heele bʋl Jerusalɛm lɛ, arɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa Juda tinteeŋ kuoro. Wɩɩŋ deeŋ saa jaŋ jʋʋ Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoro dɩgɩlɩŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa kɔ dɩ la bʋl wɩɩ-la a hɛ dɔŋɔ.”
8Mɩ mɩɩra bʋl ŋ-la a pʋ: “Wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ bʋl kala ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ nɛ. Ŋ tɩtɩa tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ ŋ bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ.”
9Ba kala faa nɛrɩgɛ dɩ ba fugisila nɛ, dɩ la nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la lɛ, dɩ la sɩ́ wuo dɛrɛ.
Ama mɩ sʋl Wɩa a bʋl, “Wɩa, pɩmɛ doluŋ.”
10Tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala mɩ mʋ Sɛmaaya dɩa. Sɛmaaya fa ŋaa Delaaya nanʋala nɛ, aŋ ŋaa Mɛhɛtabɛl ma nihiŋ, ʋ fa hɛ dɩa lɛ nɛ ʋ bɩ lɩɩ. Ʋ bʋl, “Leŋ mɩ dɩŋ mʋ faa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ a kɛŋ ʋ boyee tɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩaa nɩɩ kɔ dɩ ba kpʋŋ. Tɩtaŋɩŋ baa kɔ dɩ ba kpʋŋ nɛ.” 11Ama mɩ bʋla pʋ, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ-na baala sɩ magɛ ŋ-la jaŋ fá fɩfaa? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ jaŋ jʋʋ faa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ dɩ mɩ laa mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ? Mɩ bɩ mʋ.” 12Mɩ jɩma arɩ Wɩa dee bɩ ʋ tɩma, ama Sambalat arɩ Tobia nɛ kpalʋ ka dɩ ʋ nyɩsɛmɛ arɩ wɩaa deemba. 13Ba kpalʋ nɛ ka dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩaa a yʋɔrɛ mɩ nandaasɩŋ dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, dɩ ba to ŋɩɩ lɛ a chei mɩ yɩrɩŋ a hɩɩsɩ mɩ.
14Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a bʋl, “Mɩ Wɩa, liisi wɩalɩŋ Tobia arɩ Sambalat sɩ ŋaa, liisi haal-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ baa yɩrɛ Nʋadɩa arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la dɔnsʋŋ kala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba fugusimi wɩaa.”
Ba saa kɛrɛ-la dɛrɛ
15Jee-la saanɩŋ dɛrɛ chɛnɛ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛlʋl tʋɔŋ nɛ, ʋ tapʋlaa mara arɩ banɔŋ chɛɛŋ. Tapʋlaa mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ ba joŋo saa jee-la. 16La dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ hɛ tinteye-la kala sɩ gollila lɛ a nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba ba yɩɛlaa kala lɛl, bɛɛ wɩaa ba jɩma arɩ la Wɩa nɛ pɛ la lɛ la tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ.
17Bʋa-la kala lɛ, Juda tinteeŋ nɩbalaa fa ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ yʋgɛ nɛ a pɩpɩ Tobia. Tobia ma laa aŋ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩba. 18Nɩaa fa yʋga Juda tinteeŋ lɛ sɩ hɛ niiŋ ʋ teeŋ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa Ara nanʋala Sɛkanɩa hɩɩlɩ-baala wɩaa. Ʋ nanʋala Jehohanaŋ ma fa jaa Bɛrɛkɩa nanʋala Mesulam tolo nɛ. 19Ba yie bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la Tobia sɩ ŋaa a pɩpɩmɛ aŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ mɩ ma sɩ bʋla a pʋpʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Tobia ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ aa fugusimi.

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 7
Content:
1La sɩ paa jee-la wasa saa dɛrɛ, mɩ hɛ ʋ borusuŋ, a lɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ boi-baala-la, yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa. 2Mɩ joŋ Jerusalɛm hɛ mɩ naambie Hanani arɩ Hananaaya sɩ ŋaa dɩ-duo-la laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ ba bibeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Hananaaya fa ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ jɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kɛnɩŋ nɛ a fɩfá Wɩa a kɩɩ nɩaa jesiŋ kala. 3Mɩ bʋla pɩba, “Má sɩ́ Jerusalɛm boi-baalaa suru, see dɩ wɩa haasa. Bʋa-la lɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ boi-baala-la ha sɩ hɛ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ, má tɔ borusu-la a kɛŋ daa-dolo-la gɩrɩgɛ. Má lɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ dɩ ba pʋpɔ leriŋ, dɩ dɔnsʋŋ pʋpɔ lere-la ma sɩ jaŋ dagɛba, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma pʋpɔ lere-la sɩ kpagɛ ba dɩɩsɩŋ.”
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ mɩɩra lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ
4Tabal-la fa jalɩa, ama nɩaa fa bɩ yʋgɛ nɩmɛ, ba ha bɩ dɩɩsɩŋ ma paa wasa saa. 5Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa joŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa a hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ arɩ mɩ kɛŋ tintee-la nɩbalaa, tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ tintee-la nɩaa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ a dɩɩsɛba dɩa dɩa a ŋmʋnsa bil. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na teŋ-la lɛ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ doho nɩaa yɩraa hɛ. Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ na ba ŋmʋnsa nɛ ŋ-la:
6Juu tɩmma-la fa sɩ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ, a lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ a mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda, ba kʋŋkala mʋ hɔŋ ba tasɩŋ lɛ. Babɩlɔŋ kuoro Nebukadineza nɛ fa yuo kɛsɛba kaa mʋ nɩmɛ. 7Ba sɩpaalaaraa nɛ fa ŋaa, Zerubabɛl, Jesua, Nɛhɩmaaya, Azarɩa, Raamɩa, Nahamanɩ, Modikaaya, Bɩlɩsaŋ, Mɩsɩpɛrɛf, Bɩgɩvaɩ, Nehum arɩ Baana.
Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga a kɔ arɩ ba doho nɩaa niiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: 8Parɔs doho nɩaa fa ŋaa bʋɩ balɩa arɩ zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ. 9Sɛfatɩa ma doho nɩaa fa ŋaa zɔɔ-batori arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ. 10Ara ma doho nɩaa ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ. 11Pahaf-Mʋab doho nɩaa ŋaa bʋɩ balɩa arɩ zɔlɔ chori arɩ fii arɩ chori nɛ. (Ba fa ŋaa Jesua arɩ Jʋab doho nɩaa nɛ.) 12Ɛlam ma doho nɩaa ŋaa bʋɩ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ. 13Zatu ma doho nɩaa ŋaa zɔlɔ chori arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ banɔŋ nɛ. 14Zakaɩ ma doho nɩaa ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩpɛ arɩ mahɩŋ batori nɛ. 15Binui ma doho nɩaa ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ chori nɛ. 16Bɛbaɩ ma doho nɩaa ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ mara arɩ chori nɛ. 17Azɩgad ma doho nɩaa ŋaa bʋɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-batori arɩ mara arɩ balɩa nɛ. 18Adonikam doho nɩaa ma ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ balɩpɛ nɛ. 19Bɩgɩvaɩ ma doho nɩaa ŋaa bʋɩ balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ balɩpɛ nɛ. 20Adɩŋ ma doho nɩaa ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ nɛ. 21Ata dɩa nɩaa ŋaa mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ fii arɩ chori nɛ. (Ba ŋaa Hezikaaya doho nɩaa nɛ.) 22Hasum ma doho nɩaa ŋaa zɔɔ-batori arɩ mara arɩ chori nɛ. 23Bɛzaɩ ma doho nɩaa ŋaa zɔɔ-batori arɩ mara arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ. 24Harɩf ma doho nɩaa ŋaa zɔlɔ arɩ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ. 25Gibioŋ ma doho nɩaa ŋaa mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ nɛ.
26Nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Bɛtɩlɛhɛm arɩ Netofa tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ chori nɛ. 27Anatɔf doho nɩaa ma ŋaa zɔlɔ arɩ mara arɩ chori nɛ. 28Bɛf Azɩmavɛf tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ balɩa nɛ. 29Kɩrɩaf Jɩarɩm, Kɛfɩra arɩ Bɛɛrɔf nɩaa ma ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩpɛ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ batori nɛ. 30Rama arɩ Geba nɩaa ma ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ mara arɩ kʋbala nɛ. 31Mɩkɩmas doho nɩaa ma ŋaa zɔlɔ arɩ mara arɩ balɩa nɛ. 32Bɛtɛl arɩ Aɩ ma nɩaa ŋaa zɔlɔ arɩ mara arɩ batori nɛ. 33Nebo dɔŋɔ ma nɩaa ŋaa mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ. 34Ɛlam dɔŋɔ ma nɩaa ŋaa bʋɩ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ. 35Harɩm nɩaa ma ŋaa zɔɔ-batori arɩ mara nɛ. 36Jeriko tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa zɔɔ-batori arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ banɔŋ nɛ. 37Lod, Hadɩd arɩ Ono tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩpɛ arɩ mara arɩ kʋbala nɛ. 38Sɛnaa tɩŋŋaa ma ŋaa bʋɩ batori arɩ zɔlɔ nibi arɩ mara arɩ fii nɛ.
39Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ arɩ ba doho nɩaa niiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Jedaaya doho nɩaa sɩ lɩɩ Jesua dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ ŋaa zɔlɔ nibi arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii arɩ batori nɛ. 40Ɩma doho nɩaa ŋaa bʋɩ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ. 41Pasɩhɔ ma doho nɩaa ŋaa bʋɩ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ balɩpɛ nɛ. 42Harɩm doho nɩaa ŋaa bʋɩ arɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ nɛ.
43Levi doho nɩaa ma nɛ ŋ-la: Jesua arɩ Kadɩmɩɛl, nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Hodavia doho tʋɔŋ ŋaa mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ. 44Yɩɩlɩ-yɩɩraa: Asaf doho nɩaa ma ŋaa zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ chori nɛ.
45Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baalaa ma nɛ ŋ-la: Salum doho nɩaa, Ata doho nɩaa, Talɩmɔŋ doho nɩaa, Akub doho nɩaa, Hatɩta arɩ Sobai doho nɩaa ma ŋaa zɔlɔ arɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ chori nɛ.
46Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnaa ma nɛ ŋ-la: Zɩha doho nɩaa, Hasufa doho nɩaa, Tabaof doho nɩaa:
47Keros, Sɩa, Padɔŋ, 48Lɛbana, Hagaba, Salɩmaɩ, 49Hanaŋ, Gɩdɛl, Gaha, 50Rahaya, Reziŋ, Nekoda, 51Gazam, Uza, Pasɩa, 52Bɛsaɩ, Mewunim, Nefusim, 53Bakɩbʋk, Hakufa, Haahɔ, 54Baziluf, Mɛhɩda, Hasa, 55Bakɔs, Sɩsɛra, Tɛma, 56Nɛzɩa arɩ Hatɩfa.
57Solomoŋ tɩntɩnnaa ma doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Sotai, Sɔfɛrɛf, Pɛrɩda, 58Jaala, Daakɔŋ, Gɩdɛl, 59Sɛfatɩa, Hatɩl, Pɔkɛrɛf-Hazɛbem arɩ Amɔŋ.
60Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnaa arɩ Solomoŋ tɩntɩnnaa doho nɩaa ŋaa zɔɔ-batori arɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ.
61Nɩaa deemba ma nɛ lɩɩ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛl Mɛla, Tɛl Hasa, Kerub, Adɔŋ arɩ Ɩma a kɔ. Ama ba bɩ wuo dagɛ arɩ ba ŋaa Iziral tɩmma nɛ:
62Ba nɛ Delaaya, Tobia arɩ Nekoda doho nɩaa, ba ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩdʋ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ balɩa nɛ.
63Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma tʋɔŋ, nɩaa deemba doho nɩaa ma mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ:
Hobaaya, Hakɔs arɩ Bazɩlaɩ. (Ʋ fa jaa Gɩlɩad tɩŋŋaa Bazɩlaɩ tolo nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba joŋ yɩrɛ-la hɛ pʋ.)
64Nɩaa deemba fa chɛ ba naabalɩmaba yɩraa tenniŋ ka nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛba ta Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tʋɔŋ arɩ ba kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ. 65Tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ kiriba dɩ ba sɩ́ kʋdiile-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩa kʋzɔmɔ dii, see dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara kɛŋ Urim arɩ Tumim chɛ na.
66Nɩalɩŋ kala fa ŋaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ balɩa, zɔɔ-batori arɩ mahɩŋ batori nɛ, 67a pɛ ba tɩntɩnnaa baalaa arɩ haalaa sɩ ŋaa bʋɩ balɩpɛ arɩ zɔɔ-batori arɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ lɛ. Ba fa kɛŋ baalaa arɩ haalaa ma zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ banɔŋ nɛ sɩ ŋaa yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa. 68Ba fa kɛŋ janɩŋ zɔɔ-balɩpɛ arɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩdʋ nɛ, kakusuŋ sɩ nagɛ janɩŋ ma zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ banɔŋ, 69bʋntaŋŋaba zɔɔ-banɛsɛ arɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ banɔŋ a pɛ kakusuŋ ma bʋɩ balɩdʋ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩpɛ arɩ mara lɛ.
70Dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ ma fa chɛ kɩaa pɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la lɛ nɛ. Tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ pa sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo chori nɛ, Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-gbansɩŋ ma mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma gɛnnɩŋ zɔɔ-banɔŋ arɩ mara arɩ fii. 71Dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma pa sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ chori nɛ, hɔpʋla ma kilo bʋɩ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii. 72Nɩkaanaa ma kala sɩ pa kɩalɩŋ ŋaa sɛlɩmɛ kilo zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ chori nɛ, hɔpʋla ma kilo zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa gɛnnɩŋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ balɩpɛ.
73Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi doho nɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baalaa, yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ arɩ Iziral tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ kala fa kʋ hɔŋ ba tɩtɩa tasɩŋ lɛ nɛ.
Ɛzɩra karɩmɛ Wɩa wombiee teniŋ
Jɩ-pɛɩ kʋʋ yi dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hɔŋ ba tasɩŋ lɛ.

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 8
Content:
1Nɩalɩŋ kala kʋ hilimi ba jaŋ dɩ-hilimiŋ arɩ nii-bala, Lɩɩŋ Boi-baal-la leriŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba bʋla pɩ Ɛzɩra sɩ ŋaa Wɩa tenniŋ kerichi, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ Wɩa wombiiŋ teŋ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ to Mosis lɛ a joŋo pɩ ba Iziral tɩŋŋaa kaa kʋ lɩɩ.
2Ŋɩɩ nɛ chɛŋ-pɛɩ tapʋl-bumbuŋ, Ɛzɩra sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara kɛŋ teŋ-la kɔ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hilime sɩpaaŋ. Nɩalɩŋ fa ŋaa baalaa arɩ haalaa nɛ, a pɛ hambiisi-la sɩ waa a jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa lɛ. 3Ʋ chɩŋ ba jaŋ dɩ-hilimii-la lɛ, Lɩɩŋ Boi-baal-la leriŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ a faasa karɩmɛ teŋ-la ʋ lɩɩ, a chɩŋ chʋchʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ wɩɩhɛyɛ, ka nɩalɩŋ kala kpil dɩgɩlaa a jijegili.
4Ba fa kɛŋ daasɩŋ nɛ a ŋaa kʋŋ ʋ sii je wɩɩ-la wɩaa, Ɛzɩra Wɩa teniŋ kerichi-la jɩla chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ. Matɩtɩa, Sɛma, Anaaya, Yuria, Hɩlɩkaaya arɩ Maasɛya nɛ fa chɩŋ ʋ nadiiŋ sɛmɛ, ka Pedaaya, Mɩsɩɛl, Malɩkɩja, Hasum, Hasɩbadana, Zɛkarɩya arɩ Mesulam ma chɩŋ ʋ nagʋa sɛmɛ.
5Ɛzɩra fa sɩ chɩŋ kʋ-la nyuŋ a je kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ kala ŋɩɩ, ba kala sɩaa fa pɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ kɛŋ teŋ-la suri, nɩalɩŋ kala sii chɩŋ. 6Ɛzɩra dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩ-balɩŋ, nɩalɩŋ kala kɛŋ ba nɩsaa je aŋ laa bʋl, “Amɩɩ, Amɩɩ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba tuu kpirimi a kɛŋ nyusuŋ chugili tinteeŋ a chʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA.
7Ŋɩɩ nɛ aŋ sii chɩŋ Levi doho nɩaa deemba dagɛ Wɩa wombie-la bʋbʋɔŋ a pɩba: Jesua, Banɩ, Sɛrɛbɩa, Jamɩŋ, Akub, Sabɛtaɩ, Hodia, Maasɛya, Kɛlɩta, Azarɩa, Jozabad, Hanaŋ arɩ Pɛlaaya. 8Ba fa karɩmɛ Wɩa wombiiŋ teŋ-la ʋ tʋʋlɛ nɛ woruŋ aŋ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ wuo jɩŋ.
9Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wombii-la, ba yaraa vɛŋ ba suomo yiyel. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Nɛhɩmaaya sɩ ŋaa ba tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ, Ɛzɩra, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, aŋ pɛ ŋaa Wɩa teniŋ kerichi arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ bʋla pɩba, “Jɩnɩŋ ŋaa tapʋl-zɔŋ nɛ a pɩ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa, ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma bɩ maga dɩ ma yel koo dɩ ma tʋɔŋ chei.”
10Nɛhɩmaaya bɩra bʋla pɩba, “Má mʋ dii kʋdii-sɩŋŋaa, a nyʋa sɩ-zɔmʋŋ aŋ ŋaa dɔnsʋŋ mʋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ kʋŋ kɛnɛ. Jɩnɩŋ ŋaa tapʋl-zɔŋ nɛ a pɩ La TƖƖNA. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔŋ chei, bɛɛ wɩaa tʋɔtɔrʋ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ La TƖƖNA lɛ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ma doluŋ.”
11Levi doho nɩaa nyagɛ nɩalɩŋ bɔyɛ a bʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ ma yaraa pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, jɩnɩŋ ŋaa tapʋl-zɔŋ nɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe ma tʋɔŋ chei.”
12Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ kala mʋ dɩ ba dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋa kɩaa a gbieli arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, aŋ pɛ ŋaa kʋdiile-la pɩ ba dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ karɩma pɩba sɩaa nɛ.
13Tapʋl-lɩa chɛɛŋ, dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ kala a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa lɛ, kʋ hilimi Ɛzɩra sɩ ŋaa Wɩa teniŋ kerichi teeŋ dɩ ba gʋnnɛ Wɩa wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto. 14Ba na Wɩa wombii-la La TƖƖNA sɩ to Mosis lɛ a joŋo pɩba tʋɔŋ, dɩ Wɩa daga arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa maga dɩ ba jʋʋ lɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ, gbiele-la ba sɩ jaŋ gbieli chɛŋ-pɛɩ-la tʋɔŋ. 15Ba bɩra na arɩ ʋ maga ba heele bʋl Jerusalɛm arɩ ba tasɩŋ kala lɛ a bʋl, “Má jɩl dundolluŋ nyuŋ a bori olif pɩpaarɩŋ, chɛɛŋ pɩpaarɩŋ, abɛ pɩpaarɩŋ arɩ tɩɩsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ pɩpaarɩŋ sɩ yʋga a kaa kʋ hɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ, arɩ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa wombiiŋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ.”
16Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ mʋ chɛ pɩpaarɩ-la kaa kɔ hɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ pɩ ba tɩtɩa ba lusunuŋ nyuŋ, ba kaalɩsɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa dɩa kaalɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba jaŋ dɩ-hilimiŋ Lɩɩŋ Boi-baal-la leriŋ, arɩ dɩ-hilimii-la dɔŋɔ ma sɩ hɛ Efirem Boi-baalɩŋ lɛ. 17Nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ mɩɩra lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ hɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ a jʋjʋʋ. A lɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ Nuŋ nanʋala Josua fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa kɔ tapʋlɩɩ-la, Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa bɩ gbiele-la ŋɩɩ gbiele. Ba tʋɔŋ fa chaasa tɔrɛ nɛ woruŋ.
18Tapʋlɩa-la kala, a chɩŋ tapʋl bumbuŋ kaa mʋ yi tapʋlɩa-la dɩdɛrɩŋ, Ɛzɩra karɩmɛ Wɩa wombiee teŋ-la nɛ. Ba fa gbieli gbiele-la tapʋlaa balɩpɛ nɛ, tapʋl-chori chɛɛŋ, ba hilimi arɩ Wɩa wombiiŋ teniŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 9
Content:
Iziral tɩŋŋaa dagɛ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ
1Chɛnɛ-la tɩtɩa tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa mara arɩ banɛsɛ chɛɛŋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa hilimi, a vɔɔ niiŋ aŋ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ a ŋaa hagɩla bʋgɛ ba nyusuŋ. 2Ba fa kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa pɔrɛ lɩɩ nɩwogusu-la kala sɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ. Ba fa sii chɩŋ nɛ a dagɛ ba wʋcheelee arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba naabalɩmaba sɩ ŋaa. 3Ba fa chɩŋ lee-la ba sɩ chɩna nɛ ka ba karɩmɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa wombiiŋ teŋ-la a mʋ yi hawa batori, aŋ bɩra kɛŋ hawa batori ma a dagɛ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ chʋchʋɔlɛ ba TƖƖNA Wɩa. 4Ba fa ŋaa kʋŋ nɛ ʋ sii je Levi doho nɩaa deemba jɩla chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ: Jesua, Banɩ, Kadɩmɩɛl, Sɛbanɩa, Buni, Sɛrɛbɩa, Banɩ dɔŋɔ ma arɩ Kɛnanɩ, a faasa suri ba yikorusuŋ a sʋl ba TƖƖNA Wɩa. 5Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi doho nɩaa deemba: Jesua, Kadɩmɩɛl, Banɩ, Hasabineya, Sɛrɛbɩa, Hodia, Sɛkanɩa arɩ Pɛtahɩa bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ, “Má sii chɩŋ a dɛnnɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ.
Má zil ʋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ arɩ la sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo zilu a magɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga ma kala.” Aŋ bɩra chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a bʋl, 6“Ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa La TƖƖNA. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ba lɛ. Ŋ nɛ ŋaa tinteeŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ, a pɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ. Ŋ nɛ pɩ kʋŋkala mɩɩsɩŋ, Wɩa-jaŋ kɩaa kala ziziliŋ.
7Ŋ nɛ ŋaa La TƖƖNA Wɩa. Ŋ nɛ kɛŋ Abɩram kʋ lɩɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Uu a hɛ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ a kɛŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ Abɩraham. 8Ŋ na dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ŋ teeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ hɛ niiŋ ŋ dɩ ʋ pɛgɛ arɩ ŋ jaŋ joŋ nɩaa deemba tinteeŋ a pɩ ʋ doho nɩaa: Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa, Hiti tɩŋŋaa, Amɔrɩ tɩŋŋaa, Pɛrɛs tɩŋŋaa, Jebus tɩŋŋaa arɩ Gɩgasɩ tɩŋŋaa. Ŋ kɛŋ nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ kaa tɩŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ.
9Ŋ na hɛɛ-la la naabalɩmaba fa sɩ na Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋ jegile nɩɩ ba bunso nɛ Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ-la leriŋ. 10Ŋ ŋaa wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ nɛ Ijipiti kuoro, ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɩaa kala lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩ wʋrɩgɛ ba nɛ. Ŋ laa yɩrɩŋ a pɩ ŋ tɩtɩa nɛ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. 11Ŋ leŋe mʋgʋ-balɩŋ kpaa balɩa nɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaaŋ, ba to ʋ tʋɔŋ a vɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ a lɩɩ. Ama ŋ leŋe nɩalɩŋ sɩ kire to ba harɩŋ tuu lɩɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, a nagɛ ba sɩ joŋ tabɩɩŋ hɛ lɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ. 12Wɩɩhɛyɛ, ŋ leŋe duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ sɩ nagɛ jebiiŋ nɛ laa ba sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba vɩvɛŋ, tɩtaŋɩŋ ma, ŋ leŋ nyiniŋ nagɛ jebiiŋ a laa ba sɩpaaŋ a chaanɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ pɩba.
13Ŋ lɩɩ ŋ jaŋ kʋ tuu Sɩnaɩ peel-la nyuŋ nɛ, a bʋl wɩaa pɩba. Ŋ dagɛba ŋ wombiee sɩ tʋʋla arɩ ŋ wʋdagaa sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ. 14Ŋ leŋe ba jɩŋ ŋ chɛ-wiesii-la sɩ zɔmɔ wɩaa nɛ, aŋ to ŋ tɩntɩnna Mosis lɛ a dagɛba ŋ niiriŋ, ŋ wombiee arɩ ŋ wʋdagaa. 15Losuŋ sɩ kɛmba, ŋ pɩba Wɩa-jaŋ kʋdiilee nɛ. Lɩɩ-nyʋasʋŋ ma sɩ kɛmba, ŋ leŋe lɩɩŋ lɩɩ bʋŋ lɛ nɛ ba nyʋa. Ŋ bʋla pɩba arɩ ba yuo laa tintee-la ŋ sɩ chaasa ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ ŋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba nɛ.
16Ama la naabalɩmaba ŋaa nyu-duo tɩmma nɛ a kɛŋ babii-ballɩŋ a bɩ dagɩŋ ka nɩɩ, a vɩa dɩ ba to ŋ niiŋ. 17Ba vɩa dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ nɛ a bɩ wʋmagɩla-la ŋ sɩ ŋaa ma liise. Ba vɩa aŋ kɛŋ nyu-duo nɛ a lɩɩsɛ ba sɩpaalaara dɩ ʋ mɩɩra kɛmba mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ, lee-la ba fa sɩ ŋaa yosi. Ama ŋ ŋaa Wɩa sɩ joŋ wɩaa chɩchɛ nɩaa nɛ, a fɩfá nɩaa nisusuŋ, a kɛŋ zile. Ŋ baanɩŋ bɩ lɩma lɩma ka sii, ŋ chonuŋ ma bɩ dɛrɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ŋ bɩ ba vɩa ta, 18ba sɩ paala libi kʋŋ sɩ nagɛ nɛ-bie pɩ ba tɩtɩa aŋ bʋl, ‘Vene-la sɩ kɛnla lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ kʋ lɩɩ nɛ ŋ-la.’ Ba tʋʋsɛ ŋ joŋ-bɔŋ nɛ.
19A tɩŋ ŋ sɩ faasa fɩfá nɩaa nenige wɩaa, ŋ bɩ ba vɩa ta tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. Wɩɩhɛyɛ, duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaaŋ-la sɩ nagɛ jebiiŋ bɩ ba harɩŋ mɩɩra, nyiŋ-la ma sɩ nagɛ jebiiŋ a chaanɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ pɩpɩba a dɩdagɛba wombii-la ba sɩ jaŋ to bɩ ba harɩŋ mɩɩra. 20Ŋ joŋ ŋ Dɩma sɩ zɔmɔ pɩba nɛ ʋ dɩdagɛba. Ŋ bɩ ba kʋdiile-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ‘mana’ vɔmɔ, ŋ pɩba lɩɩŋ ma nɛ ba nyʋa. 21Ba sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ tʋɔŋ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa-la kala, ŋ pɩba ba kʋchɛɛlɛɛ nɛ. Ba bɩ kʋŋkala chɛ ka, ba gɛnnɩŋ bɩ kɩɛsa, ba naasɩŋ ma bɩ pʋʋsa.
22Ŋ joŋ kuoroo tinteyee arɩ tinteyee pɩba nɛ, ba tɩɩ ba kala. Ba yuo laa Hɛsɩbɔŋ kuoro Sɩhɔŋ tinteeŋ nɛ arɩ Basaŋ kuoro Ɔgɩ tinteeŋ. 23Ŋ leŋe ba biiriŋ yʋgɛ nɛ a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ. Ŋ kɛmba kaa kʋ jʋʋ tintee-la ŋ sɩ bʋla pɩ ba naabalɩmaba dɩ ba mʋ laa tɩɩ nɛ. 24Ba biiriŋ mʋ jʋʋ tintee-la nɛ a laaʋ tɩɩ. Ŋ yuo dii Kɛnaŋ tɩŋŋaa nɛ ba sɩpaaŋ, nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ, a joŋ ba dɩ ba kuoroo kala hɛ ba nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba ŋaaba ŋɩɩ ba sɩ cho. 25Ba yuo laa tabalaa ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli arɩ tinteyee sɩ sɩma nɛ. Ba laa dɩɩsɩŋ sɩ suo arɩ kʋzɔŋ dosunuŋ, vilee ba sɩ luo, girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ, olif tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ tɩɩsɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩ yʋga a nɩnɛŋ. Ba dii kɩaa vɔgɛ nɛ woruŋ a kala nɛrɛ, ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋ wʋzɔmɔ-la kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa lɛ.
26Ama ba vɩa ŋ niiŋ nɛ a lɩɩ ŋ harɩŋ, a joŋ harɩŋ yɩa ŋ wombiiŋ ŋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto. Ba kpʋ ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa dɩ ba mɩɩra kʋ toŋ. Ba chaasa tʋʋsɛ ŋ joŋoo nɛ. 27Ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jomba hɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba dɔgɩsɛba. Ama ba sɩ dɔgɩsɛba, ba yele pɩŋ nɛ. Ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ nɩɩ, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩ faasa fɩfá nɩaa nenige wɩaa, ŋ pɩba laataaraa nɛ, ba laaba ta ba dʋndɔmɔ-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ.
28Ama ba sɩ kʋ na wiese, ba bɩra ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ŋ lɛ. Ŋ bɩra jomba hɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ ba bibemba. Ba bɩra sɩ yele pɩŋ, ŋ hɛ ŋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ nɩɩ ba yele, a tɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige wɩaa, ŋ vɛnɛ laaba ta a yʋgɛ nɛ. 29Ŋ chagɩlɛ ba nɛ arɩ ba mɩɩra kʋ to ŋ wombiiŋ ŋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto, ama ba bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ a bɩ ŋ niiŋ to. Ba vɩa ŋ wombie-la nɩa sɩ jaŋ to a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, aŋ ha ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ba kɛŋ nyuduoŋ arɩ dɩgɩlɩŋ-bɩnɩɩ nɛ a joŋ harɩŋ yɩaŋ a bɩ chɛ dɩ ba jegile nɩɩ. 30Jɩ-daŋ nɛ ŋ kɛŋ kenyiri arɩ ba. Ŋ Dɩma to ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa chagɩlɛba. Ama ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ jomba hɛ tintee-wogusuŋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ. 31Ama a tɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige kɩŋkɛŋ wɩaa, ŋ bɩ ba cheye koo a vɩaba ta, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ ŋaa Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ zile nɛ a fɩfá nɩaa nisusuŋ.
32Lɛɛlɛ la Wɩa, ŋ nɛ yʋga a kɛŋ doluŋ nɩaa fɩfáŋ, ŋ sɩ cho ŋ nɩaa a hɛ nii-la ŋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ, ŋ kaa tɩtɩŋ nɛ. Sɩ́ bee kieli hɛɛ-la la sɩ na a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ Asiiria kuoroo sɩ dɔgɩsɛla a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ. La kuoroo arɩ la sɩpaalaaraa, la ŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ ŋ wʋlaabʋllaa, la naabalɩmaba arɩ ŋ nɩaa kala nɛ na hɛɛ-la. 33Wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa la lɛ, ŋ to wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ nɛ ka la-na bɩ woruŋ ŋaa. 34La kuoroo, la sɩpaalaaraa, la ŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ la nyɩmmaba bɩ wombii-la ŋ sɩ bile to. Ba bɩ jegile nɩɩ ŋ wʋdagaa koo wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bʋla kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa. 35Ba fa sɩ hɛ tintee-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩba lɛ a nɩnɩɩ sɩŋ-bal-la kala, tintee-la sɩ jalɩa aŋ pɛ sɩŋ lɛ, ba bɩŋ to koo a bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ.
36Ama jɩnɩŋ la ŋaa yosi nɛ tintee-la ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩ la naabalɩmaba lɛ, dɩ ba dii ʋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ arɩ kʋzɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ. 37A tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, tintee-la kʋdii daŋ-la kala mɩɩra ŋaa kuoroo-la nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋ sɩ joŋ-la hɛ kɩaa nɛ. Baa benla arɩ la pʋsʋŋ ŋɩɩ kala ba sɩ cho nɛ. Hɛɛŋ chaasa vɔgɛla nɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ ŋaa nii-bala
38A tɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala wɩaa, la Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala ŋaa nii-bala nɛ, dɩ la tɔ boŋ a ŋmʋnsa bil, dɩ la sɩpaalaaraa, la Levi doho nɩaa arɩ la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ jaŋ joŋ ba magɩlɩŋ hɛ.”

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 10
Content:
1Nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba neniee daŋ teŋ-la lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
Hakalɩa nanʋala Nɛhɩmaaya sɩ ŋaa ba tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ,
Zedikaaya, 2Sɛraaya, Azarɩa, Jɛrɩmaaya,
3Pasɩhɔ, Amarɩa, Malɩkɩja,
4Hatus, Sɛbanɩa, Maluk,
5Harɩm, Mɛrɛmɔf, Obadaaya,
6Danɩɛl, Ginetoŋ, Baruk,
7Mesulam, Abija, Mɩjamɩŋ,
8Maazɩa, Bɩlɩgaɩ arɩ Sɛmaaya.
Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ joŋ ba neniee nɛ ŋɩɩ.
9Levi doho nɩaa ma sɩ joŋ ba neniee nɛ ŋ-la:
Azanɩa nanʋala Jesua, Bunui sɩ ŋaa Henadad nyɩŋ-nʋʋ arɩ Kadɩmɩɛl.
10Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ tɩgɛ ba lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Sɛbanɩa,
Hodia, Kɛlɩta, Pɛlaaya, Hanaŋ,
11Mɩka, Rehob, Hasabɩa,
12Zaku, Sɛrɛbɩa, Sɛbanɩa,
13Hodia, Banɩ arɩ Beninu.
14Nɩalɩŋ sɩpaalaaraa ma nɛ ŋ-la:
Parɔs, Pahaf-Mʋab, Ɛlam, Zatu, Banɩ,
15Buni, Azigad, Bɛbaɩ,
16Adonija, Bɩgɩvaɩ, Adɩŋ
17Ata, Hezikaaya, Azu,
18Hodia, Hasum, Bɛzaɩ,
19Harɩf, Anatɔf, Nɛbaɩ,
20Magɩpɩas, Mesulam, Hezi,
21Mɛsɛzabɛl, Zadɔk, Jadʋa,
22Pɛlatɩa, Hanaŋ, Anaaya,
23Hosia, Hananaaya, Hasub,
24Halɔhɛs, Pɩlɩha, Sɔbɛk,
25Rehum, Hasabɩna, Maasɛya,
26Ahɩa, Hanaŋ, Anaŋ,
27Maluk, Harɩm arɩ Baana.
28Nɩkaana-la kala, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi doho nɩaa, boi-pɔɔrɔɔ, yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa, Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ pɔrɛ ba tɩtɩa a lɩɩ tintee wogusu-la nɩaa sɩ guoli la tʋɔŋ tintee-la lɛ, a tɩŋ ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba to Wɩa wombiiŋ ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto wɩaa, ba dɩ ba haalaa arɩ ba biiriŋ kala sɩ waa a jaŋ wuo jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa. 29Ba kala pɛ ba sɩpaalaaraa lɛ a ŋmɩɛsɛ, dɩ ba nɛ vɩa nii-la dɩ ŋmɩaŋ-la diiba. Ba ŋmɩɛsa arɩ ba jaŋ fɩɛlɛ ba sɩaa a to wombie-la Wɩa sɩ to ʋ tɩntɩnna Mosis lɛ a joŋo pɩba, a pɛ wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ daga arɩ ʋ niiriŋ lɛ. Ba sɩ tɔ boŋ-la bʋl wɩɩ-la nɛ ŋ-la,
30“La bɩ jaŋ joŋ la toloo pɩ tintee-wogusu-la sɩ golli la nɩaa dɩ ba jaa, koo a leŋ dɩ la hambolibiisiŋ jaa ba toloo.
31Dɩ tintee-wogusu-la nɩaa nɛ kɛŋ mɩaa koo kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kɔ dɩ ba yallɛ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ koo tapʋl-zɔŋ kala chɛɛŋ, la bɩ jaŋ yɔɔ. Jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ na-kala, la jaŋ leŋ dɩ la tinteeŋ pɩna wiesi, aŋ joŋ nɩaa chɩŋŋaa kala ma chɛba.
32Jɩna na-kala, la kʋŋkala jaŋ kɩɛsɛ moribiee mʋa mʋa dɩ ba kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa. 33Ba jaŋ kaa yɔɔ boroboro-la sɩɩ daŋ teebʋl nyuŋ, tapʋlɩɩ kala mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa arɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, a pɛ chɛ-wiesii-la Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa lɛ. Chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbielee kɩaa arɩ gbielisi-la dɔnsʋŋ kɩaa, arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kʋzɔmɔ-la, arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ ba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a pɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta, a pɛ wɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kala sɩ maga dɩ la ŋaa la Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ.
34La-na Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi doho naa, arɩ la nɩkaanaa kala tɔnsɔ nɛ dɩ la na jɩna na-kala tʋɔŋ bʋa-la lɛ dɩa na-kala nɩaa sɩ maga ba kɛŋ daasɩŋ kɔ dɩ la kaa nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa La TƖƖNA Wɩa koru-la nyuŋ, arɩ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ hɛ Wɩa wombiiŋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ.
35La bɩra sɛyɛ arɩ jɩna kala la jaŋ kɛŋ la baga kʋdii-bumbumba arɩ tɩɩ-nɛŋ bumbuŋ na-kala kɔ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ.
36La jaŋ kɛŋ la hambolibii bumbumba a kɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩɩ tɩŋ nɩmɛ teeŋ a joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, la jaŋ kɛŋ la nɛsɩŋ, piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa ma bii-bumbumba kɔ nɩmɛ a joŋo pɩ Wɩa, arɩ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ hɛ Wɩa wombiee tʋɔŋ.
37La ha bɩra jaŋ kɛŋ la mɩɩ-falaa, la tɩɩ-nɛŋ bumbumba, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ arɩ la olif nʋʋ-bumbuŋ kaa kɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ a joŋo pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa. La jaŋ kɛŋ la kʋdiilee kpaa leree fii a joŋ kʋbala kaa kʋ pɩ Levi doho nɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba nɩɩ laa kpaalɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ kʋbala deeŋ tasɩ-la kala lɛ la sɩɩ tɩŋ. 38Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Arɔŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ maga dɩ ʋ pɛ Levi doho nɩaa lɛ dɩ ba laa kpaalɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ kʋbala deeŋ. Levi doho nɩalɩŋ ma jaŋ laa kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa kpaa leree fii a joŋ kʋbala-la a pɩ Wɩa, a ma kaa kpaa leree fii a joŋ kʋbala bil Wɩa dɩa chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩ-biliŋ. 39Levi doho nɩaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala, maga ba kɩɛsɛ mɩaa, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ arɩ olif nʋʋŋ nɛ, a kaa mʋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩa-la lɛ ba sɩɩ bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa, arɩ lee-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, boi-pɔɔrɔɔ arɩ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa sɩɩ jʋʋ.
La bɩ jaŋ vɩa la Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ ta.”

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 11
Content:
Nɩfalɩa-la sɩ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ
1Tintee-la nɩhɩasɩŋ fa hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ, ka nɩkaanaa tɔnsɛ dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ nɩbala nɩaa fii kala tʋɔŋ dɩ ba mʋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm, tabal-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ, ka dɩ nɩaa nibi-la kʋkaanaa ma hɔŋ ba tasɩŋ lɛ. 2Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩaa bɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa lɩɩ a sɛɩ arɩ ba jaŋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ.
3Iziral tinteeŋ ba sɩ kaa kpaa leree sɩpaalaaraa fa hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ nɛ. Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Levi doho nɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, arɩ Solomoŋ tɩntɩnnaa doho nɩaa fa hɔŋ ba tɩtɩa tinteyee lɛ nɛ Juda tasɩŋ lɛ.
4Ka Juda arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma fa hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Juda doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la:
Ataaya sɩ ŋaa Uzia nanʋala aŋ ŋaa Zɛkarɩya ma nihiŋ. Ʋ naabalɩmaba dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ Amarɩa, Sɛfatɩa arɩ Mahalalɛl. Ba kala ŋaa Juda nanʋala Pɛrɛs doho nɩaa nɛ, 5arɩ Maasɛya sɩ ŋaa Baruk nanʋala, aŋ ŋaa Koli-Hoze ma nihiŋ. Ʋ naabalɩmaba dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ, Hazaaya, Adaaya, Joyarib arɩ Zɛkarɩya, ba kala ŋaa Juda nanʋala Sɛla doho nɩaa nɛ. 6Pɛrɛs doho nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ ŋaa ba-duoruŋ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ chori nɛ.
7Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa ma nɛ ŋaa:
Salu sɩ ŋaa Mesulam nanʋala, aŋ ŋaa Joid ma nihiŋ. Ʋ naabalɩmaba dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ: Pedaaya, Kolaaya, Maasɛya, Ɩtɩɛl arɩ Jesaaya, 8a pɛ ʋ naambiiriŋ Gabaɩ arɩ Salaɩ lɛ. Bɛnjamɩŋ ma doho nɩaa fa ŋaa zɔlɔ nibi arɩ mara arɩ chori nɛ a hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. 9Zikiri nanʋala Jowɛl nɛ fa ŋaa ba tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɩhɩaŋ, Hasɛnʋa nanʋala Juda ma nɛ fa ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ a bibeŋ tabal-la.
10Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma nɛ ŋ-la:
Joyarib nanʋala Jedaaya arɩ Jakɩŋ. 11Sɛraaya sɩ ŋaa Hɩlɩkaaya nanʋala, aŋ ŋaa Mesulam ma nihiŋ. Ʋ naabalɩmaba dɔnsʋŋ nɛ fa, Zadɔk, Mɛrayɔf arɩ Ahitub fa sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ. 12Ba doho nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ ŋaa zɔlɔ chori arɩ mara arɩ balɩa nɛ. Adaaya sɩ ŋaa Jeroham nanʋala, aŋ ŋaa Pɛlalɩa ma nihiŋ, ʋ doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ: Amizi, Zɛkarɩya, Pasɩhɔ arɩ Malɩkɩja. 13Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ a ŋaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ kala ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩa arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ balɩa nɛ. Amasɩsaɩ sɩ ŋaa Azarɛl nanʋala, aŋ ŋaa Ahɩzaɩ ma nihiŋ, 14ʋ ma doho nɩaa fa ŋaa zɔlɔ arɩ mara arɩ chori nɛ a kala ŋaa laalɩyuori-duori. Ba sɩpaalaara nɛ fa Hagɛdɔlɩm nanʋala Zabɩdɩɛl.
15Levi doho nɩaa ma nɛ ŋ-la:
Sɛmaaya sɩ ŋaa Hasub nanʋala, aŋ ŋaa Azirikam ma nihiŋ. Ʋ doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ Hasabɩa, arɩ Buni. 16Sabɩtaɩ arɩ Jozabad ma nɛ fa ŋaa Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la jeeŋ harɩŋ sɩpaalaaraa. 17Mɩka nanʋala Matanɩa sɩ ŋaa Zabidi nihiŋ, aŋ ŋaa Asaf doho nʋʋ, ʋ nɛ yie laa nɩalɩŋ sɩpaaŋ ba lʋlɔllɛ Wɩa aŋ pɛ chʋhchʋɔlʋ. Bakɩbʋkɩa ma nɛ faa tɩgɛ Matanɩa lɛ. Samʋa nanʋala Abɩda sɩ ŋaa Gala nihiŋ, aŋ ŋaa Jedutuŋ doho nʋʋ ma nɛ faa tɩgʋ lɛ. 18Levi doho nɩaa kala fa ŋaa nɩaa zɔɔ-balɩa mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ a hɛ Jerusalɛm, tabal-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ.
19Baala-la fa sɩɩ pɔ boi-baalaa ma nɛ ŋ-la:
Akub, Talɩmɔŋ arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔnsʋŋ, ba kala fa ŋaa nɩaa zɔlɔ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii arɩ balɩa nɛ.
20Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩkaana-la, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa fa hɔŋ ba tɩtɩa ba tinteyee lɛ nɛ Juda tasɩŋ lɛ.
21Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ fa hɛ Jerusalɛm dundolo kʋbala lɛ nɛ baa yɩrɛ Ɔfɛl. Zɩha arɩ Gɛsɩpa nɛ faa bemba.
22Banɩ nanʋala Uzi sɩ ŋaa Hasabaɩ ma nihiŋ nɛ fa ŋaa Levi doho nɩhɩaŋ. Ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ Matanɩa, Mɩka arɩ Asaf. Ba nɛ nyɩŋ-nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. 23Yɩɩl yɩɩra-la fa to ŋɩɩ Kuoro Devit sɩ daga nɛ, a yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa tapʋlɩɩ kala.
24Mɛsɛzabɛl nanʋala Pɛtahɩa sɩ ŋaa Juda nanʋala Zɛra doho nɩaa dɔŋɔ, nɛ faa chagɩlɛ kuoro wɩɩ na-kala sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ.
25Nɩalɩŋ jesiŋ kala hɛ tasɩŋ sɩ kpagɛ ba bagɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ. Juda nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ fa hɛ tasɩŋ deemba lɛ, Kɩrɩaf Aba arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ gollu, Dɩbɔŋ arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ gollu, Jɛkabɩzɛɛl arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ gollu. 26Ba dɔnsʋŋ ma hɛ Jesua, Molada, Bɛf Pɛlɛt, 27Haza Sʋal, Bɛɛsɩba arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ golliba. 28Dɔnsʋŋ ma hɛ Zɩkɩlag, Mɛkɔna arɩ tasɩ-la sɩ golliba, 29Ɛŋ Rimoŋ, Zora, Jamʋf, 30Zanʋa, Adulam, arɩ ba tabiisi-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ hɛ Lakɩs arɩ ʋ ŋmaŋkaanɩŋ lɛ, dɔnsʋŋ ma hɛ Azɛka arɩ ʋ tabiisiŋ lɛ. Ba fa hɔŋ Bɛɛsɩba lɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi Hɩnɔm fuonaaŋ.
31Tasɩŋ deemba lɛ nɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ lɩɩ Geba hɛ: Mɩkɩmas, Aɩja, Bɛtɛl arɩ ʋ tabiisiŋ, 32Anatɔf, Nɔb, Ananɩa, 33Hazɔ, Rama, Gitem, 34Hadid, Zeboim, Nɛbalat, 35Lod, Ono, arɩ kʋŋaarɩ-gɔgɔɔ fuonaaŋ.
36Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɩɩ Juda tinteeŋ ba sɩ kaa kpaa kpaa leree, ba dɔnsʋŋ fa hɔŋ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ.

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 12
Content:
Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa yɩraa
1Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ mɩɩra to Sɩɛlɩtɩɛl nanʋala Zerubabɛl arɩ Jesua harɩŋ a lɩɩ yoŋ-baga kɔ yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la:
Sɛraaya, Jɛrɩmaaya, Ɛzɩra,
2Amarɩa, Maluk, Hatus,
3Sɛkanɩa, Rehum, Mɛrɛmɔf,
4Ido, Ginetoŋ, Abija,
5Mɩjamɩŋ, Mʋadɩa, Bɩlɩga
6Sɛmaaya, Joyarib, Jedaaya,
7Salu, Amɔk, Hɩlɩkaaya, Jedaaya.
Nɩaa deemba nɛ fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ ba tɩntɩnnɩ dɔnsʋŋ Jesua mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa lɛ.
8Levi doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Jesua, Binui, Kadɩmɩɛl, Sɛrɛbɩa, Juda arɩ Matanɩa, a pɛ ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ lɛ nɛ faa beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a lʋlɔllɛ Wɩa. 9Bakɩbʋkɩa arɩ Uni nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ ba dɩ ba sɩɩ tɩŋ. Ba yie chɩna chaasɛ ba nɛ yɩɩlaa dɩ-yɩɩlɩŋ a laa hɩhɛ.
10Joyakim nyɩmma nɛ fa Jesua, Ɛlɩasɩb ma nyɩmma nɛ Joyakim, Joyada ma nyɩmma nɛ Ɛlɩasɩb, 11Jonataŋ ma nyɩmma nɛ Joyada, Jadʋa ma nyɩmma nɛ Jonataŋ.
12Bʋa-la Joyakim fa sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ, nɩaa deemba nɛ fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ:
Sɛraaya dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Mɛraya nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
Jɛrɩmaaya ma dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Hananaaya nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
13Ɛzɩra dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Mesulam nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
Amarɩa dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Jehohanaŋ nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
14Maluk dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Jonataŋ nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
Sɛkanɩa ma dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Josɛf nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
15Harɩm dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Adɩna nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
Mɛrɛmɔf dɩa nɩaa ma tʋɔŋ, Hɛlɩkaɩ nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
16Ido dɩa ma nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Zɛkarɩya nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
Ginetoŋ dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Mesulam nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
17Abija ma dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Zikiri nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
Mɩnɩamɩŋ arɩ Mʋadɩa dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Pɩlɩtaɩ nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
18Bɩlɩga ma dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Samʋa nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
Sɛmaaya dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Jehonataŋ nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
19Joyarib dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Matanaɩ nɛ ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
Jedaaya dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Uzi nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
20Salu dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Kalaɩ nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
Amɔk dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Ɛba nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
21Hɩlɩkaaya ma dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Hasabɩa nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
Jedaaya dɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Nɛtanɛl nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩaŋ.
22Daarus sɩ dii Pɛsɩa tinteeŋ kuoruŋ, bʋa-la lɛ nɛ ba ŋmʋnsɛ Levi doho nɩaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ yɩraa a bil. Nɩaa deemba nɛ fa ŋaa ba nɩhɩasɩŋ: Ɛlɩasɩb, Joyada, Johanaŋ arɩ Jadʋa, a saa pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa dɩa dɩa yɩraa lɛ. 23Levi doho nɩaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ, a chɩŋ Ɛlɩasɩb nanʋala Johanaŋ lɛ, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ kuoroo wʋŋaalaa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. 24Levi doho nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa nɛ fa ŋ-la: Hasabɩa, Sɛrɛbɩa, Kadɩmɩɛl nanʋala Jesua, arɩ ba tɩntɩnnɩ dɔsʋŋ ba sɩ kaa kpaa bugoo, balɩa yie chɩna chaasɛ dɔŋɔ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa a lʋlɔllʋ, buguŋ dɔŋɔ yɩɩ dɔŋɔ laa hɩhɛ arɩ Wɩa tɩntɩnna Devit sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ.
25Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa boi-pɔɔrɔɔ a pʋpɔ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baalaa niiŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Matanɩa, Bakɩbʋkɩa, Obadaaya, Mesulam, Talɩmɔŋ arɩ Akub. 26Nɩaa deemba kala fa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ a tɩtɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa, bʋa-la lɛ Jesua nanʋala Joyakim fa sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Jozadak ma nihiŋ nɛ. Bʋa-la tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ Nɛhɩmaaya fa ŋaa ba tinteeŋ nɩhɩaŋ, ka Ɛzɩra ma fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara aŋ pɛ ŋaa Wɩa teniŋ kerichi.
Ba joŋ Jerusalɛm kɛrɛ-la hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ
27Bʋa-la ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba joŋ Jerusalɛm jebii-la a hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ, ba yɩrɛ Levi doho nɩaa ba lɩɩ Juda sɛmɛ na-kala nɛ dɩ ba kʋ gbieli arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a chɩgɩsɛ buguloo, a du chenniŋ arɩ kɔnɛba a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA. 28Ba kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a lɩɩ tasɩ-la sɩ golli Jerusalɛm nɛ: taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Netofa arɩ tabiisi-la sɩ gollu. 29Dɔnsʋŋ lɩɩ Bɛf Gɩlɩgal, Geba arɩ Azɩmavɛf. Yɩɩlɩ yɩra-la fa saa ba tasɩŋ a golli Jerusalɛm nɛ. 30Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa sɩ pɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa disiniŋ ta dɛrɛ arɩ ba Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombiiŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, ba pɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ, boi-baala-la arɩ jebii-la ma disiniŋ ta.
31Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ leŋ Juda nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa jɩl jebii-la nyuŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ yɩɩlɩ yɩraa sɩ yʋga bugoo balɩa dɩ ba lʋlɔllɛ Wɩa. Bugo-la dɔŋɔ jɩl jebii-la nyuŋ a mʋmʋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, a chaasɛ Nɛ-bɩnɩŋ Boi-baalɩŋ. 32Hosaaya arɩ Juda sɩpaalaara-la kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ fa to ba harɩŋ, 33arɩ Azarɩa, Ɛzɩra, Mesulam, 34Juda, Bɛnjamɩŋ, Sɛmaaya, Jɛrɩmaaya, 35a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩ kori nyilliŋ lɛ, arɩ Jonataŋ nanʋala Zɛkarɩya sɩ ŋaa Sɛmaaya nihiŋ. Ba doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ ŋ-la: Matanɩa, Mɩkaaya, Zaku arɩ Asaf, 36a pɛ ba yɩɩl yɩɩrɩ dɔnsʋŋ deemba lɛ: Sɛmaaya, Azarɛl, Mɩlalaɩ, Gɩlalaɩ, Maayɩ, Nɛtanɛl, Juda arɩ Hanani, ba kala fa kori Wɩa tɩntɩnna Devit yɩɩlɩ yɩɩrɩ kɩaa nɛ. Ɛzɩra sɩ ŋaa Wɩa teniŋ kerichi nɛ fa laa ba nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɩɛla sɩpaaŋ. 37Ba sɩ mʋ yi Lɩɩ-bulo Boi-baalɩŋ, ba ha mʋmʋ, a mʋ jɩl lusuŋ-chol-sɩa-la ba sɩ to jʋjʋʋ Devit taŋ-la, a joŋ jebii-la ŋɩɩ a mʋ kieli Devit dɩa a mʋ Lɩɩŋ Boi-baal-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.
38Yɩɩlɩ yɩɩra-la buguŋ dɔŋɔ ma to jebii-la nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a mʋmʋ. Mɩ ma jɩl jebii-la ba harɩŋ, mɩ dɩ sɩpaalaara-la kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ. La mʋ kieli tabʋʋ-pumoo dɩɩ-leŋii-la a mʋ Je-bii Jalɩɩ-la. 39La lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mʋ Efirem Boi-baalɩŋ, a mʋ Jesana Boi-baalɩŋ, a mʋ Chenfilee Boi-baalɩŋ, a mʋ Hananɛl Dɩɩ-duduoŋ arɩ dɩɩ-leŋii-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zɔlɔ, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Piesee boi-baalɩŋ. La sɩ mʋ yi nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ boi-baalɩŋ, la chɩŋ.
40Ŋɩɩ nɛ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩrɩ bugo-la balɩa sɩɩ lɔllɛ Wɩa chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa Wɩa dɩa lɛ. Mɩ ma chɩŋ, mɩ dɩ sɩpaalaara-la kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ, 41a pɛ nɩaa deemba sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa lɛ: Ɛlɩakɩm, Maasɛya, Mɩnɩamɩŋ, Mɩkaaya, Elionai, Zɛkarɩya arɩ Hananaaya, ba kala kori nyilliŋ. 42Nɩaa deemba ma nɛ pɛ: Maasɛya, Sɛmaaya, Elieza, Uzi, Jehohanaŋ, Malɩkɩja, Ɛlam arɩ Ɛza. Jɛzɩrahɩa nɛ laa yɩɩlɩ yɩɩra-la sɩpaaŋ baa yɩɩ. 43Tapʋlɩɩ-la ba kpʋ kɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, aŋ jʋjʋɔsɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa leŋe ba tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ nɛ. Haalaa arɩ hambiisiŋ kala nɛ faa jʋɔsʋ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ paala hɛ dɩ-bolii ma, ŋ jaŋ wuo nɩɩ nɩaa sɩ jʋɔsa a ŋɩŋaa goŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ.
44Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ nɩaa ba bibeŋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ, lee-la nɩaa sɩ yie kɩɛsɛ kɩaa arɩ ba kʋdii falaa kaa kʋʋ bil, a pɛ kpaalɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ kʋbala-la ba sɩ yie joŋo pɩ Wɩa lɛ. Bagɩsɩ-la sɩ golli Jerusalɛm lɛ, ba fa yie kɩɛsɛ kɩaa nɛ a kaa kʋ bil chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩ-la lɛ a pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa a nagɛ Wɩa wombiiŋ ʋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa Juda nɩaa tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ nɛ. 45Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaa pɩ Wɩa, ŋɩɩ nɛ yɩɩlɩ yɩraa-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ pɔ leriŋ tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa arɩ kuoro Devit arɩ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. 46Kuoro Devit arɩ Asaf mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa lɛ, ba fa kɛŋ nɩaa nɛ sɩ yie laa ba sɩpaaŋ ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa, aŋ lʋlɔllʋ. 47Zerubabɛl arɩ Nɛhɩmaaya ma mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa lɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala yie kɩɛsɛ kɩaa nɛ tapʋlɩɩ kala aa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ boi-baalaa. Nɩalɩŋ yie joŋ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ a pɩ Levi doho nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ, ba ma laa a lɩɩsɛ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa kɩaa pɩba.

Title: NƐHƖMAAYA 13
Content:
Wɩalɩŋ Nɛhɩmaaya sɩ wasa kaa bɩrɩmɛ
1Tapʋlɩɩ-la ba faasa karɩmɛ teŋ-la Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa ʋ lɩɩ nɛ nʋʋkala nɩɩ. Teŋ-la tʋɔŋ nɛ ba na arɩ ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba leŋ dɩ Amɔrɩ tɩɩna koo Mʋab tɩɩna kala guoli Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, 2bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa bɩ kʋdiilee arɩ lɩɩŋ kaa kʋ cheme pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, aŋ mɩɩra joŋ kɩaa kpal Balam ka dɩ ʋ kʋ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ba lɛ. (Ama la Wɩa mɩɩra kɛŋ ŋmɩaŋ-la bɩrɩmɛ nɛ, ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ a pɩ la.) 3Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto, ba chaarɛ nɩwogusu-la kala sɩ guoli ba tʋɔŋ.
4Ka dɩ ba na ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ba fa joŋ Ɛlɩasɩb sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ hɛ ʋ bibeŋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ. Ʋ dɩ Tobia wɩaa faa jʋʋ nɛ woruŋ. 5Ʋ joŋ dɩɩ-bal kʋbala a pɩ Tobia lee-la ba sɩɩ bil kɩaa deemba: mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa, kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa, a pɛ mɩaa kpaalɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ kʋbala ba sɩ yie joŋo pɩ Wɩa lɛ, arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ, nʋʋ-la ba sɩ yie joŋo pɩ Levi doho nɩaa, yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa arɩ boi-pɔɔrɔɔ, a saa pɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yie kɩɛsa pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa lɛ.
6Ama bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa deemba kala sɩɩ ŋaa, mɩ fa tuo Jerusalɛm lɛ. Atazɛzɛs sɩ dii Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ kuoruŋ ʋ jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ balɩa lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ, dɩ mɩ mɩɩra mʋ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ bʋa kʋbala lɛ, mɩ sʋl wombiiŋ ʋ teeŋ 7a mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm. Mɩ sɩ kɔ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ wʋbɔŋ-la Ɛlɩasɩb fa sɩ ŋaa, ʋ sɩ joŋ dɩa sɩ hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kaalɩsɩŋ lɛ a pɩ Tobɩa. 8Mɩ tʋɔŋ fa chaasa chei nɛ woruŋ, mɩ paa Tobia kɩaa kala sɩ hɛ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ yuo ta. 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pa wombiiŋ ba pɩɩsɛ dɩɩsɩ-la kala disiniŋ ta, aŋ mɩɩra paa Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ kʋ jʋʋ, a pɛ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ arɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋ-la lɛ.
10Mɩ bɩra nɩa arɩ kpaal-la sɩ maga dɩ ba joŋo pɩ Levi doho nɩaa, ba bɩ baa pa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ arɩ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩra-la kala sɩ maga dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa mɩɩra mʋ tɩtɩŋ ba tɩtɩa bagɩsɩŋ lɛ. 11Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la woruŋ a pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma vɩa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la ta?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ yɩrɛ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ arɩ yɩɩlɩ yɩɩra-la ba mɩɩra kʋ tɩtɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa.
12Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ Juda nɩaa kala kɛŋ ba mɩaa, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩ-falɩŋ arɩ nʋʋŋ kpaalɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ kʋbala-la ba sɩ yie joŋo pɩ Wɩa kaa kʋ bil ba chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩ-la lɛ. 13Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ Sɛlɛmaaya sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara, Zadɔk sɩ ŋaa Wɩa teniŋ kerichi arɩ Levi tɩɩna kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Pedaaya, a leŋ ba nɛ bibeŋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩ-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bɩra lɩɩsɛ Hanaŋ sɩ ŋaa Zaku nanʋala, a ŋaa Matanɩa ma nihiŋ ʋ tɩtɩgɛ ba lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa baalaa deemba fa ŋaa nɩa ba sɩ bene dɩ ba ŋaa nɩtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Ba nɛ fa maga dɩ ba kpɩkpaa kɩalɩŋ nɩaa sɩ kaa kɔ a pɩpɩ ba naambiiriŋ.
14Mɩ Wɩa, liisi mɩ wɩaa sɩ́ wʋzɔmɔ-la kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa a tɩgɛ ŋ dɩa lɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ leŋe ba bɩra ŋɩŋaa nɩmɛ wɩaa yʋ.
15Bʋa-la lɛ, mɩ na Juda nɩaa dɩ baa chagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, a kɛŋ ba kakusuŋ chʋchʋŋ mɩaa, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ, girep, tutogi-nambɩlaa arɩ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɔnsʋŋ. Ba chʋŋ kɩaa deemba kala chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ nɛ a kʋʋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba sɩ kɩaa yallʋ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ. 16Chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ Taaya tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ fa yie kɛŋ chenfilee arɩ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kʋʋ yallɛ nɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ a pɩpɩ Juda nɩaa. 17Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ ŋaa goŋ Juda sɩpaalaaraa nyuŋ a bʋl, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ wʋbɔŋ nɛ ma ŋɩŋaa ŋ-la a chichei chɛ-wiesii-la kɩsɩŋ lɛ? 18Wʋdosunuŋ deemba dee ma naabalɩmaba ŋaa, la Wɩa joŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ ŋaa la dɩ la tabalɩŋ deeŋ lɛɛ? Lɛɛlɛ ma wasa leŋ Wɩa baanɩŋ sisii Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ chei chɛ-wiesii-la kɩsɩŋ lɛ wɩaa.”
19Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pa wombiiŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ Jerusalɛm boi-baalaa tɔ dɩdaaŋ-la, ka dɩ taŋ pʋl chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ bala. Mɩ leŋe mɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ chɩŋ boi-baalaa niiŋ nɛ dɩ ba sɩ́ chʋga kala kaa kʋ jʋʋ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ. 20Bala koo bʋlɩa nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yallɛ kʋdosunuŋ chʋa Jerusalɛm jeeŋ harɩŋ. 21Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kpʋrɩsɛ ba dɩgɩlaa aŋ pɩɛsɛba, “Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma chʋa jeeŋ harɩŋ? Dɩ ma nɛ bɩra ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ, mɩ jaŋ kɛsɛma.” A chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ a kaa kɔ ba bɩra bɩ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ kɔ. 22Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩ Levi doho nɩaa dɩ ba pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta aŋ mʋ pʋpɔ boi-baalaa dɩ chɛ-wiesii-la ŋaa chɛ-zɔŋ.
Mɩ Wɩa ŋ chonuŋ sɩ yʋga wɩaa, tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ma wɩaa a fá mɩ nenige.
23Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ bɩra, mɩ na Juda tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaa Asɩdɔd, Amɔŋ arɩ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa toloo. 24Ba hambiisiŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ faa bʋl Asɩdɔd tɩŋŋaa yikoro nɛ, koo nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ yikoro, aŋ bɩ Juda tɩŋŋaa yikoro wuo bʋl. 25Mɩ ŋaa goŋ ba nyuŋ a ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ba lɛ. Mɩ ŋmoo nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ a lɛrɛ ba nyu-pʋnaa churi. Mɩ leŋ ba ŋmɩɛsɛ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ lɛ a bʋl, “La bɩ jaŋ joŋ la toloo a pɩ ba hambolibiisiŋ dɩ ba jaa, koo a jaa ba toloo a pɩ la hambolibiisiŋ koo la tɩtɩa. 26Ha-jaa doho deeŋ dee bɩ leŋe Iziral tinteeŋ kuoro Solomoŋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ? Tinteyee kala tʋɔŋ, kuoru kala fa tuo a magʋ. Wɩa fa chou nɛ woruŋ, a leŋ ʋ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kuoro. Ama tintee-wogusuŋ toloo nɛ lɛrʋ mʋ hɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. 27Ʋ sɛnɛ magɛ dɩ la bɩra nɩɩ arɩ ma maa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba, a bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ arɩ la Wɩa aŋ jɩjaa tintee-wogusuŋ toloo?”
28Ɛlɩasɩb sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa nɩhɩaŋ nanʋala dɔŋɔ nɛ fa Joyada. Ama Joyada hɩɩlɩ-baala nɛ fa Sambalat, Horo tɩɩna-la. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ kiri Joyada ta mɩ teeŋ.
29Mɩ Wɩa, liisi ŋɩɩ ba sɩ ŋaa wɩaa a chei wombii-la ba sɩ maga dɩ ba to a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩpɩŋ arɩ nii-la sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ ŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa lɛ.
30Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ disiniŋ ta a mʋ tɩgɛ kʋŋkala sɩ ŋaa kʋwogo lɛ, aŋ dagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa ba tɩntɩmɩŋ. 31Mɩ bɩra dagɛ nɩalɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ daasɩŋ arɩ ba kʋdii falaa kɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ.
Mɩ Wɩa, liisi wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa aŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ.

Title: ƐSƖTA 1
Content:
Ba kiri Vasiti kuoruŋ lɛ
1Wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ ŋaa bʋa-la lɛ Zɛzɛs sɩɩ beŋ tasɩŋ zɔlɔ arɩ mara arɩ balɩpɛ a chɩŋ Indɩa lɛ a kaa mʋ Kus. 2Zɛzɛs kuori kpaha fa hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Susa lɛ nɛ. 3Ʋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-tori lɛ, ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, Pɛsɩa arɩ Midia laalɩyuori hɩasɩŋ, sɩpaalaaraa arɩ ʋ tinteeŋ nɩbalaa a hɛ dɔŋɔ a ŋaa kʋdiilee ba gbieli. 4Ba gbieli gbiele-la ŋɩɩ halɩɩ tapʋlaa zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ. Gbiele-la lɛ nɛ ʋ dagɛ ʋ kuoruŋ magɩsɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ ʋ tinteeŋ dʋa sɩ maga arɩ ʋ doluŋ sɩ maga ŋɩɩ. 5Gbiele-la harɩŋ, kuoro Zɛzɛs bɩra leŋ ba ŋaa kʋdiilee ʋ yɩrɛ Susa tabal-la nɩaa kala, nɩbalaa arɩ nɩbiisiŋ kala. Ba kʋ gbieli ʋ kuoru dɩɩ-zɔŋ-la lɩga tʋɔŋ tapʋlaa balɩpɛ. 6Ba kpɩɛrɛ lee-la kala a kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ a vɔɔ patɩɩsaŋ diibelimbine arɩ patɩɩsaŋ pʋllʋŋ kaala-la harɩŋ a mɛrɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ hɔpʋla ŋaa nenii-pɩraa a joŋo hɛ sɛlɩmɛ ba sɩ kaa ŋaa jebiee lɛ. Ka tinteeŋ kala ŋaa tabɩɩ mʋmʋlaa sɩ kɛŋ kpɩɛrɛ dosunuŋ. Sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla ba sɩ kaa ŋaa kpasɩnɩŋ chɩŋ nɩmɛ. 7Nɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ yɩra kɛŋ nyʋnyʋalʋsʋŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ a ŋaa ba kpɩɛraa bɩ dɔŋɔ naga nɛ a nyʋnyʋa girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ. Kuoro leŋe sɩnɩŋ pʋrɩgɛ nɛ woruŋ gbiele-la lɛ. 8Kuoro bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna-la sɩɩ kpaa sɩŋ-la, “Má leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala nyʋa sɩnɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ.”
9Baala-la kala fa sɩɩ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ ŋɩɩ, kuoro habidiire Vasiti ma ŋaa kʋdiilee yʋgɛ woruŋ a pɩ haala-la kala sɩ hɛ kuoru dɩa lɛ.
10Tapʋl-pɛɩ chɛɛŋ, dɩ Zɛzɛs nyʋa girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala tɔrɛ, ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩntɩnna-la balɩpɛ ba sɩ fere, ba yɩraa nɛ Mehuman, Bɩzɩta, Habona, Bigita, Abagɩta, Zeta arɩ Kaakas, 11dɩ ba kɛŋ ʋ habidiire Vasiti kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Kuoro faa chɛ dɩ Vasiti laalɛ ʋ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, a chu ʋ kuoru nyunchuulo, a kʋ lɩɩ dɩ kuoro nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɩaa kala na ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ zɔmɔ. 12Ama kuoro tɩntɩnna-la sɩ mʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la a pɩ Vasiti, ʋ vɩa dɩ ʋ mʋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro na baanɩŋ woruŋ.
13Ʋ fa ŋaa ba naaba wɩɩ nɛ dɩ kuoro pɩɛsɛ wʋjɩnnaa a mʋ tɩgɛ wombie-la ba sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ yɩrɛ ʋ wʋjɩnnaa a pɩɛsɛba wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa. 14Nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yɩra pɩɛsɛ yɩraa nɛ ŋ-la, Kaasɩhɛna, Seta, Adɩmata, Taasɩs, Mɛrɛs, Masɛna arɩ Mɛmukaŋ. Ba balɩpɛ nɛ ŋaa Pɛsɩa arɩ Midia tinteeŋ nɩbala-la sɩ kpagɛ kuoro tintee-la lɛ.
15Kuoro pɩɛsɛba, “Mɩ tɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ dɩ ba mʋ kɛŋ mɩ habidiire Vasiti kɔ, ba mʋ ʋ vɩa. La naabarɩŋ lɛ bɛɛ nɛ maga dɩ la ŋaaʋ?”
16Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la dɔŋɔ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɛmukaŋ bʋla pɩ kuoro Zɛzɛs arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ hɩasɩ-la, “Wɩɩ-la kuoro habidiire Vasiti sɩ ŋaa, kuoro dʋndʋŋa dee ʋ hɩɩsɛ, ʋ hɩɩsɛ kuoro tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, arɩ baal kala sɩ hɛ ʋ tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ. 17Haala-la kala sɩ hɛ la tinteeŋ lɛ jaŋ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la Vasiti sɩ ŋaa, a joŋ ba balaba hɛ sɩɩŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ bʋl ‘Kuoro Zɛzɛs paala yɩrɛ Vasiti nɛ ʋ vɩa.’ 18Ka dɩ wɩa na jʋʋ, kuoro tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la sɩ hɛ Pɛsɩa arɩ Media lɛ, ba haalaa jaŋ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la kuoro haala sɩ ŋaa, ba ma bɩ jaŋ tuto ba balaba niiŋ. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ zizil ba balaba ma, dɩ ba balaba baanɩŋ sii ba nyuŋ.
19Ŋɩɩ wɩaa kuoro dɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ jaŋ tɔrɛ, leŋ dɩ ba heele bʋl arɩ ŋ habidiire Vasiti maachie bɩra bɩ maga ʋ kɔ kuoro sɩpaaŋ, aŋ ŋmʋnsa hɛ Pɛsɩa arɩ Media tinteeŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto teniŋ tʋɔŋ, dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ sɩ bɩ jaŋ dɩsɛ. Ka dɩ la laa ʋ maŋgaazɩa-la a pɩ haal dɔŋ sɩ kpɩaʋ. 20Dɩ ba nɛ heele bʋl ŋɩɩ dɩ haalaa kala sɩ hɛ la tinteeŋ lɛ nɩɩ, ba jaŋ chaasa zizil ba balaba, dɩ ba ŋaa summo koo dɩ ba kɛŋ kɩaa.”
21Kuoro Zɛzɛs arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wɩɩ-la Memukan sɩ bʋla lɛ. 22Kuoro Zɛzɛs ŋmʋnsɛ tenniŋ joŋo kpaa ʋ tinteeŋ tasɩŋ kala. Taŋ-la kala nɩaa sɩɩ bʋl yikoro-la lɛ nɛ, ʋ kaa ŋmʋnsɛ ba teniŋ a pɩba.

Title: ƐSƖTA 2
Content:
Ba lɩɩsɛ Ɛsɩta ʋ ŋaa kuoro habidiire
1Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ bʋa kʋbala lɛ kuoro Zɛzɛs baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ, ka ʋ ha kɛŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ habidiire Vasiti sɩ ŋaa arɩ nii-la ʋ-na kuoro sɩ bile a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ wɩaa bɩbɩɩnɛ. 2Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩma pɩpɩ kuoro tapʋlɩɩ kala bʋl, “Kuoro, leŋ dɩ la chɛ hatol-zɔŋŋɔɔ ha sɩ bɩ baalaa jɩŋ a kaa kʋ pɩŋ. 3Ŋ jaŋ wuo lɩɩsɛ nɩhɩasɩŋ ŋ tinteeŋ tasɩ-la kala lɛ dɩ ba nɛ chaarɛ hatol zɔmɔ-la kaa kɔ la tabalɩŋ Susa, lee-la ŋ haalaa sɩ hɛ, dɩ ŋ tɩntɩnna ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hagaɩ bafere-la bibemba, aa pɩba nʋʋ-zɔmɔ-la ba sɩ jaŋ tɩtɩsɛ. Ʋ tɩntɩmɩŋ nɛ folo ŋɩɩ. 4Kuoro, hatolo-la nyuŋ ŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ faasa tɔrɛ leŋ dɩ ʋ nɛ laa Vasiti nyuŋ, a ŋaa ŋ habidiire.” Wɩɩŋ deeŋ sɩma pɩ kuoro ʋ kaa tɩŋ.
5Bʋa deeŋ lɛ, dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa baal kʋbala hɛ Susa lɛ baa yɩrɛ Modikaaya. Ʋ ŋaa Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nʋʋ nɛ, ʋ nyɩmma nɛ Jaa, ʋ naabalɩma ma nɛ Sɩmɛɩ, Kɩs nanʋala. 6Modikaaya ma fa hɛ nɩalɩŋ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nebukadineza sɩ yuo kɛsɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kaa mʋ Babɩlɔŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, a pɛ Juda kuoro Jehoyachiŋ lɛ. 7Modikaaya fa kɛŋ naambii nɛ baa yɩrɛ Hadasa, ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ sʋba nɛ aŋ ka Modikaaya dɩɛsʋ. Hadasa yɩrɩŋ dɔŋɔ nɛ Ɛsɩta ʋ zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ dɩɛsʋ a nagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa tol-lʋlʋŋ nɛ.
8Kuoro sɩ pa wombiiŋ dɩ ba chɛ hatol-zɔŋŋɔɔ kɔ ŋɩɩ, ba kɛsɛ hatoloo yʋgɛ woruŋ Ɛsɩta hɛ ba tʋɔŋ ba kaa mʋ Sʋsa kuoro dɩa. Ba joŋ Hagaɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ haalaa dɩa hɛ ʋ bibemba. Ba kɛŋ Ɛsɩta ma kaa kʋ hɛ Hagaɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ bibenu. 9Hagaɩ tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɛ Ɛsɩta nyuŋ nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ pʋ nʋʋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ ʋ tɩtɩsɛ, a pʋpʋ kʋdiilee ma woruŋ. Hagaɩ tʋɔsɛ ketiee balɩpɛ kuoro dɩa lɛ a kɛmba kaa mʋ hɛ dɩɩ-zɔŋ lɛ ba tɩma pɩpɩ Ɛsɩta.
