12Ma sɩ yie kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ mɩ dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ,
kʋbɛɛ nɛ yie pɩɛsɛ ma kɩaa deemba wɩaa,
wʋgɩrɩga gɩrɩga deemba ma sɩ yie ŋɩŋaa mɩ kaalɩsɩŋ lɛ?
13Má bɩra sɩ́ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ
sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kɛnɛ kaa kɔ mɩ sɩpaaŋ.
Mɩ bɩra bɩ ma kʋsʋɔrʋsʋ-la
ma sɩ yie nyɩgaa pɩmɛ maa chɛ.
Ba nagɛ bɩnɩŋ nɛ mɩ teeŋ.
Ma chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele arɩ ma chɛ-wiesiŋ gbielee
arɩ ma sɩ yie hilimi aa zilmi,
mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo chɩna gbɛrɛma ba kʋŋkala lɛ.
14Mɩ bɩ ma chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbielee arɩ ma gbiele-la dɔnsʋŋ
ma sɩ vɛnɛɛ gbieli cho.
Ba nagɛ chʋga nɛ mɩ chʋŋ,
mɩ bɛsɩmɛ nɛ ba chʋŋʋŋ lɛ.
15Dɩ ma nɛ kɔ mɩ teeŋ a je nɩsaa sʋlmɛ,
mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ harɩŋ a yɩama.
Dɩ ma nɛ sʋlmɛ magɛ ŋɩɩ kala,
mɩ bɩ jaŋ nɩɩ,
bɛɛ wɩaa ma nɩsaa kala nɛ suo arɩ chalɩŋ.
16Má chɛsɛ ma tɩtɩa, a sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ.
Má kɛŋ ma wʋbɔmɔ-la ŋaanɩŋ
sʋʋsa lɩɩ mɩ sɩpaaŋ.
Má leŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ.
17Má gʋnnɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ,
a tuto wʋtɩtɩɩ,
a pɩpɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nyaga bil lɛ.
Má chɩna gbɛrɛ biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa.”
18La TƖƖNA saa yɩrɛma nɛ a bʋl,
“Lɛɛlɛ má kɔ dɩ la bʋla nɩɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ.
Ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ paala fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ chalɩŋ ma,
mɩ jaŋ chɛsɛba ta ka ma pʋllɛ a nagɛ kuŋkunuŋ.
Dɩ ba nɛ paala fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ vachalɩŋ ma,
ma jaŋ pʋllɛ a nagɛ pie-pʋnaa.
19Dɩ ma nɛ jaŋ sɛɩ a to mɩ niiŋ,
ma tinteeŋ kɩaa jaŋ wasɛ dɩ ma dii kʋzɔŋŋɔɔ.
20Ama dɩ ma nɛ vɩa mɩ niiŋ aŋ to ma nyuduoŋ lɛ,
ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ kpʋma.”
La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.
21Jerusalɛm fa nagɛ haala sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ arɩ ʋ bala,
ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ.
Taŋ-la nɩaa fa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa nɛ fa hɛ taŋ-la lɛ,
ama lɛɛlɛ nɩkpʋʋraa nɛ suo.
22Ma fa nagɛ hɔpʋla nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ma nagɛ hɔɔ-bɩnɩŋ nɛ,
ma fa nagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ,
ama lɛɛlɛ ma nagɛ sɩnɩŋ ba sɩ pulli lɩɩŋ nɛ.
23Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bemma bɩ mɩ niiŋ ka to,
gaaraa nɛ ŋaa ba nandɔsʋŋ,
ba cho kpalaa laanɩŋ nɛ woruŋ
a kiree to kʋmɔlɩɩba harɩŋ.
Ba bɩ chɩna gbɛrɛ biisinsiŋ,
dɩ yo-haalaa nɛ kɛŋ wɩaa kɔ ba teeŋ, ba bɩ jegile nɩnɩɩ.
24Ŋɩɩ wɩaa La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna
sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ sɩ,
“Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ tiŋ mɩ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ
dɩ ba bɩra sɩ́ mɩ walɩmʋ.
25Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩaa a jʋʋ ma lɛ,
a lɩɩsɛ disiŋ-la kala sɩ hɛ ma lɛ a nagɛ hɔɔ-bɩnɩŋ,
a nagɛ ba sɩ yie lɩɩsɛ hɔɔŋ disiniŋ ŋɩɩ.
26Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ bibemma nagɛ faafaa-la nɩaa,
ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlɛma jaŋ bɩra nagɛ bumbuŋ nɩalɩŋ.
Nɩaa jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ Jerusalɛm
tabal-la nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla,
taŋ-la nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.”
27La TƖƖNA sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla,
ʋ jaŋ laa Jerusalɛm nɩaa ta,
nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla.
28Ama ba jaŋ chei nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa La TƖƖNA niiŋ aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.
La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kala sʋʋ.
29Wʋtɩtɩɩ, hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ kɛmma a tɩŋ tɩɩsɩ-la ma fa sɩɩ kpaarʋ
ba ŋaa ma vesiŋ.
Ma jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ tɩɩ-chige-la ma sɩ chɔnsɔ wɩaa,
kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ lɩɩsa a tuto.
30Ma jaŋ nagɛ piiŋ-chigee hɩlɩŋ sɩ chɩna ba pɩpaarɩŋ yuori,
koo a nagɛ lɩga tʋɔŋ kɩaa ba sɩ bɩ lɩɩŋ mɩsa ba hɩl.
31A nagɛ nyiŋ-pʋgʋmʋŋ sɩ yie tel ya-hɩlɩŋ lɛ ʋ chol ŋɩɩ,
ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ nɩaa deemba sɩ ŋaa nɩduoru,
wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ gʋra cheiba,
ka nʋʋkala tuo sɩ jaŋ laaba ta.

Title: AZAAYA 2
Content:
La TƖƖNA peeliŋ
1Wɩaa deemba nɛ Wɩa joŋo dagɛ Amos nanʋala Azaaya a mʋ tɩgɛ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm tinteeŋ lɛ.
2Tapʋlaa dɩdɛrɩŋ, La TƖƖNA peel-la
nyuŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ chɩna jaŋ kɩɩ peelee kala.
Ʋ nɛ jaŋ sii je kɩɩ dundolo kala,
dɩ dʋnɩa tinteyee kala gire mʋ lee-la.
3Nɩ-daŋ jaŋ kɔ a bʋl,
“Má kɔ dɩ la jɩl La TƖƖNA peel-la nyuŋ,
a mʋ Jekɔb Wɩa dɩa.
La TƖƖNA jaŋ dagɛla ʋ wombiee,
dɩ la tuto.
Wɩa jaŋ dagɛla ʋ wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto a lɩɩ Zaayɔŋ lɛ.
La TƖƖNA niiŋ wɩaa jaŋ lɩɩ Jerusalɛm nɛ.”
4Ʋ jaŋ laa tinteyee nɩaa wɩaa a jɩma pɩba,
aŋ kɛŋ ba nɩ-daŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa sɩma.
Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ba tokobiee a libi pirisiŋ,
aŋ kɛŋ ba tiŋŋee ma a libi sɩɩkɔrʋsʋŋ.
Tintee kala bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋ tokobiiŋ a je ʋ dɔŋɔ lɛ,
koo a bɩra gʋnnɛ laalɩŋ yuonuŋ.
5Ou, Jekɔb doho nɩaa,
má kɔ dɩ la vɛŋ La TƖƖNA pʋlʋmʋŋ lɛ.
La TƖƖNA tapʋlʋŋ
6La TƖƖNA, ŋ vɩa ŋ nɩaa nɛ,
Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ,
bɛɛ wɩaa baa ŋaa vʋgʋrʋ wɩaa nɛ,
wɩalɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ arɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ ŋaa.
Baa to nɩwogusuŋ naabarɩŋ wombiee nɛ.
7Ba tinteeŋ kala nɛ suo arɩ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ,
ba dʋa bɩ dɩdɛrɩŋ kɛnɛ.
Janɩŋ su ba tinteeŋ nɛ woruŋ,
ba janɩŋ torukoba ma bɩ nii kɛnɛ.
8Ba tinteeŋ suo nɛ arɩ vʋɩyaa,
baa kpirimi kɩalɩŋ ba tɩtɩa sɩ ŋaa teeŋ,
a dɛnnɛ kɩalɩŋ ba tɩtɩa sɩ mɛ.
9Nuhuobiine sɩaa jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ,
ba jaŋ kɛŋ nʋʋkala muuri.
La TƖƖNA bɩ jaŋ joŋo chɛba.
10Má jʋʋ bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ,
má jʋʋ faa tinteeŋ bʋɔsʋŋ lɛ
a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA doluŋ
arɩ ʋ tʋla wɩaa.
11Tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ jaŋ kɔ, nuhuobiine dagɛ ŋ-tɩtɩɩ
arɩ ʋ babii-ballɩŋ kala jaŋ dɛrɛ.
La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la.
12Tapʋlɩɩ-la, La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ leŋ
dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ
arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa je
sɩaa tuu tinteeŋ.
13Lɛbanɔŋ tɩɩ-waayiile-la arɩ
Basaŋ tɩɩ-bala-la kala jaŋ tel.
14Tapʋlɩɩ-la, peel-leŋie-la
arɩ dundolluŋ kala jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ.
15Dɩɩ-leŋee arɩ
kɛrɩsɩ-la kala ba sɩ saa golli tasɩŋ jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ.
16Ma lɩɩŋ daabori-bala-la kala
ma sɩ kaa dii bayalɩŋ jaŋ chei.
17Nuhuobiine dagɛ ŋ-tɩtɩɩ arɩ
ʋ babii-ballɩŋ kala jaŋ dɛrɛ.
La TƖƖNA yɩrɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ yɩyɩrɛ.
18Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tɔmɔ-la kala nyɩɩgɛ.
19Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ sii dɩ ʋ kɛŋ tinteeŋ a jigisi,
fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛŋ nɩaa dɩ ba fá jʋʋ bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ
arɩ tintee-bʋɔsʋŋ a faa
a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA tʋla arɩ ʋ doluŋ wɩaa.
20Tapʋlɩɩ-la, nuhuobiinee jaŋ joŋ tɔmɔ-la kala
ba sɩ kɛŋ hɔpʋla
arɩ sɛlɩmɛ libi a kpʋkpaarɛ,
a yuo pɩ taatɩaa arɩ jɩnnɩŋ.
21Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ tinteeŋ jigisi,
fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛŋ nɩaa
dɩ ba fá jʋʋ bʋ-bʋɔsʋŋ
arɩ bʋ-pɛgɩsɩŋ a faa,
a tɩŋ La TƖƖNA tʋla arɩ ʋ doluŋ wɩaa.
22Má sɩ́ ma yɩɛlaa joŋo hɛ nuhuobiine lɛ.
Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni aŋ sʋʋ.
Ʋ bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ.

Title: AZAAYA 3
Content:
La TƖƖNA jaŋ dii Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda nɩaa sarɩya
1Má bee na, La TƖƖNA
doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩɩ pɩ Juda doho nɩaa
arɩ Jerusalɛm tɩŋŋaa kʋdiilee
arɩ lɩɩŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma bɩra sɩ́ kɩaa deemba na.
2Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ laalɩyuori-wajɩaba
arɩ laalɩyuoroo arɩ sarɩya diiree, Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa,
vʋgʋraa arɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ.
3Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fiiba,
arɩ nɩalɩŋ nɩaa sɩɩ zil woruŋ,
arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlɛ kuoroo
arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a kaa tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩŋ doho kala
arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa chichiribi wɩaa,
nɩaa deemba kʋŋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ.
4La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋaa
dɩ hambiisiŋ nɛ bibemba.
5Nɩaa jaŋ nyagɛ dɔŋɔ bibil.
Nɩaa jaŋ sii chɩŋ dɔŋɔba lɛ,
nandɔsʋŋ jaŋ yʋ dɔŋɔba wɩaa.
Hambiisiŋ bɩ jaŋ zizil nɩhɩasɩŋ.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ ma paala bɩ jaŋ zizil nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ lee.
6Ʋ jaŋ kʋ yi bʋa kʋbala lɛ
dɩ dɩa nɩaa lɩɩsɛ ba naambiiriŋ dɔŋɔ a bʋla pʋ,
“Ŋaa la kuoro, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ-na ha paala kɛŋ gɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋ sɩ jaŋ laalɛ,
ŋɩɩ wɩaa ŋaa la sɩpaalaara bʋa deeŋ lɛ la sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ.”
7Ama nɩɩ-la ba sɩ lɩɩsa jaŋ bʋl,
“Aɩ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ ma lɛ,
mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo laa ma sɩpaaŋ,
bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩ kʋdiilee koo gɛnnɩŋ kɛnɛ.”
8Jerusalɛm tinteeŋ bɩ chɩna,
Juda ma titel,
bɛɛ wɩaa ba wʋbʋlaa arɩ ba wʋŋaalaa kala bɩ La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ ka tɔrɛ,
ba vɩaʋ nɛ, ba bɩ kaa faʋ arɩ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋla ma kala.
9Dɩ ŋ nɛ beŋ ba sɩaa lɛ,
ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaara nɛ.
Ba yie ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ a nagɛ Sodom tɩŋŋaa fa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ,
ba bɩ kaa fɩfaa.
Ba jaŋ na hɛɛŋ,
ba tɩtɩa nɛ lɛrɛ wʋlɔrʋŋ deeŋ kʋʋ hɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ.
10Bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla dɩ ba jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ,
wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ pɩba.
Ba jaŋ dii ba wʋzɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa nyʋʋrʋŋ.
11Wɩɩŋ puu nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ, wʋlɔrʋŋ jʋʋba nɛ.
Wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa nɩaa lɛ chɩmɩŋ jaŋ tiŋ ba tɩtɩa lɛ.
12Má bee na mɩ nɩaa,
hambiisiŋ nɩɩ dɔgɩsɛba, haalaa ma bibemba.
Ou mɩ nɩaa,
ma sɩpaalaaraa leŋe ma yeŋŋi nɛ a joŋ wombiiŋ ta.
13La TƖƖNA kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ
dɩ ʋ dii ʋ nɩaa sarɩya.
14La TƖƖNA jaŋ dii ʋ nɩaa
nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ ba sɩpaalaaraa sarɩya. Ʋ sɩ,
“Ma dii mɩ tinteeŋ kala kpʋ nɛ,
a gɩrɩma laa summoo kɩaa a kaa mʋ su ma dɩɩsɩŋ.”
15La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ,
“Ma bɩ wombiiŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ma nʋɔsɛ mɩ nɩaa bil tinteeŋ
a kɛŋ summoo jɩla tutuu.”
16La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ,
“Ma bee na Jerusalɛm haalaa sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ,
ba yie kpɩɛrɛ ba tɩtɩa nɛ a fɩɛla vɩvɛŋ,
ka ba naahɔɔnʋŋ dʋdɔŋ aŋ kɛŋ nyuŋ je a gɔllɔ
kɛŋ ba sɩaa kukosi baalaa.”
17Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ naawɩɩlaa ŋaa
Jerusalɛm haalaa nyusoo lɛ dɩ ba puori.
18Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kala Jerusalɛm haala-la sɩ kaa dɩdagɛ ba tɩtɩa laa, ba naahɔɔnʋŋ, banzɔlɔba arɩ nyu-kpallɩŋ. 19Ba dɩgɩlɩŋ kpɛnsɩŋ, na-hɔɔnʋŋ arɩ nyu-kpal duduosu-la ba sɩ kaa tɔ ba tɩtɩa, 20ba naahɔɔnʋŋ arɩ nyu-chuuluŋ arɩ ba tʋlaalɩɩ kɔlɩbɔba arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa ŋɩŋaa chichiribi wɩaa, 21kuori-nenii-pɩraa arɩ nenii-pɩra-la ba sɩ yie joŋo hɛ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, 22ba gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩɩ laalɛ putimaaniba, 23beenantɩrɛba arɩ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ.
24Bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi, ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba yaraa sʋɔra sɩŋ ŋɩɩ,
ba jaŋ mɩɩra sʋsʋɔrɛ kʋpʋɔŋ.
Ba sɩ cho dɩ baa vɔɔ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bii-zɔŋŋɔɔ ŋɩɩ,
ba jaŋ mɩɩra vʋvɔɔ ŋmɛsɩŋ.
Ba sɩ cho dɩ ba nyu-pʋnaa mɩɛla ŋɩɩ,
ba nyusoo jaŋ mɩɩra puori.
Ba sɩ cho baa vɔɔ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ ŋɩɩ,
gɛrɛ-kɔsʋmɔɔ nɛ ba jaŋ mɩɩra vʋvɔɔ.
Ba zɔmʋŋ kala jaŋ lɛl ka dɩ ba yaraa kala ŋaa fʋfʋʋnʋŋ.
25Ma baalaa arɩ ma laalɩyuori-wajɩaba
kala jaŋ sʋʋ laalɩŋ lɛ.
26Jerusalɛm kala jaŋ ŋaa yele dɩ ba tɩta jembiee.
Ʋ jaŋ wuoli a nagɛ summo sɩ hɔnɔ a bɩ kʋŋkala kɛnɛ.

Title: AZAAYA 4
Content:
Wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ sɩpaaŋ
1Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ kʋ yi, haalaa balɩpɛ
jaŋ kɛŋ ba-bala aŋ bʋl,
“La jaŋ chɛ a didii
aŋ chɛ gɛnnɩŋ ma a vʋvɔɔ la tɩtɩa lɛ.
Ŋ-na yaa leŋ dɩ ba yɩyɩrɛla
ŋ haalaa a tɔ la hɩɩsɩŋ.”
La TƖƖNA jaŋ bɩra laa Jerusalɛm nɩaa
2Wɩaa deemba kala harɩŋ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tinteeŋ zɔŋ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ sʋba. Ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ba bibigisi a tɩŋ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ pɛrɛ sɩ jaŋ wasɛ tintee-la lɛ. 3Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ka Jerusalɛm lɛ a bɩ sʋba, nɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, ba jaŋ yɩrɛba tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa. 4La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɩɩsɛ Jerusalɛm haalaa disiniŋ ta arɩ chal-la kala sɩ jaasɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ aŋ dii nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la sarɩya arɩ nyiniŋ. 5Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ tʋla kʋ chu tɔ ʋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ hilimi nɩmɛ. Wɩɩhɛyɛ ʋ jaŋ nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ, tɩtaŋɩŋ ma ʋ nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ. La TƖƖNA tʋla jaŋ chu tɔ ʋ nɩaa kala. 6Ʋ tʋla-la jaŋ nagɛ fɩɛlɩŋ sɩ tɔ hɛ ba lɛ wɩɩhɛyɛ, aa kɛrɛ wʋbɔŋ kala, aŋ pɛ kɛrɛ duoŋ-peliŋ ma sɩ jaŋ lu nɩmɛ.

Title: AZAAYA 5
Content:
Yɩɩl-la sɩ mʋʋ tɩgɛ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga lɛ
1Mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ a pɩ nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ cho,
yɩɩl-la mʋʋ tɩgɛ ʋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga lɛ nɛ.
Mɩ nandɔŋɔ kɛŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga nɛ
tintee-sɩŋ kʋbala lɛ peeliŋ sɛmɛ.
2Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bugili baga-la tinteeŋ kala a tʋɔsɛ tabɩaa ta,
aŋ chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩ-la ʋ sɩ cho baga-la lɛ,
a saa dɩɩ-leŋiŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ aŋ bibeŋ baga-la,
aŋ lu buotuoŋ ba sɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ tɩɩnɛnɛ-la hɛ a chɩchagɛ ba lɩɩŋ.
Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ gbɛrɛ dɩ tɩɩsɩ-la nɛŋ nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ,
ba mɩɩra nɛŋ nɛŋ-lɔrʋnʋŋ dʋndʋŋa.
3“Lɛɛlɛ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm arɩ Juda tinteeŋ lɛ,
má laa mɩ dɩ mɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga-la wɩaa a jɩma pɩmɛ.
4Wʋbɛɛ nɛ fa maga dɩ mɩ ŋaa mɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga-la lɛ
ka mɩ bɩ ŋaa?
Mɩ faa chɛ dɩ ʋ nɛŋ nɛŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ,
ka ʋ mɩɩra nɛŋ nɛŋ-lɔrʋnʋŋ dʋndʋŋa.
5Lɛɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ
jaŋ joŋo ŋaa mɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga-la lɛ a pɩma.
Mɩ jaŋ kɩɛsɛ lɩga-la
aŋ ka dɩ ʋ kala chei,
mɩ jaŋ ŋmoo ʋ jebii-la lo
ka dɩ baga kɩaa jʋʋ didii tɩɩnɛnɛ-la.
6Mɩ jaŋ vɩa tintee-la ta dɩ ʋ bɩrɩmɛ kʋŋkʋlʋŋ.
Mɩ bɩ jaŋ buori tɩɩsɩ-la koo a pɛrɛ nɩmɛ.
Yaŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ jaŋ tɔ ʋ kala.
Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ duonuŋ nɩɩ nɩmɛ.”
7La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna tɩɩnɛnɛɛ baga-la
nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa,
Juda doho ma nɛ ŋaa tɩɩsɩ-la
ʋ sɩ chɔnsɔ, ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba nyuŋ.
Ʋ yie cho dɩ baa to wʋtɩtɩɩ ka ba kpʋkpʋ nɩaa.
Ʋ yie cho dɩ baa ŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa, ka nɩaa yiyel kɩŋkɛŋ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ.
8Wɩɩŋ puu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩɩsɩŋ
arɩ tinteyee a pɛ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛnɛ lɛ
a bɩ lee-kala ka,
ka dɩ ma dʋndʋŋa hɛ nɩmɛ.
9La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla pɩmɛ,
“Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ma dɩɩ-balaa deemba jaŋ pɩŋ hoi,
ma dɩɩ-zɔmɔ-la jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.
10Tɩɩnɛnɛɛ baga jaŋ yi eekaba fii,
ama tɩɩnɛnɛ-la kala sɩ jaŋ bɩɩ nɩmɛ sɩnɩŋ jaŋ ŋaa lonnuŋ banɛsɛ.
Dɩ ba nɛ joŋ mɩɩ-doho bɔtɔ a duu,
ba jaŋ kʋŋ kuokuo gbansɩŋ banɛsɛ.”
11Wɩɩŋ puu nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie sii chʋchʋɔ-fɩɛla
a kire to sɩnɩŋ harɩŋ,
a nyʋa ŋɩɩ deeŋ deeŋ taŋ mʋ siesi
a kala bugi.
12Dɩ ba gbielee ma lɛ nɛ, ba yie du chenniŋ arɩ ba kɔnɛba
a chɩgɩsɛ chɩnchɩgɩsɩŋ a ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlaa hɛ,
aŋ nyʋnyʋa sɩnɩŋ.
Ama ba paala bɩ wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa kaa tɩtɩŋ,
ba sɩpaaŋ tuo ba lɛ.
13Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba jaŋ kɛsɛ mɩ nɩaa a kaa mʋ yoŋ-baga,
a tɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ.
Losuŋ jaŋ kpʋ ba sɩpaalaaraa dɩ ba sʋʋ,
ka dɩ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ ma chaasa kɛŋ ba nɩ-daŋ.
14Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a gbɛrɛ,
sʋʋŋ bʋa faasa suri niiŋ nɛ,
dɩ Jerusalɛm nɩbalaa arɩ ba nɩ-daŋ-la kala sɩɩ ŋaa goŋ jʋʋ-ʋ.
15Nuhuobiine sɩaa jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ,
ba jaŋ kɛŋ nʋʋkala muuri,
dɩ nuhuobiinee babii-ballɩŋ dɛrɛ.
16La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ a tɩŋ ʋ tɛŋɛ wɩaa.
Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ jaŋ dii ʋ nɩaa sarɩya arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ
dɩ ŋɩɩ dagɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋla Tɩɩna nɛ.
17Ba tinteeŋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ
dɩ piesee arɩ bʋ-pɔrɔɔ
didii yaŋ nɩmɛ.
18Wɩɩŋ puu nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ
ʋ nagɛ ŋmɛnɩŋ ba kaa lɛrɛ wʋcheelee arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tuto ba harɩŋ,
a nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ lɩlɛrɛ torukoba ŋɩɩ.
19Nɩalɩŋ yie bʋl, “Má leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA ŋaa lɩma
a ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa
dɩ la na.
Má leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ
ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa,
dɩ la kala jɩŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ.”
20Wɩɩŋ puu nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋbɔmʋŋ yɩrɛ wʋzɔmʋŋ,
aŋ kɛŋ wʋzɔmʋŋ ma yɩrɛ wʋbɔmʋŋ,
nɩalɩŋ sɩ leŋe birimiŋ nɛ ŋaa ba pʋlʋmʋŋ,
aŋ leŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ ma nɛ ŋaa ba birimiŋ,
nɩalɩŋ sɩ leŋe kʋhaarɩŋ nɛ ŋaa ba kʋsɩŋŋaa,
aŋ ka kʋsɩŋŋaa ma nɛ ŋaa ba kʋhaarɩŋ.
21Wɩɩŋ puu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ba kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ,
a na ba tɩtɩa arɩ ba nɛ ŋaa wʋjɩnnaa.
22Wɩɩŋ puu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa sɩ-nyʋarʋ-babiibalaa
a yie wuo joŋ sɩ-duoruŋ a guoli dɔŋɔ lɛ aa nyʋa,
23nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie laa kpalaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ chei wɩaa teeŋ aŋ jomba ta,
aŋ vɩa dɩ ba bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ a laa pɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye lɛ.
24Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, a nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩ yie wuo joŋ sekelee
arɩ ya-hɩlɩŋ a dii ŋɩɩ buru,
ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa jaŋ chei nɩalɩŋ.
Ba nagɛ tɩɩsɩŋ naapoloo sɩ pʋa ba fɩɩlaa yuori nɛ,
dɩ peliŋ lu a paaba a nagɛ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ,
bɛɛ wɩaa ba vɩa dɩ ba to La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto nɛ,
aŋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa wɩalɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩ dagɛba.
25Ŋɩɩ wɩaa La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ nɛ ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ,
a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ kpʋ ʋ nɩaa.
Peelee jaŋ jigisi
dɩ nɩaa sʋʋ a yieni a nagɛ nʋsʋrʋŋ sɩ pɩŋ womporoo lɛ.
Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa
ka ʋ baanɩŋ ha bɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ,
ʋ ha kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ ʋ nɩaa.
26La TƖƖNA hɛ duoso nɛ pɩpɩ tinteye-la sɩ hɛ dɩ-bolii,
aŋ ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlʋŋ ma a yɩyɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ.
Na ba nɛ fá kʋkɔ ŋɩɩ
lɩma lɩma.
27Ba laalɩyuoroo kʋbala ma bɩ jaŋ lɔl, koo a joŋ ʋ naaŋ a ŋmoo.
Ba kʋbala ma bɩ jaŋ dɩɛgɛ koo a pɩŋ doŋ.
Ba kʋŋkala tɩŋ-gɛnnɛ ma bɩ jaŋ jɔl ʋ tɩŋa,
ba nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ ma ŋmɛnɩŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛrɛ.
28Ba to-hɛŋŋɛɛ kɛŋ niiŋ nɛ woruŋ,
ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ba yuo ba tosuŋ,
ba janɩŋ naachɛŋŋɛɛ ma dolie a nagɛ naŋkpachɩllɩŋ nɛ,
ba janɩŋ torukoba ma fɩfá a nagɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ.
29Ba laalɩyuoro-la tʋɔrʋ a nagɛ naachigiŋ nɛ
ba huoso nagɛ naachigi-biisiŋ
sɩ kpʋ kʋa aŋ hʋhʋʋnɛ,
ka nʋʋkala tuo sɩ jaŋ laaʋ ta.
30Tapʋlɩɩ-la huuro jaŋ huuri nɩaa nyuŋ
a nagɛ mʋga sɩɩ huuru,
dɩ nʋʋ nɛ beŋ tintee-la,
ʋ jaŋ na leriŋ kala bire
dɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.
Duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa jaŋ leŋ dɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ bɩrɩmɛ birimiŋ.

Title: AZAAYA 6
Content:
La TƖƖNA leŋe Azaaya ŋaa ʋ wʋlaabʋllʋ
1Jɩna-la lɛ kuoro Uzia fa sɩ sʋba nɛ mɩ na La TƖƖNA a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ a yʋga kɩɩ kʋŋkala, ʋ gɛrɩŋ jɛrɛ su Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ. 2Kɩa kʋbalaba sɩ chaana a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa, chugili ʋ nyuŋ. Ba kʋŋkala kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ balɩdʋ nɛ. Ba kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩ-la balɩa balɩa a tɔ ba sɩaa, a kɛŋ balɩa balɩa ma a tɔ ba naasɩŋ, aŋ kɛŋ balɩa balɩa ma fifil. 3Ba yɩrɛ dɔŋɔ a bʋla pɩ dɔŋɔ:
“La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ,
ʋ bɩ disiŋ kala kɛnɛ,
ʋ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ,
dʋnɩa kala nɛ suo arɩ ʋ tʋla.”
4Ba sɩɩ ŋaa goŋ-la ŋɩɩ, Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ jigisi, nyʋɔsʋŋ tɔ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ kala. 5Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ a bʋl, “Wɩɩŋ jʋʋmɛ, mɩ sʋʋ dɛrɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ to mɩ niiŋ lɩlɩɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ ma mɩ sɩ hɛ wʋbʋlaa kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ, ka mɩ na La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa kuoro.”
6Ŋɩɩ nɛ kɩalɩŋ dɔŋɔ file kɔ mɩ teeŋ a kɛŋ chɛŋŋɛɛ chɛbɛ joŋ nyiŋ-halɩŋ, ʋ fa lɩɩsɛ nyiŋ-hal-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ koru-la lɛ nɛ. 7Ʋ kɛŋ nyiŋ-hal-la kʋ digi mɩ niiŋ lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Bee na, nyiniŋ deeŋ sɩ digi ŋ niipinee ŋ-la, ŋ wʋcheelee arɩ ŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala nɛ mɩ pɩɩsa ta ŋɩɩ.”
8Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ La TƖƖNA yikoro dɩ ʋ pɩɛsa, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ? Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ laa la nyuŋ a mʋ?” Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Namɛ, tɩmmɛ.”
9Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bʋl, “Mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ,
ba jaŋ nɩnɩɩ wɩaa aŋ bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ,
a nɩna wɩaa aŋ bɩ jaŋ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa.”
10La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl, “Leŋ dɩ nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ dol,
ŋaa dɩ ba dɩgɩlaa kparɩmɛ,
aŋ ŋaa dɩ ba sɩaa ma tɔ.
Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ba jaŋ na wɩaa
koo a nɩɩ wɩaa
a bɩrɩmɛ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa
a kɔ mɩ teeŋ dɩ mɩ laaba ta.”
11Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɩɛsɛ, “La TƖƖNA ɛɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ jaŋ diene magɛ?”
Ʋ bʋl,
“See dɩ ba tabalaa cheye a pɩŋ jikpeeŋ,
dɩ nɩaa tuo ba lɛ
dɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ kala wuoli,
dɩ ba bagɩsɩŋ ma kala pɩŋ kʋŋkʋlʋŋ.
12Mɩ-na ba TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛŋ ba kala kaa mʋ dɩ-bolii
ka ba tinteeŋ pɩŋ pɛɩ.
13Dɩ nɩaa fii tʋɔŋ, nɩbala ma nɛ paala ka tintee-la lɛ,
ʋ ha jaŋ bɩra pɩŋ hoi.
Nɩɩ-la jaŋ nagɛ piiŋ tɩa ba sɩ kere ta
aŋ ka ʋ gentine bɩra tɔsɛ.
Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩaa ma jaŋ nagɛ tɩa-gentine tintee-la lɛ.”

Title: AZAAYA 7
Content:
Ba jaŋ lʋl Ɩmanʋɛl
1Baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ahas nɛ fa dii Juda tinteeŋ kuoruŋ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Jotam nanʋala nɛ a ŋaa Uzia ma nihiŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ Siiria tinteeŋ kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Reziŋ arɩ Iziral kuoro ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Pɛka sɩ ŋaa Remalia nanʋala, sii mʋ dɩ ba yuo Jerusalɛm, a bɩ wuo yuo dii.
2Devit doho nɩaa sɩ kʋ nɩɩ arɩ Siiria tɩŋŋaa arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛ niiŋ nɛ dɩ ba yuoba, ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahas arɩ ʋ nɩaa bɔyɛ joŋ ba chichel, a nagɛ peliŋ sɩ yie lu a kɛŋ tɩɩsɩŋ jijigisi ŋɩɩ duuŋ lɛ.
3Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Azaaya, “Kɛŋ ŋ nanʋala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩa Jasub dɩ ma mʋ Ahas teeŋ. Ʋ nɛ hɛ lee-la lɩɩ-la sɩ pɛllɛ lɩɩ nyuŋ arɩ lɩɩ-libe-la ba sɩ kpɛrɛ lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ jʋjʋʋ taŋ-la sɩ kʋ cheŋ dɔŋɔ, wombii-la lɛ gɛrɩpɛ yuoroo sɩɩ chɛsɛ gɛnnɩŋ.
4Bʋla pʋ, dɩ ʋ fɩɛlɛ ʋ sɩaa a leŋ dɩ ʋ yaraa pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ dɩ ʋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ. Bɛɛ wɩaa, baaŋ-la Reziŋ arɩ Siiria tɩŋŋaa arɩ Remalia nanʋala Pɛka sɩ faasa na bɩ kʋŋkala ŋaa, ʋ nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩ hɛ daa-kuuŋ lɛ a chɩchɛ ʋ dɩsɛ nɛ.
5Siiria arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ kuoro Pɛka, Remalia nanʋal-la vʋʋra nɛ dɩ ba cheyiŋ. Ba sɩ, 6‘Má leŋ dɩ la jʋʋ yuo Juda, a kɛnʋ pʋɔsa kpaa dɔŋɔ, aŋ leŋ dɩ Tabɛɛl nanʋala nɛ dii kuoruŋ nɩmɛ.’ 7Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ saa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:
Ŋɩɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ ŋaa,
ŋɩɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa,
8bɛɛ wɩaa Siiria tabalɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Damasɩkʋs,
Damasɩkʋs tɩŋŋaa kuoro nɛ Reziŋ.
Jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ banɔŋ pɛgɛ,
Iziral nɩaa jaŋ pɩsɛ kɩŋkɛŋ a bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa tintee.
9Iziral tabalɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Samarɩa,
Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa kuoro nɛ Pɛka sɩ ŋaa Remalia nanʋala.
Dɩ ma nɛ saa bɩ ma Wɩa laa diiniŋ lɛ chɩna kpaŋkpaŋ,
ma bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ dɩ-chɩnɩɩ kala.”
10La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩ Ahas, 11“Sʋl mɩ-na, ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩ mɩ pɩŋ magɩlɩŋ, a lɩɩ tinteeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ koo wɩa-nyuŋ dɩ-bolii.”
12Ŋɩɩ nɛ Ahas bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩkala a magɩsɛ mɩ TƖƖNA.”
13Ŋɩɩ nɛ Azaaya ma bʋl, “Má jegili daha, kuoro Devit doho nɩaa, ma magɩsɛ nuhuobiine nɛ dɩ ma na ʋ kenyiri sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ, ma saa chɛ dɩ ma magɩsɛ Wɩa ma a na ʋ kenyiri sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛɛ? 14Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma na magɩlɩŋ. Hatolo ha sɩ bɩ baal jɩŋ jaŋ kɛŋ luoruŋ a lʋl hambolibie, a hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Ɩmanʋɛl. 15Ʋ jaŋ didii nɛyɩl-dɩndɛrɩŋ arɩ tʋʋŋ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ waa, a wuo vɩa wʋbɔmʋŋ aŋ lɩɩsɛ wʋzɔmʋŋ. 16Ka dɩ bile-na kʋ jɩŋ wɩaa a magɛ dɩ ʋ vɩa wʋbɔmʋŋ aŋ lɩɩsɛ wʋzɔmʋŋ, kuorusu-la balɩa sɩ joŋ fawʋllʋŋ kɩŋkɛŋ hɛ ma lɛ, ba tinteeŋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ. 17La TƖƖNA jaŋ lɔgɛ wɩaa hɛ ŋ dɩ ŋ nɩaa arɩ ŋ nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa kala lɛ, wɩalɩŋ doho ma ha sɩ bɩ na aŋ ka a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ Iziral arɩ Juda tinteeŋ sɩ pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ Asiiria kuoro kʋ hɛ ma lɛ.
18Tapʋlɩɩ-la, La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlʋŋ a yɩrɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba lɩɩ dɩ-bolii kɔ a nagɛ nanchʋɔsʋŋ sɩ lɩɩ fuonuŋ lɛ, dɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa ma lɩɩ ba tinteeŋ kɔ a nagɛ tʋʋ-biee. 19Ba jaŋ kʋ jʋʋ su ma fuonaasɩ-la kala sɩ luŋie arɩ bʋ-pɛgɩsɩŋ arɩ lere-la kala sɩ kɛŋ sɔsʋŋ arɩ lere-la sɩ kɛŋ lɩɩŋ. 20Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛŋ Asiiria kuoro a lɩɩ Yufireti fuo-la harɩŋ kɔ. Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ nyu-fʋna a fʋŋ ma nyu-pʋnaa arɩ ma naapʋnaa arɩ ma tɔŋŋɔɔ kala. 21Bʋa-la lɛ, baala jaŋ kɛŋ nɛ-pa-bie arɩ bʋʋnaa balɩa dʋndʋŋ, 22ama a tɩŋ pʋsʋŋ deemba sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ yɩlɩŋ yʋgɛ ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ na nɛyɩl-dɩndɛrɩŋ a didii. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ sʋba aŋ ka tintee-la lɛ jaŋ dii nɛyɩl-dɩndɛrɩŋ arɩ tʋʋŋ. 23Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, girep tɩɩsɩŋ baga sɩ kɛŋ tɩɩsɩŋ bʋɩ ba sɩ jaŋ wuo joŋo yallɛ warɩpʋla bʋɩ, yaŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ jaŋ mɩɩra nyʋ a tɔ ʋ kala. 24Nɩaa jaŋ mʋ nɩmɛ arɩ tosuŋ a bɩbagɩlɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa yaŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ tɔ ʋ kala. 25Dundollu-la nyuŋ ma fa sɩɩ pɛrʋ jaŋ tɔ arɩ yaŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ. Lee-la jaŋ mɩɩra bɩrɩmɛ nɛsɩŋ arɩ piesee dɩ-diiliŋ.”

Title: AZAAYA 8
Content:
Asiiria nɛ ŋaa La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnnɩ kʋa
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, “Joŋ teŋ-jalɩɩ a ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba hɛ: Maha-Salal-Hasɩ-Bas. (Ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ: Má yuo diiba a paa ba kɩaa viiri lɩma.) 2Mɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ Yuria sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara arɩ Jɛbɛrɩkaaya nanʋala Zɛkarɩya nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii dɩ ba kʋ ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naaraa.”
3Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ dɩ haal-la sɩ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllʋ pɛ bɔsɔ. Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ kɛŋ luoruŋ a lʋl hambolibie. La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, “Hɛ bile yɩrɩŋ Maha-Salal-Hasɩ-Bas. 4Ka dɩ bile-na kʋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ bʋl: ‘Mɩ nyɩmma,’ koo ‘Mɩ naaŋ,’ Asiiria kuoro jaŋ paa Damasɩkʋs dʋa arɩ dʋa-la kala ba sɩ yuo laa Samarɩa tɩŋŋaa teeŋ a kaa viiri.”
5La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋla pɩmɛ, 6“A tɩŋ nɩaa deemba sɩ vɩa
mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ nagɛ lɩɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩɩ pɛllɛ mʋa mʋa a lɩlɩɩ Sɩlʋa fuo-la lɛ,
aŋ jʋjʋɔsɛ Reziŋ
arɩ Remalia nanʋala Pɛka wɩaa,
7mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ Asiiria kuoro
arɩ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kala kʋ yuo Juda tɩŋŋaa.
Ba jaŋ kɔ a nagɛ Yufireti fuo-la lɩɩŋ sɩ suo a gbu lɩlɩɩ.
8Ba jaŋ tii paa Juda tɩŋŋaa kala
a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ pɛllɛ paa kɩaa.
Ba jaŋ jɛrɛ tɔ tintee-la kala pɩlɩm pɩlɩm.
Wɩa hɛ la teeŋ nɛ, a jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa jɛrɛ tɔla.”
9Ma tintee wogusu-la kala,
má leŋ dɩ ma bɔɩsɩŋ jujoŋ.
Má jegile nɩɩ,
ma nyɩgɩla nɛ a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa kɔ dɩ ma yuola,
ama fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmma.
10Ma vʋʋrɛ wɩaa a tɩgɛ la lɛ nɛ,
ama wɩalɩŋ kala jaŋ pugi.
Má kɛŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ arɩ la,
ama ma tʋɔbɩɩna-la bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ,
bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa hɛ la teeŋ nɛ.
Má fɩfá Wɩa
11La TƖƖNA chaasa kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa kpʋrɩsɛ mɩ dɩgɩlaa, dɩ mɩ sɩ́ wombii-la nɩaa deemba sɩɩ to joŋ. Ʋ sɩ,
12“Pʋpɔ ŋ sɩ́ nɩaa deemba lɛ pɛ
dɩ ma vʋʋrɛ wʋbɔŋ kala.
Sɩ́ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ fá ma fá,
a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ŋ bɔyɛ joŋ ba lɛ.
13Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa
nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.
Mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ maga dɩ ma fɩfá.
14Mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a pʋpɔma,
ama mɩ jaŋ nagɛ tabɩɩŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ laa dii gɛrɛ titel,
aŋ nagɛ bɛrɛ a kɩkɛsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa
a pɛ Jerusalɛm tɩŋŋaa lɛ.
15Ba nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a gɛrɛ
tel a nyʋgʋsɛ,
bɛrɩsɩŋ jaŋ kɛsɛba.”
16Mɩ harɩ-tooroo,
má pɔ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ a kɛmba woruŋ.
17Mɩ jaŋ gbɛrɛ La TƖƖNA,
ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa faa Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ.
Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ʋ lɛ.
18Na mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la. La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ, ʋ jonla la ŋaa magɩl nɛ a pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.
19Ama, nɩaa jaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ ma mʋ vʋgʋraa arɩ chichiribee teeŋ a chɛ na wɩaa. Ba nɛ yie lʋaraa bʋl wɩaa arɩ yikori-bie ŋɩɩ. Wɩa dee nɩaa maga dɩ ba pɩɛsɛ a na wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaa? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma pɩpɩɛsɛ nɩsʋʋnʋŋ dɩ ma na nɩweyee wɩaa? 20Dɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla nɛ bɩ wombii-la La TƖƖNA sɩ daga lɛ to, ŋɩɩ-na ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ. 21Tʋɔ-cheeŋ arɩ losuŋ jaŋ jʋʋba, dɩ ba gɔllɔ baarɛ tintee-la lɛ. Dɩ losu-la nɛ jʋʋba, ba baanɩŋ jaŋ sii woruŋ dɩ ba wʋla beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ a chɛ kʋŋ ka, aŋ bʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tɩgɛ ba kuoro arɩ ba Wɩa lɛ. 22Ba jaŋ beŋ tinteeŋ ma a chɛ kʋŋ ka, see tʋɔ-cheeŋ arɩ birimiŋ arɩ fawʋllʋŋ dʋndʋŋa, biriŋ-la tʋɔŋ nɛ ba jaŋ hɛ.

Title: AZAAYA 9
Content:
Ba lʋl bie pɩla
1Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ. Faafaa-la Zebuluŋ doho nɩaa arɩ Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa dii hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ, ama maachie lere-la yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ, a chɩŋ Mediterenia mʋga-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kaa mʋ tintee-la sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ arɩ Galilii tinteeŋ, lee-la nʋhʋɔraa sɩ hɛ.
2Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ vɛŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ
na pʋlʋŋ-bal nɛ.
Tintee-la nɩaa fa sɩ hɛ birimiŋ lim tʋɔŋ,
pʋlʋmʋŋ lɛɛlɛ chaanaa hɛ ba lɛ nɛ.
3Ŋ kɛŋ tintee-la chʋʋla kɩɩ nɛ
a leŋ ʋ nɩaa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ yʋgɛ,
ba jʋjʋɔsɛ ŋ sɩpaaŋ,
a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ yie jʋjʋɔsɛ ŋɩɩ dɩ ba nɩɩ ŋaa ba baga kɩaa,
koo a nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɩaa sɩ yie jʋjʋɔsɛ dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ dʋa-la
ba sɩ yuo laa ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ teeŋ kpɩkpaa.
4Ŋ dʋɔrɛ hɛɛ-la fa sɩ nagɛ daaŋ a daŋ ba baŋŋaa lɛ nɛ,
a lɩɩsɛba hɛɛ-la lɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ fa sɩ jomba hɛ.
Ŋ yuo dii nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛba nɛ
arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ fa sɩ yuo dii Midiaŋ tɩŋŋaa.
5Laalɩyuori-wajɩaba nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ
arɩ ba gɛnnɩ-la sɩ fo arɩ chalɩŋ
jaŋ dii nyiniŋ,
ba jaŋ joŋo hɛ nyiniŋ,
6bɛɛ wɩaa ba lʋl bii nɛ a pɩla,
hambolibie nɛ ba joŋo pɩla,
ʋ nɛ jaŋ bibenla.
Ba jaŋ yɩyɩrʋ:
Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ nɩaa chagɩlɩŋ ʋ dɔŋ tuo, Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ,
Nyɩmma-la sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ,
Kuori-bile sɩ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ kʋkɔ.
7Ʋ kuoruŋ doluŋ arɩ ʋ fɩɛlɩŋ jaŋ pʋŋa pɩpɛ a kaa mʋ wuu,
ʋ bɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ.
Ʋ nɛ jaŋ hɔŋ Devit kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ
a beŋ ʋ nɩaa
a kɛŋ kuorii-la woruŋ a leŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ.
Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔpʋla
a benu a lɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.
La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nyuŋ sɩ nyaasɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ
jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa.
La TƖƖNA na baanɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ
8La TƖƖNA bʋl wʋbɔŋ nɛ a tɩgɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ,
wɩɩ-la jaŋ jʋʋ Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ.
9Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ:
Efirem tɩmma-la arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Samarɩa lɛ,
sɩɩ-duo tɩmma-la
sɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa a bʋl,
10“Toŋgolumoo dɩa-la tele nɛ,
la-na jaŋ kɛŋ tabɩaa ba sɩ wasa ta, a saa.
Ba keri tutogusu-la kala lo nɛ,
la-na jaŋ chɔnsɛ kuolu tɩɩsɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ.”
11Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA yigi kuoro Reziŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ a hɛ ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa lɛ nɛ.
Ʋ lɔgɛ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ ba lɛ nɛ.
12Siiria tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, arɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ,
ba jaŋ yuo dii Iziral tɩŋŋaa.
Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa,
ama La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ ha bɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ,
ʋ ha jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a pɛ.
13Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, Iziral tɩŋŋaa ha vɩa nɛ dɩ ba bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ
aŋ kɔ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ dɔgɩsɛba teeŋ.
14Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, tapʋl-bala nɛ
La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ,
a keri Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ
arɩ ba bʋbʋɔ-doho kala ta,
ba naakelee arɩ ba pɩpaarɩŋ kala.
15Ba nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ ba nɩbala-la nɛ ŋaa nyuŋ-la,
Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la ma sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa nɛ ŋaa bʋbʋɔ-doho-la.
16Nɩaa deemba nɛ laa ba sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba yeŋŋi,
ba nɛ dagɛ nɩalɩŋ ba lɛl.
17Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba-pʋɔsa-la kʋŋkala fori.
Ʋ bɩ jaŋ fá biisinsiŋ arɩ yo-haalaa ma nenige,
bɛɛ wɩaa ba kʋŋkala bɩ Wɩa ka fá, aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ,
a kala bʋbʋl wʋtɔɔnʋŋ.
Wɩaa deemba kala lɛ, La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ ha bɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ,
ʋ ha jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a pɛ.
18Tɛŋɛ, nɩalɩŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩɩ dii nɛ,
ʋ yie dii ya-kʋɔŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ
a chol duuŋ nyiŋgeliŋ sisii,
nyʋɔsʋŋ sii tɔ dugugu.
19La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna
baanɩŋ jaŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ
a dii tintee-la arɩ nɩaa kala.
Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ fá ʋ naambie nenige.
20Ba jaŋ kɛŋ ba nadiiŋ kuogi kɩaa dii
ka dɩ losuŋ ha kɛmba,
a kɛŋ nagʋa ma kuogo dii,
ka dɩ losuŋ ha kɛmba.
Ba jaŋ gʋra kɛsɛ ba biiriŋ a chɩchaŋ.
21Manasɛ arɩ Efirem nɩaa jaŋ gʋra yuyuo dɔŋɔ,
ba balɩa-la ma jaŋ bɩra gbaara yuyuo Juda.
Wɩaa deemba kala lɛ La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ ha bɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ,
ʋ ha jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a pɛ.

Title: AZAAYA 10
Content:
1Wɩɩŋ puu ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bil wombie-la
sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ ka to,
a dʋdɔgɩsɛ mɩ nɩaa,
2a bɩ leŋe summoo nɩna wɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba na,
a bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ bʋla pɩ mɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nyaga bil,
aŋ kɛŋ yo-haalaa
arɩ biisinsiŋ kɩaa lɩlaa.
3Wʋbɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ ŋaa tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ
lɩɩ dɩ-bolii a kɔ dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛma?
Kʋbɛɛ teeŋ nɛ ma jaŋ fá mʋ dɩ ʋ pɛ ma lɛ?
Nɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ joŋ ma dʋa-la bil?
4Wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ laama, ba jaŋ kpʋma
koo a kɛsɛma dɩ ma ŋaa nɩa ba sɩ kaa tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa.
Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa ma lɛ, ama La TƖƖNA baanɩŋ ha bɩ jaŋ fɩɛlɛ.
Ʋ ha jaŋ dɔgɩsɛma a pɛ.
Wɩa jaŋ dii Asiiria sarɩya
5La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Asiiria tɩmma, wɩɩŋ puuma, ma nɛ ŋaa mɩ baanɩŋ daŋkpɩlɩŋ,
mɩ sɩ jaŋ kaa dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ mɩ sɩ chaasa na baanɩŋ.
6Mɩ tɩŋ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa nɛ dɩ ba mʋ yuo tintee-la nɩaa sɩ bɩ mɩ-na Wɩa ka fá,
nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ baanɩŋ sii.
Mɩ tɩmba dɩ ba mʋ kɛŋ ba dʋa laa nɛ
aŋ fɩrɩgɛba a nagɛ vʋchɔɔŋ sɩ pɩŋ wombiiŋ lɛ.
7Ama Asiiria kuoro ma mɩɩra kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ wogusu nɛ,
wɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ dee ŋɩɩ,
ʋʋ bɩɩnɛ dɩ ʋ chei tintee daŋ nɛ,
a leŋ dɩ ba dɛrɛ.
8Ʋ bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ a bʋl, ‘Mɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ kala ŋaa kuoroo nɛ.
9Mɩ yuo dii tasɩŋ deemba nɛ:
Kalino arɩ Kachɛmɩsɩ arɩ Hamaf arɩ Apadɩ,
Samarɩa arɩ Damasɩkʋs.
10Mɩ yuo dii tinteye-la kala sɩɩ to vʋɩyaa nɛ,
ba vʋɩyaa nɛ paala kɩɩ Jerusalɛm arɩ Samarɩa kala vʋɩyaa.
11Mɩ jaŋ chei Jerusalɛm arɩ ʋ vʋɩyaa kala,
arɩ mɩ sɩ chei Samarɩa arɩ ʋ vʋɩyaa ŋɩɩ.’ ”
12Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl, “Dɩ mɩ nɛ dɛrɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ joŋo ŋaa peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ arɩ Jerusalɛm tɩŋŋaa lɛ, mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Asiiria kuoro a tɩŋ ʋ dagɩŋ-tɩtɩɩ arɩ ʋ babii-ballɩŋ wɩaa.” 13Ʋ sɩ,
“Mɩ doluŋ nɛ mɩ kaa ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala,
bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ a jɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔsʋŋ.
Mɩ gbaa tinteyee bʋɔsʋŋ ta nɛ,
a paa ba kɩalɩŋ ma kala ba sɩ tʋɔla,
aŋ yuo dii ba kuoroo ma kala.
14Mɩ yuo dii tinteye-la kala nɛ,
a laa ba dʋa a nagɛ nʋʋ sɩ na
diibie sɩ sie aŋ ka ʋ paa halaa dɛlɛ lɛ,
ka nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ kire.”
15La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Saaŋ jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ ʋ nɛ kɩɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛnʋ tɩtɩŋ?
Koo sɩa jaŋ wuo bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ ʋ nɛ kɩɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛnʋ kikeri kɩaa?
Dantɩga bɩ jaŋ wuo tɩgɛ ʋ tɩtɩa
koo dɩ toŋguluŋ baasɛ ʋ tɩtɩa.”
16Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna
jaŋ joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ
a hɛ ʋ laalɩyuori babiibala-la kala
sɩ nɛrɛ pimee pimee lɛ dɩ ba yʋɔlɛ.
Nyiniŋ jaŋ chei ba yara-la kala,
dɩ ba nagɛ nyiniŋ sɩ lieri kʋa.
17Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ ŋaa ba pʋlʋmʋŋ jaŋ nagɛ nyiniŋ.
Ba Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ jaŋ nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ,
ʋ jaŋ joŋ tapʋl-bala a dii Asiiria tɩmma-la sɩ
nagɛ yakʋɔŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ sɩ lugo.
18Asiiria duu-la arɩ ʋ ŋmaŋkaa
sɩma-la kala jaŋ chei
a nagɛ nyanyalaa sɩ yie chei nɩa ŋɩɩ.
19Ʋ duu-la tɩɩsɩŋ mʋapɩlɩɩ jaŋ ka,
dɩ bii-bie ma wuo dɩɩsɛba.
Iziral nɩkaanaa
20Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ kʋ yi Iziral nɩkaana-la,
Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ sʋba,
bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋ ba tɩtɩa a yelli
nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋba a dɛrɛ.
Ba jaŋ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa kala hɛ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa
sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ lɛ.
21Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩkaana-la
jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ la Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna teeŋ.
22Iziral tɩmma, ma fa yʋga a nagɛ hagɩla sɩ pɩŋ mʋga niiŋ nɛ,
ama nɩalɩŋ baŋmɛnɛ sɩ ka nɛ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.
Cheeriŋ chaasa jʋʋma nɛ a cheima,
ŋɩɩ nɛ saa maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa.
23La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna ka chɛ
dɩ ʋ chei ma tinteeŋ kala nɛ
arɩ ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.
24Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:
“Mɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ,
má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a tɩŋ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa wɩaa.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ dɔgɩsɛma,
a joŋ toŋguluŋ je ma nyuŋ a nagɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩ dɔgɩsɛma ŋɩɩ.
25Ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni, ka baaŋ-la mɩ sɩ na ma nyuŋ dɛrɛ,
ka dɩ mɩ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ a chaasɛba a cheiba.”
26La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ vɩɩrɛba arɩ kpaasa
a nagɛ ʋ fa sɩ ŋmoo Midiaŋ tɩŋŋaa bil ŋɩɩ Oreb bʋŋ-la leriŋ.
Ʋ jaŋ je ʋ dantɩga ba lɛ a nagɛ ʋ fa sɩ je ʋ dantɩga Mʋgʋ-fɩaŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ,
a nagɛ ʋ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.
27Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, ʋ jaŋ dʋɔrɛ chʋga-la sɩ sagɛ ma vaasɩŋ lɛ,
a dʋɔrɛ hɛɛ-la fa sɩ nagɛ daaŋ a daŋ ma baŋŋaa lɛ,
ʋ jaŋ boru, ka dɩ ma wiesi.
28Dʋndɔmɔ-la jʋʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ayaf,
ba to taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɩgɩrɔŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ,
ba joŋ ba kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ a bil taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mɩkɩmas lɛ nɛ.
29Ba chol fuonaa-bie nɛ aŋ bʋl,
“La jaŋ chʋa Geba lɛ.
Fawʋllʋŋ kɛŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rama nɩaa nɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ kuoro Sɔɔl taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Geba lɛ fá viiri nɛ.”
30Galɩm tɩmma, má ŋmoo niiŋ,
Layɩsa tɩŋŋaa, ma má nɩɩ.
Anatɔf nenigi tɩmma, wɩɩŋ jʋʋma.
31Madɩmɛna tɩŋŋaa ka fá nɛ,
Gɛbɩm tɩŋŋaa fá lɛl nɛ dɩ ba laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ.
32Jɩnɩŋ, dʋndɔmɔ-la chɩŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nɔb lɛ nɛ,
a chuchuu barɩŋ
peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ lɛ,
Jerusalɛm dundolo.
33Má bee na La TƖƖNA, doluŋ kala Tɩɩna
jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kala nyʋgʋsɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ keri tɩa naakelee ba tele nyʋgʋsɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa jije
jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmba.
34La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ ʋ saaŋ a keri tɩɩ-lugunu-la kala lo.
Lɛbanɔŋ tinteeŋ kala jaŋ tel doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩpaaŋ.

Title: AZAAYA 11
Content:
Devit doho jaŋ pɔsɛ
1Devit kuoru gentine nagɛ tɩa ba sɩ kere lo nɛ, ama arɩ ba sɩ yie keri tɩa lo ka gentine bɩra tɔsɛ a nɛŋ ŋɩɩ,
ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ kuori-falɩŋ jaŋ lɩɩ Devit doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ.
2Wɩa Dɩma jaŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ
dɩ ʋ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a wuo jɩjɩŋ wɩaa bʋbʋɔŋ,
a jɩŋ nɩaa chagɩlɩŋ, a kɛŋ doluŋ
a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa a zizil La TƖƖNA.
3Ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ tuto La TƖƖNA niiŋ.
Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ na koo ʋ sɩ nɩa dee
ʋ jaŋ kaa dii nɩaa sarɩya.
4Tʋɔpʋla nɛ ʋ jaŋ kaa dii nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ sarɩya,
wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ʋ jaŋ kaa dii summoo sarɩya a chɩŋ ba harɩŋ.
Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wɩaa chei,
aŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ.
5Tʋɔpʋla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ jaŋ
nagɛ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie ʋ tɩŋa lɛ.
6Guŋgurusuŋ arɩ pie-biisiŋ jaŋ jʋjʋʋ dɩ-bala,
dɩ kpeye arɩ bʋʋnaa ma guoli dɔŋɔ lɛ a pɩŋ,
nɛ-bie arɩ naachigi-bie jaŋ pɛ kɩaa dɩ-diiliŋ,
dɩ bii-bie nɛ bibeŋ ba nyuŋ.
7Nɛŋ arɩ lugumuŋ jaŋ didii kɩaa dɩ-bala,
dɩ ba biiriŋ ma pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a pɩŋ ka wɩɩkala bɩ ŋaa.
Naachigiŋ jaŋ didii yaŋ a nagɛ nɛŋ.
8Bii-mulo jaŋ gbigbieli kataha bʋa niiŋ ka wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ ŋaaʋ,
bii-bie jaŋ joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ a hɛ dʋndɔ-kuuro bʋa lɛ ka wɩɩ bɩ ʋ ka ŋaa.
9Wɩa peel-zɔŋ-la kala lɛ
wʋbɔŋ koo wʋcheyii bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ hɛ nɩmɛ.
Wɩa wɩaa jaŋ su dʋnɩa kala
a nagɛ lɩɩŋ sɩ yie su mʋgʋ-balɩŋ ŋɩɩ.
10Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, kuoru-la sɩ jaŋ lɩɩ Jesi gentine lɛ jaŋ chɩŋ a nagɛ tuuta nɩaa teeŋ, tinteyee jaŋ kɔ ʋ teeŋ a zilu. 11Dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, La TƖƖNA jaŋ tiire laa ʋ nɩkaanaa a lɩɩ Asiiria arɩ Ijipiti sɛmɛ-la sɩ hɛ bʋbʋɔŋ arɩ Ijipiti sɛmɛ sɩ hɛ nyuŋ arɩ Kus, Ɛlam, Babɩlɔŋ, Hamaf a pɛ tinteye-la kala mʋgʋ-balɩŋ sɩ gollo chu lɛ.
12Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ tuuta-la je
a dagɛ tinteyee nɩaa kala,
aŋ kɛŋ Iziral tɩmma-la ba sɩ kɛsɛ
mʋ yoŋ-baga kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ.
Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ Juda nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ pɩsa,
a lɩɩ dʋnɩa loŋgorunu-la banɛsɛ kala lɛ
a mɩɩra kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ.
13Iziral tɩŋŋaa yarɩ-bieriŋ jaŋ dɛrɛ,
dɩ Juda tɩŋŋaa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ma lɛl.
Iziral tɩŋŋaa yaraa bɩra bɩ jaŋ bibieri Juda nyuŋ.
Juda tɩŋŋaa ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ bɛrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.
14Ba jaŋ sii a to lere-la sɩ chulloo tuu a kʋ yuo Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ.
Ba jaŋ gbaara yuo dii nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ aŋ laa ba kɩaa.
Ba jaŋ yuo dii Ɛdɔm arɩ Mʋab nɩaa.
Amɔŋ tɩŋŋaa-na jaŋ sɛɩ wɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ bʋla.
15La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ
dɩ Ijipiti mʋgʋ-bal-la lɩɩ-libe kala hʋ.
Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ pel-lɩmɩŋ lu
a hɛ Efireti fuo-bal-la ma lɛ
dɩ ʋ hʋ.
Ʋ jaŋ kɛnʋ kpaa bil fuo-biisiŋ balɩpɛ
dɩ nɩaa wuo vɛŋ ba tʋɔŋ a chol.
16Womporuŋ jaŋ pɩŋ
a pɩ ʋ nɩkaana-la
sɩ jaŋ lɩɩ Asiiria lɛ,
a nagɛ ʋ fa sɩ pɩŋ ŋɩɩ pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba
bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.

Title: AZAAYA 12
Content:
Wɩa Dɛnnɩŋ yɩɩlaa
1Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, ma jaŋ bʋl,
“Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ La TƖƖNA,
ŋ fa paala na baanɩŋ nɛ mɩ nyuŋ,
ama ŋ leŋe ŋ baaŋ-la fɩɛlɛ nɛ,
aŋ ŋaa mɩ tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala.
2Wʋtɩtɩɩ, Wɩa nɛ ŋaa mɩ Laataara,
mɩ jaŋ laaʋ dii a bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá.
La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa mɩ doluŋ, mɩ jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ dɛnnʋ,
ʋ nɛ ŋaa mɩ Laataara.”
3A nagɛ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ yie kɛŋ nɩa ʋ nyʋa lɩɩzɔmʋŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋɩɩ,
ŋɩɩ nɛ ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ ʋ nɛ laama ta.
4Tapʋlɩɩ-la ma jaŋ bʋl,
“Má lɔllɛ La Tɩɩna, má yɩrɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ,
má leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa,
a leŋ dɩ ba jɩŋ arɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yʋga.
5Má yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA,
a tɩŋ wʋduoru-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa,
má leŋ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa.
6Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ, má faasa yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ,
bɛɛ wɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ.”

Title: AZAAYA 13
Content:
Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Babɩlɔŋ lɛ
1Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo dagɛ Amos nanʋala Azaaya a mʋ tɩgɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
2Jɩl dundolo nyuŋ kʋŋkala sɩ tuo,
a kɛŋ tuuta je aŋ kpɩa laalɩyuoroo lɛ
aŋ kɛŋ nɩsɩŋ dagɛba
dɩ ba mʋ taŋ-la nɩaa sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa boi-baalaa a yuoba.
3Mɩ hɛ mɩ laalɩyuoro-la sɩ jɩŋ laalɩ-yuonuŋ nɛ,
mɩ yɩrɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ jʋɔsɛ mɩ doluŋ lɛ nɛ,
dɩ ba mʋ yuo nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ mɩ sɩ na baanɩŋ.
4Má jegile nɩɩ goŋ-la sɩɩ ŋaa peelee nyuŋ,
ʋ nagɛ nɩ-daŋ goŋ nɛ.
Má jegile nɩɩ dɔmɔ-la sɩɩ dɔŋ kuori-gentisiŋ leree,
ʋ nagɛ tinteyee nɩaa kala sɩ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ goŋ nɛ.
Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ kɛŋ ʋ laalɩyuoroo
hɩhɛ dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ,
dɩ ba yuo laalɩŋ.
5Ba lɩɩ tinteyee sɩ bolie nɛ,
ba lɩɩ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ.
Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA baanɩŋ chaasa sii nɛ,
mɩ kori mɩ laalɩyuori kɩaa kʋkɔ dɩ mɩ chei tintee-la kala nɛ.
6Má yel, bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ-na
ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ jaŋ kɔ kpaga nɛ,
mɩ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya a chei leriŋ.
7A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa, nɩaa nɩsaa jaŋ sʋʋ,
nʋʋkala nandaasɩŋ jaŋ yʋɔrɛ.
8Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba,
hɛɛŋ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ jaŋ jʋʋba,
ba hɛɛŋ jaŋ nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl, ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ ŋɩɩ.
Ba jaŋ gɩgɩɛnɛ dɔŋɔ,
dɩ ba sɩaa fɩɛsɛ a nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ.
9Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya ka kɔ nɛ,
ʋ ŋaa tapʋl-bɔŋ nɛ,
mɩ jaŋ na baanɩŋ dɩ mɩ yaraa hosi.
Mɩ jaŋ chei wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa,
ka dɩ tinteeŋ pɩŋ hoi.
10Chɛnwʋlaa sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ ba nagɩsɩŋ kala
bɩ jaŋ chaanɛ.
Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ ma jaŋ biri,
chɛnɛ ma pʋlʋmʋŋ bɩ jaŋ chaanɛ.
11Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa,
a dɔgɩsɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.
Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa jije tuu tinteeŋ,
dɩ ba babii-ballɩŋ kala dɛrɛ.
Mɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ sɩɩ-duo tɩmma-la sɩ chaasa bɔŋ.
12Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nuhuobiinee nyaa tinteeŋ lɛ
a nagɛ sɛlɩmɛ-la sɩ chaasa zɔŋ sɩ nyaa ŋɩɩ.
13Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wɩa-nyuŋ chel,
dɩ tinteeŋ ma zigili,
a sʋrɩsɛ ʋ dɩchɩnɩŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna
sɩ jaŋ dagɛma mɩ baaŋ-la mɩ sɩ faasa na.
14Nɩwogusu-la kala sɩ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ jaŋ fá pɩsɛ a mʋ ba jasɩŋ
a nagɛ tɛhɩɩ sɩɩ fá dɩ ʋ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ nambagɩla nɩsɩŋ lɛ,
koo a nagɛ piesee sɩ bɩ pie-daara kɛnɛ.
Nʋʋkala jaŋ fá mʋ ʋ jaŋ.
15Nɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ kɛnɛ, ba jaŋ joŋ tokobiiŋ tɔbʋ lɩɩ gɩrɩgɛ,
ba jaŋ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kɛsɛ arɩ tokobiiŋ.
16Ba jaŋ paa ba bii-mulluŋ vɩɩra yɛrɛ ba sɩɩŋ lɛ,
aŋ jʋʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ paa ba kɩaa kala aŋ gurigi ba haalaa.
17Má bee na, mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛ Midiaŋ tɩŋŋaa
kʋ hɛ Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa lɛ,
ba-na bɩ hɔpʋla
arɩ sɛlɩmɛ wɩaa chɩla.
18Ba jaŋ kpʋ ba bapʋɔsaa arɩ tosuŋ,
ba bɩ jaŋ fá bii-mulluŋ nisusuŋ,
koo a fá hambiisiŋ nenige.
19Babɩlɔŋ kɛŋ kpɩɛra-la sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ woruŋ a kɩɩ tintee kala,
ba nɛ ʋ nɩaa kaa dagɛ ba tɩtɩa,
ama mɩ-na Wɩa jaŋ chei ʋ kala
arɩ mɩ fa sɩ chei Sodom arɩ Gomora ŋɩɩ.
20Nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ
koo a hɛ lee-la a kaa mʋ wuu.
Arab tɩŋŋaa ma sɩ ŋaa nɩgɔllɔ baarɩa ma bɩ jaŋ hɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ a hɔŋ nɩmɛ.
Pie-daaraa ma bɩ jaŋ kiri ba piesee mʋ nɩmɛ dɩ ba dii yaŋ.
21Gɩrɩŋ kɩaa dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.
Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa jolluŋ dɩa,
nɩmɛ nɛ hajaaŋkuŋkumba jaŋ jʋjʋʋ,
dɩ tɛhɩɩba ma gbigbieli nɩmɛ.
22Babɩlɔŋ kuori-dɩɩ-zɔmɔ-la jaŋ ŋaa kpeyee dɩjʋʋlaa,
dɩ jolluŋ nɩnɩɩ sɩma nɩmɛ.
Ba jaŋ huoso su lee-la kala.
Babɩlɔŋ cheyiŋ tapʋlaa chese nɛ,
ba bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tapʋlaa lɛrɛ mʋ sɩpaaŋ.

Title: AZAAYA 14
Content:
1La TƖƖNA jaŋ fá Iziral tɩŋŋaa nenige.
Ʋ jaŋ bɩra lɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba ŋaa ʋ nɩaa,
a leŋ dɩ ba hɔŋ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ lɛ.
Nɩwogusuŋ jaŋ kʋ pɛ hɔŋ Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ
dɩ ba niiŋ ŋaa kʋbala.
2Tintee-daŋ jaŋ pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ
a kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ ba tinteeŋ.
Jekɔb doho nɩalɩŋ jaŋ tɩɩ tinteye-la nɩaa
dɩ baalaa arɩ haalaa tɩma pɩpɩba tintee-la La TƖƖNA sɩ joŋo pɩba lɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ yuo kɛsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ba ma jaŋ yuo kɛsɛba,
a bibeŋ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ dɔgɩsɛba.
3Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA jaŋ lɩɩsɛ Iziral nɩaa hɛɛ-la lɛ ba sɩ hɛ, arɩ tɩntɩŋ-duoru-la ba fa sɩ yie fʋgɛba hɛ ba tɩtɩŋ, 4dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ sieri Babɩlɔŋ kuoru-la lɛ a bʋl:
“Ŋ fa sɩ bɔmɔ ŋɩɩ a dʋdɔgɩsɛ nɩaa, lɛɛlɛ ʋ dɛrɛ nɛ,
ŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo dɔgɩsɛ nʋʋ.
5La TƖƖNA bori kuoru bɔmɔ-la kuori-dantɩgɩsɩŋ nɛ,
ba nɛ ŋaa ba doluŋ.
6Ba nɛ ba yie na baanɩŋ a kaa ŋmoo nɩaa kpʋkpʋ
a bɩ leŋ.
Ba yie kɛŋ baanɩŋ nɛ kire dʋdɔgɩsɛ nɩaa,
a bɩ leŋe tinteye-la ma ba sɩ yuo dii nɩaa wiwiesi.
7Lɛɛlɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala na wiese nɛ a fɩɛla hɔŋ,
ba kala ka yɩɩ yɩɩlaa nɛ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a jʋjʋɔsɛ.
8Tɩɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ ma paala jʋjʋɔsɛ nɛ
a tɩŋ kuoru-la sɩ tele wɩaa, a bʋl,
‘Lɛɛlɛ ŋ sɩ tele ŋ-la, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ kerila lo.’
9Lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a gbɛrɛ
dɩ Babɩlɔŋ kuoro kɔ ʋ teeŋ.
Nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ ŋaa sɩpaalaaraa dʋnɩa lɛ aŋ sʋʋ,
ba dɩnsɩŋ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ba laaŋ.
Nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ ŋaa kuoroo a bibeŋ tinteyee aŋ sʋʋ,
sii ba kuoru kpasɩnɩŋ nyuŋ nɛ,
ba dɩnsɩŋ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ba cheme kɛnɩŋ.
10Ba kala jaŋ bʋl,
ba jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ,
‘Ŋ ma lɛɛlɛ pʋgɩma nɛ, a nagɛla.
Ŋ bɩrɩma nagɛla nɛ.’
11Ŋ dɩ ŋ babii-ballɩŋ kala nɛ tuu bʋa ŋɩɩ,
ba fa yie du chenniŋ nɛ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɩdɛnnɩŋ.
Na ŋ nɛ lɛɛlɛ pɩŋ ŋɩɩ,
nanchʋɔlaa jɛrɛ tɔ ŋ kala a didii.
12Ɛɛ ma nɛ ŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ tuu tel ŋɩɩ,
ŋ fa nagɛ nanyʋɔlʋŋ sɩ pɔsɔ nɛ.
Ŋ fa yie yuo dii tinteyee nɛ,
ama lɛɛlɛ ba kiriŋ ta nɛ ŋ tuu tinteeŋ.
13Ŋ fa yie bʋl ŋ tʋɔŋ lɛ,
‘Mɩ jaŋ jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ,
mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ kuoru kpasa jɩla
kieli Wɩa chɛnwʋlaa,
mɩ jaŋ hɔŋ mɩ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ peel-la nyuŋ
vesiŋ sɩɩ hilimu.
14Mɩ jaŋ kieli duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa jɩla hɔŋ,
mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa ŋaa nagɛ Wɩa sɩ kɩɩ kʋŋkala.’
15Ama, na ŋ nɛ ba joŋo nyaga hɛ bʋa lɛ ŋɩɩ,
ŋ ŋaa lɛlɩɩ.
16Nɩalɩŋ sɩ naŋ tuo bibeniŋ nɛ,
a kɛŋ ŋ nagɩŋ bɩbɩɩnɛ a bʋl,
‘Baala deeŋ dee fa bɩ tinteeŋ kaa zigili ŋɩɩ,
a leŋ kuori-gentisiŋ chel,
17ʋ dee bɩ tasɩŋ cheye ŋɩɩ
a leŋ tinteeŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ
a bɩ chɛ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ kɛsɛ mɩɩra mʋ ba dɩɩsɩŋ?’
18Tinteyee kala kuoroo nɛ ba hugi,
ba kʋŋkala pɩŋ ʋ kuoru-bʋa lɛ.
19Ama, ba joŋ ŋ-na kʋsʋʋŋ yuo ta nɛ,
a nagɛ tɩa naakeliŋ ba sɩ vɩa ta.
Nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa laalɩŋ lɛ
a paa yuo hɛ bʋɔsʋŋ lɛ,
ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ pilime tɔ ŋ kʋsʋʋŋ nɛ.
Ŋ nagɛ kʋa sɩ sʋba nɛ ba joŋo ta a nʋɔsa bɩbal.
20Nʋʋ bɩ ŋ-na ka hugi arɩ ba sɩɩ hugi kuoro ŋɩɩ,
bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ chei ŋ tinteeŋ kala nɛ
a kpʋ ŋ nɩaa ma.
Nɩbɔmʋŋ doho yɩrɩŋ
bɩra bɩ maga dɩ ba yɩrɛ.
21Má wasɛ leriŋ a kɛsɛ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ kpʋ
a tɩŋ ba naabalɩmaba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.
Ba bɩ maga dɩ ba hɛ nɩmɛ
a sii tɩɩ tinteeŋ
a saa tabalaa tɔ leriŋ.”
22La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ,
“Mɩ jaŋ yuo dii Babɩlɔŋ
a kpʋ ʋ nɩkaana-la sɩ bɩ sʋba,
ʋ biiriŋ arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa,
dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛl dʋnɩa lɛ.
Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.
23Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ mɩɩra nagɛ fuonaaŋ sɩ luro,
a kɛnʋ bɩrɩmɛ lee hajaaŋkuŋkumba sɩ jaŋ jʋjʋʋ.
Mɩ jaŋ cheyu dɩ ʋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a nagɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ chaaŋ tii paa nʋsʋrʋŋ.
Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.”
Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Asiiria tɩŋŋaa lɛ
24La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna ŋmɩɛsa nɛ a bʋl,
“Tɛŋɛ, wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩɩna nɛ jaŋ ŋaa,
wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ mɩ ŋaa, mɩ jaŋ ŋaaba.
25Mɩ jaŋ chei Asiiria tɩŋŋaa Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, mɩ tinteeŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.
Mɩ jaŋ nʋɔsɛba bil
mɩ peelee nyuŋ.
Hɛɛ-la sɩ nagɛ daaŋ ba joŋo daŋ mɩ nɩaa baŋŋaa lɛ, mɩ jaŋ dʋɔrʋ,
a dʋɔrɛ chʋga-la ba sɩ joŋo sagɛ mɩ nɩaa vaasɩŋ lɛ.
26Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa kala lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.
Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ dɔgɩsɛ tinteyee kala.”
27La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bɩɩna.
Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo giru?
Ʋ suomo dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩaa nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa jaŋ wuo bʋl ʋ sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa?
Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa lɛ
28Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla jɩna-la kuoro Ahas sɩ sʋba nɛ ŋ-la:
29“Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa kala, ma pɔ má sɩ́ jʋɔsʋ
a tɩŋ daa-la fa sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛma sɩ boro wɩaa.
Dɩ dɩmɩŋ nɛ sʋba, dɩŋ-la sɩ kɛŋ huoŋ a kɩɩʋ yie lɩɩ chɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ nɛ.
Ʋ halaa jaŋ tiesi dɩ-bɔmɔ-la doho sɩ kɛŋ huoŋ-la tɩtɩa.
30Mɩ jaŋ pɛ ʋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chaasa ŋaa summo lɛ dɩ ba na kʋdiilee dii,
dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ fɩɛla pɩŋ sɔm.
Ama mɩ jaŋ joŋ losuŋ hɛ ma Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩŋŋaa lɛ
dɩ mɩ kpʋ ma nɩkaana-la kala dɩ ba sʋʋ.
31Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tɩmma, má ŋmoo niiŋ ma tabalaa lɛ,
má leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma, dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ.
Laalɩyuoroo nɛ hɛ dɔŋɔ a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ a lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ a kʋkɔ ma lɛ,
nɩtɛsʋ kala tuo laalɩyuoro-la tʋɔŋ.
32Wʋbɛɛ nɛ saa la jaŋ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ tɩma
ba lɩɩ Fɩlɩsɩtɩa tinteeŋ kɔ?
Ma jaŋ bʋla pɩba arɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ leŋe Zaayɔŋ chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ,
ʋ nɩaa fa sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ba mʋ nɩmɛ a wuo hɔŋ,
wɩɩ bɩ baa walɩmɛ.”

Title: AZAAYA 15
Content:
Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Mʋab tɩŋŋaa lɛ
1Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ Mʋab lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Aa a hɛ Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ,
ba cheyu tɩtaŋɩŋ nɛ.
Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kii a hɛ Mʋab tinteeŋ lɛ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ,
ba cheyu tɩtaŋɩŋ nɛ.
2Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Dɩbɔŋ,
ʋ nɩaa sii jɩl ba vene dɩa nɛ peeliŋ nyuŋ a yiyel.
Mʋab tɩŋŋaa ka ŋmoo niiŋ nɛ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Mediba arɩ Nebo wɩaa.
Ba paala fʋŋ ba nyusuŋ
a fʋŋ ba tɔŋŋɔɔ ma kala
a dɩdagɛ arɩ ba tʋɔŋ cheye nɛ.
3Ba laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ nɛ
a yiyel ba lusunuŋ nyuŋ arɩ wombiee, arɩ ba biliŋ lɛ.
Ba kala yele nɛ,
a pɔ ba bɩ tɔrɛ.
4Tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ arɩ Eliali nɩaa ma faasaa yel nɛ.
Ba nii-ŋmobo mʋ yiyi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jahas.
Mʋab laalɩyuoroo ŋmoo niiŋ nɛ aŋ chichel,
ba nandaasɩŋ yʋɔra nɛ.
5Mɩ tʋɔŋ ka wɩɩ Mʋab wɩaa nɛ,
ʋ nɩaa kala lɩɩ fá nɛ a mʋmʋ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zʋa
arɩ Ɛgɩlaf Sɛlɩsɩya sɩ hɛ dɩ-bolii, dɩ ba laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ.
Ba dɔnsʋŋ jɩla joŋ wombiiŋ nɛ a yele mʋmʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Luhif,
ka dɔnsʋŋ ma joŋ wombii-la sɩɩ mʋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Horonem a faasa yele mʋmʋ
a tɩŋ ba sɩ chei ba tinteeŋ wɩaa.
6Fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Nimirim lɩɩŋ kala nɛ hʋa,
yaŋ-la ma sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ kala hɩl.
Kʋ-laarɩŋ sʋba nɛ,
kʋ-laa kala bɩra tuo nɩmɛ.
7Dʋa-la ma kala ba fa sɩ dʋa a bil,
ba kala nɛ ba paa kaa chol fuonaa-la sɩ kɛŋ tɩɩsɩŋ a viiri.
8Ba nii-ŋmobo-la chɩɩmɛ Mʋab tinteeŋ kala nɛ,
ba yele mʋ yi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛgɩlam
arɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Bɛɛ Ɛlɩm.
9Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Dimoŋ fuonuŋ kala nɛ suo arɩ chalɩŋ,
ama mɩ-na Wɩa ha jaŋ lɛrɛ wɩaa kʋ hɛ ba lɛ a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ.
Mɩ jaŋ lɛrɛ naachigiŋ kʋ hɛ Mʋab tɩmma-la sɩɩ fá dɩ ba laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ
arɩ nɩkaana-la sɩ hɛ tintee-la lɛ.

Title: AZAAYA 16
Content:
1Mʋab tɩmma, má kɛsɛ pie-pɔrɔɔ
kaa mʋ pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ tinteeŋ,
má kaa chol taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛla sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ,
a kaa mʋ ŋaa zile pɩ
kuoru-la sɩɩ beŋ Jerusalɛm.
2Mʋab tɩŋŋaa haalaa mʋ nyɩrɩgɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ nɛ fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Anɔŋ niiŋ,
lee-la sɩ bɩ luŋ a chɩchɛ ba chol,
baa baarɛ nɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ kiri diibiisiŋ ta ba dɛllɩŋ lɛ
ba lɩɩ bɩbaarɛ.
3Ba bʋla pɩ Juda nɩaa,
“Má dagɛla wɩɩ-la la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.
Má tɔ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ la lɛ a nagɛ tɩa fɩɛlɩŋ sɩ yie keese tɔ nɩaa lɛ ŋɩɩ,
wɩɩ-hɛɛ-siesee.
La ŋaa nɩa sɩ fá kʋ yuorima nɛ,
má kɛnla kaa faa dɩ la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ́ la na.
4Má leŋ dɩ la Mʋab tɩmma-la sɩɩ fá la laa la tɩtɩa hɔŋ ma tʋɔŋ.
Má laala ta la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.”
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyagɛba bil jaŋ dɛrɛ,
wɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ cheiba jaŋ birigi,
nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ baanɩŋ aa nʋɔsɛba jaŋ dɛrɛ tintee-la lɛ.
5Devit doho nɩaa dɔŋɔ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ a cho nɩaa woruŋ,
ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ beŋ ʋ nɩaa.
Ʋ jaŋ dii ʋ nɩaa sarɩya arɩ tʋɔpʋla, a chɩchɛ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ chɩŋ.
6La Juda nɩaa nɩɩ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa babii-ballɩŋ wɩaa nɛ,
ama ba bigisine-la
arɩ ba sɩɩ bɩ suo-la kala ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.
7Mʋab tɩŋŋaa jaŋ ŋmoo niiŋ
hɛ dɔŋɔ a tɩŋ ba tinteeŋ wɩaa,
ba tʋɔŋ jaŋ chei a tɩŋ kʋdii-zɔmɔ-la
ba fa sɩɩ dii Kii Harɛsɛf lɛ wɩaa.
8Bagɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Hɛsɩbɔŋ lɛ
arɩ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩbɩma lɛ kala ŋmaama nɛ.
Tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩŋ-la sɩ chaasa sɩŋ
tinteyee kuoroo fa yie nyʋa bugi.
Tɩɩsɩ-la fa tɛllɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ a mʋ yi tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jazɛ
a joŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi tintee-hɩlɩŋ
a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ mʋ yi Mʋgʋ-sʋʋŋ.
9Lɛɛlɛ, mɩ jaŋ yel a nagɛ Jaza sɩ yel ŋɩɩ,
a tɩŋ Sɩbɩma girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩ-la wɩaa.
Mɩ kala nɛ fo arɩ sɩlɩɩrɩŋ
a tɩŋ Hɛsɩbɔŋ arɩ Eliali wɩaa.
Ba fa sɩ yie tʋtɔrɛ tɩɩnɛnɛ-la
a ŋɩŋaa goŋ-la arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ,
ŋɩɩ bɩra tuo.
10Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩra tuo girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩ-la lɛ,
nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ yɩɩlaa yɩa a ŋɩŋaa goŋ ba lɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ ma fa sɩɩ chagɛ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ bɩra bɩ chagɛ.
Mɩ giri goŋ-la ta nɛ.
11Mɩ tʋɔŋ cheye nɛ woruŋ mɩ yiyel
a tɩŋ Mʋab tinteeŋ arɩ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kii Harɛsɛf wɩaa.
12Dɩ Mʋab tɩŋŋaa nɛ mʋ
ba vene dɩa peeliŋ nyuŋ a sʋlʋ ma,
baa lɔl ba tɩtɩa nɛ,
ba bɩ jaŋ na wɩɩkala.
13Wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl a tɩgɛ Mʋab lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. 14Ama lɛɛlɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Jɩsɩŋ batori lɛ, Mʋab tɩŋŋaa dʋa arɩ ʋ nɩ-daŋ-la kala jaŋ dɛrɛ, a nagɛ pachɩŋ diiree tɩntɩŋŋaa sɩ yie dɛrɛ ŋɩɩ jɩsɩŋ batori pɛgɛ. Ba nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ nɛ jaŋ ka, ba ma paala bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ.”

Title: AZAAYA 17
Content:
Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Damasɩkʋs lɛ
1Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ a tɩgɛ Damasɩkʋs lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
“Má bee na, Damasɩkʋs kala jaŋ chei,
ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa taŋ,
ʋ jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.
2Siiria tabalaa kala jaŋ pɩŋ hoi,
a bɩrɩmɛ piesee arɩ nɛsɩŋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ arɩ dɩ-diiliŋ,
ka nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ kiriba nɩmɛ.
3Iziral tasɩ-la kala ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ golli jaŋ tel,
dɩ Damasɩkʋs ma kuoruŋ dɛrɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka Siiria tinteeŋ lɛ
jaŋ na hɛɛ-la tɩtɩa
Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩɩ na.
Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.”
4Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, Iziral tɩŋŋaa tʋla-la kala ba sɩ kɛnɛ jaŋ lɛl,
dɩ ba dʋa ma kala dɛrɛ.
5Iziral jaŋ nagɛ ba sɩ pɛrɛ mɩaa baga
a ta a bori,
ʋ jaŋ nagɛ ba sɩ kuuni mɩaa
fuonaa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rafem lɛ.
6Ama nɩaa mʋa ha jaŋ ka Iziral lɛ,
a nagɛ ba sɩ tɔrɛ olif nɛnɛɛ aŋ ka nɛnɛɛ balɩa
koo batori ha ka tɩa-la nyu-gbaŋa lɛ.
Banɛsɛ koo banɔŋ ma ka naakelee lɛ.
La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa nɛ bʋla.
7Dɩ bʋa deeŋ nɛ yie, nɩaa jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaaba teeŋ,
ba jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa
Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ teeŋ.
8Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa
hɛ vʋɩyaa korunu-la ba tɩtɩa sɩ saa lɛ,
koo aa kpaarɛ veŋ-haal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ
arɩ vʋɩyaa korunu-la ba sɩ saa aa nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ.
9Bʋa-la lɛ, ta-duoru-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ kiri nɩaa ba lɩɩ fá kagɛ, tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ yaŋ jaŋ tɔba. Lee-la kala jaŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.
10Iziral tɩmma, ma yʋ ma Laataara Wɩa wɩaa nɛ,
ʋ nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ dolie a nagɛ bʋŋ a pʋpɔma ŋɩɩ.
Ma mɩɩra chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ
dɩ ma kpʋkpaarɛ vʋɩyaa ba bʋbʋɔŋ.
11Ama dɩ tɩɩsɩ-la nɛ pɔsɔ a fɩɩlɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la tɩtɩa chʋchʋɔŋ ma sɩ chɔnsɛba ma,
ma bɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ nɛŋ kala ba lɛ.
Ma jaŋ wɩɩlɛ a na hɛɛ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.
12Tintee-daŋ nɩaa nɛ faasa ŋaa goŋ,
ba dɔmɔ nagɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ sɩɩ huuru nɛ,
goŋ-la nagɛ lɩɩ-balɩŋ nɛ.
13Nɩalɩŋ dɔmɔ nagɛ lɩɩ-balaa sɩ gulimo a vɩvɛŋ nɛ,
ama dɩ Wɩa nɛ kpɩa ba lɛ,
ba yie pɩsɛ nɛ a fá mʋ dɩ-bolii,
a nagɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ sɩ paa kʋŋkɔlʋŋ koo nɩsʋrʋŋ.
14Dɩdaanɩŋ ba jaŋ ŋaa dɩ fawʋllʋŋ faasa kɛnla.
Ama taŋ jaŋ pʋpʋl dɩ ba viire.
Wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kʋ dii la tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ,
ba time ba sɩ jaŋ laa nɛ ŋɩɩ.

Title: AZAAYA 18
Content:
Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Kus lɛ
1Wɩɩŋ puu Kus tɩŋŋaa, ba nɛ hɛ Naayɩl fuo-la niiŋ ŋɩɩ,
lee-la hɔbɔ sɩ suo.
2Ba nɛ yie tɩŋ nɩaa a leŋ ba paa lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ ba sɩ kɛŋ saŋgɛɛŋ ŋaa
a duori fuo-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Naayɩl a kɔ ŋɩɩ.
Má mɩɩra mʋ dɩa tɩndaara, ma lɩma nɛ woruŋ.
Má mɩɩra mʋ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ waa yi teeŋ,
ba yaraa ma ŋaa mʋla mʋla.
Tintee-duo-la nɩaa sɩ laa yɩrɩŋ nɩaa yuo diiniŋ lɛ,
dʋnɩa nɩaa kala sɩɩ fá,
ba tinteeŋ nɛ fuonuŋ kaa kpaa kpaa ŋɩɩ.
3Ma dʋnɩa nɩaa kala,
má jegile nɩɩ,
dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ jɔnjɔŋ je peeliŋ nyuŋ,
ma jaŋ naʋ,
dɩ ba nɛ ŋmʋʋ banyile ma,
ma jaŋ nɩɩ.
4Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
“Mɩ jaŋ hɛ mɩ dɩɩ-zɔŋ-la lɛ a ŋaa chɩm,
aŋ bibeŋ leriŋ a nagɛ wulumuŋ bʋa lɛ ŋ sɩ yie na leriŋ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ tʋl ŋɩɩ wɩɩhɛɛ siesee
koo a nagɛ baga kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ bʋa lɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa sɩ yie chɩŋ dɩ-bala ŋɩɩ.”
5A nagɛ tɩa sɩ yie fɩɩlɛ aŋ-na nɛŋ
a bɩɩ, ŋɩɩ ba mʋ tɔrɛ,
Wɩa jaŋ kɛŋ sɩa-la ba sɩ kaa bubuori tɩɩsɩŋ
a keri tɩa-la naakele-la kala sɩ nɛnɛ ta.
Kus tɩŋŋaa nɛ tɩɩ-naakele-la.
6Ba kʋsʋʋnʋŋ jaŋ ŋaa zaaraa arɩ baga kɩaa kʋdiilee.
Ba jaŋ ŋaa zaaraa kʋdiilee yibiiniŋ,
aŋ ŋaa baga kɩaa ma kʋdiilee lɩmbaŋa.
7Dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, nɩalɩŋ sɩ waa yi,
ba yaraa ŋaa mʋla mʋla, a laa yɩrɩŋ nɩaa yuo diiniŋ lɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala fɩfába,
ba tinteeŋ nɛ fuonuŋ kaa kpaa kpaa ŋɩɩ,
ba jaŋ kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ ŋaa zile pɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.
Ba jaŋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kɔ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ,
lee-la ba sɩɩ zil La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.

Title: AZAAYA 19
Content:
Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Ijipiti lɛ
1Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Ijipiti lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
La TƖƖNA to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ lɛ nɛ a faasa fá kʋkɔ Ijipiti lɛ.
Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa tɔŋŋɔɔ kala ka chel nɛ ʋ sɩpaaŋ,
ʋ nɩaa ma kala nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ.
2La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ yigi Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa hɛ dɩ ba gʋraa yuo dɔŋɔ nɛ.
Naambie jaŋ yuyuo ʋ naambie,
dɩa nɩaa jaŋ yuyuo dɔŋɔ,
tasɩ-la ma sɩ ŋaa naambiiriŋ jaŋ gʋra yuyuo dɔŋɔ,
tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa ma jaŋ sii mʋ yuyuo tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ nɩaa.
3Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala jaŋ vʋgʋmɛ,
ka dɩ mɩ leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ ma kala ba sɩ vʋʋra bil,
dɩ ba ŋaa wʋpɛɩba.
Ba jaŋ pɩɛsɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ lɛlɛɛ,
vʋgʋraa arɩ kantɔŋŋɔɔ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba pɛ ba lɛ.
4Mɩ jaŋ joŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa
hɛ kuoru-tʋɔhɛɩ tɩɩna nɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ʋ bibemba.”
La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.
5Naayɩl fuo-la lɩɩŋ jaŋ hʋ,
dɩ fuo-bʋa-la tʋɔŋ kala hɩl.
6Lɩɩ-libisi-la sɩ pɛllɛ jʋjʋʋ fuo-la jaŋ sʋsʋɔrɛ.
Lɩɩŋ jaŋ tuo Ijipiti lɛ
dɩ yasɩ-la kala sɩ chɩŋ fuo-la niiŋ sʋʋ.
7Bagɩsɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ
Naayɩl fuo-la niiŋ kɩaa kala jaŋ sʋʋ
dɩ peliŋ paa ba viiri.
8Chenfil kpʋʋraa jaŋ yel,
nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ lo gbɩamba
arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuo jomba Naayɩl fuo-la lɛ tʋɔŋ jaŋ chei dɩ ba yel.
9Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tɩɩ-pugubie-la nɛnɛɛ ba sɩ kaa ŋaa gɛnnɩŋ a yuo ŋmɛnɩŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa jaŋ vʋgʋmɛ,
nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuo gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ nandaasɩŋ jaŋ yʋɔrɛ.
10Gɛrɩpɛ-sʋaraa tʋɔbɩɩnaa jaŋ vʋgʋmɛ,
dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩma ka ba titimba ma tʋɔŋ chei.
11Taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zʋaŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ ŋaa nɩyaara nɛ.
Wʋjɩnna-la ma sɩɩ dagɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro ka dagʋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ nɛ.
Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba bʋla pɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro,
“La kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, la nɛ faa to faafaa kuorusu-la harɩŋ.”
12Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro, nɩɩ nɛ ŋ wʋjɩnna-la hɛ lɛɛlɛ?
Leŋ dɩ ba dagɩŋ wɩalɩŋ
La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bɩɩna
dɩ ʋ joŋo ŋaa Ijipiti lɛ.
13Zʋaŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ bɩrɩmɛ nɩyaara nɛ,
nɩaa nyɩsɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Memfis sɩpaalaaraa nɛ.
Ijipiti tinteeŋ sɩpaalaaraa kala
leŋe Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa yeŋŋi nɛ.
14La TƖƖNA leŋe ba bugumi nɛ
a dɩdagɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ zɔŋ,
ŋɩɩ leŋ ba sɩsɩɛrɛ wɩɩkala ba sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ,
a nagɛ nɩa sɩ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bugi a tʋɔsɛ a sɩsɩɛrɛ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ tʋɔsa tʋɔŋ.
15Nʋʋkala tuo Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala,
sɩpaalaarʋ koo harɩ-tooru,
ʋ-na cho ʋ nagɛ ɛɛ kala ma.
16Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa, ba kala jaŋ nagɛ haalaa. Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋba dɩ ba chichel, dɩ ba nɛ na La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna dɩ ʋ je ʋ nɩsɩŋ ba lɛ. 17Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa jaŋ fɩfá Juda tɩŋŋaa. Dɩ ba nɛ yɩrɛ Juda yɩrɩŋ dɩ ba kʋŋkala nɩɩ, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛŋ tɩɩna a tɩŋ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bɩɩna dɩ ʋ joŋo ŋaa ba lɛ wɩaa.
18Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, tabala-la banɔŋ sɩ hɛ Ijipiti lɛ nɩaa jaŋ bʋbʋl Iziral tɩŋŋaa wʋbʋlʋŋ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ tɩtɩŋ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ tasɩ-la dɔŋɔ aa yɩrɛ Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ taŋ.
19Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ jaŋ chɩŋ Ijipiti tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ, ka dɩ jebiiŋ ma chɩŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ bʋa niiŋ dɩ ba liliisi ʋ wɩaa. 20Kɩaa deemba jaŋ ŋaa magɩl a dɩdagɛ arɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna hɛ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ yele pɩ La TƖƖNA a tɩŋ hɛɛ-la sɩ jʋʋba wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ pɩba nʋʋ sɩ jaŋ laaba ta dɩ ba na wiese. 21La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa jɩmʋ. Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩaa jaŋ polli La TƖƖNA nyuŋ. Ba jaŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ, a ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a dɛnnʋ. Ba jaŋ hɛ niiriŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA aŋ sɛnɛ kɛŋ niiri-la tɩtɩŋ ma. 22La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ jʋʋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa, aŋ bɩra lɩɩsɛba. Ba jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ La TƖƖNA teeŋ a sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ jegile nɩɩ ba sʋla aŋ lɩɩsɛba wɩalɩŋ lɛ.
23Bʋa-la lɛ, womporuŋ jaŋ pɩŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a mʋmʋ Asiiria, dɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa arɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa mʋmʋ dɔŋɔba tasɩŋ. Ba kala jaŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ a zizil La TƖƖNA. 24Bʋa-la lɛ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ jaŋ pɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa tasɩŋ batori sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tinteeŋ nɩaa kala na La TƖƖNA pɛnɩŋ. 25La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ aŋ bʋl, “Pɛnɩŋ jaŋ hɛ mɩ nɩaa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, arɩ Asiiria tɩŋŋaa mɩ sɩ ŋaa, arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa.”

Title: AZAAYA 20
Content:
Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ
1Kuoru kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ a bibeŋ Asiiria tinteeŋ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Saagɔŋ. Jɩna kʋbala ʋ hɛ ʋ laalɩyuoroo kʋhɩaŋ ba mʋ yuo dii taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩdɔd a kɛsɛba. 2Bʋa-la lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ Amos nanʋala Azaaya. Ʋ sɩ, “Wuri tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩ-la ŋ sɩ laala, a chaarɛ nɛntɛŋŋɛ-la ma ŋ naasɩŋ lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ La TƖƖNA fa sɩ daga, aŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree arɩ naabirimee a gʋgɔllɛ.
3Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ tɩntɩnna Azaaya sɩ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree arɩ naabirimee a gɔllɛ ŋɩɩ jɩsɩ-la batori, ʋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa magɩl nɛ a dɩdagɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Kus tɩŋŋaa lɛ. 4Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Asiiria kuoro jaŋ kɛsɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Kus tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba ŋaa nɩa ba sɩ kaa tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa, a kɛŋ yarɩ-biree arɩ naabirimee a vɩvɛŋ. Hambiisiŋ arɩ nɩhɩasɩŋ kala jaŋ kɛŋ bʋbʋɔ-biree a vɩvɛŋ, dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa. 5Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa Kus lɛ, aŋ bibigisi Ijipiti lɛ, fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba, dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiba. 6Dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔŋ Mediterenia mʋga-la niiŋ jaŋ bʋl, ‘Má na wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ lɛ la sɩ joŋ la yɩɛlaa hɛ dɩ ba laala ta Asiiria kuoro nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Nɩɩ nɛ la bɩra jaŋ to a fori?’ ”

Title: AZAAYA 21
Content:
Wɩa bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Babɩlɔŋ lɛ
1Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Babɩlɔŋ tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
Dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ lɩɩ tintee nɩaa sɩ tɛrɛ tʋɔŋ
a kʋ yuoba a nagɛ pel-vinvilimiŋ
sɩ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ kʋkɔ.
2Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ chaasa ŋaa wʋlɔrʋ nɛ.
Mɩ na zɛmbɛ tɩɩna ka bɛ zɛmbɛ,
a na wʋcheere ma sɩɩ chei leriŋ.
Má bʋla pɩ Ɛlam tinteeŋ laalɩyuoroo arɩ Midiaŋ tinteeŋ laalɩyuoroo
dɩ ba sii gollo yuo Babɩlɔŋ nɩaa.
Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ hɛɛ-la kala ba sɩ joŋo hɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa lɛ dɛrɛ.
3Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ na
arɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ nɩa leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ,
hɛɛŋ jʋʋmɛ nɛ,
a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl
ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ ŋɩɩ.
4Mɩ nyuŋ kala wʋwɩɩ,
fawʋllʋŋ ma kɛmmɛ mɩ kala chichel.
Dɩdaanɩŋ ma mɩ sɩ bɩɩna ʋ jaŋ kpɩa,
ʋ nɛ mɩɩra lɔrɔ pɩmɛ.
5Wɩɩ-la mɩ fa sɩ na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ:
Mɩ na dɩ Babɩlɔŋ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ hɛ dɔŋɔ
a hɔŋ kumpuŋŋuba nyuŋ a didii kɩaa aŋ nyʋnyʋa.
Ba guu kpɩa a bʋl,
“Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ, má sii paa ma hɔɔtaalɩ-la ma sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ.”
6Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ,
“Mʋ a hɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ mʋ bibeŋ,
a na wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a kaa kʋ bʋla pɩŋ.
7Dɩ ʋ nɛ na janɩŋ torukoba
arɩ ja-laalɩŋ,
a na nɩaa dɩ ba jɩl kakusuŋ
koo bʋntaŋŋaba,
ʋ chaasa bemba woruŋ.”
8Nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ hɛ ʋ bibeŋ leriŋ ŋaa goŋ a bʋl,
“Mɩ kʋhɩaŋ, tapʋlɩɩ na-kala mɩ yie chɩŋ lee-la ŋ sɩ hɛ mɩ nɛ,
a bibeŋ leriŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala.
9Lɛɛlɛ, na nʋʋ nɛ hɔŋ toruko lɛ ja-laalɩŋ lɛrɛ kʋkɔ ŋɩɩ.
Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ toruko-la lɛ bʋl,
‘Babɩlɔŋ tele, Babɩlɔŋ tele,
ʋ vesiŋ ma kala nɛ ba ŋmoo pɩsɛ tinteeŋ.’ ”
10Mɩ nɩaa, ba pugisi ma kala nɛ arɩ ba sɩ ŋmoo mɩaa taha lɛ,
ama mɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩ
La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna
sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa teeŋ pɩma nɛ.
Wɩa bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Ɛdɔm lɛ
11Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Ɛdɔm lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
Nʋʋ nɛ yɩrɛmɛ Ɛdɔm lɛ a pɩɛsɛ,
“Nɩɩ-la sɩ pɔ a bibeŋ leriŋ,
ɛɛ nɛ taŋ jaŋ diene maga aŋ pʋl
ɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ diene magɛ?”
12Nɩɩ-la sɩ pɔ a bibeŋ leriŋ sɩ,
“Taŋ jaŋ pʋl, dɩ taŋ bɩra biri.
Dɩ ŋ nɛ ha cho dɩ ŋ pɩɛsɛmɛ,
ŋ jaŋ bɩra wuo kʋ pɩɛsɛ.”
Wɩa bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Arebia lɛ
13Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla a mʋ tɩgɛ Arebia tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
Ma-na Dedaŋ tɩŋŋaa sɩ hɛ dɔŋɔ vɩvɛŋ
a ŋmoo buguŋ Arebia tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ,
14má ŋaa lɩɩŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ
lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ sɩ kɛnɛ.
Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Tɛma lɛ,
má ŋaa kʋdiilee a pɩ nɩalɩŋ
sɩ kʋ yuorima.
15Ba fá lɩɩ laalɩŋ sɩ hoso tʋɔŋ nɛ
a kɔ dɩ ba laa ba mɩɩsɩŋ.
16Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la: “Jɩ-bala lɛ, Kɛda tɩŋŋaa babii-ballɩŋ kala jaŋ dɛrɛ a nagɛ pachɩŋ diire tɩntɩŋŋaa sɩ yie dɛrɛ ŋɩɩ jɩna pɛgɛ. 17To-yuoroo nɛ ŋaa Kɛda laalɩyuori babiibalaa, ama ba jaŋ dɛrɛ aŋ ka baŋmɛnɛ. Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa nɛ bʋla.”

Title: AZAAYA 22
Content:
Ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Jerusalɛm lɛ
1Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla tɩgɛ fuonaa-la lɛ ba sɩ yie mʋ nɩna wɩaa Wɩa teeŋ nɛ ŋ-la:
Wʋbɛɛba nɩɩ walɩmɛma lɛɛlɛ,
ma kala sii fá jɩl lusunuŋ?
2Jaŋ kala hoso nɛ a zizigili,
nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ŋɩŋaa goŋ,
ka dɔnsʋŋ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.
Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba ma jaŋ lɛ,
laalɩŋ dee bɩ ba kpʋa.
3Ma sɩpaalaaraa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a lɩɩ fá dɩ ma laa ma mɩɩsɩŋ,
ama nɩaa bɩ to-hɛŋ kala yuo aŋ kɛsɛma.
Ma nɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kɛsɛ,
ma paala suomo fɩfá nɛ dɩ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ha hɛ dɩ-bolii.
4Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Má mʋ aŋ lemmi,
dɩ mɩ chaasa yel.
Má sɩ́ mɩ bɔyɛ nyagʋ a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kpʋa wɩaa.”
5La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna lɩɩsɛ tapʋlɩɩ nɛ
nɩaa sɩ jaŋ ŋaa goŋ,
dɩ fuonaa-la lɛ ba sɩ mʋ nɩna wɩaa Wɩa teeŋ kala vʋgʋmɛ a kɛŋ fawʋllʋŋ woruŋ.
Tapʋlɩɩ-la, jeye-la sɩ golli la taŋ, ba jaŋ ŋmooba lo
ka nɩaa yiyel peelee tʋɔŋ aa chɛ dɩ nɩaa pɛ ba lɛ.
6Ɛlam tinteeŋ nɩaa nyɩgɩla nɛ
a jɩl janɩŋ arɩ janɩŋ torukoba a paa ba to-huonuŋ kʋkɔ.
Ka Kɩɩ tinteeŋ laalɩyuoroo ma kori hɔɔtaalɩ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛɛ laa bayuori hɛŋŋɛɛ.
7Janɩŋ torukoba nɛ su Juda fuonaa zɔmɔ-la kala,
ka ja-jɩllaa ma chɩŋ ma tabalaa boiŋ-baalaa lɛ.
8Kɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩɩ pɔ Juda cheye nɛ.
Tapʋlɩɩ-la, ma joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ ma laalɩyuori kɩalɩŋ
ma sɩ joŋo faa ma bayuori kɩaa dɩa lɛ.
9Ma na dɩ Devit tabal-la jebiiŋ
kɛŋ wuoloo nɛ a magɛ dɩ ba saa tɔ.
Ma lu pɩlɩŋ nɛ lɩɩŋ pɩŋ taŋ-la tʋɔŋ.
10Ŋɩɩ nɛ ma beŋ dɩ dɩɩsɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ maga dɩ ma ŋmoo lo
a chaarɛ tabɩaa,
a kaa nyɩrɛ wuolo-la sɩ hɛ jebii-la lɛ.
11Ma lu vil-balɩŋ nɛ kɛrɩsɩŋ balɩa pɛgɛ dɩ lɩɩ-la sɩ pɛllɛ
lɩɩ fuo bɩnɩɩ-la kʋʋ jʋʋ,
ama ma bɩ Wɩa nɛ sɩ bil fuo-la niiŋ to,
ma paala bɩ ʋ nɛ sɩ bɩɩnɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ faafaa kala kaa tɩŋ.
12La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna
yɩrɛma nɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la
dɩ ma ŋmoo niiŋ a yiyel
a fʋŋ ma nyusuŋ aŋ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ.
13Ama ma tʋɔŋ mɩɩra tɔrɛ nɛ,
ma jʋjʋɔsɛ a kpʋ nɛsɩŋ arɩ piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa a chɩchaŋ
aŋ nyʋnyʋa sɩnɩŋ aŋ bʋl,
“Má leŋ la dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋa kʋnyʋalaa,
bɛɛ wɩaa chie la jaŋ sʋʋ.”
14La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la mɩ nɩɩ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋbɔmʋŋ deeŋ chɛma, a kaa mʋʋ yi ma sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ.” La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.
15Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:
“Mʋ pɩɛsɛ nɩhɩaŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛbɩna,
ʋ nɩɩ beŋ kuoru dɩa-la wɩɩkala ŋɩɩ:
16Bɛɛ nɛ ŋ ŋɩŋaa daha, kʋbɛɛ nɛ pɩŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ŋ lɔsɛ
ŋ dɩ-huguŋ bʋŋ lɛ dundolo nyuŋ?”
17Bee-na La TƖƖNA kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ʋ chigiŋ a joŋo yuo ta,
ŋ-na babiibal.
18Ʋ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ gulumi a nagɛ bɔɔl,
a joŋo yuo hɛ tintee-bal lɛ.
Lee-la nɛ ŋ jaŋ sʋʋ pɩŋ
ŋ janɩŋ torukoba-la ŋ sɩ kaa ŋmoo ŋ bɔyɛ bʋbʋɔŋ.
Ŋ hɛ ŋ nɩhɩaŋ dɩa nɩaa hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ.
19La TƖƖNA jaŋ kiriŋ ŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ,
aŋ kɛnɩŋ muuri.
20La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Tapʋlɩɩ-la mɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ mɩ tntɩnnʋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛlɩakɩm, Hɩlɩkaaya nanʋala. 21Mɩ jaŋ joŋ ŋ tɩntɩnnɩ gɛrɩ-zɔŋ-la a laalʋ, a joŋ ŋ gɛrɩ-pɛlɩɛɛ-bie-la vɔbʋ aŋ joŋ dol-la ŋ fa sɩ kɛnɛ pʋ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ arɩ Juda nɩaa kala nyɩmma. 22Mɩ jaŋ joŋ Devit dɩa boribiiŋ hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ dɩa-la suri, nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa tɔ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩra kaa tɔ ma, nʋʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo kaa suri. 23Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ chɩŋ woruŋ a nagɛ ba sɩ pɛ daapɛhɛ tinteeŋ dɩ-duoŋ, dɩ ʋ nagɛ kuoru kpasa a kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ ʋ nyɩmma dɩa lɛ. 24Ɛlɩakɩm nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa wɩaa kala jaŋ sagɛ ʋ vaaŋ lɛ. Ba jaŋ sagɛ ʋ lɛ a nagɛ zalɩŋ ba sɩ yie joŋ gbaŋ-balaa, gbaŋ-biisiŋ, dasɔsʋŋ arɩ danyinsiŋ a sagɛ ʋ lɛ ŋɩɩ.” 25La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ, “Tapʋlɩɩ-la, daapɛhɛ-la ba sɩ ŋmoo pɛ dɩ-duoŋ jaŋ churi, dɩ chʋgʋsʋ-la kala sɩ sagɛ ʋ lɛ kɛrɛ tel.” La TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ bʋla.

Title: AZAAYA 23
Content:
Wɩa bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Taaya lɛ
1Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla pɩmɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Taaya lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ tʋɔŋ Taasɩs lɛ,
má ŋmuŋmoo niiŋ,
bɛɛ wɩaa Taaya kala nɛ cheye.
Ʋ dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ lere-la kala ma sɩɩ bil ma lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ
kʋŋ bɩ ka.
Duoso-la sɩ lɩɩ Saapʋrɔs tinteeŋ
kɔ nɛ ŋɩɩ.
2Ma Sɩdɔŋ bayalaa
sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ,
má kɛŋ goŋ,
lɩɩŋ dabori jʋʋraa leŋe ma dʋa nɛ.
3Ma bayalaa chol fuo-balɩŋ arɩ lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ,
ba dɩ tintee daŋ didii yɔbɔ.
Ba kɛŋ mɩaa lɩɩ Naayɩl fuo-la niiŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ a kɔ Taaya nɛ,
nɩmɛ bɩrɩmɛ yɔɔ-bal
a pɩ tinteyee nɩaa.
4Ou, Sɩdɔŋ nɩaa, hɩɩsɩŋ diima nɛ, ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ joŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ ʋ ŋaa ma dɩ-duoŋ,
mʋga-la vɩama nɛ lɛɛlɛ aŋ bʋl,
“Mɩ ha bɩ ha-lʋllɛ luoruŋ wɩɩ na,
mɩ bɩ bii lʋla aŋ ka,
mɩ ha bɩ hambolibie koo hantolibie ma dɩɛsa.”
5Dɩ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa nɛ nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ sɩ ŋaa Taaya tɩŋŋaa lɛ,
ba tʋɔŋ kala jaŋ chei.
6Má ŋmoo niiŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɔŋ mʋga niiŋ.
Má sii fá chol taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Taasɩs.
7Ma tabal-la sɩ ŋaa ta-bɩnɩɩ,
ma tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-laa?
Taŋ-la lɛ ma fa sɩ yie lɩɩsɛ nɩaa ba mʋ hɔŋ tasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ lɛ a bibemba nɛ ŋ-laa?
8Kʋbɛɛba nɛ vʋʋra joŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa Taaya lɛ,
tabal-la kuoroo sɩɩ bil kuori biisiŋ?
Ʋ bayalaa kala fa ŋaa kuori-biiriŋ nɛ,
dʋnɩa nɩaa kala zizilba.
9La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ leŋe ŋɩɩ ŋaa Taaya tabal-la lɛ,
dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ba babii-ballɩŋ dɛrɛ,
a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa lɛ,
dɩ ba nɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ zil yɩrɩŋ tuu tinteeŋ.
10Taasɩs tɩmma, má bil bagɩsɩŋ
a nagɛ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa sɩ bil bagɩsɩŋ Naayɩl fuo-la niiŋ ŋɩɩ,
bɛɛ wɩaa lee-la ma fa sɩɩ bil ma lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ cheye nɛ.
11La TƖƖNA kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ zaarɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ nyuŋ nɛ
a kɛŋ kuoru-gentisi-la kala jigisi.
Ʋ nɛ leŋe ba chei Taaya arɩ Sɩdɔŋ
ta-duoru-la ba sɩ saa jebiee
a kaa pʋpɔ ba tɩtɩa.
12Ʋ sɩ, “Má Sɩdɔŋ tɩmma,
ma tʋɔtɔrʋ-la kala ma fa sɩ kɛnɛ dɛrɛ nɛ lɛɛlɛ,
ka ŋ nɩaa nɩna hɛɛŋ.
Dɩ ma nɛ paala sii fá mʋ Saapʋrɔs ma,
ma ha bɩ jaŋ na wiese.”
13Má beŋ Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ na,
ba bɩra bɩ lee kɛnɛ.
Asiiria tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋaa taŋ-la
lɛɛlɛ bɩrɩmɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ
baga kɩaa jʋjʋʋ.
Ba nɛ golli taŋ-la chu
a saa dɩɩ-leŋee
a to ba lɛ jʋʋ yuo diiba,
aŋ giri ba jebii-duori-la ma kala
ba sɩ kaa pʋpɔ ba tɩtɩa,
ka ʋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ ŋɩɩ.
14Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ duori lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ Taasɩs lɛ, má ŋmoo niiŋ,
dɩ-duoru-la ma sɩɩ bil ma lɩɩŋ daborusuŋ kala nɛ cheye.
15Bʋa-la lɛ, ba jaŋ yʋ Taaya wɩaa jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa kuoru kʋbala mɩɩsɩŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Jɩsɩŋ deemba mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii harɩŋ, Taaya taŋ-la jaŋ nagɛ yɩɩlɩŋ deeŋ ba sɩ yɩɩ tɩgɛ hachɔrʋmʋŋ lɛ.
16“Hachɔrʋmʋŋ, nɩaa yʋ ŋ wɩaa nɛ,
joŋ cheŋ du woruŋ
a gɔllɛ tabalɩŋ tʋɔŋ
yɩɩ yɩɩlaa yʋgɛ
dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ ŋ ha hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ.”
17Dɩ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii-la nɛ bala, La TƖƖNA jaŋ bɩra leŋ dɩ Taaya mɩɩra mʋ ʋ ha-yalɩŋ lɛ, a nagɛ hachɔrʋmʋŋ sɩ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa yalla pɩpɩ tintee na-kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. 18Ama nyʋʋrɩ-la kala ba sɩ jaŋ na jaŋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA kɩaa, ba bɩ jaŋ joŋo bil. Nyʋʋrɩ-la nɛ ba jaŋ joŋo yɔɔ kʋdiilee yʋgɛ arɩ gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩma pɩpɩ La TƖƖNA.

Title: AZAAYA 24
Content:
La TƖƖNA jaŋ chei dʋnɩa
1Ma-na bibeŋ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ chei tinteeŋ kala,
a ŋmoo nɩaa kala pɩsɛ
a leŋ dɩ tinteeŋ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ a ŋaa hoi.
2Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, arɩ nʋʋkala,
yosuŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩɩ ba tɩtɩa,
haalaa arɩ ba ketiee,
nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yallɛ kɩaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɔɔ,
nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ kɩaa chɩchɩŋ nɩaa arɩ chɩŋ-diiree,
kɩaa tɩŋŋaa arɩ summoo,
ba kala lɛ nɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ ŋaa.
3Dʋnɩa kala sɛnɛ jaŋ chei
a pɩŋ hoi,
ba jaŋ tii paa ʋ kʋŋkala.
La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ.
4Tinteeŋ kala jaŋ hɩl a yɛrɛ,
dʋnɩa kala sɛnɛ jaŋ hɩl a yɛrɛ.
Nɩbala-la kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ jaŋ ŋaa nenigi tɩmma.
5Dʋnɩa nɩaa ŋaa tinteeŋ kɛŋ disiniŋ nɛ.
Ba chei La TƖƖNA wombie-la ʋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto nɛ
a vɩa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga,
aŋ ŋaa wɩaa chei nii-la fa sɩ maga ʋ hɛ ʋ dɩ ba pɛgɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.
6Ŋɩɩ leŋe La TƖƖNA ŋmɩaŋ dii tinteeŋ nɛ.
Nɩaa maga dɩ ba na hɛɛŋ nɛ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa chei wɩaa.
Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nyiniŋ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa
aŋ ka nɩaa baŋmɛnɛ.
7Tɩɩsɩ-la nɛnɛɛ ba sɩ kaa chɔ sɩnɩŋ kala hɩla nɛ ka sɩnɩŋ nyaa.
Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ yie nyʋa sɩnɩŋ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ,
lɛɛlɛ ba tʋɔŋ kala cheye nɛ.
8Ba fa sɩ yie du cheŋ
a ŋmʋʋ ŋmʋlaa,
a yɩyɩɩ tʋɔtɔrɛ yɩɩla-la kala dɛrɛ nɛ,
lɛɛlɛ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩra tuo.
9Nɩaa bɩra bɩ sɩnɩŋ nyʋa a yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa,
sɩnɩŋ bɩra bɩ sɩŋ ba teeŋ.
10Wɩaa vʋgʋma nɛ tabal-la kala lɛ,
nɩaa jʋʋ dɩɩsɩŋ aŋ tɔ ba boiŋ niiriŋ.
11Nɩaa yele su jaŋ tʋɔŋ wombiiŋ kala nɛ a chɩchɛ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ dɩ ba nyʋa.
Ba tʋɔtɔrʋŋ kala dɛrɛ nɛ.
Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ bɩra tuo tintee-la kala lɛ.
12Tabal-la pɩŋ jikpeeŋ nɛ,
ba ŋmoo ʋ boi-baalaa kala nɛ bori muno muno.
13Wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa tinteyee kala
sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ.
Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ ba sɩ tɔrɛ olif nɛnɛɛ
koo ba sɩ tɔrɛ girep nɛnɛɛ, aŋ ka kʋkuunoo.
14Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ka jaŋ chaasa ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.
Ka nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ heeli aa dagɛ La TƖƖNA ballɩŋ.
15Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ jaŋ dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA.
Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ jaŋ leŋ
La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.
16La jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala yɩɩ yɩɩlaa
a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, a bʋl,
“Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ tʋla arɩ tʋɔpʋla.”
Ama mɩ sɩ,
“Hɛɛŋ jʋʋmɛ nɛ,
mɩ yɛrɛ ta nɛ, mɩ yɛrɛ ta nɛ.
Zɛmbɛ tɩŋŋaa ka bɛ nɛ,
a bɩ leŋ.”
17Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛŋ ma dʋnɩa nɩaa kala,
buotuo-luŋoo arɩ bɛrɩsɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ foro tuu gbɛrɛma nɛ.
18Dɩ fawʋllʋŋ nɛ jʋʋ nɩɩ-la kala dɩ ʋ fɩfá dɩ ʋ laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ,
ʋ jaŋ foro tuu buotuo-luŋii-la.
Dɩ nɩɩ-la ma kala nɛ wuo nɛrɩgɛ lɩɩ buotuo-la lɛ,
ʋ jaŋ jʋʋ bɛrɛ lɛ. Wɩa-nyuŋ jaŋ suri dɩ lɩɩŋ chuchuuri,
ka dɩ tinteeŋ ma zigili.
19Tinteeŋ jaŋ yɛrɛ,
a suri pagɩɩ
a faasa zizigili.
20Tinteeŋ jaŋ begili a nagɛ nɩa sɩ bugo a gɩgɛrɛ.
Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ lɛbɩŋ sɩ chɩna peliŋ kaa viisi,
ʋ bɩ dɩ-bala wuo chɩŋ.
Dʋnɩa nɩaa wʋcheelee jaŋ leŋ dɩ dʋnɩa tel,
ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ wuo sii.
21Tapʋlɩɩ-la, La TƖƖNA jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ kɩalɩŋ kala
sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ
arɩ kuorusu-la kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.
22Ba jaŋ kiriba hɛ dɔŋɔ
a nagɛ nɩaa sɩ hɛ bɩnɩŋ dɩa tʋɔŋ.
Ba jaŋ tɔba hɛ nɩmɛ a mʋ yi bʋa-la
ba sɩ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba.
23La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna jaŋ
bibeŋ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ nɩaa arɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa kala.
Ʋ jaŋ ŋmoo chɛnɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ a hɛ pɛgɛ lɛ,
ka dɩ ʋ nɩhɩasɩŋ na ʋ tʋla.

Title: AZAAYA 25
Content:
La dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA
1Ou La TƖƖNA,
ŋ nɛ mɩ Wɩa.
Mɩ jaŋ dɛnnɩŋ a yɩrɛ ŋ yɩrɩŋ.
Ŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ,
wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ bɩɩna bil faafaa kala.
2Ŋ nɛ leŋe tabal-la pɩŋ jikpeeŋ,
tasɩ-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɩsɩŋ a golli
pɩŋ hoi nɛ.
Taduoru-la nɩwogusuŋ sɩ saa bɩra tuo,
nʋʋkala ma bɩ jaŋ wuo wasa paa saa.
3Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɩduoruŋ kala jaŋ ziliŋ,
dɩ tintee-tʋɔhɛɛ tɩŋŋaa ma kala ziliŋ.
4Summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ lee kɛnɛ yie fá kʋ yuori ŋ nɛ,
ŋ nɛ ba yie kʋ yuori,
ba wʋwalɩmaa dɛrɛ.
Dɩ pel-duo nɩɩ kɔ,
ŋ nɛ yie chu tɔba,
dɩ wɩa nɩɩ kpʋba,
ŋ nɛ yie tɔ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ ba lɛ.
Nɩbɔmɔ-la wʋŋaalaa nagɛ
pel-duoŋ sɩ luo aa yagɛ jeeŋ nɛ,
5a bɩra nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ sɩ faasa lɩŋ bagɛ-bagɛ.
Ama ŋ-na La TƖƖNA leŋe la dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ pʋgʋmɛ nɛ
a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa
sɩ yie keese tɔ wɩa-sɩɩŋ leriŋ fɩɛlɛ ŋɩɩ.
Ŋ leŋe tʋɔhɛɛ tɩŋŋaa goŋ bal-la dɛrɛ nɛ.
6Peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ nyuŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna
jaŋ yɩrɛ gbiele,
a ŋaa kʋdii-zɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nammɩɩ-zɔmʋŋ arɩ sɩŋ-la sɩ chaasa sɩŋ
a pɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala.
7Peel-la nyuŋ, La TƖƖNA jaŋ giri tʋɔ-chee-la
sɩ nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ
a keese tɔ tinteyee ta.
8La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ jaŋ giri sʋʋŋ ta a kaa mʋ wuu,
aŋ fɩɩsɛ nʋʋkala sɩlɩɩrɩŋ ta.
Hɩɩsɩ-la kala ʋ nɩaa fa sɩ die dʋnɩa lɛ, ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsʋ ta.
La TƖƖNA nɛ bʋla.
9Tapʋlɩɩ-la nʋʋkala jaŋ bʋl,
“Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ nɛ la Wɩa, ʋ nɛ la laa dii, ʋ nɛ laala ta.
La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋ-la, la laaʋ dii nɛ.
Má leŋ dɩ la tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ,
dɩ la jʋjʋɔsɛ a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ laala ta wɩaa.”
10La TƖƖNA joŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ peeliŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ,
ama Mʋab tɩŋŋaa-na ʋ jaŋ nʋɔsɛba a bil
a nagɛ ba sɩ nʋɔsɛ sekelee a ŋmʋra hɛ nɛ-bɩnɩŋ sɩ pʋa lɛ.
11Ba jaŋ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ aŋ kɛŋ ba nɩsaa jɛrɛ
a nagɛ lɩɩ-duoroo sɩ yie kɛŋ ba nɩsaa a jɛrɛ ŋɩɩ dɩ ba nɩɩ duori lɩɩŋ.
Arɩ ba wʋjɩmɩɩ-la kala,
Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba dii hɩɩsɩŋ.
12La TƖƖNA jaŋ ŋmoo ba jebii-leŋie-la kala
ba sɩ kaa pʋpɔ ba tɩtɩa lo.
Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba kala tuu tinteeŋ.

Title: AZAAYA 26
Content:
Wɩa dɛnnɩŋ yɩɩlɩŋ
1La TƖƖNA tapʋlɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ yi, Juda nɩaa jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlɩŋ deeŋ ba tinteeŋ lɛ:
La kɛŋ tabalɩŋ nɛ, ʋ dolie,
Wɩa tɩtɩa nɩɩ pɔ ʋ jebiee.
2Má suri boi-baalaa
dɩ tintee-la nɩaa sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla wuo jʋʋ.
Ba nɛ tintee-la nɩaa sɩ laa Wɩa dii.
3Ŋ-na La TƖƖNA nɛ yie joŋ fɩɛlɩŋ tɩtɩa,
a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chɩna gbɛrɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ
a joŋ ba wʋtɩtɩɩ kala a hɛ ŋ lɛ,
bɛɛ wɩaa ba laaŋ dii nɛ.
4Má laa La TƖƖNA dii a kaa mʋ wuu,
bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA nagɛ bʋŋ nɛ
a pɔla bʋa na-kala.
5Ʋ yie kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ba tɩtɩa muuri nɛ,
aŋ chei ba ta-duoruŋ ma kala
a yigi ba jebiee lo a kaa jɛrɛ.
6Nɩalɩŋ ba fa sɩ nyaga bil
arɩ summoo
ka vɛŋ taŋ-la nyuŋ nɛ a nʋɔsa bɩbal.
7Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ.
La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ,
ŋ nɛ wasɛ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa wombii-la
ʋ ŋaa mʋla mʋla.
8La TƖƖNA, laa to ŋ wombiee ŋ sɩ bile dɩ la tuto nɛ,
la yɩɛlaa kala hɛ ŋ lɛ nɛ.
La cho dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ ka yɩrɛ nɛ bʋa na-kala
a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa lɛ.
9Mɩ dɩma arɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ kala hɩɛna aa chɛŋ nɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala.
Dɩ ŋ nɛ dii tinteeŋ nɩaa sarɩya,
dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ba jɩŋ tʋɔpʋla wombiiŋ.
10Ŋ dagɛ ŋ zile nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ teeŋ nɛ,
aŋ ka ba bɩ chɛ dɩ ba to tʋɔpʋla wombiiŋ,
aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa tinteeŋ lɛ.
Ba vɩa dɩ ba liisi La TƖƖNA ballɩŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ.
11La TƖƖNA, ŋ kɛŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ je nɛ dɩ ŋ dɔgɩsɛba,
ka ba bɩ ʋ na.
Leŋ dɩ ba na ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ cho ŋ nɩaa aŋ leŋ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ dii hɩɩsɩŋ.
Leŋ dɩ nyiŋ-la ŋ sɩ joŋo bile gbɛrɛ diiba.
12La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ leŋe la hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ,
wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ wuo ŋaa,
ŋ nɛ pɛ la lɛ.
13La TƖƖNA Wɩa, nɩhɩasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma fa kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ la nyuŋ a bibenla,
ama ŋ dʋndʋŋa yɩrɩŋ nɛ la zizil.
14Nɩalɩŋ-na sʋba nɛ, ba bɩra tuo,
ba dɩnsɩŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ sii.
Ŋ dɔgɩsɛba nɛ a cheiba,
nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ ba wɩaa ka liisi.
15La TƖƖNA, ŋ kɛŋ ŋ nɩaa tinteeŋ kaa jallɛ nɛ,
ŋ kɛŋ la tinteeŋ sɛmɛ na-kala bʋa kaa jalla pɛ nɛ.
Ŋ leŋe ŋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ nɛ.
16La TƖƖNA, bʋa-la lɛ ŋ sɩ dɔgɩsɛ ŋ nɩaa,
ba na hɛɛŋ.
Ŋ sɩ lɛrɛ ba dɩgɩlɩŋ
ba kɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛ a nɛrɩgɛ munso sʋsʋlʋŋ.
17Ŋ-na La TƖƖNA ŋaa la yel nɛ woruŋ ŋ sɩpaaŋ,
a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl a na hɛɛŋ a ŋmuŋmoo niiŋ ŋɩɩ.
18La na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ a nagɛ bii nɛ laa chɛ dɩ la lʋl,
ka dɩdɛrɩŋ kala ʋ ŋaa pɛɩ.
La bɩ wuo kɛŋ laatanɩŋ a kɔ tinteeŋ,
la bɩra bɩ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala ma a pɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa.
19Ama la laa dii arɩ ŋ nɩalɩŋ
sɩ sʋba jaŋ sii a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ,
nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ bʋa tʋɔŋ jaŋ sii a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.
A nagɛ nyalɩŋ sɩ yie nyal a leŋ leriŋ fɩɛlɛ ŋɩɩ,
ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ a na fɩɛlɩŋ.
20Mɩ nɩaa, má jʋʋ faa ma dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ
a kɛŋ ma borusuŋ tɔ
aŋ gbɛrɛ mʋa dɩ Wɩa baanɩŋ fɩɛlɛ.
21Má bee na, La TƖƖNA lɩɩ ʋ dɩjʋʋlʋŋ nɛ a kʋkɔ
dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.
Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ lʋara kpʋ nɩaa wɩaa jaŋ kʋ lɩɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ,
ka tinteeŋ ma lusi nɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kpʋa a hugi.

Title: AZAAYA 27
Content:
La TƖƖNA jaŋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta
1Tapʋlɩɩ-la,
La TƖƖNA jaŋ joŋ ʋ tokobii-duo-la sɩ kɛŋ niiŋ woruŋ
a dɔgɩsɛ peribanyeŋŋu,
aŋ kpʋ kʋkpuŋkpere-la sɩ yʋga
a nagɛ dɩmɩŋ a hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ.
2Tapʋlɩɩ-la,
La TƖƖNA jaŋ bʋl ŋ-la
a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ baga-la sɩ nɛŋ woruŋ lɛ:
3“Mɩ beŋ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ,
a ŋaa lɩɩŋ hɩhɛ ʋ lɛ bʋa na-kala.
Mɩ yie pɔʋ nɛ tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala,
dɩ nʋʋ sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ joŋo ŋaa ʋ lɛ.
4Mɩ bɩra bɩ baanɩŋ na
mɩ tɩɩnɛnɛɛ baga-la nyuŋ.
Ama dɩ ʋ nɛ fa nagɛ sɔ-lugunuŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ ba walɩmɛmɛ,
mɩ jaŋ kpʋba a nyɩga ta.
5Ama dɩ mɩ nɩaa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kʋ yuorimi,
ba jaŋ wuo kɔ dɩ la bʋla hɛ dɔŋɔ.
Wʋtɩtɩɩ, má leŋ dɩ la bʋla hɛ dɔŋɔ.”
6Bʋa dɔŋ lɛ, Iziral naapoloo jaŋ tuu tinteeŋ a nagɛ tɩa,
a fɩɩlɛ a nɛŋ nɛnɛɛ a su dʋnɩa kala.
7La TƖƖNA bɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ka dɔgɩsɛ
a nagɛ ʋ sɩ yie dɔgɩsɛ
ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ŋɩɩ.
Ʋ bɩra bɩ baa kpʋ ma
a nagɛ ʋ sɩ yie kpʋ
nɩalɩŋ sɩ kpʋba ŋɩɩ.
8Dɩ La TƖƖNA nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ ʋ nɩaa,
ʋ yie kiriba hɛ tintee wogo lɛ nɛ.
Ʋ yie leŋ pel-lɩmɩŋ nɛ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kʋ ŋmooba a pɩsa hɛ tintee wogo lɛ.
9Wɩɩ-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ jaŋ ŋaa
dɩ La TƖƖNA joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala chɛba nɛ ŋ-la:
Dɩ ba nɛ ŋmoo ba vʋɩyaa korunu-la tabɩaa kala
a yɛrɛ muno muno arɩ ba sɩ bugisi chʋrʋŋ ʋ bii ŋɩɩ,
a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ veŋ-haal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩra daasɩŋ kʋŋkala hɛ nɩmɛ
arɩ ba kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ
sʋɔra sɩ sɩma korunuŋ.
10Taŋ-la ba sɩ saa kɛrɛ a golli kala pɩŋ hoi nɛ,
ba vɩa ta nɛ, ʋ nagɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ,
nɛsɩŋ didii kɩaa nɩmɛ
aŋ pɛ pɩpɩŋ nɩmɛ a gbegisi ʋ tɩɩsɩŋ pɩpaarɩŋ kala.
11Dɩ tɩɩsɩ-la naakelee nɛ hɩla a boro tel,
haalaa yie paa mʋ hɛ nyiniŋ nɛ.
Nɩaa deemba bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ,
ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa sɩ ŋaaba bɩ
ba nenige fá ŋɩɩ a bɩ ba lɛ pɛ.
12Ama bʋa deeŋ lɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɛsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋŋ kʋŋ a kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a chɩŋ Efireti fuo-la lɛ, a kaa mʋ yi Ijipiti tinteeŋ niiŋ. Ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsɛba a nagɛ ba sɩ yie chaarɛ mɩaa a lɩɩsɛ mɩɩ-biiŋ aŋ ka mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ ŋɩɩ. 13Tapʋlɩɩ-la ba jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ ba faasa ŋmʋʋ banyile. Iziral tɩmma-la ba sɩ kɛsɛ a kaa mʋ Asiiria arɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ La TƖƖNA teeŋ a dɛnnʋ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ a hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ nyuŋ.

Title: AZAAYA 28
Content:
Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ Efirem
1Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa tabalɩŋ Samarɩa,
ʋ nɛ chɩŋ fuonaa sɩmɩŋ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.
Ba sɩpaalaaraa kala ŋaa sɩ-nyʋaraa nɛ.
Ba babii-ballɩɩ-la kala nagɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa
ba sɩ kaa ŋaa kuori-nyunchuulo nɛ.
Ʋ jaŋ hɩl a yuori.
2Má bee na, La TƖƖNA kɛŋ nɩduo nɛ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ kʋkɔ ma lɛ.
Ʋ jaŋ kɔ a nagɛ duoŋ-peliŋ
koo pel-la sɩɩ chei leriŋ
koo a nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ faasa nɩnɩɩ
koo fuoŋ sɩ suo a gbu lɩlɩɩ,
a chei tintee-la kala.
3Iziral tabal-la ʋ sɩpaalaarɩ sɩ-nyʋaraa sɩ kaa ŋmoo bɔyɛ,
ba jaŋ chei ʋ kala a nʋɔsʋ bil tinteeŋ.
4Taŋ-la tʋla kala jaŋ lɛl
a nagɛ tɩɩ-fɩɩlɩŋ sɩ hɩla yuori,
ʋ jaŋ nagɛ tutogo
sɩ chɩŋ fuonaaŋ sɩ sɩma nyuŋ
a bugimo nɛŋ a bɩɩ
dɩ ba tɔrʋŋ bʋa ha bɩ yie
ka ba naʋ a guu tɔrɔ dii.
5Tapʋlɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna tɩtɩa nɛ
jaŋ nagɛ kuoru-nyunchuulo
sɩ zɔmɔ woruŋ,
a chu tɔ ʋ nɩkaana-la ba sɩ bɩ kpʋa lɛ.
6Ʋ nɛ jaŋ pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ hɔŋ
sarɩya diiree kpasa lɛ dɩma-la sɩ kɛŋ tɛŋɛ,
aŋ joŋ doluŋ ma
a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ pʋpɔ
ba taŋ boi-baalɩŋ
dɩ ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ́ kʋ jʋʋ.
7Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa
arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la ma yie nyʋa tɩɩnɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ a bugi nɛ
a gɩgɛrɛ a bɩ ba tɩtɩa jɩŋ.
Dɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la nɛ na wɩaa arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ ma,
ba bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ ka jɩŋ.
Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa ma bɩ wɩaa ka bʋl ba bʋɔsʋŋ lɛ.
8Teebʋlba-la nyuŋ ba sɩɩ dii kɩaa kala nɛ ba tʋɔsa chei,
lee bɩ ka a bɩ nyɛsɩŋ kɛnɛ.
9Ba pɩɛsɛ, “Kʋbɛɛ nɛ Azaaya chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩaa a dagɛ?
Kʋbɛɛba nɛ ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ dagɛ wɩaa bʋbʋɔsʋŋ a pa?
Ʋ bɩɩna lɛɛlɛ nɛ ba kɛrɩla yɩlɩŋ lɛɛ?
10Ʋ chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ dɩdagɛla wɩaa kʋbala kʋbala,
wɩɩ wɩɩ, daha mʋa, daha ma mʋa.”
11Azaaya bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ-na ʋ zɔmɔ,
Wɩa jaŋ kɛŋ nɩwogusuŋ wʋbʋlʋŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩ nɩaa deemba.”
12Wɩa fa bʋla pa ʋ nɩaa:
“Má na dɩ-wiesiŋ,
má leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ lɔlɔ kʋ hɔnɔ wiesi,
daha ŋaa dɩ-wiesii nɛ.”
Ama ma bɩ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ ʋ teeŋ.
13Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA jaŋ dɩdagɛma ʋ wɩaa kʋbala kʋbala.
Wɩɩ wɩɩ, daha mʋa daha ma mʋa.
Ŋɩɩ saa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma gɛrɛ a tele bolimi a jʋʋ bɛrɛ
dɩ ba kɛsɛma a nagɛ nɩaa ba sɩ kaa tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa.
14Ma nɩhɩa-yaayaa deemba sɩɩ dagɛ ma tɩtɩa a bibeŋ Jerusalɛm,
má jegile nɩɩ wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla.
15Ma bigisi ma tɩtɩa lɛ nɛ a bʋl,
“La dɩ sʋʋŋ bil niiŋ pɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ,
la dɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ ma bʋla nɩɩ dɔŋɔ.
Dɩ wʋbɔŋ nɛ kʋ jʋʋ la tinteeŋ ma,
ʋ bɩ jaŋ ŋaala wɩɩkala,
bɛɛ wɩaa la kɛŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ a pilime
tɔ la tɩtɩa nɛ dɩ ʋ laala ta.”
16Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la,
“Má bee na, mɩ joŋ tabɩɩŋ
mɩ sɩ magɩsa a jɩŋ ʋ maŋŋaa nɛ a bil Zaayɔŋ lɛ,
ʋ ŋaa je-gʋnʋŋ tabɩɩ-zɔŋ nɛ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Zaayɔŋ gentine chɩŋ kpaŋkpaŋ.
Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ laa tabɩɩ-la wɩaa dii,
hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ dii tɩɩna.
17Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ ŋaa naaderi-la ba sɩ kaa bil ʋ gentine,
aŋ ka dɩ tʋɔpʋla ma nɛ ŋaa kʋ-la sɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ tʋraa kɩɩ.”
Duoŋ-tabɩaa nɛ jaŋ yɛrɛ wʋnyɩɛrʋ-la ma sɩ joŋ ma yɩɛlaa hɛ lɛ,
ka dɩ lɩɩŋ ma pɛllɛ paa lee-la ma sɩ faa ʋ pʋpɔma.
18Ma dɩ sʋʋŋ sɩ bil nii-la pɩ dɔŋɔ bɩra bɩ jaŋ chɩŋ,
ma dɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ bʋla nɩɩ-la ma jaŋ birigi.
Dɩ wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ nɛ kɔ,
ʋ jaŋ cheima.
19Bʋa-la kala lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kɔ, ʋ jaŋ cheima,
chʋchʋɔŋ, wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala,
ʋ jaŋ tii paama.
Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmma
dɩ ma nɛ jɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ.
20Ma nagɛ nɩa kʋpɩnɩŋ sɩ bɩ duomi nɛ dɩ ʋ wuo pɩna tɩɛnɛ ʋ tɩtɩa.
Ʋ kuntuŋ ma bɩ jal arɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa tɔ ʋ tɩtɩa.
21La TƖƖNA jaŋ sii yuoma arɩ ʋ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Parazɩm lɛ.
Ʋ jaŋ sii ma lɛ arɩ ʋ fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ Gibioŋ fuonaaŋ lɛ,
dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ wuo ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ ŋaa,
wɩalɩŋ ma ha sɩ bɩ na aŋ ka.
22Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má leŋ nɩaa sieriŋ,
dɩ ŋɩɩ dee chɔrʋmɔ-la sɩ hɛ ma lɛ jaŋ faasa yuŋ.
La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna bʋla pɩmɛ ŋɩɩ
ʋ sɩ jaŋ chei tinteeŋ kala nɛ.
23Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ woruŋ,
a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl.
24Dɩ paara nɩɩ pɛrɛ ʋ baga dɩ ʋ duu kɩaa, ʋ yie pɩpɛrɛ deeŋ deeŋ nɛɛ?
Ʋ yie bugili tinteeŋ deeŋ deeŋ nɛɛ?
25Dɩ ʋ nɛ bugili baga-la dɛrɛ,
ʋ bɩ kɩaa ka duu?
Aɩ, ʋ yie joŋ jisiiŋ arɩ siee nɛ a duu,
aŋ joŋ mɛmpɛ arɩ mɩaa a duu naaderee a golli baga-la niiŋ.
26Ʋ Wɩa yie dagʋ nɛ
ʋ jɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ.
27Ʋ bɩ daa-balɩŋ nɛ kaa ŋmoo miiriŋ,
koo a joŋ hɔ-daaŋ aa ŋmoo mɩaa.
Ʋ yie joŋ daa-la sɩ maga nɛ.
28Ba yie nɔŋ mɩaa nɛ aŋ-na kaa ŋaa boroboro.
Nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ mɩaa ka ŋmoo deeŋ deeŋ.
Ʋ yie kɛŋ toruko jʋʋ nʋɔsɛ nɛ,
ama ʋ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ janɩŋ nʋɔsa bugili.
29Wɩaa deemba kala lɩɩ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ jɩŋ nɩaa chagɩlɩŋ woruŋ,
a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ teeŋ nɛ.

Title: AZAAYA 29
Content:
Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ Devit taŋ nɩaa
1Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm,
tabal-la lɛ Devit fa sɩ hɔnɔ.
Ma yie gbigbieli ma gbielee nɛ
jɩna na-kala, ma ha ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ.
2Ama arɩ ŋɩɩ kala mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ wʋlɔrʋŋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm
dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ chei dɩ ʋ ŋmoo niiŋ.
Ʋ jaŋ nagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ chalɩŋ sɩ tɔ.
3Mɩ jaŋ golli ʋ kala chu,
mɩ jaŋ saa kɛrɛ-duoruŋ
golli ʋ kala
a saa lusuŋ chol sɩaa jʋʋ yuou.
4Mɩ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ muuri,
ŋ jaŋ bʋl wɩaa
a pɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ.
